Measuring the Machine

EVALUATING GENERATIVE AI
AS PLURALIST SOCIOTECHNICAL SYSTEMS

丽贝卡·林恩·约翰逊Rebecca Lynn Johnson

文学学士、理学学士、文学硕士（研究）。B.A., B.Sc., M.A. (Res).ORCID：https://orcid.org/0000-0001-7321-0744 EthicsGenAI.comORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0001-7321-0744 EthicsGenAI.com

研究问题Research Questions

测量：Measurement:如何以体现社会技术系统中嵌入的规范假设的方式来评估生成式人工智能？How can generative AI be evaluated in ways that surface the normative assumptions embedded in sociotechnical systems?

责任：Responsibility:在价值多元化的世界中负责任地评估人工智能，使评估揭示而不是规定，这意味着什么？What does it mean to evaluate AI responsibly in a world of value pluralism, so that evaluation reveals rather than prescribes?

共建：Co-construction:生成系统以什么方式与人类和机构共同构建价值，以及评估如何使这种共同构建在经验上清晰易读？In what ways do generative systems co-construct values with humans and institutions, and how can evaluation make this co-construction empirically legible?

答案The answer我得出的结论是，如何评估生成式人工智能模型以负责任地在上下文中使用，这一观点发生了转变。评估应该是描述性的、多元化的和积极的：捕捉分布而不是单一的结论，揭示假设而不是隐藏它们，映射递归的机器-社会-人类（MaSH）循环而不是隔离输出。I arrived at is a shift in perspective of how generative AI models should be evaluated for responsible in-context use. Evaluation should be descriptive, pluralist, and enactivist: capturing distributions rather than single verdicts, revealing assumptions rather than concealing them, and mapping recursive Machine–Society–Human (MaSH) Loops rather than isolating outputs.

论文摘要THESIS ABSTRACT

在测量理论中，仪器不仅仅记录现实——它们还帮助构成观察到的东西。这同样适用于生成人工智能 (AI) 评估：基准不仅衡量，而且塑造模型的外观。植根于计算主义假设的功能主义基准将模型视为孤立的预测变量，而规范性、规定性的基准则根据系统应该是什么样子来进行评估。这两种方法都掩盖了意义和价值得以体现的社会技术动态。在多元化的世界中，此类措施可能会具体化狭隘的文化认识论并边缘化另类价值观点。In measurement theory, instruments do not simply record reality — they help constitute what is observed. The same holds for generative artificial intelligence (AI) evaluation: benchmarks do not just measure, they shape what models appear to be. Functionalist benchmarks, rooted in computationalist assumptions, treat models as isolated predictors, while normative, prescriptive benchmarks frame evaluation in terms of what systems ought to be. Both approaches obscure the sociotechnical dynamics through which meaning and values are enacted. In a pluralist world, such measures risk reifying narrow cultural epistemologies and marginalising alternative value perspectives.

本文提出了一种描述性的替代方案：负责任的评估必须将生成式人工智能视为一个多元化的社会技术系统。它开发了机器-社会-人类 (MaSH) 循环，这是一个原始框架，可追踪模型、人员和机构如何递归地共同构建意义和价值。从这个立场来看，评估不再是关于宣布模型是什么This thesis advances a descriptive alternative: responsible evaluation must treat generative AI as a pluralist sociotechnical system. It develops Machine–Society–Human (MaSH) Loops, an original framework that traces how models, people, and institutions recursively coconstruct meaning and values. From this stance, evaluation becomes less about declaring what a model应该是ought to be以及更多关于揭示它的内容and more about revealing what itis以及它如何and how it颁布enacts与用户和社会互动的价值观。values in interaction with users and society.

论文共五章，做出了三个相互关联的贡献。从概念上讲，它开发了 MaSH Loops 作为一个enactivist 框架，用于评估生成式人工智能作为递归机器-社会-人类交互。在方法论上，它引入了世界价值观基准作为一种基于世界价值观调查数据、提示集和锚定评分的分配方法。应用后，它通过两个案例展示了这些承诺：早期 GPT-3 中的价值漂移和房地产中的社会技术评估。然后，第五章通过参与现实主义深化了哲学论证，展示了为什么提示和评估是构成性干预而不是中立观察。Across five chapters, the thesis makes three linked contributions. Conceptually, it develops MaSH Loops as an enactivist framework for evaluating generative AI as recursive machine– society–human interaction. Methodologically, it introduces the World Values Benchmark as a distributional method grounded in World Values Survey data, prompt sets, and anchoraware scoring. Applied, it demonstrates these commitments through two cases: value drift in early GPT-3 and sociotechnical evaluation in real estate. Chapter 5 then deepens the philosophical argument through participatory realism, showing why prompting and evaluation are constitutive interventions rather than neutral observations.

最终，论文提出了这样的观点：生成式人工智能无法通过静态的功能主义基准进行充分评估。负责任的评估需要多元、递归的框架，使正在制定的价值观可见。通过重新概念化从分数到社会技术过程的评估，这项工作有助于人工智能治理中更具包容性、文化响应性的实践，对研究实践、政策设计和公众信任产生直接影响。Ultimately, the thesis advances the claim that generative AI cannot be evaluated adequately through static, functionalist benchmarks. Responsible evaluation requires pluralist, recursive frameworks that make visible whose values are being enacted. By reconceptualising evaluation from scores to sociotechnical processes, this work contributes to more inclusive, culturally responsive practices in AI governance, with direct implications for research practice, policy design, and public trust.

十四xiv

第四章：世界价值观基准：从元伦理角度构建人工智能评估方法论。Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark: Building an AI evaluation methodology from a meta-ethic viewpoint.

本章是我在谷歌研究院人工智能伦理部门实习一年的主要成果。该基准的发布将保留在本论文中。This chapter is the primary output from my year-long internship at Google Research in the department of AI Ethics. Publication of this benchmark will remain in this thesis.

第 5 章：语义极光：致生成人工智能的一封信。Chapter 5: Semantic Auroras: A Letter to Generative AI.

本章构成了目前正在审查的一对相关论文的基础。This chapter forms the basis of a linked pair of papers currently under review.

遍历，而不是令牌：生成人工智能中的运动、时间和评估Traversals, Not Tokens: Movement, Time, and Evaluation in Generative AI

“当前对生成式人工智能的评估将输出视为能力的稳定指标，但这忽略了行为是如何通过由提示、记忆、工具和上下文形成的路径依赖的交互而出现的。本文主张评估轨迹而不是单独的输出，引入语义摩擦和涟漪传播作为捕获阻力、敏感性和下游效应的结构。它提出了一种方法论框架，将系统视为产生轨迹的社会技术过程，其中评估的重点是行为如何随着时间的推移而展开，它如何响应扰动，以及早期行动如何影响后来的结果。”“Current evaluation of generative AI treats outputs as stable indicators of capability, but this misses how behaviour emerges through path-dependent interactions shaped by prompts, memory, tools, and context. This paper argues for evaluating trajectories rather than outputs alone, introducing semantic friction and ripple propagation as constructs to capture resistance, sensitivity, and downstream effects. It advances a methodological framework that treats systems as trajectory-producing sociotechnical processes, where evaluation focuses on how behaviour unfolds over time, how it responds to perturbation, and how early actions shape later outcomes.”

评估代理人工智能系统：机器-社会-人类循环中的治理Evaluating Agentic AI Systems: Governance in Machine-Society-Human Loops

“当前的人工智能评估依赖于静态基准和模型级测试，一旦系统作为具有内存、工具和持续工作流程的代理运行，它们就会崩溃。这些方法假设行为是稳定的且与上下文无关，错误地描述了如何通过交互形成输出。本文提出了一个基于 MaSH Loops 的关系框架，其中行为出现在模型、用户和机构之间的递归反馈中。因此，评估不仅仅是测量，而且是治理，需要随着时间的推移跟踪行为并考虑提示、工具和机制的方法。记忆作为主体系统的构建条件。”“Current AI evaluation relies on static benchmarks and model-level tests, which break down once systems operate as agents with memory, tools, and ongoing workflows. These approaches assume behaviour is stable and context-independent, mischaracterising how outputs are shaped through interaction. This paper proposes a relational framework based on MaSH Loops, where behaviour emerges across recursive feedback between models, users, and institutions. Evaluation is therefore not just measurement but governance, requiring methods that track behaviour over time and account for prompts, tools, and memory as structuring conditions of agentic systems.”

我得到了 Dean Rickles 教授、Dominic Murphy 教授、科学历史与哲学学院（悉尼大学理学院）、Kimberlee Weatherall 教授和学生生活（悉尼大学）的资助，举办了两次大型会议。这些会议被称为 ChatLLM23（约 100 名现场与会者和 100 名虚拟与会者）和 ChatRegs23（受邀参加的人工智能治理研讨会，约 40 人参加）。 ChatLLM23 是当时于 2023 年 3 月在澳大利亚举行的最大的人工智能道德会议。ChatRegs23 利用 OpenAI 的 GPT-4 的早期访问权限来协助收集和报告参与者对拟议的澳大利亚人工智能道德准则的看法。这两次会议都得到了研究生和戈登·麦克唐纳博士领导下的悉尼信息学中心（悉尼大学）工作人员的支持。I received funding from Professor Dean Rickles, Professor Dominic Murphy, The School of History and Philosophy of Science (Faculty of Science, The University of Sydney), Professor Kimberlee Weatherall, and Student Life (The University of Sydney) to run two large conferences. The conferences were called ChatLLM23 (approximately 100 in-person attendees and 100 virtual attendees) and ChatRegs23 (an invited AI governance workshop of approximately 40 people). ChatLLM23 was the largest AI Ethics conference held in Australia at the time, in March 2023. ChatRegs23 used early access to OpenAI’s GPT-4 to assist with gathering and reporting participant views on proposed Australian AI ethics guidelines. Both these conferences were supported by the work of research students and by the staff at the Sydney Informatics Hub (The University of Sydney) under Dr Gordon McDonald.

我得到了教育副校长 Pip Pattison 教授和悉尼大学研究生代表协会的资助，举办了一个名为 ConnectHDR 的研究生会议（大约有 400 名研究生和 100 名行业代表）。这是该大学历史上规模最大的全日制研究生会议，旨在将研究生与工业界联系起来。I received funding from the Deputy Vice Chancellor of Education, Professor Pip Pattison and from the Sydney University Postgraduate Representatives Association to run a graduate student conference called ConnectHDR (approximately 400 graduate students and 100 industry representatives). This was the largest recorded full-day graduate conference in the history of the University, aimed at connecting research students with industry.

十八xviii

使用生成人工智能作为研究工具USING GENERATIVE AI AS A RESEARCH TOOL

在准备这篇论文的最后阶段，我有限地使用了生成式人工智能工具，主要用于后期编辑、结构测试和关于清晰度的简短反馈。这些工具不用于生成研究设计、核心论点、分析或证据主张。所有实质性判断、解释和最终措辞都是我自己的。如果与生成人工智能的交互对章节的方法或权利要求范围产生重大影响，则该使用会在相关章节级模型卡中公开。所有内容的最终责任由我承担。I made limited use of generative AI tools during the final stages of preparing this thesis, primarily for late-stage editing, structural testing, and brief feedback on clarity. These tools were not used to generate the research design, core arguments, analysis, or evidentiary claims. All substantive judgements, interpretations, and final wording are my own. Where interaction with generative AI materially affects a chapter’s method or scope of claims, that use is disclosed in the relevant chapter-level model card. Final responsibility for all content remains with me.

十九xix

抓住老虎的尾巴Catching the Tiger’s Tail

“我们必须记住，我们观察到的不是自然本身，而是暴露在我们提问方法下的自然”"We have to remember that what we observe is not nature herself, but nature exposed to our method of questioning”

维尔纳·海森堡，物理学与哲学（1958）[167]Werner Heisenberg, Physics and Philosophy (1958) [167]

序言：Prologue:抓住老虎的尾巴Catching the Tiger’s Tail

1

简介：抓住老虎的尾巴INTRODUCTION: CATCHING THE TIGER’S TAIL

在生成式人工智能和人工智能哲学的交叉流中，本文提出了在湍流和速度中抓住老虎尾巴意味着什么的问题[1]。它通过借鉴一系列广泛的传统来做到这一点：心灵哲学、测量理论、伦理学、控制论、认知科学、量子力学、参与现实主义、社会技术系统理论、社会学和道德价值多元化。这些不是分散的装饰品，而是精心挑选的工具，每一个工具的引入都是为了阐明技术的特定方面。人工智能哲学并不新鲜，但它与生成人工智能的接触仍然相对不够巩固；定义尚未确定，框架存在争议，方法仍在不断变化。At the cross-currents of Generative AI and the Philosophy of AI, this thesis asks what it means to grasp the tiger’s tail amid turbulence and speed[1] . It does so by drawing on a deliberately wide set of traditions: philosophy of mind, measurement theory, ethics, cybernetics, cognitive science, quantum mechanics, participatory realism, sociotechnical systems theory, sociology, and moral value pluralism. These are not scattered ornaments, but carefully chosen tools, each brought in to clarify specific aspects of a technology. Philosophy of AI is not new, but its engagement with generative AI remains comparatively under-consolidated; definitions are unsettled, frameworks are contested, and methods are still in flux.

该领域的发展步伐加剧了这些紧张局势。现在，对道德和负责任的生成人工智能的研究超出了任何一位学者的密切关注能力。大公司发布的文件通常会突出能力主张，简单地对待道德规范，并且在未经外部审查的情况下传播。与此同时，缓慢的同行评审使得预印本和 arXiv 草案在想法得到适当测试之前就引发了争论。在这种情况下，哲学的清晰性和方法论的严谨性并不是奢侈品，而是一种奢望。它们是保障措施。The pace of the field compounds these tensions. Research on ethical and responsible generative AI now outstrips any one scholar’s ability to follow it closely. Release papers from major firms often foreground capability claims, treat ethics briefly, and circulate without external review. At the same time, slow peer review leaves preprints and arXiv drafts shaping debate before ideas are properly tested. In such conditions, philosophical clarity and methodological rigour are not luxuries; they are safeguards.

本论文提出了当系统本身具有概率性、社会嵌入性和价值负载时，应该如何评估生成式人工智能。我认为评估不应将模型单独视为孤立的预测因素。相反，它应该让人们看到价值观是如何在递归机器、社会和人际关系中体现的。在此基础上，我开发了 MaSH Loops 和世界价值基准 (WVB)，这是一种描述性方法，可将模型价值概况与社会科学基线进行比较，同时控制即时敏感性和锚定偏差。 MaSH 循环与一般的社会技术映射不同，它将评估本身视为跨机器、机构和人类反馈的价值制定的递归站点。通过两个案例研究（早期的 GPT-3 和房地产领域的人工智能），我展示了评估选择如何塑造清晰的模型行为。This thesis asks how generative AI should be evaluated when the systems themselves are probabilistic, socially embedded, and value-laden. I argue that evaluation should not treat models as isolated predictors alone. Instead, it should make visible how values are enacted across recursive machine, society, and human relations. On that basis, I develop MaSH Loops and the World Values Benchmark (WVB), a descriptive method that compares model value profiles with social-science baselines while controlling for prompt sensitivity and anchor bias. MaSH Loops differ from generic sociotechnical mapping by treating evaluation itself as a recursive site of value enactment across machine, institutional, and human feedback. Through two case studies, early GPT-3 and AI in real estate, I show how evaluation choices shape what becomes legible as model behaviour.

该项目始于一个简单的担忧：强大的系统正在快速到来，而道德护栏看起来很薄弱。类似布奥拉姆维尼的故事The project began with a simple concern: powerful systems were arriving fast, and the ethical guardrails looked thin. Stories like Buolamwini’s性别差异Gender Shades[59] 和其他关于已部署系统中的偏差的早期研究 [291, 354, 403] 清楚地表明，测量失败可能会转化为真正的危害。我不仅想了解价值观如何进入系统，还想了解我们如何衡量这些运动，而不将多元观点分解为单一的规范分数。[59] and other early work on bias [291, 354, 403] in deployed systems made clear that measurement failures could translate into real harm. I wanted to understand not only how values enter systems, but how we might measure those movements without collapsing plural perspectives into a single normative score.

1 在缅甸传统中，“抓住老虎尾巴”意味着陷入危险：你无法安全地放手，但抓住它却很危险。我在这里用它来描述人工智能与生成人工智能的互动哲学：不可避免的、不稳定的，而且危险既存在于我们的测量方法中，也存在于系统本身中。1 From Burmese tradition, “grasping the tiger’s tail” means being trapped in danger: you cannot let go safely, yet holding on is perilous. I use it here to describe the Philosophy of AI’s engagement with Generative AI: unavoidable, precarious, and where the danger lies as much in our methods of measurement as in the systems themselves.

序言：Prologue:抓住老虎的尾巴Catching the Tiger’s Tail

3

这种追求塑造了我的研究之旅。 2021 年初，我为访问 GPT-3 奋斗了数月，终于在 5 月 25 日获得了“绿灯”。我们与一小群博士生一起开始探索性测试，揭示文化价值漂移；为第二章奠定了基础的工作。同时，我创立了That pursuit shaped my research journey. In early 2021, I fought for months for access to GPT-3, finally receiving the “green light” on 25 May. With a small group of PhD peers, we began exploratory tests that revealed cultural value drift; work that seeded Chapter 2. In parallel, I founded the人工智能伦理学博士生PhD Students in AI Ethics该网络迅速发展成为一个由 400 多名研究人员组成的国际社区。它强化了这样一种感觉：我们都在紧迫且不明确的领域工作。network, which quickly grew into an international community of more than 400 researchers. It reinforced the sense that we were all working in terrain that was both urgent and under-defined.

从 2021 年到 2022 年，在 Google Research 道德人工智能团队为期一年的实习改变了我的注意力。对话应用语言模型 (LaMDA) 和路径语言模型 (PaLM) 等模型的内部访问提出了一个更深层次的问题：不是模型可以做什么，而是我们的测量选择使它们看起来做什么。我像数字考古学家一样阅读每一篇法学硕士论文，仔细研究附录以挖掘隐藏的假设：代理任务、脆弱的有效性声明、缺失的上下文。本论文记录了这种挖掘：不仅试图抓住模型本身的老虎尾巴，而且试图抓住模型本身的评估实践。From 2021 to 2022, a year-long internship at Google Research in the Ethical AI team shifted my focus. Insider access to models such as Language Model for Dialogue Applications (LaMDA) and Pathways Language Model (PaLM) raised a deeper question: not what models can do, but what our measurement choices make them appear to do. I read every LLM release paper like a digital archaeologist, poring over appendices to excavate hidden assumptions: proxy tasks, fragile validity claims, missing contexts. This thesis records that excavation: the attempt to catch the tiger’s tail not only of the models themselves, but of the evaluative practices racing to contain them.

2020 年至 2025 年间，地面不断变化。模型从闭门 API 转向大规模公众采用。基准激增，通常被视为权威排行榜，即使它们的构造需要深入审查。媒体话语放大了一些人工智能派别推动的存在风险叙事和近乎意识的炒作，而直接社会技术影响和测量有效性的问题往往难以获得氧气。这些争论反复回到一个问题：为什么一些开发人员看到了物种层面的威胁，而许多人工智能伦理学家却持不同观点？Between 2020 and 2025, the ground kept moving. Models shifted from closed-door APIs to mass public adoption. Benchmarks proliferated, often treated as definitive leaderboards, even when their constructs needed deep scrutiny. Media discourse amplified existential-risk narratives and near-consciousness hype promoted by some AI factions, while questions of immediate sociotechnical impact and measurement validity often struggled for oxygen. Those debates repeatedly returned to one question: why did some developers see species-level threats while many AI ethicists took a different view?

我得出的答案是评估视角的转变。评估应该是描述性的、多元的和积极的：它应该捕获分布而不是单一的结论，揭示假设而不是隐藏假设，映射递归 MaSH 循环而不是隔离输出。人工智能辩论的认识论冲突不仅与风险本身有关，而且与风险本身有关The answer I arrived at is a shift in evaluative perspective. Evaluation should be descriptive, pluralist, and enactivist: it should capture distributions rather than single verdicts, reveal assumptions rather than conceal them, and map recursive MaSH Loops rather than isolate outputs. The epistemological conflicts of the AI debates were not just about risk itself but about如何衡量风险how risk was being measured。许多受过工程和计算机科学功能主义传统训练的人倾向于将计算主义作为一种心灵哲学，引导他们通过功能主义假设来解释机器行为。本文认为，这样的假设不是中立的：它们是嵌入在我们的测量工具中的设计选择。. Many trained in functionalist traditions of engineering and computer science gravitated toward computationalism as a philosophy of mind, leading them to interpret machine behaviour through functionalist assumptions. This thesis argues that such assumptions are not neutral: they are design choices embedded in our instruments of measurement.

贡献和目标CONTRIBUTIONS AND AIMS

这项研究的中心目的是了解生成系统及其内在价值，并展示评估如何使这些价值清晰易读。本论文做出了三个相互关联的贡献：The central aim of this research is to understand generative systems and their embedded values, and to show how evaluation can make those values legible. This thesis makes three linked contributions:

  1. 概念性的Conceptual：它将 MaSH Loops 开发为一个激活主义评估框架，通过将分析单元从孤立的输出转移到递归机器、社会和人类交互，超越但不放弃功能主义和建构主义分析。: It develops MaSH Loops as an enactivist evaluation framework that moves beyond, without discarding, functionalist and constructivist analysis by shifting the unit of analysis from isolated outputs to recursive machine, society, and human interaction.

序言：Prologue:抓住老虎的尾巴Catching the Tiger’s Tail

4

  1. 方法论Methodological：它引入了世界价值观基准（WVB），这是一种基于社会科学实践的分布式评估方法，使用平衡锚、提示集和基于可能性的评分来比较价值概况而不是单一答案。: It introduces the World Values Benchmark (WVB), a distributional evaluation method grounded in social-science practice, using balanced anchors, prompt sets, and likelihood-based scoring to compare value profiles rather than single answers.

  2. 应用Applied：它通过两个领域案例在实践中展示了这些评估性承诺：早期 GPT-3 中价值漂移的历史研究和人工智能在房地产中的应用社会技术分析。: It demonstrates these evaluative commitments in practice through two domain cases: a historical study of value drift in early GPT-3 and an applied sociotechnical analysis of AI in real estate.

总而言之，这些章节认为，负责任的评估应该使价值假设变得可见，而不是将其扁平化为单一规范。然后，尾声引出了更大的含义：测量有助于确定哪些值变得清晰、可信和稳定。Taken together, these chapters argue that responsible evaluation should make value assumptions visible rather than flatten them into a single norm. The Coda then draws out the larger implication: measurement helps determine which values become legible, credible, and stabilised.

研究问题RESEARCH QUESTIONS

  1. 测量：Measurement:如何以体现社会技术系统中嵌入的规范假设的方式来评估生成式人工智能？How can generative AI be evaluated in ways that surface the normative assumptions embedded in sociotechnical systems?

  2. 责任：Responsibility:在价值多元化的世界中负责任地评估人工智能，使评估揭示而不是规定，这意味着什么？What does it mean to evaluate AI responsibly in a world of value pluralism, so that evaluation reveals rather than prescribes?

  3. 共建：Co-construction:生成系统以什么方式与人类和机构共同构建价值，以及评估如何使这种共同构建在经验上清晰易读？In what ways do generative systems co-construct values with humans and institutions, and how can evaluation make this co-construction empirically legible?

意义SIGNIFICANCE

这个论点有三个主要含义：This argument has three main implications:

哲学的。Philosophical.它认为计算主义和建构主义本身不足以指导评估，从而为生成人工智能的哲学工作做出了贡献。生成主义的社会技术解释提供了一种不同的框架，它也与量子力学哲学中的工作产生共鸣，在量子力学中，观察被理解为干预而不是被动记录。这很重要，因为生成人工智能的哲学工作仍然悬而未决：定义存在争议，概念基础仍在制定中。将评估视为一个哲学问题有助于澄清这场辩论的术语。It contributes to philosophical work on generative AI by arguing that computationalism and constructivism alone do not adequately guide evaluation. An enactivist, sociotechnical account offers a different frame, one that also resonates with work in the philosophy of quantum mechanics, where observation is understood as intervention rather than passive registration. This matters because philosophical work on generative AI remains unsettled: definitions are contested, and conceptual foundations are still being worked out. Foregrounding evaluation as a philosophical problem helps clarify the terms of that debate.

方法论。Methodological.它开发并展示了超越狭隘、规定性基准的评估方法。通过使规范性假设在经验上可见，分布和描述性方法使评估向多元化和争议开放。对于治理而言，其含义很简单：夸大一致性或扁平化多样性的指标可能会放大主导规范，而不是揭示正在发挥作用的价值观。It develops and demonstrates evaluation approaches that move beyond narrow, prescriptive benchmarks. By making normative assumptions empirically visible, distributional and descriptive methods open evaluation to pluralism and contestation. For governance, the implication is straightforward: metrics that overstate alignment or flatten diversity risk amplifying dominant norms rather than revealing the values at play.

序言：Prologue:抓住老虎的尾巴Catching the Tiger’s Tail

5

概念性的。Conceptual.它表明评估不是一种中立行为，而是一种配置人工智能如何出现及其治理如何展开的实践It shows that evaluation is not a neutral act but a practice that configures how AI appears and how its governance unfolds.这一框架还利用量子力学和参与现实主义来论证意义是被制定的而不是简单地给出的，并且测量有助于塑造清晰的内容。This framing also draws on quantum mechanics and participatory realism to argue that meaning is enacted rather than simply given, and that measurement helps shape what becomes legible.

总而言之，这些贡献将评估建立为能力、治理和公众信任汇聚的中心场所；哲学的清晰性、方法论的严谨性和概念创新必须共同发挥作用。Taken together, these contributions establish evaluation as a central site where capability, governance, and public trust converge; and where philosophical clarity, methodological rigour, and conceptual innovation must work together.

挑战CHALLENGES

这项工作是在一个既受限制又受机遇限制的环境中进行的。对前沿模型的访问一直参差不齐：一些系统仅短暂可用，其他系统现已被弃用，还有一些系统仍被锁定在研究大门之外。发展的速度非常快，新模型的出现速度快于严格的评估所能跟上的速度，使得每项研究都是临时的。训练数据和架构的保密性使这些问题变得更加复杂，使得很难将模型固有的属性与隐藏语料库或设计选择的人工制品区分开来。与此同时，该领域本身的扩张速度远远超过了同行评审的缓慢周期，使得预印本和猜测主导了公众辩论。这些条件不是偶然的，而是评估必须在其中进行的地形的组成部分。本文的目的不是克服它们，而是公开承认它们，并设计即使在我们脚下的地面继续变化的情况下也能保持稳健、透明和多元化的方法。This work has been carried out in a landscape defined as much by constraint as by opportunity. Access to frontier models has been uneven: some systems were available only briefly, others are now deprecated, and several remain locked behind research gates. The pace of development has been extreme, with new models arriving faster than rigorous evaluation can keep up, making every study provisional. Secrecy around training data and architectures compounds these issues, making it difficult to distinguish properties intrinsic to models from artefacts of hidden corpora or design choices. At the same time, the field itself has expanded at a velocity that far outstrips the slow cycle of peer review, leaving preprints and speculation to dominate public debate. These conditions are not incidental but constitutive of the terrain in which evaluation must operate. The aim of this thesis is not to overcome them but to acknowledge them openly and to design methods that remain robust, transparent, and pluralist even as the ground continues to shift beneath our feet.

学术研究本身也面临着挑战，尤其是当它跨越多个学科时。关于哲学、伦理学、认知科学、控制论和人工智能的文献数量巨大，任何一篇论文都无法在不失去重点的情况下引用每一位贡献者。跨学科性加剧了困难：过于深入任何一种传统都有可能缩小框架，而对所有传统进行调查则有可能缩小细微差别。对于要包含的内容的选择必然是有选择性的，而且通常必须以牺牲深度来换取连贯性。这里的任务是将不同的线索编织成一种仍然可理解的模式，即使某些观点被留在边缘——不是因为忽视，而是因为范围的实际限制。清晰度要求决定要放大哪些声音，而连贯性则要求让其他声音保持含蓄。这不是一张包含一切的地图，而是一条穿越争议地形的思路。Academic research itself carries its own challenges, especially when it spans multiple disciplines. The literatures on philosophy, ethics, cognitive science, cybernetics, and AI are vast, and no thesis can cite every contributor without losing focus. Interdisciplinarity sharpens the difficulty: to go too deep into any one tradition risks narrowing the frame, while to survey them all risks flattening nuance. Choices about what to include are necessarily selective, and depth must often be traded for coherence. The task here has been to weave diverse strands into a pattern that remains intelligible, even if some perspectives are left at the margins—not from neglect but from the practical limits of scope. Clarity requires deciding which voices to amplify, and coherence requires letting others remain implicit. This is not a map of everything, but a line of thought through contested terrain.

正如 Dignum 等人[108]所言，太多的跨学科人工智能工作仍然起到“桥梁建设”的作用：工程师进行建设，而伦理学家和社会科学家随后进行批评，从而使认识论上的差距完好无损。相反，他们呼吁一种“竞争-对抗”的跨学科性，这种跨学科性质疑和重塑学科假设，而不是巩固它们。这与我自己的经验产生了共鸣：负责任地研究生成人工智能不仅需要将方法拼接在一起，还需要重新思考评估的工具和假设。As Dignum et al., [108] argue, too much interdisciplinary AI work still functions as “bridge-building”: engineers build, while ethicists and social scientists are brought in afterward to critique, leaving epistemological gaps intact. They call instead for an “agonistic–antagonistic” interdisciplinarity, one that contests and reshapes disciplinary assumptions rather than cementing them. This resonates with my own experience: to study generative AI responsibly requires not just stitching together methods but rethinking the very instruments and assumptions of evaluation.

序言：Prologue:抓住老虎的尾巴Catching the Tiger’s Tail

6

除了哲学家之外，这个不稳定的空间也吸引了计算机科学家和工程师，他们热切地转向哲学，尽管有时没有深入研究哲学。他们的贡献很有价值，但有时会产生拼凑的弗兰肯式人工智能哲学：没有背景的概念借用、社会技术理论的误用，或者伦理类别被扁平化为工程清单。这些举措可能会扭曲它们所借鉴的传统，模糊而不是澄清生成系统的本质。Alongside philosophers, this unsettled space has attracted computer scientists and engineers who turn eagerly to philosophy, though at times without engaging its depth. Their contributions are valuable but sometimes produce a patchwork Franken-philosophy of AI: conceptual borrowing without context, sociotechnical theories misapplied, or ethical categories flattened into engineering checklists. Such moves risk distorting the very traditions they draw from, obscuring rather than clarifying the nature of generative systems.

在这个领域工作需要不断的语码转换。对于哲学家来说，技术变革的速度和不透明性可能会让人感觉像是一条护城河。我的部分职责是降低吊桥，使模型、数据和评估细节清晰易读，无需使用行话。与工程师一起，我被要求展示为什么揭示规范假设和应用哲学测量理论很重要。我与政策制定者一起将多元论点转化为实用且负责任的治理建议。这些转变绝非易事，而且纪律孤岛往往会巩固。 2022 年至 2023 年的人工智能伦理和安全辩论生动地证明了这一点，因为各派系围绕存在风险或社会技术危害团结一致，几乎没有留下跨范式对话的空间。Working in this space requires constant code-switching. With philosophers, the pace and opacity of technical change can feel like a moat; part of my role is to lower the drawbridge, making models, data, and evaluation details legible without jargon. With engineers, I’m asked to show why uncovering normative assumptions and applying philosophical measurement theory matter. With policymakers, I translate pluralist arguments into practical and accountable governance recommendations. These shifts are rarely easy, and disciplinary silos often solidify. The AI ethics and safety debates of 2022– 2023 demonstrated this vividly, as factions closed ranks around existential risk or sociotechnical harm, leaving little space for dialogue across paradigms.

跨学科需要谦逊：工程师认识到人文学科的深度和严谨性，哲学家尊重技术工作的实际限制。只有相互尊重每个领域的专业知识，我们才能避免肤浅的借用，并开始更加努力地构建共享的、反思性的工具来理解人工智能。Interdisciplinarity requires humility: engineers recognising the depth and rigour of the humanities, and philosophers respecting the practical constraints of technical work. Only with mutual respect for each field’s expertise can we avoid superficial borrowing and begin the harder work of building shared, reflexive instruments for understanding AI.

论文路线图THESIS ROADMAP

第一章，认识论的隆隆声Chapter 1, Epistemological Rumbles

本章说明了为什么理解法学硕士的功能主义方法（即计算主义）和建构主义批评总是互相推诿。本章还提出了评估协议的enactivist替代方案（MaSH）。第一章源于 2023 年的“人工智能 Twitter 战争”，其中的争论在存在风险和直接社会技术危害之间摇摆。我卷入了这些争论，经常为哲学的作用辩护，反对哲学应该被排除在计算机科学培训之外的说法。This chapter shows why functionalist approaches to understanding LLMs (i.e. computationalism) and constructivist critique keep talking past each other. The chapter also proposes an enactivist alternative (MaSH) for evaluation protocols. Chapter 1 grew out of the “AI Twitter wars” of 2023, where debates swung between existential risk and immediate sociotechnical harms. I was drawn into those disputes, often defending the role of philosophy against claims it should be excluded from computer science training.

这种深入的参与导致我们受邀为人工智能道德手册做出贡献。在准备我的贡献时，我不断地回到我在采访、小组讨论和会议中反复被问到的一个问题：为什么像“人工智能教父”这样的人物在法学硕士中看到了前意识的火花，而其他人，包括我自己，却没有看到？在这些对立叙事的喧嚣之下，我开始看到认识论的冲突：一方面是功能主义和计算主义，另一方面是建构主义。我意识到，缺失的桥梁是行动主义。这种洞察力成为我选择以认识论地图作为论文开头的原因。That deep engagement led to an invitation to contribute to an AI Ethics handbook. In preparing my contribution, I kept returning to a question I was asked repeatedly in interviews, panels, and conferences: why did figures such as the “Godfather of AI” see sparks of pre-consciousness in LLMs when others, including myself, did not? Beneath the noise of these opposing narratives, I came to see a clash of epistemologies: functionalism and computationalism on one side, constructivism on the other. The missing bridge, I realised, was enactivism. That insight became the reason I chose to open the thesis with an epistemological map.

第2章 机器里的幽灵有美国口音Chapter 2, The Ghost in the Machine Has an American Accent

本章是早期 GPT-3 中价值漂移的历史快照（2021 年），使用带有文化色彩的输入来表达规范“口音”并激励分配评估。这是问题首先显现出来的地方。第 2 章从 2021 年提前访问 GPT-3 开始。通过我在 2020 年创建的网络，与跨国家/地区和语言的合作者合作（This chapter is an historical snapshot (2021) of value drift in early GPT-3, using culturally charged inputs to surface normative “accents” and motivate distributional evaluation. This is where the problem first showed itself. Chapter 2 began with early access to GPT-3 in 2021. With collaborators across countries and languages, through a network I founded in 2020 (人工智能伦理学博士生PhD Students in AI Ethics）我们观察到价值漂移：输出以令人惊讶的规范方向重新构建输入。我们的预印本被广泛引用，但认识更深刻：记录早期的、未对齐的模型很重要，因为后来的微调可以掩盖它们的规范印记。本章保留了这段历史，同时将其与更广泛的主题联系起来。) we observed value drift: outputs that reframed inputs in surprising normative directions. Our preprint became widely cited, but the realisation was deeper: documenting early, unaligned models matter, because later fine-tuning can mask their normative imprints. This chapter preserves that history while connecting it to the broader thesis.

人工智能房地产的应用翻译。尽管本章并不局限于法学硕士，但这是经过深思熟虑的：它表明论文的核心评估主张也适用于其他人工智能系统，这些系统的代理、输出和反馈循环塑造了市场和社会结果。社会技术映射使反馈循环和权力可见；关于代理和指标的选择An applied translation in AI-Real Estate. Initially a side project, it became a chance to apply complex Responsible AI debates to a domain that touches almost everyone. 第 4 章，世界价值观基准Chapter 4, The World Values Benchmark

方法论核心。 WVB 实施了调查构建、实施了负责任的提示设计 (RPD) 和偏差纠正，并证明纠正提示和锚点人工制品会实质性地改变结论。第 4 章源于我在 Google Research 的实习（2021-22）。在那里，我像数字考古学家一样阅读法学硕士论文，发现脆弱的有效性主张和脆弱的代理基准。通过早期接触 LaMDA 和 PaLM，我亲眼目睹了模型变化的速度有多快，以及评估的跟上速度有多差。其结果是 WVB：一种方法框架，将评估从规定性分数转变为描述性、可争议的概况。它列出了支持论文方法论主张的基准设计、验证逻辑和结果。The methodological core. The WVB operationalises survey constructs, implements Responsible Prompt Design (RPD) and bias correction, and demonstrates that correcting prompt and anchor artefacts materially changes conclusions. Chapter 4 grew from my internship at Google Research (2021–22). There, I read LLM release papers like a digital archaeologist, uncovering fragile validity claims and brittle proxy-laden benchmarks. With early access to LaMDA and PaLM, I saw firsthand how quickly models changed, and how poorly evaluation kept pace. The result is the WVB: a methodological framework that moves evaluation from prescriptive scores to descriptive, contestable profiles. It sets out the benchmark design, validation logic, and results that support the thesis’s methodological claims.

反思性综合。它将生成主义与参与现实主义联系起来，解释了为什么测量在生成人工智能中创造了世界；以及为什么我们的仪器必须进行相应的设计。在这里，我回到了更大的图景，将行动主义、参与现实主义和语义超空间的线索结合在一起。本章采用反思性的方式，将论文的哲学线索集中在行动主义、参与性等方面。A reflective synthesis. It connects enactivism to participatory realism to explain why measurement makes worlds in generative AI; and why our instruments must be designed accordingly. Here I returned to the bigger picture, drawing together threads of enactivism, participatory realism, and semantic hyperspaces. The chapter adopts a reflective register and draws together the thesis’s philosophical threads around enactivism, participatory

现实性和评价。它以我希望在我的研究生涯中发扬光大的想法结束了这篇论文。realism, and evaluation. It closes the thesis with the ideas I hope to carry forward in my research career.

Coda：衡量我们制定的内容Coda: Measuring What We Enact

Coda 通过表明评估不是一项副业活动而是决定如何理解和管理模型的核心实践来总结该论文。它巩固了论文的概念、方法和应用贡献，强调未来的工作必须保持评估假设在不同背景下可见。核心信息很简单：我们选择衡量的内容决定了人工智能在实践中的表现。The Coda concludes the thesis by showing that evaluation is not a side activity but a central practice that shapes how models are understood and governed. It consolidates the thesis’s conceptual, methodological, and applied contributions, stressing that future work must keep evaluative assumptions visible across contexts. The core message is straightforward: what we choose to measure determines what AI becomes in practice.

本论文保留了早期系统的痕迹，并开发了评估后续系统的方法。它的论点是，评估是理解和管理生成人工智能的一部分，更好的工具可以使制定的价值更容易被看到。This thesis preserves traces of early systems and develops methods for evaluating those that followed. Its argument is that evaluation is part of how generative AI is understood and governed, and that better instruments can make enacted values easier to see.

关键概念KEY CONCEPTS

此处简要定义这些概念以供指导。更全面的发展出现在他们做实质性工作的章节中。These concepts are defined briefly here for orientation. Fuller development appears in the chapters where they do substantive work.

基准测试：Benchmarking:通常在标准化条件下根据固定数据集、任务或指标评估系统性能的做法，以便能够跨模型进行比较。基准通常通过简化的代理来操作复杂的功能，并将性能视为稳定的、与上下文无关的属性。在本论文中，基准测试被视为评估的一个有用但有限的子集，它可能会掩盖提示、背景和社会技术条件如何塑造行为。the practice of assessing system performance against a fixed dataset, task, or metric, often under standardised conditions to enable comparison across models. Benchmarks typically operationalise complex capabilities through simplified proxies and treat performance as a stable, context-independent property. In this thesis, benchmarking is treated as a useful but limited subset of evaluation, one that risks obscuring how behaviour is shaped by prompts, contexts, and sociotechnical conditions.

建构主义（社会建构主义）：Constructivism (social constructivism):知识和价值观不是被发现的，而是通过社会、文化和历史背景建立的。在人工智能中，这与科学哲学和技术哲学的传统相一致，强调系统如何由人类实践、规范和制度塑造。在这篇论文中，建构主义有助于解释为什么人工智能系统无法在生产和使用它们的社会世界之外被理解。knowledge and values are not discovered but built through social, cultural, and historical contexts. In AI, this aligns with traditions in philosophy of science and philosophy of technology that emphasise how systems are shaped by human practices, norms, and institutions. In this thesis, constructivism helps explain why AI systems cannot be understood outside the social worlds that produce and use them.

控制论（循环学习）Cybernetics (loop learning)：研究动物、人类和机器系统中的反馈、控制、通信和适应。其核心观点是系统不只是行动，而是行动。他们根据自己行为的影响进行调整。在本论文中，控制论提供了将生成人工智能理解为递归而非静态的系统词汇。单环校正可在固定目标内调整行为。双环反思质疑该目标背后的假设、任务框架或奖励结构。三环反思首先考察了更广泛的社会和制度价值观，正是这些价值观使这些目标显得自然。在本论文中，控制论为 MaSH Loops 奠定了基础，并支持评估是其研究系统的一部分的主张。: the study of feedback, control, communication, and adaptation in systems of animals, humans, and machines. Its central insight is that systems do not simply act; they adjust in response to the effects of their own action. In this thesis, cybernetics provides the systems vocabulary for understanding generative AI as recursive rather than static. Single-loop correction adjusts behaviour within a fixed objective. Doubleloop reflection questions the assumptions, task framing, or reward structure behind that objective. Triple-loop reflection examines the wider social and institutional values that made those objectives appear natural in the first place. In this thesis, cybernetics grounds MaSH Loops and supports the claim that evaluation is part of the system it studies.

描述性与规范性（是与应该）：Descriptive vs. normative (is vs. ought):报告模型行为方式的评估和规定模型应该做什么的评估之间的区别。这种分歧可以追溯到休谟的“是-应该”问题，并且是元伦理学的核心，在元伦理学中，试图从描述转向处方的风险是在隐藏的规范假设中走私。在本论文中，这种区别很重要，因为负责任的评估应该首先使模型行为和嵌入的假设可见，然后再进行规定。a distinction between evaluations that report how models behave and those that prescribe what models should do. The divide traces back to Hume’s is-ought problem and is central in meta-ethics, where attempts to move from description to prescription risk smuggling in hidden normative assumptions. In this thesis, the distinction matters because responsible evaluation should first make model behaviour and embedded assumptions visible before moving to prescription.

激活主义（4E认知和现象学）：Enactivism (4E cognition and phenomenology):一种关于心灵和认知的关系理论，其中意义是通过具体的、情境的和交互的活动而不是仅仅通过内部符号操纵而产生的。与瓦雷拉、汤普森和罗什相关，生成主义认为认知不是对预先给定世界的被动表征，而是通过持续的互动产生一个有意义的世界。对于人工智能来说，这种情况发生了变化a relational theory of mind and cognition in which meaning arises through embodied, situated, and interactive activity rather than internal symbol manipulation alone. Associated with Varela, Thompson, and Rosch, enactivism argues that cognition is not the passive representation of a pre-given world but the bringing forth of a meaningful world through ongoing interaction. For AI, this shifts

序言：Prologue:抓住老虎的尾巴Catching the Tiger’s Tail

10

评价远离隐藏的内在状态，转向参与、可供性和共同适应的模式。在本论文中，生成主义是功能主义对智能的解释与对语境和权力的建构主义批判之间的主要哲学桥梁。evaluation away from hidden inner states and toward patterns of participation, affordance, and co-adaptation. In this thesis, enactivism is the main philosophical bridge between functionalist accounts of intelligence and constructivist critiques of context and power.

评价：Evaluation:通过设计的测量、比较和解释行为使系统行为变得清晰的实践。评估从来都不是中立的，因为它取决于关于结构、代理、提示、指标和上下文的选择。在本论文中，评估不是被视为被动报告，而是被视为一种社会技术实践，它塑造了人工智能系统的外观及其治理方式。the practice of making system behaviour legible through designed acts of measurement, comparison, and interpretation. Evaluation is never neutral because it depends on choices about constructs, proxies, prompts, metrics, and contexts. In this thesis, evaluation is treated not as passive reporting but as a sociotechnical practice that shapes what AI systems appear to be and how they are governed.

功能主义：Functionalism:这种观点认为，心理状态或人工智能能力是由它们所做的事情而不是它们的成分来定义的。在人工智能中，这通常通过计算主义出现，并支撑基于输入输出基准和性能测试的评估方法。在本论文中，功能主义有助于解释为什么如此多的人工智能评估优先考虑可观察的性能，而忽略了行为发生的关系和情境条件。the view that mental states, or AI capabilities, are defined by what they do rather than what they are made of. In AI, this often appears through computationalism and underpins evaluation methods built on input-output benchmarks and performance tests. In this thesis, functionalism helps explain why so many AI evaluations privilege observable performance while neglecting the relational and contextual conditions through which behaviour is enacted.

MaSH 循环：MaSH Loops:本论文的评估框架用于跟踪机器、社会和人类流程之间的递归交互。 MaSH Loops 没有将人工智能系统视为具有固定属性的孤立模型，而是将行为视为通过技术系统、人类参与者和社会机构之间的反馈而制定的事物。该框架以行动主义为基础，并以控制论为基础。在本论文中，MaSH Loops 将分析单元从孤立的输出转变为模式化的交互，并为研究生成人工智能中的世界塑造反馈提供了中心镜头。this thesis’s evaluation framework for tracing recursive interaction across machine, social, and human processes. Rather than treating AI systems as isolated models with fixed properties, MaSH Loops treats behaviour as something enacted through feedback among technical systems, human actors, and social institutions. The framework is grounded in enactivism and informed by cybernetics. In this thesis, MaSH Loops shifts the unit of analysis from isolated outputs to patterned interaction and provides the central lens for studying world-shaping feedback in generative AI.

测量原理：Measurement theory:科学哲学和心理测量学的一个分支，涉及如何通过工具定义、操作和论证抽象结构。一个好的衡量标准不仅仅会产生稳定的数字，而且会产生稳定的数字。它还必须表明该仪器实际上正在捕获它声称捕获的结构。这就是有效性问题。表面效度询问一项措施看起来是否合理。内容有效性询问其是否涵盖相关领域。结构有效性询问操作化是否真正跟踪潜在概念而不是方便的替代品。在本论文中，测量理论用于表明人工智能基准不是中立的读数，而是具有哲学和社会后果的设计工具。a branch of philosophy of science and psychometrics concerned with how abstract constructs are defined, operationalised, and justified through instruments. A good measure does not simply produce stable numbers; it must also show that the instrument is actually capturing the construct it claims to capture. This is the problem of validity. Face validity asks whether a measure looks plausible. Content validity asks whether it covers the relevant domain. Construct validity asks whether the operationalisation genuinely tracks the underlying concept rather than a convenient substitute. In this thesis, measurement theory is used to show that AI benchmarks are not neutral readouts but designed instruments with philosophical and social consequences.

道德价值多元化（MVP）：Moral Value Pluralism (MVP):道德哲学中的一种立场，认为多种（有时是相互冲突的）道德价值观都可以是真实的且不可还原的。与涉及不同群体共存的政治多元化不同，MVP 解决的是道德推理本身的结构，其中没有任何单一原则可以解决所有价值冲突。在这篇论文中，MVP 支持了对单分对齐的批评，并激发了描述性的、有争议的评估方法。a position in moral philosophy which holds that multiple, sometimes conflicting, moral values can each be genuine and irreducible. Unlike political pluralism, which concerns the coexistence of diverse groups, MVP addresses the structure of ethical reasoning itself, where no single principle can resolve all value conflicts. In this thesis, MVP underpins the critique of one-score alignment and motivates descriptive, contestable approaches to evaluation.

序言：Prologue:抓住老虎的尾巴Catching the Tiger’s Tail

11

参与现实主义（量子基础）：Participatory realism (quantum foundations):从量子基础中得出的立场，其中观察不被视为被动检查，而是被视为对结果产生的参与。在本论文中，它被用作生成主义的哲学延伸。重点不在于法学硕士是任何字面工程意义上的量子系统。关键是人工智能的评估是参与性的：提示、标签、基准、界面和治理选择有助于形成他们后来描述的行为。在本论文中，参与现实主义强化了评价是构成性的而不仅仅是观察性的主张。a position drawn from quantum foundations in which observation is not treated as passive inspection but as participation in the production of outcomes. In this thesis it is used as a philosophical extension of enactivism. The point is not that LLMs are quantum systems in any literal engineering sense. The point is that evaluation in AI is participatory: prompts, labels, benchmarks, interfaces, and governance choices help bring into being the behaviour they later describe. In this thesis, participatory realism sharpens the claim that evaluation is constitutive rather than merely observational.

提示：Prompting:通过语言、框架或指令干预生成系统以塑造可能输出空间的行为。提示并不是简单地从模型中检索预先存在的含义；而是简单地从模型中检索预先存在的含义。它扰乱概率场并有助于制定特定的响应。在本论文中，提示被视为一种类似测量的干预措施，它共同产生输出，因此构成了评估装置本身的一部分。the act of intervening in a generative system through language, framing, or instruction so as to shape the space of possible outputs. A prompt does not simply retrieve a pre-existing meaning from the model; it perturbs a probabilistic field and helps enact a particular response. In this thesis, prompting is treated as a measurement-like intervention that co-produces outputs and therefore forms part of the evaluative apparatus itself.

负责任的提示设计（RPD）：Responsible Prompt Design (RPD):一种评估设计方法，使用平衡锚定、释义、标准化和去偏来稳定结果和表面规范假设。在本论文中，RPD 是用于减少即时假象的实用方法，从而使评价主张更少地依赖于措辞意外，而更多地依赖于所研究的行为。an approach to evaluation design that uses balanced anchors, paraphrases, normalisation, and debiasing to stabilise results and surface normative assumptions. In this thesis, RPD is the practical method used to reduce prompt artefacts so that evaluative claims rest less on wording accidents and more on the behaviour under study.

语义超空间（语义极光）：Semantic hyperspace (semantic auroras):第五章中提出的一个比喻，用于捕捉生成人工智能中潜在意义的概率场，其中提示将潜在分布折叠为已制定的输出。这个比喻强调意义是通过交互产生的，而不是存储在内部的。在本论文中，语义超空间提供了一种描述提示如何导航结构化潜力而不是检索固定含义的方法。a metaphor developed in Chapter 5 to capture the probabilistic field of potential meanings within generative AI, where prompts collapse latent distributions into enacted outputs. This metaphor underscores that meaning is enacted through interaction, not stored internally. In this thesis, semantic hyperspace provides a way of describing how prompting navigates structured potentials rather than retrieving fixed meanings.

社会技术映射：Sociotechnical mapping:一种使代理、指标、机构和反馈循环如何塑造应用领域的实践和权力关系可见的方法。在本论文中，社会技术映射用于揭示评估设计中嵌入的假设，并追踪技术系统和社会世界如何递归地相互塑造。a method for making visible how proxies, metrics, institutions, and feedback loops shape practices and power relations in applied domains. In this thesis, sociotechnical mapping is used to expose the assumptions embedded in evaluation design and to trace how technical systems and social worlds recursively shape one another.

值漂移：Value drift:投入中嵌入的价值观在产出中发生转变或重新构建的趋势，从而在预期规范和已颁布的规范之间产生系统性差异。它强调了生成系统如何随着时间的推移改变文化或道德内容。在本论文中，价值漂移作为一种经验信号，表明模型行为是由训练分布、提示条件和更广泛的社会技术背景塑造的，而不仅仅是中性传播。the tendency for values embedded in inputs to shift or be reframed in outputs, producing systematic divergence between intended and enacted norms. It highlights how generative systems can mutate cultural or ethical content over time. In this thesis, value drift functions as an empirical signal that model behaviour is shaped by training distributions, prompting conditions, and wider sociotechnical context rather than by neutral transmission alone.

序言：Prologue:抓住老虎的尾巴Catching the Tiger’s Tail

“认知不是通过独立的思想或自我来把握一个独立的外部世界，而是在具体行动中并通过具体行动来产生或制定一个相关的依赖世界。”“Cognition is not the grasping of an independent, outside world by a separate mind or self, but instead the bringing forth or enacting of a dependent world of relevance in and through embodied action.”

第一章：负责任的人工智能中的认识论隆隆声Chapter 1: Epistemological Rumbles in Responsible AI

从功能主义、建构主义和积极主义的角度看伦理与安全。Ethics and Safety through the lenses of Functionalism, Constructivism, and Enactivism.

摘要Abstract

2023 年，Responsible AI 社区的分裂变得不容忽视。看似政策分歧的根源在于相互冲突的认识论。主导人工智能安全和基准测试的功能主义方法将模型视为输入输出设备，其性能可以进行评分和比较。建构主义方法是人工智能伦理和社会技术系统 (STS) 的核心，它揭示了系统的社会技术嵌入及其所承载的规范假设。这两种观点都阐明了人工智能的重要方面，但都没有充分解释当今生成系统的递归性、自适应性。In 2023, fractures in the Responsible AI community became impossible to ignore. What looked like policy disagreements were rooted in conflicting epistemologies. Functionalist approaches, which dominate AI Safety and benchmarking, treat models as input–output devices whose performance can be scored and compared. Constructivist methods, central to AI Ethics and Sociotechnical Systems (STS), uncover the sociotechnical embedding of systems and the normative assumptions they carry. Both perspectives illuminate important aspects of AI, yet neither fully accounts for the recursive, adaptive nature of today’s generative systems.

本章认为需要第三种立场。行动主义将智力重新定义为一种关系性和参与性的属性，而不是静态的属性。从这个角度来看，评估更多的是观察模型在与人类和机构的互动中如何变化，而不是发现模型是什么。作为这一转变的早期实施，我引入了 MaSH Loops（机器-社会-人类）作为一种激活主义评估框架，它将注意力从孤立的模型输出重新定向到递归的社会技术交互。分析表明，功能主义和建构主义都错过了生成人工智能的递归特征，而 MaSH 循环提供了更好地捕捉情境响应性和参与性一致性的标准。这不是灵丹妙药，而是立场的转变：从静态基准到关系测量。This chapter argues that a third stance is needed. Enactivism reframes intelligence not as a static property but as relational and participatory. From this perspective, evaluation is less about discovering what a model is and more about observing how it becomes in interaction with humans and institutions. As an early operationalisation of this shift, I introduce MaSH Loops (Machine–Society–Human) as an enactivist evaluation framework that reorients attention from isolated model outputs to recursive sociotechnical interaction. The analysis demonstrates that functionalism and constructivism each miss the recursive character of generative AI, while MaSH Loops provide criteria that better capture situated responsiveness and participatory alignment. This is not a silver bullet but a shift in stance: from static benchmarks to relational measurement.

本章的影响是双重的。从概念上讲，它为本文奠定了认识论基础。实际上，它激发了后面章节中开发的方法创新，特别是世界价值观基准，并提供了一个描述性、多元化和可争议的评估框架。The impact of this chapter is twofold. Conceptually, it establishes the epistemological foundation for the thesis. Practically, it motivates the methodological innovations developed in later chapters, especially the World Values Benchmark, and offers a framework for evaluations that are descriptive, pluralist, and contestable.

[17 ]

第一章：Chapter 1:负责任的人工智能中的认识论隆隆声Epistemological Rumbles in Responsible AI

1.1 简介1.1 Introduction

负责任的人工智能社区现在发现自己陷入了一个递归循环——与衔尾蛇不同——关于未来风险和当前危害的争论围绕着不同的价值观、基准和认知框架无休止地循环。在 Responsible AI 社区中，关于人工智能 (AI) 带来的风险的争论十分激烈。研究人员对于缓解这些问题的策略存在强烈分歧。其中一部分主要关注人工智能对个人、社会和弱势群体的直接影响。他们的工作深深地扎根于情境开发和部署，以及人类偏见的细微差别，很大程度上借鉴了社会技术理论。其他研究人员更关注对人类的生存威胁，例如超级智能人工智能导致广泛的人类灾难，以及对未来社会的挑战。这两种方法通常形成对立的阵营（尽管存在一些重叠的担忧），导致 2023 年负责任的人工智能研究社区高度分裂。为了方便起见，我们将第一组主要关注直接影响的群体称为“AIE 社区”，第二组关注存在威胁的群体称为“人工智能安全社区”。[343]。另一个绰号是人工智能对齐，它考虑人工智能如何与人类价值观保持一致，有时代表第三阵营，有时被归类为人工智能伦理或人工智能安全的子集。与所有新兴的科学和社会学领域一样，随着来自众多领域的研究人员带来自己的方法论和认识论，编纂、定义和标准化正在发生重大变化。值得注意的是，即使这些术语及其应用也存在激烈争议，因为边界是可变的，并且每个大类都可以进一步细分。The Responsible AI community now finds itself caught in a recursive loop—not unlike the ouroboros—where debates about future risk and present harm circle endlessly around divergent values, benchmarks, and epistemic frames. Debate is rife in the Responsible AI community regarding the risks posed by artificial intelligence (AI). Researchers disagree strongly on the strategies to mitigate them. One segment is chiefly concerned with the immediate repercussions of AI on individuals, societies, and vulnerable populations. Their work is deeply entrenched in contextual development and deployment, and the nuances of human bias, drawing heavily from sociotechnical theories. Other researchers are more focussed on existential threats to humanity such as a super-intelligent AI leading to widespread human catastrophe, and challenges to future societies. These two approaches form what are often opposing camps (despite having some over-lapping concerns) resulting in a highly fractured Responsible AI research community in 2023. For the sake of convenience, we will call the first group primarily focussed on immediate impacts the “AIEthics community” and the second, those concerned with existential threats, the “AI-Safety community.”[343]. Another moniker, AI-Alignment, which considers how AI might be aligned to human values, sometimes stands as a third camp, or sometimes is categorized as a subset of either AI-Ethics or AI-Safety. As with all nascent scientific and sociological fields, codification, definitions, and standardisation are in significant flux as researchers from numerous fields bring their own methodologies and epistemologies. It is important to note, that even these terms and their applications are hotly contested, since the borders are fluid, and each broad category can be further sub-divided.

总的来说，“负责任的人工智能”研究人员关注人类社会（现在和未来）、边缘群体和自然环境的风险和影响。负责任的人工智能研究人员还可能关心维护人权原则并确保隐私、公平、可靠性、透明度、可竞争性和问责制。负责任的人工智能研究人员来自许多学科，包括计算机科学、哲学、社会科学、法律和经济学[343]。他们还来自不同且经常相互冲突的政治偏好和意识形态[115]和其他不同的价值体系以及不同类型的工作环境，每个环境都有自己的文化和规范。Collectively, “Responsible AI” researchers are concerned with risks and impacts to human society (present and future), marginalised groups, and the natural environment. Responsible AI researchers may also be concerned with upholding human rights principles and ensuring privacy, fairness, reliability, transparency, contestability, and accountability. Responsible AI researchers come from many disciplines including computer sciences, philosophies, social sciences, law, and economics[343]. They also hail from different and often conflicting political preferences and ideologies[115] and other diverse value systems as well as differing types of workplace environments each with their own cultures and normalisations.

人工智能伦理和人工智能安全社区之间的争论在 Twitter/X 等社交媒体平台、学术会议、arXiv 和 GitHub 等平台上的预印本、对立研究人员之间的公开赌注以及各种公共媒体渠道中表现得非常明显。辩论可能会迅速升级为争论，有时甚至会导致个人和高度公开的对抗。有争议的问题范围很广，从对人工智能模型表现出“一般火花”的猜测到The debates between the AI-Ethics and AI-Safety communities are strongly evident on social media platforms such as Twitter/X, at academic conferences, via pre-prints on platforms like arXiv and GitHub, in public wagers between opposing researchers, and across various public media channels. Debate can rapidly escalate to arguments and sometimes culminate in personal and highly public confrontations. The range of contentious issues is broad, spanning from speculations about AI models exhibiting “sparks of general

第一章：Chapter 1:负责任的人工智能中的认识论隆隆声Epistemological Rumbles in Responsible AI

18

情报”[57]，以关注系统性有毒偏见、流行意识形态的具体化、环境影响以及在文化异质世界中协调价值观的挑战。intelligence” [57], to concerns about systemic toxic bias, reification of prevailing ideologies, environmental impacts, and the challenge of aligning values in a culturally heterogeneous world.

2022 年和 2023 年，关于人工智能系统的行为和内部构成（例如人工智能模型能否理解、推理或接近意识）的争论将成为许多讨论的焦点。密切相关的是许多评估指标的有效性，例如那些旨在衡量模型常识和理解能力的指标。一些人工智能伦理学家批评常识性评估基准将人工智能模型的功能能力和形而上学性质混为一谈。 2022 年，许多人工智能安全专家声称，随着模型规模的扩大，超级智能即将到来，新兴人工智能对人类构成了与原子弹类似的危险。这些不同的认识论可能会导致人们对这些新技术是什么及其带来的风险产生不同的看法。In 2022 and 2023, debates over the behaviour and inner constitution of AI systems (e.g. can AI models understand, or reason, or are approaching consciousness) feature in many of the discussions. Closely related is the validity of many evaluation metrics such as those purporting to gauge a model’s commonsense and understanding competencies. Some AIEthicists criticise commonsense evaluation benchmarks of conflating the functional capabilities and metaphysical nature of AI models. In 2022, many AI-Safety experts claimed that emerging AI presents a similar danger to humanity as the atomic bomb due to imminent superintelligence as models scale up. These differing epistemologies can result in divergent views of what these new technologies are and the risks they present.

人工智能伦理和人工智能安全研究重点和方法的成果都有可能以不同的方式影响当前和未来的人类群体。它们还可以强烈影响针对不同主要问题的治理和监管决策，从而对科技行业以及下游行业和人员造成不同的财务影响。世界各地的政府都在向 Responsible-AI 研究人员寻求指导。因此，这些激烈的分歧不再只是学术不和的问题，它们对我们如何资助人工智能研究、提供最新模型、决定政策以及如何将这些强大的新技术融入我们的社会结构具有重大影响。Outcomes from AI-Ethics and AI-Safety research foci and methods, each hold the potential to impact current and future human groups in different ways. They can also strongly influence governance and regulatory decisions towards differing primary concerns, causing different financial impacts on the tech sector and downstream industries and people. Governments all over the world are looking to Responsible-AI researchers for guidance. As a result, these heated divisions are no longer just a matter of academic discord, they have significant implications for how we fund AI research, provide access to the latest models, decide on policy, and handle adoption of these new and powerful technologies into our social structures.

如果认为人工智能伦理和人工智能安全分歧仅仅是由经济利益和竞争驱动力造成的，那就过于简单化了，尽管这些都是促成因素。假设一个阵营比另一个阵营道德或伦理差也是不合理或建设性的，因为大多数负责任的人工智能研究人员都有真正的良好意图。我们需要比表面特征更深入地观察，并关注支撑每个群体的不同认识论基础。本章研究了如何构建问题的认知差异，特别是建构主义和功能主义的不同观点。这里展示的镜头只是我们如何构建负责任的人工智能不和谐的一个例子；这绝不是看待问题的唯一可能的方式。然而，由于科学深受所涉及的人类的影响，因此重要的是要考虑不同的范式如何导致人工智能研究人员的不同立场。It would be simplistic to think that the AI-Ethics and AI-Safety divide is fuelled solely by financial interests and competitive drives, though those are contributing factors. Nor is it reasonable or constructive to assume that one camp is less moral or ethical than the other as most Responsible-AI researchers have genuinely good intentions. We need to look more deeply than surface level characterisations and focus on the differing epistemological foundations underpinning each group. This chapter investigates the cognitive differences in how problems are framed, specifically the varying perspectives of constructivism and functionalism. The lens presented here is just one example of how we might frame the Responsible AI discord; it is by no means the only possible way of looking at the issue. However, as science is deeply shaped by the humans involved, it is important to consider how different paradigms can result in varying standpoints of AI researchers.

功能主义和建构主义为理解智能的本质和评估人工智能的方法提供了两种截然不同的视角。Functionalism and Constructivism offer two contrasting lenses for understanding the nature of intelligence and the methods by which AI should be evaluated.功能主义Functionalism强调外部行为和因果作用；认为精神状态（或人工智能能力）是由它们所做的事情定义的，而不是由它们的成分定义的。emphasises external behaviour and causal roles; arguing that mental states (or AI capabilities) are defined by what they do, not what they’re made of.建构主义Constructivism相反，认为知识和意义是通过经验、背景和社会互动主动构建的；这意味着人工智能系统不仅仅是执行任务, in contrast, holds that knowledge and meaning are actively constructed through experience, context, and social interaction; implying that AI systems are not merely performing

功能，但嵌入复杂的社会技术世界。这些不同的基础有助于解释负责任的人工智能话语中的分歧。本章首先将负责任的人工智能研究置于社会历史背景下，然后解析功能主义和建构主义范式以及它们如何在两个案例研究中体现：通用人工智能（AGI）辩论和模型评估实践。最后介绍了functions, but embedded in complex sociotechnical worlds. These divergent foundations help explain the fractures in Responsible AI discourse. This chapter begins by situating Responsible AI research within a socio-historical context, then unpacks the functionalist and constructivist paradigms and how they manifest in two case studies: the artificial general intelligence (AGI) debate and model evaluation practices. It concludes by introducing行动主义Enactivism作为第三个综合框架，并提出as a third, integrative framework, and proposesMaSH 循环MaSH Loops作为一个可行的框架，以更具价值的多元化方法评估人工智能系统。as an actionable framework to evaluate AI systems in a more value pluralistic approach.

1.2 负责任的人工智能研究作为一个社会建构的领域1.2 Responsible-AI research as a socially constructed field

为了理解人工智能研究的现状，我们需要看到它的基础不仅植根于算法和计算，还植根于社会、文化、政治和哲学背景。我们受到环境和制度影响的影响，这些影响影响我们处理问题的方式以及我们如何看待技术制品。这些影响反过来又影响了实验设计和结果的解释。To understand the current landscape of AI research, we need to see that its foundations are rooted not only in algorithms and computation but also in social, cultural, political, and philosophical contexts. We are shaped by environmental and institutional influences that affect how we approach problems and how we perceive technological artefacts. Those influences, in turn, shape experimental design and the interpretation of results.

科学本质上是人类的一项事业，它与文化和个人规范假设以及更大的结构力量深深地交织在一起[参见126、161、213、218、312，了解一些开创性的作品]。不幸的是，在许多自然科学、计算机科学和工程项目中，这种关于科学领域如何社会构建的建构主义观点仍然没有得到应有的频繁教授。如果没有接触到这些想法，许多基于更多技术学科的人工智能研究就会表现出强烈的功能主义方法论倾向，而牺牲了建构主义见解。Science, being a fundamentally human endeavour, is just as deeply intertwined with cultural and individual normative assumptions and larger structural forces [see 126, 161, 213, 218, 312 for a selection of seminal works]. Unfortunately, this constructivist perspective on how scientific fields are socially constructed is still not taught as often as it should be in many natural science, computer science, and engineering programmes. Without exposure to these ideas, a lot of AI research grounded in more technical disciplines, displays a strong propensity towards functionalist methodologies at the expense of constructivist insights.

历史清晰地展示了人工智能是如何被社会构建的，以及功能主义和建构主义倾向是如何在其中出现的。一个关键时刻是 1956 年的达特茅斯会议，参加的人数相对较少，接受过数学、计算机科学和控制论培训的白人。大多数都与美国精英大学、研究机构和政府网络有联系，这可能缩小了那里代表的世界观范围。无论好坏，会议还创造了“人工智能”一词[252]，尽管明斯基也指出“我们通常不会根据他们的愿望来命名领域，而是根据他们的主题或功能”[361，Ch.9]。History gives a clear view of how AI was socially constructed and how functionalist and constructivist tendencies emerged within it. One pivotal moment was the 1956 Dartmouth conference, attended by a relatively small group of white men trained in mathematics, computer science, and cybernetics. Most were connected to elite US universities, research institutes, and government networks, which likely narrowed the range of worldviews represented there. The conference also, for better or worse, coined the term Artificial Intelligence [252] despite even Minsky noting that “we don’t usually name fields for their aspirations, but for their subject matter or their function” [361, Ch.9].

达特茅斯会议是人工智能历史上的决定性时刻，那里举行的讨论继续对人工智能的发展产生重大影响。与会者的一个主要信念是，包括自我意识、情感和自由意志在内的思维计算模型的应用是人工智能可以实现的目标[251,252,266]。达特茅斯学院关注的思想是，心理状态可以根据其功能和行为来理解和模拟，而不是其潜在的生物学或内在本质，至今仍然影响着许多人工智能研究人员。会议主办方，The Dartmouth conference was a defining moment in the history of AI, and the discussions held there continue to have a significant impact on AI development. A predominant belief among the attendees was that applications of computational models of the mind, including self-awareness, emotion, and free will, were achievable goals for AI [251, 252, 266]. The Dartmouth focus on ideas that mental states can be understood and emulated based on their functions and behaviours rather than their underlying biologic or intrinsic essence still influences many AI researchers today. Organiser of the conference,

麦卡锡向一位同事指出，“我们将专注于设计一种对计算器进行编程以形成概念并形成概括的方法的问题”[207]，这是对计算主义关注的有力指标。McCarthy noted to a colleague “we shall concentrate on a problem of devising a way of programming a calculator to form concepts and to form generalizations” [207], a strong indicator of the focus on computationalism.

值得注意的是，许多达特茅斯与会者也曾参加过早期的控制论研讨会，最著名的是 19461953 年的梅西会议 [207]。控制论是对动物和机器的系统、反馈和控制的研究[420]，在人工智能的早期进化中发挥了关键作用。与大多数新兴领域一样，特别是那些高度跨学科的领域，学者们对于如何研究控制论存在分歧和分歧。我们没有一个单一的时刻可以用来定义分裂，并且对于如何定义分裂有很多观点[207, 400]，但很明显，一些研究人员追求更加机械的焦点，如计算主义所代表的，一些研究人员则采用更具建构主义风格的方法，例如自创生（自我维持和复制系统）和社会科学的应用所代表的方法。It is important to note that many of the Dartmouth attendees had also been participants in earlier Cybernetics workshops, most notably the Macy Conferences of 19461953 [207]. Cybernetics, the study of systems, feedback, and control in animals and machines [420], played a pivotal role in AI's early evolution. As with most nascent fields, particularly those that are highly interdisciplinary, there were divisions and differences amongst scholars of how cybernetics should be approached. There is no single moment we can point to as defining the split and there are many opinions of how to define the split [207, 400], but it is clear that some researchers pursued a more mechanical-focus as exemplified by computationalism and some worked with more constructivist style approaches such as exemplified by autopoiesis (self-sustaining and replicating systems) and applications to the social sciences.

达特茅斯会议上的大多数控制论专家在他们的著作中都展示了强有力的机械和功能主义方法。 McCulloch 和 Pitts [254] 开发了神经网络的可计算性。纽厄尔和西蒙 [281] 开发了逻辑理论机器，为世界上第一个计算机程序奠定了基础。 Solomonoff [365]继续发展算法概率理论。而且，香农[357]发展了一种可以应用于机器的通信数学理论（值得注意的是，香农后来的控制论观点转向了更加建构主义的方法）。许多机械控制论专家的工作成为了符号人工智能（或者后来被称为“老式人工智能”）的基础。Most of the cyberneticians at the Dartmouth conference showed strong mechanical and functionalist approaches in their writings. McCulloch and Pitts [254] had developed the computability of neural networks. Newell and Simon [281] developed the logic theory machine laying the groundwork for the world’s first computer programs. Solomonoff [365] went on to develop the theory of algorithmic probability. And, Shannon [357] developed a mathematical theory of communication that could be applied to machines (it is important to note that Shannon’s later cybernetic opinions shifted to a more constructivist approach). The work of many of these mechanical cyberneticians became the foundation for symbolic AI (or as it was later known, Good Old Fashioned AI).

一些脱离这些功能主义倾向的控制论专家为平行领域的发展做出了贡献，这个领域可以被宽松地称为二阶控制论。这种替代方法采取了更加建构主义的立场，如 Von Foerster [411] 关于现实的构建和沟通的塑造的著作中所体现的那样；米德[258]对人类学过程的控制论解释；以及 Maturana 和 Varela 的 [249] 自创生系统。到了 20 世纪下半叶，虽然一些倾向于功能主义的机械控制论专家致力于打造以计算范式为基础的符号人工智能系统，但其他人[即] 300, 302, 307]，强调了系统固有的关系动态，导致将这些想法应用于人工智能、教育和认知科学的新兴现象。尽管人工智能硬件开发、哲学和控制论在 20 世纪中叶都紧密相连，但功能主义/建构主义的分歧在 21 世纪只会变得越来越大。Some of the cyberneticians that split from these functionalist leanings contributed to the development of a parallel field that can loosely be called second-order cybernetics. This alternative approach took a more constructivist stance as exemplified in the works of Von Foerster [411] on the construction of reality and shaping of communication; Mead’s [258] cybernetic explanations of anthropological processes; and Maturana and Varela’s [249] autopoietic systems. By the latter half of the 20[th] Century, while some functionalist leaning, mechanical cyberneticians aimed to craft symbolic AI systems underpinned by computational paradigms, others [i.e. 300, 302, 307], accentuated the relational dynamics intrinsic to systems, resulting in emergent phenomena applying these ideas to AI, education, and cognitive sciences. Though AI hardware development, philosophy, and cybernetics were all closely tied in the mid-20th century, the functionalist/constructivist split has only grown wider in the 21[st] century.

当然，许多哲学视角可以剖析认知过程、问题解决机制、认识论和创新。虽然功能主义与建构主义的观点提供了这样的视角，但还有其他二分法，例如Of course, numerous philosophical lenses can dissect cognitive processes, problemsolving mechanisms, epistemology, and innovation. While functionalist versus constructivist perspectives provide one such lens, there are other dichotomies like

第一章：Chapter 1:负责任的人工智能中的认识论隆隆声Epistemological Rumbles in Responsible AI

实证主义与解释主义、客观主义与相对主义、还原论与整体论、绝对主义与多元主义立场。最重要的是要明白，这些二分法虽然简化了复杂的哲学思考，但并不是严格意义上的二元对立。他们经常勾画出一个谱系，其中散布着多个细微差别的位置。然而，当我们试图审视分裂、分歧以及由此产生的主导路径的根本原因时，镜头会很有帮助。联结主义学派为这种科学岔路提供了一个说明性的例子。连接主义分支在 20 世纪中叶帮助开创了人工神经网络 (ANN) 研究，后来成为深度学习创新的基石，推动了当今为 GenAI 提供动力的深度学习技术。positivism versus interpretivism, objectivist against relativist, reductionism in contrast with holism, and absolutist to pluralist standpoints. It's paramount to understand that these dichotomies, while simplifying intricate philosophical deliberations, aren't strictly binary. They often sketch out a spectrum with multiple nuanced positions interspersed. However, lenses are helpful when we are trying to view underlying causes for splits, dissension, and resulting paths that become dominant. The School of Connectionism offers an illustrative example of such a scientific fork in the road. The Connectionist fork helped pioneer artificial neural network (ANN) research in the mid-20th century which later became the bedrock for the deep learning innovations fuelling today's Deep Learning technology that powers GenAI.

1.3 符号人工智能和联结主义1.3 Symbolic AI and Connectionism

20 世纪 50 年代和 1960 年代的第一波联结主义起源于认知科学，其特点是通过通常是顺序的逻辑演算技术来理解神经回路的功能主义方法 [254, 336]。显着的范式转变标志着 20 世纪 80 年代和 90 年代的第二次浪潮。联结主义开始偏离其最初的功能主义系泊，转向更加建构主义的框架，许多人工智能研究人员试图通过一种更关注神经元之间连接的强度和活动的方法来挑战符号人工智能。这一时期的一个重要见解是认识到人类认知可能按照并行和分布式原则运行，而不是纯粹的顺序和符号[82]。这种观点表明，认知采取非线性路径，因为知识是跨系统构建的。First wave Connectionism in the 1950s and 1960s originated in the cognitive sciences and was characterised by functionalist approaches to understanding neural circuitry through logical calculus techniques that are typically sequential [254, 336]. A noticeable paradigm shift marked the second wave in the 1980s and 1990s. Connectionism began to drift from its original functionalist moorings, shifting toward more constructivist framings where many AI researchers sought to challenge symbolic AI with an approach that focussed more on the strengths and activities of connections between neurons. A key insight from this period was the realization that human cognition might operate on parallel and distributed principles rather than being purely sequential and symbolic [82]. This perspective suggests that cognition takes non-linear pathways, as knowledge was constructed across the system.

1980 年代的第二波联结主义被许多人（尽管不是全部，即 348）视为与计算主义截然对立，并大量借鉴了建构主义学习理论，特别是让·皮亚杰 (Jean Piaget) 的基础性工作 [307, 341, 360]。这种影响促进了 ANN 方法的进步，特别是隐藏层 [339, 340] 的引入，它是当今深度学习技术的重要组成部分。因此，人工神经网络扩大了其适用性，例如字符识别等早期研究；当今复杂的图像识别的先驱。与二阶控制论一致，建构主义观点认为学习者从他们的经验中主动建构知识。与此相呼应的是，第二波 ANN 模型通过并行和分布式架构，动态修改无数权重以响应传入数据。这种迭代细化可以比作人类不断发展的理解力，区别在于机器根据数据交互而不是“理解”来定制内部模式表示。当比较源自互动的知识的建构主义观点时，这种一致性是显而易见的。The second wave of connectionism in 1980s was viewed by many [though not all, i.e., 348] as starkly oppositional to computationalism and drew heavily from constructivist theories of learning, particularly the foundational work of Jean Piaget [307, 341, 360]. This influence facilitated advancements in ANN methods, notably the introduction of hidden layers [339, 340] an essential component of today’s Deep Learning technologies. As a result, ANNs expanded their applicability, exemplified in early endeavours like character recognition; a precursor to today's sophisticated image recognition. In line with secondorder cybernetics, the constructivist viewpoint posits that learners actively construct knowledge from their experiences. Mirroring this, second wave ANN models, through their parallel and distributed architecture, dynamically modify countless weights in response to incoming data. This iterative refinement can be likened to humans' evolving comprehension, with the distinction that machines tailor internal pattern representations based on data interactions rather than “comprehend”. This alignment is evident when comparing the constructivist perspective of knowledge stemming from interactions to the

第一章：Chapter 1:负责任的人工智能中的认识论隆隆声Epistemological Rumbles in Responsible AI

22

连接主义模型，从协作处理数据的众多单元中获得模式识别能力。connectionist models, which derive pattern recognition abilities from numerous units processing data collaboratively.

经过符号人工智能几十年的统治之后，我们现在知道联结主义是深度学习难题中缺失的一块，而深度学习为我们现在争论的大多数人工智能提供了动力。当我们进入人工智能技术的下一个学习循环时，令人惊讶的是，许多研究人员仍然强烈倾向于功能主义，而很少考虑建构主义。一些人工智能伦理学学者的建构主义方法，特别是那些呼吁更多社会技术和背景考虑的学者，可以被视为有助于纠正负责任人工智能发展的方向。After decades of the dominance of symbolic AI, we now know that connectionism was a missing piece of the puzzle to Deep Learning which powers most of the AI we are now arguing about. As we move into the next learning loop of AI technologies, it is surprising then, how polarised many researchers still are in strong tendencies toward functionalism with minimal constructivist considerations. The constructivist approaches of some AIEthics scholars, particularly those calling for greater sociotechnical and contextual considerations could be seen as contributing to righting the listing ship of Responsible-AI development

1.4 建构主义与功能主义1.4 Constructivism and functionalism

在称为心灵哲学的哲学分支中，功能主义断言事物的行为方式、其功能方式决定了事物是什么[129, 317]。功能主义是一种唯物主义心理理论，它利用输入和输出或行为之间的因果关系来确定研究对象的内部心理状态[42,225,335]在这个范式中，函数是In a branch of philosophy called Philosophy of Mind, functionalism asserts that the way a thing behaves, the way it functions, determines what a thing is[129, 317]. Functionalism is a materialist theory of mind that uses causal relationships between inputs and outputs or actions to determine the internal mental states of the object of study [42, 225, 335] In this paradigm, a function is造成的caused通过其他事物，例如感官输入或其他精神状态：将手指猛地撞在门上会导致称为“疼痛”的状态，告诉您将手指移出门！功能主义观点认为，心灵是一个复杂的机器，每一种心理状态都在整个系统中发挥着作用。功能主义的观点是，如果你观察某种行为，你就可以推断出系统的本质：机器的运作方式与智能人类相同，因此它必须是智能的 [32, 398]。功能主义方法可能认为人工智能的行为最好通过其操作和可观察的输入和输出来解释。人工智能中的功能主义范式围绕规则、逻辑序列和因果关系；尽管 Vallor [403] 等一些研究人员批评这些方法忽视了技术实践的道德和背景维度。社会规范、价值观和道德是社会中存在的所有事物，实体可以通过人工智能系统吸收和复制以产生适当的行为。by something else, such as a sensory input or another mental state: slamming your finger in the door causes the state known as “pain” to tell you to get your finger out of the door! The functionalist view of the mind is that it is an intricate piece of machinery in which every mental state has a role to play in the overall system. The functionalist perspective is that if you observe some kind of behaviour, you can make inferences about the nature of the system: that machine is functioning in the same way as an intelligent human, therefore it must be intelligent [32, 398]. A functionalist approach may posit that an AI's behaviour is best interpreted via its operations and observable inputs and outputs. Functionalist paradigms in AI revolve around rules, logical sequences, and causal relationships; though some researchers such as Vallor [403] critique these approaches for neglecting the moral and contextual dimensions of technological practice. Social norms, values, and ethics are all things that exist in society that an entity can absorb and replicate by AI systems to produce appropriate behaviour.

另一方面，建构主义认为，大脑不仅接收外部输入，而且过去和现在的经验积极结合起来构建知识或学习。建构主义认为，理解和知识系统是由个人和集体经验构建和塑造的，而不是被动接受或天生的。因此，事物的行为方式是多种内力和外力共同作用的结果。当人们互动并将自己的经验和世界观带入这一过程时，就会构建社会规范和价值观。建构主义观点可能认为我们对人工智能的理解是深刻的Constructivism, on the other hand, holds that a mind doesn’t just receive external inputs but that experiences, both past and present, actively combine to construct knowledge or learning. Constructivism holds that understanding and knowledge systems are constructed, shaped by individual and collective experiences rather than being passively received or innate. Therefore, the way a thing behaves is the emergent result of many internal and external forces coming together. Social norms and values are constructed when people interact, bringing their own experiences and worldviews to the process. A constructivist viewpoint might contend that our grasp of AI is profoundly

[23 ]

第一章：Chapter 1:负责任的人工智能中的认识论隆隆声Epistemological Rumbles in Responsible AI

它与社会结构交织在一起，并由人类观念、社会交流和错综复杂的文化所塑造。interwoven with social structures and shaped by human perceptions, societal exchanges, and cultural intricacies.

虽然建构主义强调知识的社会塑造，但它通常仍然将价值观视为技术的外部输入，而不是实践中制定的品质。 Vallor [403] 通过她的描述挑战了这一限制While constructivism highlights the social shaping of knowledge, it often still treats values as external inputs to technology rather than as qualities enacted in practice. Vallor [403] challenges this limitation through her account of技术美德Technomoral Virtues，展示了技术本身如何成为道德形成的场所。她认为，道德评估不能简化为计算正确性或监管合规性，而必须将智慧、正义、同理心和勇气的培养作为生活实践。最近，Vallor 和 Vierkant [405] 通过引入, showing how technologies themselves become sites of moral formation. She argues that ethical evaluation cannot be reduced to computational correctness or regulatory compliance, but must instead engage with the cultivation of wisdom, justice, empathy, and courage as lived practices. More recently, Vallor and Vierkant [405] extend this relational critique by introducing the idea of a脆弱性差距vulnerability gap：人工智能系统及其影响的系统之间结构性地缺乏相互责任。与人们所熟悉的不透明或人类控制减弱的担忧不同——这也给人类机构带来了麻烦——这一差距凸显了缺乏能够正确定位的代理人来应对那些受到人工智能行为伤害的人。总而言之，这些观点强调了为什么需要关系账户。生成主义恰恰提供了这样一个框架，它不把认知和评价视为抽象的属性，而是从具体的、相互的参与过程中产生的。: the structural absence of mutual answerability between AI systems and those they affect. Unlike the familiar concerns of opacity or diminished human control — which also trouble human agency — this gap highlights the absence of agents who can be properly situated to answer to those harmed by AI actions. Taken together, these perspectives underscore why relational accounts are needed. Enactivism offers precisely such a framework, treating cognition and evaluation not as abstract properties but as emergent from embodied, reciprocal processes of engagement.

以下是对这两个范例的简要介绍。在第 3 节中，我们探讨了两个案例研究，说明看待人工智能的不同方式如何导致截然不同的观点：AGI 辩论和人工智能模型的评估。在第 4 节中，我们将研究一种更现代的方法，称为 Enactivism（来自 4E 认知），它可能更适合对这些新技术进行负责任的管理。Following is a brief look at the two paradigms. In section 3 we explore two case studies of how these different ways of viewing AI can lead to very different opinions: the AGI debate and the evaluation of AI models. In section 4, we will look at a more modern approach called Enactivism (from 4E cognition) that may be better suited to developing responsible management of these new technologies.

1.4.1 功能主义1.4.1 Functionalism

功能主义观点侧重于通过功能而不是组成来理解系统，跨学科的各种功能主义理论表明心理状态是由它们在认知系统中的作用来定义的[317]。普特南认为，任何实体（有机体或机器）如果能够实现正确的计算过程，就可以表现出给定的心理状态。在认知科学中，一些研究人员认为心理状态的特征是“根据他们所做的事情，根据他们与刺激输入和行为输出的关系”[311]。Functionalist perspectives focus on understanding systems by their functions, not composition, with various functionalist theories across disciplines suggesting mental states are defined by their role in cognitive systems [317]. Putnam argued that any entity— organism or machine—could exhibit a given mental state if it could implement the right kind of computational process. In the cognitive sciences some researchers consider that psychological states are characterised “according to what they do, by their relations to stimulus inputs and behavioural outputs” [311].

功能主义与行为主义密切相关：实体或人工制品的行为或功能方式表明了幕后发生的事情[71]。这种观点认为，只要不同的物理实例执行类似的功能，它们就可以被视为具有可比性。实例可以包括类似于人脑中的神经元网络的人工神经网络（ANN）。它为人工智能研究提供了一个灵活的框架，表明如果一个人工系统像人类一样执行功能，就可以推断它复制了相同的认知过程。Functionalism is strongly related to Behaviouralism: the way an entity or artefact behaves or functions, indicates what is happening under the hood [71]. This viewpoint considers different physical instances be viewed as comparable, provided they perform analogous functions. Instances may include artificial neural networks (ANNs) as analogous to neuronal networks in human brains. It provides a flexible framework in AI research, suggesting that if an artificial system performs a function like a human, it can be inferred to have replicated the same cognitive process.

功能主义（在人工智能的背景下）高度依赖于计算主义等计算心理理论的假设有效性[254,317,308,89]，其核心思想是认知状态更多地由其角色或功能而不是其内在品质来表征。图灵测试也许是功能主义在机器上最著名的应用。测试中包含了图灵的假设，即如果一台机器足以欺骗用户，让他们认为他们正在与“假装成女人的男人”而不是“假装成女人的机器”交谈，那么该机器就可以Functionalism (in the context of AI) is highly dependent on the assumed validity of computational theories of mind such as Computationalism [254, 317, 308, 89], centring on the idea that cognitive states are characterised more by their roles or functions than their intrinsic qualities. The Turing test is perhaps the most well-known application of functionalism to machines. Encoded into the test is Turing’s assumption that if a machine could sufficiently fool a user into thinking they were conversing with a “man pretending to be a woman” rather than a “machine pretending to be a woman,” then that machine could

第一章：Chapter 1:负责任的人工智能中的认识论隆隆声Epistemological Rumbles in Responsible AI

可以说拥有思考的能力[398]。人工智能的功能主义观点认为，模仿人类的功能意味着智能、思维或理解的存在。be said to possess the capability to think [398]. A functionalist perspective of AI considers that the mimicking of human-like functions signifies the presence of intelligence, thinking, or understanding.

功能主义方法可以为评估人工智能系统提供有用的方法。通过关注模型可以成功执行的任务，开发人员可以更快地进行原型设计、测试、报告功能、与竞争对手模型进行比较以及迭代新模型。模型的功能主义评估侧重于与任务和预期成功衡量标准相一致的输出。这种面向结果而不是复杂的内部流程的导向有助于更快的进步和应用程序驱动的结果。此外，功能主义的观点允许跨不同平台和技术的多样化实施，从而提高一个领域的开发效率。Functionalist approaches can provide useful methods for evaluating AI systems. By focusing on the tasks a model can successfully perform, developers can more rapidly prototype, test, report on capabilities, compare with competitor models, and iterate on new models. Functionalist assessments of a model focus on the output aligning with the task and the expected measure of success. This orientation towards outcomes rather than intricate internal processes facilitates faster advancements and application-driven results. Moreover, the functionalist perspective allows for diverse implementations across various platforms and technologies, promoting efficiency of development as a field.

功能主义观点可以主导人工智能-安全对话，特别是在进行线性结果预测时。一个例子是，有人认为生成式人工智能模型具有一定的理解力或智能，因为它们能够通过法律资格考试、大学入学考试以及各种数学挑战等人类测试。请参阅表 1，了解功能主义风格评估的一些示例。功能主义视角可以提供对政策制定者有用的宝贵见解，并轻松识别监管遵守情况或失误，重点是减轻规定性道德护栏所带来的危害和风险。这样的客观视角有助于为人工智能治理提供一个务实的框架，该框架更加以风险为中心，并且可以更容易地利用现有的法律和政策。Functionalist perspectives can dominate AI-Safety dialogues, particularly when making linear outcome predictions. An example would be arguments that generative AI models have some understanding or intelligence, based on them being able to pass human tests such as legal bar and college entrance exams and various mathematical challenges. See Table 1 for a few examples of functionalist style evaluations. A functionalist perspective can contribute valuable insights that are useful for policymakers and easily identify regulation adherence or missteps with a focus on mitigating harms and risks espoused by prescriptive ethical guardrails. Such an objective lens assists with providing a pragmatic framework for AI governance that is more risk-centric and can more easily take advantage of existing laws and policies.

虽然 AGI 的功能主义解释通常依赖于行为等效性；这表明如果一台机器的行为像人类一样，它可能被认为是智能的，甚至是有感知的。这一立场受到越来越多的审查。伊波利托等人。 [172]通过提供一个可证伪的最小感知框架来挑战这些假设，该框架不是基于模仿，而是基于结构和关系标准：积极的自我维护、历史适应性和自主机构。他们认为，当前的人工智能系统，包括法学硕士，可能看起来很流畅，但无法满足这些核心条件。他们的贡献将话题从基于模仿的基准转向了更具生物学和伦理学基础的评估人工智能机构的标准。While functionalist accounts of AGI often lean on behavioural equivalence; suggesting that if a machine behaves like a human, it may be considered intelligent or even sentient. This position has come under increasing scrutiny. Hipólito et al. [172] challenge such assumptions by offering a falsifiable framework for minimal sentience based not on imitation, but on structural and relational criteria: active self-maintenance, historical adaptability, and autonomous agency. According to their view, current AI systems, including LLMs, may appear fluent but fail to meet these core conditions. Their contribution shifts the conversation away from imitation-based benchmarks toward more biologically and ethically grounded criteria for assessing AI agency.
