1.4.2 建构主义1.4.2 Constructivism

建构主义[2]是一个跨越教育、哲学、道德理论和认知科学等学科的概念。它假定我们对世界的认识是Constructivism[2] is a concept embraced across disciplines like education, philosophy, moral theory, and cognitive sciences. It posits that our knowledge of the world is建造的constructed来自观察、经验、文化和世界观。建构主义声称，对我们世界的测量的有效性受到我们的选择和社会背景的影响，这一观点对我们可以对物体声称的客观真理的程度产生影响。在教育学科中，建构主义通常意味着知识是积极互动的结果，例如教师、学生和环境之间的互动[307, 413]，并重视学生主动构建世界上的有形物体[110, 157, 195]。from observations, experiences, cultures, and worldviews. Constructivism purports that the validity of measurements of our world is influenced by our choices and societal context, a viewpoint that has implications for the extent of objective truths we can claim about objects. In the discipline of education, constructivism typically means that knowledge results from active interactions, such as those between teacher, student, and environment [307, 413] and places importance on students actively constructing tangible objects in the world [110, 157, 195].

在科学哲学中，建构主义强调科学知识是由研究人员的集体努力塑造的[218]。更具体地说，社会建构主义研究知识主张、类别和科学实践如何受到社会、历史和制度条件的影响 [214, 218] 相比之下，人工智能中的建构主义是指将学习建模为通过与环境交互而出现的方法，通常借鉴发展和教育理论 [110, 157, 195, 199] 两者是相关的，但它们不可互换。In philosophy of science, constructivism emphasises that scientific knowledge is shaped by the collective efforts of researchers [218]. Social constructivism, more specifically, examines how knowledge claims, categories, and scientific practice are shaped by social, historical, and institutional conditions [214, 218] Constructivism in AI, by contrast, refers to approaches that model learning as emerging through interaction with an environment, often drawing on developmental and educational theory [110, 157, 195, 199] The two are related, but they are not interchangeable.

人工智能领域的建构主义（无论是否明确命名）有着悠久的历史[199]，在神经网络技术的早期发展以及 Logo 等教育编程语言的创建过程中尤其引人注目[300]。当符号人工智能（或优秀的老式人工智能）在 20 世纪下半叶采取更加功能主义的道路时，人工智能中的建构主义概念经历了几次人工智能冬天，但随着预训练深度学习方法的出现而回归，特别是自 2017 年以来[199]。对模型进行建构主义评估，以更好地理解行为和输出如何与影响模型开发和微调的各种人为因素相关联，例如社会技术环境中的偏见、规范假设和普遍价值观。Constructivism (whether explicitly named or not) in the field of AI has a long history [199], and is particularly notable in the early developments of neural network technologies and then again during creation of educational programming languages like Logo [300]. When symbolic-AI (or Good Old Fashioned AI) took a more functionalist path in the latter half of the 20[th] century, constructivist concepts in AI suffered several AI-winters but returned with the advent of pre-trained deep learning approaches, particularly since 2017 [199]. Constructivist evaluations of a model to better understand how behaviours and outputs are relationally linked to a variety of human factors impacting the development and finetuning of models such as bias, normative assumptions, and prevailing values within a sociotechnical environment.

人工智能领域的建构主义工作还通过更明确的社会建构主义登记册与人工智能伦理联系起来。那时，焦点从系统如何学习转移到人工智能如何被机构、话语、规范和权力塑造。例如，肯尼迪与菲利普斯 [203]Constructivist work in AI also connects to AI ethics through a more explicitly socialconstructivist register. At that point the focus shifts from how systems learn to how AI is shaped by institutions, discourse, norms, and power. For example, Kennedy & Phillips [203]

2 建构主义和建构主义是密切相关的术语，都指知识是社会建构的这一观点。实证主义的概念坚持认为知识存在于世界上，我们通过获取知识来学习，而建构主义则强调我们的经验和文化对我们所获得的知识的构建的影响。建构主义通常与认知主义相似，并且心理模型是特殊的而不是普遍的。建构主义建立在建构主义早期作品的基础上，并与技术思想密切相关。建构主义通常包括外部的、物理世界的人工制品，以帮助建立内部构建的模型。为了便于阅读，在本章中，我们将使用原始术语“建构主义”，但承认大量已发表的著作将这两个概念分开。2 Constructivism and Constructionism are closely related terms that both refer to the idea that knowledge is socially constructed. Unlike the concept of Positivism that adheres to the belief that knowledge exists in the world, and we learn by acquiring the knowledge, constructivism highlights the impact our experiences and culture have on the construction of the knowledge we acquire. Constructivism is often similar to cognitivism, and that mental models are idiosyncratic not universal. Constructionism builds on the earlier work of Constructivism and is strongly connected to ideas around technology. Constructionism in general includes external, physical world artefacts to help build internal internally constructed models. For ease of reading, in this chapter, we will use the original term Constructivism but acknowledge the huge body of published work separating the two concepts.

突出人类和人工智能在摆姿势时所构建的关系highlight the constructed relationships between humans and AI when they pose参与游戏The Participation Game作为图灵模仿游戏的 21 世纪更新，探索生成式人工智能和人类如何参与语言作为现实表征的社会建构过程。符号和图像如何与生成人工智能中的知识模式和抽象概念联系起来是一个已确定的问题[246]，也是 2023 年的活跃研究领域，也是建构主义观点的象征。许多科学家采用或主张采用建构主义方法来解决这些问题 [即 157, 195] 更广泛地说，建构主义作为一种元伦理立场，为多元人工智能联盟的进一步工作留下了巨大的空间。as a 21[st] century update to Turing’s Imitation Game, exploring how generative AI and humans can join in social construction processes of language as representations of reality. How symbols and images are connected to knowledge schemas and abstract concepts in generative AI is an identified problem [246] and active area of research in 2023 and is emblematic of constructivist viewpoints. Many scientists employ, or argue for, constructivist approaches to these problems [i.e., 157, 195] More broadly, constructivism as a metaethical stance leaves significant room for further work on pluralist AI alignment.

将知识是由主体与其环境的交互形成的建构主义思想转化为嵌入社会技术人类系统中的人工智能模型，建构主义方法将人工智能视为人类的延伸：通过人机交互与人类主体一起学习和进化。基于建构主义的人工智能系统的目标是产生对人类社会结构、沟通模式具有上下文敏感性并符合适当的人类价值观（无论如何定义）的模型和评估。Translating the constructivist idea that knowledge is shaped by an agent's interactions with their environment, to an AI model embedded in sociotechnical human systems, a constructivist approach would view AI as an extension of humans: learning and evolving in tandem with human agents from human-machine interactions. The goal of constructivist grounded AI systems is to produce models and evaluations that are contextsensitive to human social structures, communication patterns, and aligned to appropriate human values (however defined).

为了使这一点更加具体，人工智能评估的建构主义方法倾向于通过模型和基准中的特定设计选择来实施这些想法。其中包括关注提示如何构建任务、训练数据如何编码文化假设，以及评估协议如何在上下文中解释输出而不是孤立的响应。这些方法没有将评估视为固定能力的中立衡量标准，而是将其视为反映和强化特定认知和社会承诺的情境实践。表 2 总结了如何在当代人工智能系统和评估框架中实例化建构主义原则的关键示例。To make this more concrete, constructivist approaches to AI evaluation tend to operationalise these ideas through specific design choices in both models and benchmarks. These include attention to how prompts frame tasks, how training data encodes cultural assumptions, and how evaluation protocols interpret outputs in context rather than as isolated responses. Rather than treating evaluation as a neutral measurement of fixed capability, these approaches treat it as a situated practice that reflects and reinforces particular epistemic and social commitments. Table 2 summarises key examples of how constructivist principles are instantiated in contemporary AI systems and evaluation frameworks.

从这个角度来看，人工智能模型的学习与人类的参与有着错综复杂的联系。人工智能伦理学经常强调人类在人工智能学习中的影响作用，特别是在开发生成人工智能（GenAI）模型所需的大量训练数据集中编码的刻板印象和偏见。例如，到 2021 年，大多数大型语言模型都主要针对英语文本进行训练，导致对西方和以美国为中心的规范观点和道德产生偏见 [192]。Through this perspective, an AI model's learning is intricately tied to human engagement. The role of human influence in AI learning is often highlighted in AI-Ethics, particularly regarding the stereotypes and biases encoded in the vast training datasets required to develop generative AI (GenAI) models. For example, in 2021 most large language models were trained on predominantly English texts resulting in biases toward western and US-centric normative views and ethics [192].

人类对 GenAI 影响的其他途径包括：模型架构、目标阐明、基准设计、即时工程、微调、通过人类反馈强化学习 (RLHF) 和宪法人工智能方法。考虑将有毒偏见和规范假设纳入人工智能系统的多种途径，以及这些途径如何相互作用以产生有害或不适当的模型，本质上是一种建构主义的努力。它需要对模型的起源和演变有一个整体的看法，并承认主观输入Other pathways of human influence on GenAI include: model architecture, articulation of goals, benchmark design, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, reinforcement learning through human feedback (RLHF), and constitutional AI methods. Considering the multiple avenues of incorporating toxic biases and normative assumptions into an AI system and how those avenues interact with one another to produce a harmful or inappropriate model, is an inherently constructivist endeavour. It requires a holistic view of the model's genesis and evolution as well as acknowledgment of the subjective inputs at

[29 ]

第一章：Chapter 1:负责任的人工智能中的认识论隆隆声Epistemological Rumbles in Responsible AI

人工智能发展的各个阶段。由于人工智能伦理界普遍强调人工智能对人类的影响是由于人工智能设计和情境部署的相互作用而产生的，因此我们可以认为该群体普遍倾向于建构主义观点。each stage of AI development. As the AI-ethics community generally underscores the impact of AI on humans as resulting from the interplay of AI's design, and contextual deployment, we can consider that group to generally tilt toward constructivist perspectives.

1.4.3 一枚硬币的两面1.4.3 Two sides of one coin

重要的是，功能主义和建构主义的观点并不相互排斥。它们只是看待和解释世界的不同观点或镜头；同时持有功能主义和建构主义观点是可能的。差异源于我们选择何时、何地以及如何使用这些框架的决策；可以深刻影响我们对人工智能的道德评估的选择。尽管负责任人工智能研究中功能主义和建构主义的二分框架并没有涵盖所有观点，但它为负责任人工智能辩论中的根本差异之一提供了清晰的分类。这种划分不应被视为方法的强烈两极分化，而是一个微妙的框架，以更好地阐明不同社区之间理解人工智能模型的不同方式。Importantly, functionalist and constructivist perspectives are not mutually exclusive. They are merely different viewpoints or lenses for seeing and interpreting the world; it is possible to hold functionalist and constructivist views concurrently. Differences emerge from decisions regarding when, where, and how we choose to employ these frameworks; choices that can deeply impact our ethical assessment of AI. Though this dichotomous framing of functionalism and constructivism in Responsible-AI research doesn't capture the entire spectrum of perspectives, it provides a perspicacious categorisation for one of the underlying differences in Responsible-AI debates. The division should not be seen as a strong polarization of approaches, rather a nuanced framework to better illuminate different ways of understanding AI models amongst various communities.

1.5 功能主义和功能主义的表现1.5 Manifestations of functionalist and

Responsible-AI 中的建构主义辩论constructivist debates in Responsible-AI

以下是人工智能研究中功能主义/建构主义分歧如何明显的两个案例研究。我这样做的目的不是为了捍卫某一方，而是为了说明人们可以采用不同的方式来处理和理解负责任人工智能研究中的这些趋势辩论。Below are two case studies of how the functionalist/constructivist split in AI research is manifest. My intent in doing so is not to defend one side or the other but to illustrate different ways that one can approach and make sense of these trending debates in Responsible-AI research.

1.5.1 AGI 和存在风险的争论1.5.1 The AGI and existential risk debates

ResponsibleAI 圈子内关于 AGI 的不可能性、潜力或迫在眉睫的争论非常激烈，重点关注可能拥有意识的超级人工智能带来的生存风险。 AGI 通常与意识和感知的讨论联系在一起。一些研究人员认为自我意识是 AGI 的必要组成部分 [216,138,150]。一些人认为更高层次的认知推理是 AGI 的必要条件The debate over AGI's impossibility, potential, or imminence is intense within ResponsibleAI circles, focusing on existential risks from superintelligent AI, possibly possessing consciousness. AGI is often associated with discussions of consciousness and sentience. Some researchers consider self-awareness a necessary component of AGI [216, 138, 150]. Some see higher level cognitive reasoning as a requisite for AGI with a type of计算性的computational意识[33]。其他人则认为机器意识（至少在可预见的未来）要么不可能，要么完全无法证明 [17, 333]。尽管有人认为我们对人类意识的了解也是有限的，但 AGI 倡导者断言，人工意识显然即将到来（伴随着超级智能和奇点），我们必须立即解决我们物种面临的长期生存风险 [34, 334]。consciousness [33]. Others consider machine consciousness (at least in the foreseeable future) is either out of the question or completely unprovable [17, 333]. Despite the arguments that we are limited in what we can say about even human consciousness, AGI advocates assert that artificial consciousness is so obviously on the imminent horizon (with superintelligence and singularities in tow) that we must address the long-term existential risk to our species right now [34, 334].

第一章：Chapter 1:负责任的人工智能中的认识论隆隆声Epistemological Rumbles in Responsible AI

30

功能主义观点评估意识的作用，并开发测试来根据这些基准评估人工智能，通常使用人类行为作为标准（不包括其他智能动物行为）。他们优先考虑可观察的结果，而不是感知或情感等主观体验。虽然通用人工智能、超级智能和人工意识之间的定义界限并不明确，但毫无疑问，所有这些都与对潜在恶意或非人类通用通用人工智能的存在风险的担忧密切相关。斯蒂芬·霍金 [165] 和尼克·博斯特罗姆 [50] 所提出的担忧是一些人工智能安全研究人员经常关注的问题。Functionalist perspectives assess roles of consciousness and develop tests to evaluate AI against these benchmarks, typically using human behaviour as a standard (excluding other intelligent animal behaviours). They prioritise observable outcomes over subjective experiences like perception or emotion. Whilst the definition lines between AGI, superintelligence, and artificial consciousness are fluid, there is no doubt that all these are strongly related to concerns about existential risk from potential malevolent or non-human aligned AGIs. Concerns which had been popularized by Stephen Hawking [165] and Nick Bostrom [50] and are frequent concerns amongst some AI-Safety researchers.

一些研究人员表示，他们确信某些 GenAI 系统已经具有意识，例如前谷歌工程师 Blake Lemoine [222]。或者正如 OpenAI 联合创始人 Ilya Sutskever 在推特上所说的那样，“今天的大型神经网络可能具有轻微的意识”[377]。或者，根据前谷歌研究员 Geoffrey Hinton [206] 和牛津大学人类未来研究所的研究人员的说法，他们还没有到达那里，但已经很接近了 [61]。在讨论 AGI 的风险时，Bengio 等人。 [35] 认为该技术正在迅速超越人类的能力，并带来社会规模的风险，特别是在流氓自主代理的情况下。 OpenAI 的使命宣言“确保 AGI 惠及全人类”代表了那些对即将到来的 AGI 感兴趣的人；这份声明成为 2023 年 11 月下旬董事会崩溃的核心[37]。A few researchers say they are certain some GenAI systems are already conscious such as former Google engineer Blake Lemoine [222]. Or that “it may be that today's large neural networks are slightly conscious” as tweeted by OpenAI co-founder Ilya Sutskever [377]. Or they’re not there yet but are close, as per former Google Researcher Geoffrey Hinton [206] and researchers from the Future of Humanity Institute at Oxford [61]. In discussing the risks of AGI, Bengio et al. [35] argue that the technology is fast surpassing human capabilities and poses societal-scale risks particularly in the case of rogue autonomous agents. Those concerned with impending AGI are emblematised by the OpenAI mission statement “To ensure that AGI benefits all of humanity”; a statement which became the centre of their board meltdown in late November 2023 [37].

大多数人工智能伦理学家表示，对通用人工智能的担忧是对当前社会群体面临的更紧迫风险的危险转移。例如，Rooij 等人，[333] 认为当前的人工智能系统远未达到人类水平的认知，而是提供人类认知扭曲图像的“诱饵”。关于人工智能模型“理解”语言的能力，Browning 和 LeCunn [54] 强调指出“仅接受语言训练的系统永远不会接近人类智能，即使从现在开始训练直到宇宙热寂”（第 24 段）。 Mitchell 和 Krakauer [269] 认为，由于人工智能模型缺乏内部心理状态，它们永远无法“理解”任何东西。所有建构主义风格的论点都坚决反对人工制品行为表明心智模型和理解的观点。Most AI-Ethicists say AGI concerns are dangerous diversions from more pressing risks on current social groups. For instance, Rooij et al., [333] argue that current AI systems are far from achieving human-level cognition and are instead “decoys” offering distorted images of human cognition. On the ability of AI models to “understand” language, Browning and LeCunn [54] emphatically state “A system trained on language alone will never approximate human intelligence, even if trained from now until the heat death of the universe” (para.24). Mitchell & Krakauer [269] argue that as AI models lack internal mental states they can never “understand” anything. All constructivist style arguments that firmly oppose the idea that an artefacts behaviour indicates mental models and understanding.

我们对生物意识的缺乏理解对这些争论产生了重要影响。在文章“成为一只蝙蝠是什么感觉？”托马斯·内格尔[275]强调了真正理解意识体验的挑战——每个意识存在所固有的“它是什么样的”方面——因为它超出了我们自己的领域。内格尔以蝙蝠为例，认为即使我们了解蝙蝠的生物学和神经学原理Our lack of understanding of even biological consciousness has an important influence on these debates. In the essay “What is it like to be a bat?” Thomas Nagel [275] underscored the challenge of truly understanding conscious experience—the "what it's like" aspect inherent to every conscious being—as being outside of our own realm. Using bats as an example, Nagel argues that even if we understand the biological and neurological功能functions对于蝙蝠来说，我们永远无法真正接触或理解它们对世界的独特、主观体验。因此，内格尔挑战了功能主义和还原主义对意识的解释的充分性。同样，“人工智能是什么样子”的问题，或者人工智能是否确实不存在，也带来了同样多的挑战。建构主义方法并不排除 AGI 在人工意识方面的潜力 [70]。然而，为了与建构主义保持一致，互动等因素of bats, we can never truly access or comprehend their unique, subjective experience of the world. As such, Nagel challenges the adequacy of functionalist and reductionist explanations of consciousness. Similarly, the question of "what it is like to be an AI," or if indeed there is not anything it is like to be an AI, presents just as many challenges. A constructivist approach doesn't rule out AGI's potential for artificial consciousness [70]. However, to align with constructivism, factors such as interactive

第一章：Chapter 1:负责任的人工智能中的认识论隆隆声Epistemological Rumbles in Responsible AI

必须考虑涌现、情境悟性、具体经验、独特发展和适应性。许多建构主义理论，如现象学和主观主义，都需要人工智能中定性经验或“质量”的证据，考虑到当前研究的局限性，这是一个具有挑战性的证据。虽然功能主义和建构主义视角都为意识问题提供了有价值的见解，但它们导致了对人工智能本质的根本不同的理解和影响，类似于对蝙蝠主观体验的不同解释。emergence, contextual savvy, embodied experiences, distinctive development, and adaptability must be considered. Many constructivist theories, like phenomenology and subjectivism, demand evidence of qualitative experience or 'quale' in AI, a challenging proof given current research limitations. While both functionalist and constructivist lenses offer valuable insights into the issue of consciousness, they lead to fundamentally different understandings and implications about the nature of AI, akin to the diverse interpretations of the subjective experiences of bats.

2023 年，著名的人工智能安全倡导者散发公开信，呼吁出于对超级智能的担忧而“暂停”人工智能研究，有时将人工智能与流行病和核战争的风险水平进行比较 [62, 137]，并有数千名研究人员签名。这些公开信被通俗地称为In 2023, prominent AI-Safety advocates circulated public letters calling for a “pause” in AI research due to concerns of superintelligence, sometimes comparing AI to a level of risk on par with pandemics and nuclear war [62, 137], and thousands of researchers signedon. These open letters have become colloquially known as暂停字母The Pause letters。批评者（有很多）指责著名签署者试图“护城河”他们的竞争对手以获取经济利益[303]，或者认为签署者（有时称为. Detractors (and there were many) accused notable signatories of trying to “moat out” their competitors for financial gain [303], or argued that signatories (sometimes calledX风险者X-riskers or 厄运者Doomers一些人工智能伦理研究人员提出的观点）忽视了紧迫的人道主义和环境危害 [30, 144]。其他研究人员指出，暂停信函的一些主要签署者是开发公司的首席执行官和高管，他们实际上是有权暂停的人[即 265 引用的惠特克]。 Bryson 认为人工智能安全中心 (CAIS) 的信件是“公开的监管干预”[55]，许多其他人工智能伦理研究人员对暂停信件表示愤怒 [343]。社论文章by some AI-Ethics researchers) were ignoring pressing humanitarian and environmental harms [30, 144]. Other researchers noted that some of the primary signatories to the Pause letters were the same people who had the power to actually enact a pause in that they were CEOs and executives of the development companies [i.e., Whittaker as quoted by 265]. Bryson argued the Center for AI Safety (CAIS) letter was “openly regulatory interference”[55] and numerous other AI-Ethics researchers expressed outrage at the Pause letters [343]. An Editorial piece in自然Nature6 月表示，与作者交谈过的许多人工智能伦理学家对主导辩论的世界末日言论感到沮丧，他们担心这会提高科技公司的财政优势并削弱监管力度 [277]。几乎所有暂停信件的批评者都表示担心这些信件未能充分解决当前人工智能的社会技术问题。简而言之，人工智能伦理界认为人工智能安全界未能考虑问题的构建方面，并且过于短视地关注功能定义的长期预测。in June stated that many of the AI ethicists the authors had spoken to were frustrated by the doomsday rhetoric dominating debates, which they feared was improving the fiscal advantage of tech firms and weakening regulatory efforts [277]. Virtually all critics of the Pause letters expressed concerns that these letters failed to adequately address current sociotechnical issues of AI. In short, the AI-Ethics community felt that the AI-Safety community was failing to consider the constructed aspects of the problem and was focusing too myopically on functionally defined long-term projections.

2022 年下半年，计算语言学协会（ACL）对 327 名受访者进行的一项调查表明，大多数受访者认为 AGI 令人担忧（58%）和即将到来（57%），一些人认为核战争级别的灾难性风险是一个可能的后果（36%）[116]。然而，67% 的受访者认为自己是男性，只有 25% 是女性，58% 来自美国（其次是欧洲，比例为 11%），这表明人口结构存在明显倾向。有效利他主义者（EA）团体发表的报告In the later part of 2022, a survey of 327 respondents from the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL), indicated that the majority of those surveyed believed that AGI is concerning (58%) and incoming (57%), and some agreed that catastrophic risk on the level of nuclear war is a plausible consequence (36%) [116]. However, 67% of the respondents identified as men and only 25% as women and 58% hailed from the US (the next highest representation being Europe at 11%) indicating significant leanings in the demographics. A report published by the effective altruist (EA) group重新思考Rethink对 2407 名美国在线付费受访者态度的调查表明，受访者主要 (59%) 支持暂停信 [116]。然而，人口统计数据并未随报告一起发布。引用这份报告的媒体头条广为流传，并且在篝火上发挥了汽油的作用。 EA 运动通常与 AI 相关联on the attitudes of 2407 paid online US-based respondents indicated respondents predominantly (59%) supported the Pause letters [116]. However, the demographic data was not released with the report. Media headlines citing this report were well circulated and performed functionally to gasoline on a bonfire. The EA movement is often associated with the AI-

第一章：Chapter 1:负责任的人工智能中的认识论隆隆声Epistemological Rumbles in Responsible AI

32

安全社区[240,143,148,248]并寻求确保帮助人类的资源在功利主义框架中发挥最大作用。 EA 的人工智能安全方法反映了他们更大的理念：通过基于证据的策略优化结果，优先考虑人工智能最小化风险和提高收益的能力。这种功能主义观点将道德行为和决策等同于清晰、有针对性的系统的结果。然而，许多人工智能伦理学家认为这种观点过分强调可测量的数据，忽视了更广泛的伦理原则，如美德伦理和各种元伦理概念。Safety community [240, 143, 148, 248] and seeks to ensure resources to assist humans are used to maximum effect in a utilitarianist framework. The EA approach to AI-safety reflects their larger philosophy: optimizing outcomes with evidence-based tactics, prioritizing AI's ability to minimize risks and enhance benefits. This functionalist view equates ethical actions and decisions to the results of clear, targeted systems. However, many AI Ethicists argue this perspective overemphasizes measurable data, neglecting broader ethical principles like virtue ethics and diverse metaethical concepts.

AGI 争论并不纯粹是学术性的。双方的论文和分析不仅影响媒体叙述和公众对这些技术的道德安全的看法，而且影响治理和政策制定决策[例如。 12, 393]。了解这场辩论中的核心差异有助于我们了解那些更关心 AGI 风险的人在负责任的人工智能方法以及他们向媒体、政府和行业提出的建议和建议方面如何与人工智能伦理学家的优先事项存在分歧。The AGI debate is not purely academic. Papers and analyses from both sides not only impact media narratives and public perceptions of the ethical safety of these technologies but also governance and policy making decisions [e.g. 12, 393]. Understanding the core differences in this debate helps us see how those more concerned with AGI risks diverge from the priorities of AI-Ethicists in their approaches to Responsible-AI and thus their advice and recommendations to media, government, and industry.

1.5.2 AI模型评估1.5.2 Evaluations of AI models

负责任的人工智能研究人员的差异也与人工智能模型评估过程的方法有关。一个关键的驱动因素是社会科学和计算机科学之间测量有效性方法的差异[188]。在社会科学中，非常强调建构有效性：调查和测试等测量工具是否真正概括了它们声称要测量的抽象概念（即智力、理解、推理或道德）。社会科学家竭尽全力确保他们的工具不会受到参与者偏见、社会期望或其他情境或背景因素等因素的影响[23]。在整个数据收集过程中，社会科学家的任务是反复自我反思这个问题：这个工具是否捕捉到了我想要测量的预期本质或结构？Responsible-AI researcher differences also pertain to methodologies around evaluation processes of AI models. A key driver is differences in approaches to measurement validity between the social sciences and computer sciences [188]. In social sciences there is a strong emphasis on construct validity: whether measurement tools, such as surveys and tests, genuinely encapsulate the abstract concepts (i.e., intelligence, understanding, reasoning, or morals) they claim to measure. Social scientists go to great lengths to ensure their instruments are not confounded by elements such as participant bias, social desirability, or other situational or contextual factors [23]. Throughout the data collection process, a social scientist is tasked with repeatedly self-reflecting on the question: is this instrument capturing the intended essence or construct that I want to measure?

在计算机科学中，有效性通常侧重于算法或模型是否真正遵守其预定义的指标，而不受外部因素或噪音的污染。主要关注的是稳健性和可重复性。计算机科学家将注意减轻硬件不一致、输入变化、数据质量和其他因素。然而，如今计算机科学家更频繁地基于这些认知框架来衡量 GenAI 模型中不可观察的理论概念。这些计算机科学设计的评估测试通过更适合可观察且易于量化的指标的测量模型来操作，例如模型在以人为本的考试中正确回答了多少个问题[188, 320]。这种将指标与机制联系起来以及为道德和道德等抽象概念创建不准确衡量标准的错位可能会造成有害的社会和个人影响[181,230,354]。In computer science, validity often takes a different emphasis focusing on whether algorithms or models genuinely adhere to their pre-defined metrics without being tainted by external factors or noise. Chief concerns are robustness and reproducibility. A computer scientist will take care to mitigate hardware inconsistencies, varying input, data quality, and other factors. Yet, more frequently these days computer scientists are building on these epistemic frameworks to measure GenAI models for unobservable theoretic concepts. These computer science designed evaluation tests are operationalised via a measurement model more suited to observable and easily quantifiable metrics such as how many questions did a model answer correctly on a human-oriented exam [188, 320]. Such misalignments in linking metrics to mechanisms and creating inaccurate measures for abstract concepts such as ethics and morals can cause harmful social and individual impacts [181, 230, 354].

[33 ]

第一章：Chapter 1:负责任的人工智能中的认识论隆隆声Epistemological Rumbles in Responsible AI

测量抽象结构有效性的社会科学方法本质上更倾向于建构主义，而计算机科学方法显然更倾向于功能主义。对于计算机科学和社会科学来说，测量有效性和可靠性的根本问题仍然是一致的。然而，这两个领域的研究人员在讨论如何实施或管理 Responsible AI 工作时可能不会考虑他们的测量方法差异，从而导致群体之间可能产生误解。然而，这两种方法对于 Responsible-AI 领域都非常有用The social science approach to measurement validity of an abstract construct is fundamentally more constructivist in nature and the computer science approach is obviously more functionalist. The underlying issues in measurement validity and reliability remain consistent for both computer and social sciences. Yet researchers from those two fields may not consider their measurement methodological differences when discussing how to implement or manage Responsible-AI efforts resulting in the potential for misunderstandings between groups. Both methods, however, can be highly useful to the field of Responsible-AI当以适合上下文的方式使用时。when used in contextually appropriate ways.

为了探索这些差异，让我们考虑一套流行的（且有争议的）人工智能评估基准。称为常识推理，典型的例子是 Winograd-Schema Challenge (WSC) [224]。当新的 GenAI 模型推出时，几乎所有随附的发布文件或技术报告都会引用旨在评估模型展示常识推理能力的基准。如果我们检查原始的 WCS（为了简单起见），我们会发现该测试旨在通过​​向 AI 模型提供代词引用不明确的句子对来衡量常识推理的抽象概念。也许最著名的例子是：To explore these differences let’s consider a popular (and contested) suite of AI evaluation benchmarks. called Commonsense Reasoning, canonically exemplified by the Winograd-Schema Challenge (WSC) [224]. Benchmarks aimed at evaluating a model's capability to exhibit commonsense reasoning are cited in virtually every accompanying release paper or technical report when a new GenAI model comes out. If we examine the original WCS (for simplicity), we see the test purports to measure the abstract concept of commonsense reasoning by presenting AI models with sentence pairs where a pronoun's reference is ambiguous. Perhaps the most well-known example is:

1.“奖杯太大了，放不进手提箱。”“The trophy doesn’t fit in the suitcase because it’s too large.”

  1. “奖杯放不进手提箱，因为它太小了。”“The trophy doesn’t fit in the suitcase because it’s too small.”

每个句子中的代词“it”都有不同的指称。虽然这对人类来说似乎很简单，但许多人工智能模型多年来一直在努力解决这些难题。测试工具的广泛假设是，模型正确的谜题越多，幕后发生的一些“推理”就越有可能。这种高度功能主义的方法来衡量推理的理论概念，导致一些研究人员随后声称先进的 GenAI 模型的行为表明了 AGI 的火花；和其他人对这一测量假设提出质疑[例如，73、270]。The pronoun "it" in each sentence has a different referent. While this might seem straightforward to a human, many AI models struggled with these puzzles for years. The broad assumption of the testing instrument was that the more of these puzzles the model got right, the more likely there was some “reasoning” going on under the hood. This highly functionalist approach to measuring the theoretical concept of reasoning has led some researchers to subsequently claim behaviour of advanced GenAI models as indicative of sparks of AGI; and others to contest this measurement assumption [e.g., 73, 270].

2023 年最具争议的论文之一是One of the most controversial papers of 2023 was通用人工智能的火花：GPT-4 的早期实验Sparks of Artificial General Intelligence: Early Experiments with GPT-4[57] 主要由微软的研究人员撰写。 《火花论文》认为，GPT-4 模型已经获得了“一种通用智能的形式，确实展现了人工通用智能的火花”。 [57，p.92] 作者的主张基于对他们所声称的核心心理能力的评估，包括数学难题、推理、演绎、专家知识水平和玩游戏。 Sparks论文中描述的评估方法可以被认为是功能主义思维的例子；也就是说，评估取决于模型的功能输出与相同测试中的预期人类输出相一致。当人类和机器的结果一致时，可以推断 GPT4 中很可能正在发生与人脑类似的事情。[57] written primarily by researchers at Microsoft. The “Sparks Paper” argued that the GPT-4 model had attained “a form of general intelligence, indeed showing sparks of artificial general intelligence.” [57, p.92] The authors based their claim on evaluations of what they asserted to be core mental capabilities including math puzzles, reasoning, deduction, expert levels of knowledge, and playing games. The evaluation methods described in the Sparks paper can be considered examples of functionalist thinking; that is, the evaluations depended on functional outputs of the model aligning with expected human outputs on the same tests. Where the humans and machines results aligned it was inferred that it is likely that something similar is going on in GPT4 as human brains.

34

Sparks 的论文受到了媒体的广泛报道；以及人工智能伦理学家的广泛批评。斯坦福大学研究人员的回应，The Sparks paper received significant media coverage; as well as widespread criticism from AI-Ethicists. A response by Stanford researchers,大型语言模型的新兴能力是海市蜃楼吗？Are Emergent Abilities of Large Language Models a Mirage?认为“涌现能力的出现是由于研究人员对度量标准的选择，而不是由于模型行为随规模的根本变化”[349，p.1]。另一篇论文认为，Sparks 论文中引用的新兴能力是由于从训练数据中进行上下文学习而产生的[237]。另一组研究人员[243]强调了他们认为逻辑中的一个根本缺陷，即功能主义语言思维关系（以图灵测试为特征）的谬误，该关系假设擅长语言的实体拥有推理能力。他们主张在人工智能社区中更好地区分形式语言能力和功能语言能力，认为 GenAI 模型是“良好的语言模型，但人类思维的不完整模型 [243，p.1]argued that “emergent abilities appear due to the researcher's choice of metric rather than due to fundamental changes in model behaviour with scale” [349, p.1]. Another paper argued that the emergent abilities cited in the Sparks paper were due to in-context learning from the training data [237]. Another set of researchers [243] highlighted what they saw as a fundamental flaw in the logic whereby the fallacy of the functionalist language-thought relationship (characterised in the Turing test) that posits entities good at language possesses reasoning capabilities. They advocated for a better distinction in the AI community between formal and functional language competencies arguing that GenAI models are “good models of language but incomplete models of human thought [243, p.1]

GenAI 的常识或推理评估基准越来越多，这里无法一一列出。一些值得注意的包括：HellaSwag [429]、SuperGLUE [414]、Unicorn on Rainbow [236] 和 BIG-bench [366]。常识性基准通常在设计上是功能主义的，也是规范性的，因为有一个定义的“成功”目标指标可以反映设计者的规范性假设。这些和其他评估设计考虑因素引起了人工智能伦理界的严厉批评[103,350,208,51,229,245]，特别是在基准声称报告的测量有效性方面。值得注意的是，WSC 的最初设计者之一 Ernest Davis [98] 也对常识基准的有效性进行了反击：There is a growing plethora of commonsense or reasoning evaluation benchmarks for GenAI, far too many to list here. Some notable ones include: HellaSwag [429], SuperGLUE [414], Unicorn on Rainbow [236], and BIG-bench [366]. Commonsense benchmarks are usually functionalist in design as well as prescriptive in that there is a defined target metric of ‘success’ may reflect the designer’s normative assumptions. These and other evaluation design considerations have drawn heavy criticism from the AI-Ethics community [103, 350, 208, 51, 229, 245] particularly in regard to the measurement validity of what the benchmarks are claiming to report on. Significantly, one of the original designers of the WSC, Ernest Davis [98], has also hit back at the validity of commonsense benchmarks:

“已经开发了一百多个基准来测试人工智能（AI）系统的常识知识和常识推理能力。然而，这些基准往往存在缺陷，常识的许多方面仍未经过测试。因此，我们目前没有任何可靠的方法来衡量现有人工智能系统在多大程度上实现了这些能力”[98]。“More than one hundred benchmarks have been developed to test the commonsense knowledge and commonsense reasoning abilities of artificial intelligence (AI) systems. However, these benchmarks are often flawed and many aspects of commonsense remain untested. Consequently, we do not currently have any reliable way of measuring to what extent existing AI systems have achieved these abilities” [98].

这种基准测试风格的另一个重要考虑因素是Another important consideration in this style of benchmark is谁是who’s常识被包括/排除[192]。考虑基准commonsense is being included/excluded [192]. Consider the benchmark伦理数据集The ETHICS dataset旨在评估法学硕士的道德判断[168]，该判断依赖于对名为“Am I the Asshole”的 Reddit 子版块“Am I the Asshole”[168] 的公众贡献的道德判断的校准。这就引出了一个问题，Reddit 子论坛中代表了谁的道德？它们在上下文中是否适合衡量人工智能模型的道德行为？that seeks to evaluate LLMs on their moral judgements [168] which relies on calibration of the moral judgements on public contributions to a sub-Reddit called “Am I the Asshole” [168]. This begs the question, who’s morals are being represented in that sub-Reddit forum and are they contextually appropriate for measuring an AI model’s ethical behaviours?

流行的功能主义风格基准的其他陷阱包括：Other pitfalls for popular functionalist-style benchmarks include:

  1. 文化偏见和背景：Cultural Bias and Context:规定性基准通常反映设计基准的团体的文化、历史和社会规范。因此，他们可能会无意中优先考虑特定的文化观点，而将其他观点置于一边。Prescriptive benchmarks often reflect the cultural, historical, and social norms of the groups designing them. Consequently, they might inadvertently prioritise a specific cultural viewpoint, sidelining others.

[35 ]

第一章：Chapter 1:负责任的人工智能中的认识论隆隆声Epistemological Rumbles in Responsible AI

  1. 过分强调表面知识：Overemphasis on Surface-Level Knowledge:虽然一些基准衡量模型的能力While some benchmarks gauge a model's ability to再现reproduce常识性知识，他们可能无法评估义务论和功利主义道德框架之外的伦理考虑，例如美德伦理和道德价值多元化等非规范伦理。例如，在一种文化中看似中立或事实的句子或问题在另一种文化中可能会引起争议或敏感。commonsense knowledge, they might fail to evaluate ethical considerations beyond deontological and utilitarianist moral frameworks, such as virtue ethics and non-normative ethics like moral value pluralism. For example, sentence or question that appears neutral or factual in one culture might be contentious or sensitive in another.

  2. 缺乏道德和情感的细微差别：Lack of Ethical and Emotional Nuance:计算机科学中突出的二元评估可能会错过社会科学优先考虑的灰色地带。考虑道德困境（如电车难题）、情绪激动的场景（医疗协助自杀）或所有人都不清楚正确选择的其他场景（即如何管理 Covid-19 大流行）。虽然人工智能可能在技术上表现出评估设计者定义的成功输出，但它可能缺乏敏感性或上下文适当的细微差别。Binary evaluations prominent in computer science may miss out on the grey areas that social sciences prioritise. Consider moral dilemmas (cue, the Trolley Problem), emotionally charged scenarios (medically assisted suicides), or other scenarios where the right choice is unclear to all (i.e. how to manage the Covid-19 pandemic). While an AI might technically exhibit successful outputs defined by the evaluation designer, it might lack sensitivity or contextually appropriate nuance.

评估基准的功能主义方法寻求设计精确的基准来评估依赖于规范性设计过程的模型。然而，这些基准可能会无意中过度简化人类经验和理解的复杂性。另一方面，建构主义方法或描述性评估虽然强调捕捉抽象结构本质的重要性，但有时也会陷入过于复杂的陷阱。由于建构主义试图囊括广泛的人类情感、文化和信仰，因此建构主义方法有时会变得模糊且难以标准化。如果我们能够在计算机科学家、社会科学家和许多其他学科之间促进更多的跨协作基准设计，那么毫无疑问，我们最终可能会得到更强大的基准，并且可以在整个行业中制定一些标准化，而这些标准化在道德上对人类的多元体验仍然敏感。Functionalist approaches to evaluation benchmarks seek to design precise benchmarks for evaluating models that rely on prescriptive design processes. However, these benchmarks can inadvertently oversimplify the complexities of human experience and understanding. On the other hand, constructivist approaches, or descriptive evaluations, while emphasising the importance of capturing the essence of abstract constructs, can sometimes fall into the pitfalls of overcomplexity. Since constructivism attempts to encapsulate a broad spectrum of human emotions, cultures, and beliefs, constructivist approaches can occasionally become ambiguous and difficult to standardise. If we were able to foster more cross-collaborative benchmark designs between computer scientists, social scientists, and many other disciplines, there is little doubt we would likely end up with more robust benchmarks and could develop some standardisation across the industry that remains ethically sensitive to a plurality of human experiences.

虽然功能主义和建构主义都为解释人工智能行为和指导早期评估方法提供了宝贵的哲学视角，但它们越来越难以适应现代人工智能系统的递归、自主和上下文敏感的性质。随着系统变得更加多模式、生成性和代理性，基于产出的评估和社会建构主义批评的局限性变得更加明显。这些框架的设计初衷并不是考虑在动态展开的环境中学习、适应和参与的系统。接下来，我将介绍Enactivism，这是一种关系型、具体化和面向过程的范式，它综合了两种传统的元素，同时为负责任的人工智能的伦理和认识论挑战提供了一种更具响应性的方法。While both Functionalism and Constructivism have provided valuable philosophical lenses for interpreting AI behaviour and guiding early evaluation methods, they increasingly struggle to accommodate the recursive, autonomous, and context-sensitive nature of modern AI systems. As systems grow more multimodal, generative, and agentic, the limitations of output-based assessments and social constructivist critiques become more apparent. These frameworks were not designed to account for systems that learn, adapt, and participate within dynamically unfolding environments. In what follows, I introduce Enactivism, a relational, embodied, and process-oriented paradigm that synthesises elements of both traditions while offering a more responsive approach to the ethical and epistemological challenges of Responsible AI.

第一章：Chapter 1:负责任的人工智能中的认识论隆隆声Epistemological Rumbles in Responsible AI

36

1.6 现代方法：行动主义1.6 A modern approach: enactivism

1.6.1 激活主义简介1.6.1 Introduction to Enactivism

生成主义是更广泛的 4E 认知框架（体现、嵌入、扩展和制定认知）中的一个有影响力的理论，它将认知定位为主体与其环境之间的动态交互，而不是内部表征的处理。源于 Maturana、Varela、Thompson 和 Rosch 的著作[105,249,407]，生成主义强调有机体的感知、行动和环境的相互作用，提出认知过程是通过主动参与而不是被动计算而产生的涌现现象。Enactivism is an influential theory within the broader 4E cognition framework (embodied, embedded, extended, and enacted cognition) that positions cognition not as the processing of internal representations, but as a dynamic interaction between agents and their environments. Originating from the works of Maturana, Varela, Thompson, and Rosch [105, 249, 407], Enactivism emphasises the reciprocal interplay of an organism's perception, action, and the environment, proposing that cognitive processes are emergent phenomena arising through active engagement rather than passive computation.

功能主义将认知主要视为系统内的计算过程，而建构主义强调知识的社会和经验形成，而生成主义则通过将认知牢固地置于具体的互动中来综合这些观点。它认为认知是一个本质上的关系过程，是通过持续的主体-环境耦合主动构建的。这种综合立场使Enactivism特别适合解决负责任人工智能的当代挑战，特别是在自主生成代理、多模式人工智能和专家混合模型（MoE）的开发和评估方面。While Functionalism views cognition primarily as computational processes within systems, and Constructivism highlights the socially and experientially situated formation of knowledge, Enactivism synthesises these perspectives by situating cognition firmly in embodied interactions. It posits that cognition is an inherently relational process, constructed actively through continuous agent-environment couplings. This integrative stance makes Enactivism particularly suitable for addressing contemporary challenges in Responsible AI, especially concerning the development and evaluation of autonomous generative agents, multimodal AI, and Mixture of Experts models (MoEs).

4E 认知为当代认知科学提供了基础见解，特别是在 Responsible AI 等背景下。它强调认知、感知和行动的相互依赖性，并大量借鉴建构主义原则，认为认知是通过系统与其环境的动态互动而产生的[262,407,282]。 4E 认为理解不是局限于大脑或内部过程，而是来自于情境互动中的积极参与。在这个框架内，具体化本身是沿着一个范围来解释的：从“弱”观点，其中身体仅支持认知[85]，到“强”立场，其中具体化是构成性的，认知被理解为交互的新兴属性。这些解释与道德认知特别相关：一些学者认为道德判断源于身体反应[285, 315]，这提出了关于我们如何评估无形人工智能主体和多主体系统的道德能力的重要问题。最终，4E 强调智力不是从环境中抽象出来的，而是通过有机体嵌入周围世界并对其做出反应而产生的。4E cognition provides foundational insights into contemporary cognitive science, particularly in contexts like Responsible AI. It emphasises the interdependence of cognition, perception, and action, and draws heavily from constructivist principles to suggest that cognition arises through a system’s dynamic engagements with its environment [262, 407, 282]. Rather than being confined to the brain or internal processes, 4E posits that understanding emerges from active participation within contextually situated interactions. Within this framework, embodiment itself is interpreted along a spectrum: from “weak” views, where the body merely supports cognition [85], to “strong” positions in which embodiment is constitutive and cognition is understood as an emergent property of interaction. These interpretations have particular relevance for moral cognition: some scholars argue that moral judgements originate in bodily reactions [285, 315] raising important questions about how we evaluate the ethical capacities of disembodied AI agents and multi-agent systems. Ultimately, 4E highlights that intelligence is not abstracted from context but arises through an organism’s embeddedness in, and responsiveness to, the world around it.

在生成主义中，认知是通过In enactivism, cognition emerges through a动态相互作用dynamic interplay主体与其环境之间的关系，强调积极参与而非单纯代表的重要性。激活主义概念已应用于机器人技术和 GenAI 的各种努力中，以推进开发并了解它们在机器人上所做的事情between an agent and its environment, emphasising the importance of active engagement over mere representation. Enactivist concepts have been applied to various endeavours in robotics and GenAI both to advance development and to understand what they are doing on a

第一章：Chapter 1:负责任的人工智能中的认识论隆隆声Epistemological Rumbles in Responsible AI

更深层次[7,133,348]。激活主义与体现方法一致，但在此基础上通过包括代理和自治[105, 348]使其成为理解多模式系统和自治代理的更合适的工具。使用enactivism来解决AI对齐问题也有一些初步步骤，例如尝试使用这些概念使AI在本体论上更类似于人类[64]。这种方法与功能主义重叠，认识到外部结构和工具不仅是促进者，而且是认知系统的组成部分。生成主义与建构主义观点的不同之处在于它强调认知的体现和情境性。从本质上讲，虽然所有的生成主义方法本质上都可以被认为是建构主义的，但并非所有的建构主义方法都是生成主义的。因此，生成主义可以被视为建构主义原则的具体体现，它特别关注身体及其环境的积极作用。deeper level [7, 133, 348]. Enactivism agrees with embodiment approaches but builds on that by including agency and autonomy [105, 348] making it a more suitable tool for understanding multimodal systems and autonomous agents. There are also some initial steps toward using enactivism to address AI-alignment, such as attempting to use the concepts to make AI ontologically more similar to humans [64]. This approach overlaps with functionalism in recognizing that external structures and tools are not just facilitators but integral components of cognitive systems. Where enactivism does diverge from constructivist views is in its emphasis on the embodiment and situatedness of cognition. In essence, while all enactivist approaches can be considered constructivist in nature, not all constructivist approaches are enactivist. Therefore, enactivism can be seen as a particular embodiment of constructivist principles, with a distinct focus on the active role of the body and its environment.

1.6.2 历史和哲学基础1.6.2 Historical and Philosophical Foundations

激活主义的哲学根源深深植根于现象学和二阶控制论。弗朗西斯科·瓦雷拉 (Francisco Varela)、埃文·汤普森 (Evan Thompson) 和埃莉诺·罗什 (Eleanor Rosch) 在《具身心灵》[407] 中引入了该术语，强调认知是一种具身和相关的现象。他们的框架的核心是自创生的概念：自组织系统通过与环境的相互作用不断再生和维持自身。The philosophical roots of Enactivism lie deeply embedded in phenomenology and secondorder cybernetics. Francisco Varela, Evan Thompson, and Eleanor Rosch introduced the term in "The Embodied Mind" [407], highlighting cognition as an embodied and relational phenomenon. Central to their framework is the concept of autopoiesis: self-organising systems continually regenerating and maintaining themselves through interactions with their environment.

安迪·克拉克（Andy Clark）和大卫·查尔默斯（David Chalmers）通过他们的“扩展思维”假说进一步扩展了Enactivism，该假说提出认知并不局限于个人思维，而是延伸到环境人工制品和互动中[85]。虽然生成主义和扩展思维假说都拒绝认知的内在主义解释，但生成主义更强调生活互动和意义建构随时间的连续性，而不是跨工具的心理过程的功能分布。这些理论共同从根本上重塑了对认知过程的理解，为当代人工智能研究中应用主义的应用奠定了基础，特别是在新兴代理和关系自治的分析中。Andy Clark and David Chalmers further extended Enactivism through their "Extended Mind" hypothesis, which proposes that cognition is not confined to the individual mind but extends into environmental artefacts and interactions [85]. While both Enactivism and the Extended Mind hypothesis reject internalist accounts of cognition, Enactivism places greater emphasis on lived interaction and the continuity of sense-making over time, rather than the functional distribution of mental processes across tools. Together, these theories have fundamentally reshaped understandings of cognitive processes, laying foundations for contemporary applications of Enactivism in AI research, particularly in the analysis of emergent agency and relational autonomy.

1.6.3 可供性和关系认知1.6.3 Affordances and Relational Cognition

理解Enactivism 对 Responsible AI 的贡献的核心是可供性的概念，该概念首先由 Gibson [147] 提出，随后在生态心理学中得到完善。可供性描述了环境为代理提供的可行机会，具体取决于代理的能力和意图。例如，椅子可供人类坐着，但可供幼儿攀爬。Central to understanding Enactivism’s contribution to Responsible AI is the concept of affordances, first introduced by Gibson [147] and subsequently refined in ecological psychology. Affordances describe actionable opportunities provided by an environment to an agent, depending on the agent’s capabilities and intentions. For example, a chair affords sitting to a human but climbing to a toddler.

第一章：Chapter 1:负责任的人工智能中的认识论隆隆声Epistemological Rumbles in Responsible AI

38

功能可供性通过弥合功能主义对计算输出的关注和建构主义对社会情境互动的强调之间的差距，帮助实施启用主义。实际上，这意味着可供性表明智能行为不仅仅是内部计算或事后社会构建的东西，而是通过智能体与其世界之间持续协商实时制定的东西。在负责任的人工智能环境中，可供性不仅对于评估至关重要Affordances help operationalise Enactivism by bridging the gap between Functionalism’s focus on computational outputs and Constructivism’s emphasis on socially situated interactions. In practical terms, this means affordances show how intelligent behaviour is not just something computed internally or socially constructed after the fact, but something enacted in real-time through the ongoing negotiation between an agent and its world. In Responsible AI contexts, affordances are crucial for evaluating not just什么what一个系统可以做到，但是a system can do, but它如何实时解释和参与其操作环境how it interprets and engages with its operational environment in real time .

例如，考虑一辆在复杂的城市环境中行驶的自动驾驶汽车。这种车辆可以动态地感知可供性，例如为行人停车、安全加速通过十字路口或调整道路危险周围的轨迹。类似地，虚拟环境中的自主生成代理基于上下文和关系动态而不是单独的预编程指令来识别交互的可供性（例如与模拟用户交谈、避免冲突场景或启动合作任务）。即使大型语言模型 (LLM) 也能从可供性角度受益，其响应的有效性取决于动态评估对话上下文、用户意图和文化规范，而不仅仅是复制训练数据中的模式。可供性揭示了激活主义如何将认知操作为适应性和关系性的，基于上下文而不是静态设计。Consider, for instance, an autonomous vehicle navigating a complex urban environment. Such a vehicle dynamically perceives affordances like stopping for pedestrians, accelerating safely through intersections, or adjusting trajectories around road hazards. Similarly, an autonomous generative agent in a virtual environment identifies affordances for interaction (such as conversing with simulated users, avoiding conflict scenarios, or initiating cooperative tasks) based on context and relational dynamics rather than pre-programmed instructions alone. Even large language models (LLMs) benefit from an affordance perspective, where the effectiveness of their responses depends on dynamically assessing conversational context, user intent, and cultural norms rather than merely replicating patterns from training data. Affordances reveal how Enactivism operationalises cognition as adaptive and relational, grounded in context rather than static design.

1.6.4 赋能主义应用于人工智能1.6.4 Enactivism Applied to AI

功能主义和建构主义本身越来越不足以解决先进人工智能系统（如多模式和 MoE 模型以及利用各种人工智能技术的多模式堆栈）的伦理和安全挑战。具有处理和生成文本、图像和声音能力的模型为 Responsible-AI 实践增加了复杂性，而仅靠功能主义或建构主义可能无法解决这些问题。此外，自主生成代理[301, 415]的兴起，有望成为人工智能的主导趋势，通过将人工代理或多代理系统（MAS）集合引入到可能与人类用户交互的构建环境中，或者在机器人技术与物理世界的情况下，放大了这些挑战。生成代理带来了大范围的潜在伦理风险，特别是因为一些研究人员已经建议将该技术用作人类的替身来评估 GenAI 模型 [231]，并作为社会科学研究中人类行为实验的代理 [109, 156]。Functionalism and constructivism are increasingly insufficient in themselves to address the ethical and safety challenges of advanced AI systems like multimodal and MoE models, and multimodal stacks leveraging a variety of AI technologies. Models with the capacity to process and generate text, image, and sound, add layers of complexity to Responsible-AI practices that likely can’t be addressed by either functionalism or constructivism alone. Additionally, the rise of autonomous generative agents [301, 415], poised to become a dominant AI trend, amplifies these challenges by introducing artificial agents or collections of multi-agent systems (MAS) into constructed environments that may interact with human users, or in the case of robotics with the physical world. Generative agents open large areas of potential ethical risks, particularly as there has already been suggestions from some researchers that this technology be used as stand-ins for humans in evaluations of GenAI models [231] and as a proxy for experimenting with human behaviour in social science research [109, 156].

随着人工智能系统变得更加复杂、适应性强、自主并嵌入到物理环境中，纯粹的功能主义或建构主义观点可能会忽视关键的伦理As AI systems grow more complex, adaptive, autonomous, and embedded in physical environments a purely functionalist or constructivist viewpoint may overlook critical ethical

[39 ]

第一章：Chapter 1:负责任的人工智能中的认识论隆隆声Epistemological Rumbles in Responsible AI

这些系统在我们的生活中扮演的根深蒂固且积极的角色所产生的安全影响。这些发展需要对 ResponsibleAI 的方法进行修改。and safety implications that arise from the deeply embedded and enactive roles these systems play in our lives. Such developments demand a revised approach to ResponsibleAI.

要将Enactivism应用于负责任的人工智能，我们不仅必须评估人工智能系统做什么，还要评估它们如何做到这一点：它们的行为如何通过与特定用户、环境和文化背景的交互而显现。行动主义评估并不假设认知仅限于内部系统或可简化为行为主义输出。相反，它强调了认知是如何通过动态的、关系性的和具体化的交互来制定的。To apply Enactivism to Responsible AI, we must evaluate not just what AI systems do but how they come to do it: how their behaviours emerge through interactions with specific users, environments, and cultural settings. Enactivist evaluation does not assume that cognition is confined to an internal system or reducible to behaviourist outputs. Instead, it foregrounds how cognition is enacted through dynamic, relational, and embodied interactions.

功能主义可能强调系统执行特定计算任务的能力，而建构主义可能会检查这些任务的社会文化框架，而激活主义则增加了第三个轴：意义如何从系统与世界之间的纠缠中产生。在评估自主和生成代理时，这种观点尤其重要，因为它们越来越多地在开放式、不可预测的环境中运行。Where Functionalism may emphasise a system's capacity to perform specific computational tasks, and Constructivism may examine the sociocultural framing of those tasks, Enactivism adds a third axis: how meaning emerges from the entanglement between system and world. This perspective is especially crucial when evaluating autonomous and generative agents, which increasingly operate in open-ended, unpredictable environments.

可供性在这里提供了一个强大的概念工具。它们使我们能够根据人工智能系统的设计、训练、实施（如果适用）以及与人类代理的交互，检查人工智能系统在给定环境中可以感知的可操作内容。评估可供性意味着不仅要评估人工智能系统是否能够做出响应，还要评估它如何受到可能行动的影响以及如何塑造可能的行动领域。Affordances provide a powerful conceptual tool here. They allow us to examine what an AI system can perceive as actionable in a given context, based on its design, training, embodiment (if applicable), and interface with human agents. Evaluating affordances means assessing not only whether an AI system can respond, but how it is shaped by and shapes the field of possible actions.

第一章：Chapter 1:负责任的人工智能中的认识论隆隆声Epistemological Rumbles in Responsible AI

40

人工智能领域的生成主义学者的最新贡献[65,172,344]通过探索生成主义原则如何为社会智能、自适应和参与性人工智能体的设计提供信息，进一步丰富了这一观点。在 Safron 等人关于 Bio A.I. 的 [344] 社论中，他们强调了在 AI 环境中应用 Enactivism 所必需的两个核心思想：参与式意义建构和自适应自主。Recent contributions from scholars of Enactivism in AI [65, 172, 344] have further enriched this perspective by exploring how enactivist principles can inform the design of socially intelligent, adaptive, and participatory artificial agents. In Safron et al.’s [344] editorial on Bio A.I., they highlight two core ideas essential to applying Enactivism in AI contexts: participatory sense-making and adaptive autonomy.

参与式意义建构是指通过互动来共同构建意义。行动主义方法并不将认知理解为私人的或预先编程的东西，而是将其视为从主体与环境（包括其他主体）之间的动态相互作用中产生的。在人工智能设计中，这将重点从内部表示转移到系统如何与用户和环境互动以生成共享意义。这在人工智能伴侣（例如 Replika）等应用程序中尤其重要，其中交互质量不仅取决于流畅性或连贯性，还取决于系统如何随着时间的推移适应用户不断变化的需求、情绪和目标。Participatory sense-making refers to the co-construction of meaning through interaction. Rather than understanding cognition as something private or pre-programmed, enactivist approaches view it as emerging from the dynamic interplay between agent and environment—including other agents. In AI design, this shifts the emphasis from internal representations to how systems engage with users and contexts to generate shared meaning. This is especially relevant in applications such as AI companions (e.g., Replika), where the quality of interaction depends not just on fluency or coherence, but on how the system adapts over time to the user's evolving needs, emotions, and goals.

自适应自主强调智能系统不仅要响应环境线索，还要保持自身的连贯性、连续性和学习轨迹。这种品质在功能主义方法中常常被低估，但它是行动主义机器人和新兴人工智能系统的核心。在实践中，这意味着不仅要评估任务完成情况，还要评估人工智能系统如何维持参与、驾驭模糊性以及以适合社会和道德敏感的方式重新调整其行为。Adaptive autonomy emphasises that intelligent systems must not only respond to environmental cues but also maintain their own coherence, continuity, and learning trajectory. This quality, often underemphasised in functionalist approaches, is central to enactivist robotics and emerging AI systems. In practice, this means evaluating not only task completion, but how an AI system sustains engagement, navigates ambiguity, and recalibrates its actions in socially appropriate and ethically sensitive ways.

相关地，Hipólito 等人。 [172]提出了一个可证伪的最小感知框架，以补充这些行动主义者的见解。他们的模型确定了三个关键条件（主动自我维护、历史适应性和自主机构）作为区分智能模式识别和真正参与意义创造的基础。这些标准应用于大型语言模型或人工智能伴侣等系统，对传统功能主义基准的充分性提出了挑战。相反，他们支持转向由行动主义者启发的评估，强调持续的关系纠缠、上下文敏感的响应能力以及系统跨时间共同维持交互的能力。Relatedly, Hipólito et al. [172] propose a falsifiable framework for minimal sentience that complements these enactivist insights. Their model identifies three key conditions (active self-maintenance, historical adaptability, and autonomous agency) as foundational for distinguishing between intelligent pattern recognition and genuine participation in meaning-making. Applied to systems like large language models or AI companions, these criteria challenge the adequacy of traditional functionalist benchmarks. Instead, they support a shift toward enactivist-inspired evaluations that emphasise ongoing relational entanglement, context-sensitive responsiveness, and a system’s ability to co-sustain its interactions across time.

总之，将启用主义应用于负责任的人工智能，为根据系统参与、适应和有意义地共同创造社会和道德环境的能力来评估系统开辟了新的途径。它鼓励从以输出为中心的模型转向交互、关系和紧急的情报测量。In sum, applying Enactivism to Responsible AI opens new avenues for evaluating systems based on their capacity to participate, adapt, and meaningfully co-create social and ethical environments. It encourages a shift from output-centric models to interactional, relational, and emergent measures of intelligence.

1.6.5 意识难题：IIT 到 4E1.6.5 The hard problem of consciousness: IIT to 4E

在计算机科学、哲学和神经科学的交叉领域，对于意识这个难题还远未达成共识。最近，长达 25 年的赌注——我们将在 2023 年查明人类意识的生物机制——终于迎来了高潮。At the intersection of computer science, philosophy, and neuroscience, a consensus to the hard problem of consciousness is far from settled. 查尔默斯和神经科学家克里斯托夫·科赫之间的争论，得出了有利于查尔默斯的结论——也就是说，我们仍然不知道[177]。尽管科赫寄希望于最近用于解决这一问题的技术进步，如功能磁共振成像、光遗传学和其他计算理论，但科赫还是承认失败。这些理论包括综合信息理论 (IIT) [9, 390]，该理论认为意识是一种基于物理客观结构（位于大脑后部）的因果属性。此外，全局工作空间理论 (GWT) [21, 223] 假定了一个心理工作空间（位于大脑的前部），它是当前需要注意的任何事物的场所。 IIT 和 GWT 都已应用于人工智能意识问题[即45、158]。虽然这些领域的研究很活跃，但尚未出现任何证据；同样重要的是要注意这两种理论也受到许多人的强烈批评[即16, 353]。between Chalmers and neuroscientist Christof Koch, concluded in favour of Chalmers—that is, we still don’t know [177]. Koch conceded defeat despite pining hopes on recent technological advances used to address the problem such as fMRI, optogenetics, and other computational theories. Those theories include Integrated Information Theory (IIT) [9, 390] that considers consciousness to be a causal property grounded in physical objective structures (at the back of the brain). Also, Global Workspace Theory (GWT) [21, 223] which posits a mental workspace (at the front of the brain) that is the site of whatever requires attention in the moment. Both IIT and GWT have been applied to the question of AI consciousness [i.e. 45, 158]. Whilst research is active in these areas, no proofs have arisen; it is also important to note both theories have also been strongly criticised by many [i.e. 16, 353].

与这些功能性方法相反，我们还见证了更新的、建构主义风格的认知和自我体验模型的发展，例如前面提到的 4E 框架，其中包括四种认知现象：体现、嵌入、扩展和制定 [262]。 4E 框架起源于联结主义者、心理学家和现象学家，包括神经科学家、哲学家、语言学家和机器人学家的工作[358]。简而言之，该框架通过身体及其与环境的相互作用之间的相互作用来看待意识和自我意识的出现。该方法并不排除计算过程，它表明这些过程本身不足以实现高级认知机制和意识。In contrast to these functional approaches we are also witnessing the development of newer, constructivist-style, models of cognition and self-experience such as the aforementioned 4E framework, which includes four cognitive phenomena: embodied, embedded, extended, and enacted [262]. The 4E framework is originated amongst connectionists, psychologists, and phenomenologists and includes the work of neuroscientists, philosophers, linguists, and roboticists [358]. In brief, this framework looks at the emergence of consciousness and self-awareness through an interplay between the body and its interactions with the environment. The approach doesn’t exclude computational processes, it indicates that those processes alone are insufficient for high level cognitive mechanisms and consciousness.

4E 和前面提到的 IIT 都挑战了内在主义或代表性观点（例如计算主义）；然而，两者之间存在重要差异。 IIT 更关注内部结构，而 4E 则强调与外部世界互动的重要性（前面讨论的enactivism）。 4E 植根于现象学和动力系统理论，而 IIT 植根于信息论；而且，4E 具有更广泛的抽象边界，将认知扩展到环境中，这更符合人工智能对社会影响的社会技术理论。简而言之，虽然 IIT 并不排除建构主义过程，但它确实具有一些功能主义方面，例如提出的可量化措施（phi F），该措施试图根据系统的集成信息程度来衡量系统中的意识水平。Both 4E and previously mentioned IIT challenge internalist or representational views (for example, computationalism); however, there are important differences. IIT is more focussed on internal structures whilst 4E highlights the importance of interaction with the external world (the enactivism discussed earlier). 4E is rooted in phenomenology and dynamical systems theory whilst IIT is grounded in information theory; and, 4E has a broader abstraction boundary extending cognition into the environment which is more aligned with sociotechnical theories of AI impacts on society. In short, whilst IIT doesn’t exclude constructivist processes, it does have some functionalist aspects such as the proposed quantifiable measure (phi F) that attempts to gauge the level of consciousness in a system based on its degree of integrated information.

如果我们暂时回到我们的 AGI 案例研究，我们会发现 4E 和生成主义的新认知范式通过身体之间的相互作用、身体与环境的相互作用以及制定代理意志的能力来看待意识和自我意识的出现 [262, 358]，并且可能为旧的争论提供一些新的见解。 4E 方法并不排除计算过程，它只是表明这些过程本身不足以实现真正的 AGI 所需的高级认知机制 [394]。 Triguero 等人，[394] 认为我们通过通用人工智能 (GPAI) 向 AGI 迈出了一步If we return to our AGI case study for a moment, we find newer cognitive paradigms of 4E and enactivism look at the emergence of consciousness and self-awareness through an interplay between the body, its interactions with the environment, and the capacity to enact agentic volition [262, 358] and may provide some new insights into an old debate. The 4E approach does not exclude computational processes, it simply indicates that those processes alone are insufficient for high level cognitive mechanisms required for true AGI [394]. Triguero et al, [394] posit that we take a step toward AGI via general purpose AI (GPAI)

1.6.6 使用Enactivism 建立更好的评估1.6.6 Using Enactivism to build better evaluations

前面的章节将启用主义确立为一种哲学视角，它结合了功能主义和建构主义的优势，同时解决了它们在现代人工智能背景下的局限性。但除了理论之外，Enactivism 还提供了一个框架，让我们重新思考如何在实践中评估人工智能系统。它邀请我们摆脱以性能为中心的指标，转向反映系统如何参与、响应和帮助共同构建动态关系环境的评估。The preceding sections establish Enactivism as a philosophical lens that unifies the strengths of Functionalism and Constructivism while addressing their limitations in the context of modern AI. But beyond theory, Enactivism also provides a framework for rethinking how we evaluate AI systems in practice. It invites us to move away from performance-centred metrics and toward evaluations that reflect how systems participate in, respond to, and help co-construct dynamic relational environments.

Michael Cannon [65] 对传统人工智能评估方法提出了令人信服的实践主义批评，特别是那些植根于假设相关性可以通过客观规范预先定义的对齐方法的方法。 Cannon 不是询问人工智能系统是否能够正确解决给定的任务，而是将评估重新定义为系统是否能够识别并响应动态环境中的相关内容。这种区别挑战了基于绩效或奖励的基准的逻辑。从行动主义者的角度来看，相关性不是输入或任务的属性——它是通过具体的、情境化的交互来制定的。因此，真正有意义的评估必须评估系统以反映其嵌入和关系组织的方式参与上下文的能力，而不仅仅是其输出正确答案的能力。Michael Cannon [65] offers a compelling enactivist critique of conventional AI evaluation methods, particularly those rooted in alignment approaches that assume relevance can be pre-defined through objective specification. Rather than asking whether an AI system can solve a given task correctly, Cannon reframes evaluation as a matter of whether the system can discern and respond to what is relevant within a dynamic context. This distinction challenges the logic of performance or reward based benchmarks. From an enactivist perspective, relevance is not a property of the input or the task—it is enacted through embodied, situated interaction. Therefore, truly meaningful evaluation must assess a system’s capacity to engage with context in a way that reflects its embedded and relational organisation, not just its ability to output correct answers.

这种见解将负责任的人工智能从优化逻辑转变为本体论对齐逻辑。 Cannon 称这种从低带宽对齐（指令跟随）到高带宽对齐（意义共享）的转变[65]。在这个框架下，评估方法不仅必须评估系统的功能，还要评估其设计如何使其能够在有意义的环境中生存和适应；不仅仅是它执行孤立任务的效果如何。例如，评估心理健康聊天机器人不应仅限于它是否提供适当的脚本响应，而应评估它如何响应用户情绪、语气和脆弱性的变化：展示对关系动态和交互的道德分量的敏感性。与静态基准测试方法不同，行动主义评估需要纵向关注系统如何随用户、机构和规范随时间而演变。This insight shifts Responsible AI from a logic of optimisation to a logic of ontological alignment. Cannon calls this shift from low-bandwidth alignment (instruction-following) to high-bandwidth alignment (meaning-sharing) [65]. Evaluation methods, under this framing, must assess not only what the system does, but how its design enables it to inhabit and adapt within meaningful environments; not just how well it performs isolated tasks. For example, evaluating a mental health chatbot should not be limited to whether it delivers appropriate scripted responses, but should assess how it responds to shifts in user emotion, tone, and vulnerability: demonstrating sensitivity to relational dynamics and the ethical weight of the interaction. Unlike static benchmarking approaches, enactivist evaluation demands longitudinal attention to how systems evolve with users, institutions, and norms over time.

这种关系性的、上下文相关的情报观点与 Hipólito 等人提出的框架密切相关。 （2024），他们认为最低限度的感知需要This relational, context-sensitive view of intelligence aligns strongly with the framework proposed by Hipólito et al. (2024), who argue that minimal sentience requires

三个可测试的条件：主动自我维护、历史适应性和自主代理。他们的清单提供了行动主义价值观的操作延伸，评估的基础不是表面行为，而是系统自我维持、随时间适应以及独立行动以应对不断变化的环境的能力。three testable conditions: active self-maintenance, historical adaptability, and autonomous agency. Their checklist offers an operational extension of enactivist values, grounding evaluation not in surface-level behaviour, but in the system’s ability to sustain itself, adapt over time, and act independently in response to changing contexts.

总而言之，这些观点表明评估本身必须重新考虑。负责任的人工智能评估不应完全依赖于测试静态输入输出映射的基准，而应提出关系能力的问题：Taken together, these perspectives suggest that evaluation must itself be reconceived. Rather than relying exclusively on benchmarks that test static input-output mappings, Responsible AI evaluation should ask questions of relational capacity:

  • 该系统与其环境的互动是否有意义？Does this system engage meaningfully with its environment?

  • 它能否自适应地应对不可预见的变化？Can it respond adaptively to unforeseen changes?

  • 它是否共同参与其运作的道德和社会环境？Does it co-participate in the ethical and social contexts it operates within?

1.6.7 MaSH 循环作为Enactivist 评估框架1.6.7 MaSH Loops as Enactivist Evaluation Frameworks

为了使enactivist原则在Responsible AI中具有可操作性，我提出了机器-社会-人类（MaSH）循环。虽然 MaSH Loops 以生成主义为基础，但它也借鉴了控制论思维，将评估视为一种递归反馈过程，其中机器、社会和人类动态不断相互重塑。 MaSH Loops 是一个执行主义评估框架，它不将人工智能系统视为孤立的工具或单个人机循环管道，而是将其视为机器、社会和人类流程之间的递归耦合。To make enactivist principles actionable in Responsible AI, I propose Machine–Society– Human (MaSH) Loops. While MaSH Loops is grounded in enactivism, it also draws on cybernetic thinking by treating evaluation as a recursive feedback process in which machine, social, and human dynamics continuously reshape one another. MaSH Loops is an enactivist evaluation framework that treats AI systems not as isolated tools or single human-in-the-loop pipelines, but as recursive couplings among machine, social, and human processes.

这将评估从孤立的输出转向递归条件，在递归条件下模型行为在机器、社会和人类环境中产生、解释和采用。在 MaSH 循环中，这些域被视为相互调节而不是可分离的：机器由训练数据、接口和优化机制塑造；社会的制度、规范和集体实践；和人类通过解释、吸收和情境使用。 MaSH 循环与一般的社会技术映射不同，它将评估本身视为跨机器、机构和人类反馈的价值制定的递归站点。This shifts evaluation away from isolated outputs and toward the recursive conditions under which model behaviour is produced, interpreted, and taken up across machine, social, and human contexts. In MaSH Loops, these domains are treated as mutually conditioning rather than separable: machines are shaped by training data, interfaces, and optimisation regimes; society by institutions, norms, and collective practices; and humans by interpretation, uptake, and situated use. MaSH Loops differ from generic sociotechnical mapping by treating evaluation itself as a recursive site of value enactment across machine, institutional, and human feedback.

因此，分析的单位从输出转向交互：系统在上下文中变成什么样子，以及当这些交互通过持续的相关性构建展开时，系统的价值被制定。 MaSH Loops 使价值制定在各个层面上都可追溯，因此评估不仅可以询问The unit of analysis thus shifts from outputs to interactions: what the system becomes in context, and whose values are enacted as those interactions unfold through ongoing relevance-making. MaSH Loops makes value-enactment empirically traceable across levels, so evaluation can ask not only模型做了什么what the model did但是but它如何对谁产生影响，在何种激励措施和规范下how it came to matter to whom, under which incentives and norms ?

MaSH Loops 框架建立在人工智能伦理和哲学工作的广泛基础之上。伊亚德·拉万的 [319]The MaSH Loops framework builds on a broad foundation of ethical and philosophical work in AI. Iyad Rahwan’s [319]社会在环Society-in-the-Loop明确需要将民主协商纳入算法治理，并提出made clear the need to embed democratic negotiation into algorithmic governance, proposing an算法社会契约algorithmic social contract确保系统对社会负责。 Inês Hipólito 及其同事 [173] 将enactivist 哲学扩展到人工智能，强调如何通过社会文化实践来制定认知和意义，以及设计选择如何加强或颠覆这些规范。 Virginia Dignum [107] 通过主张问责制、透明度以及整个 AI 生命周期中社会价值观的整合，推动了 RAI 领域的发展。 Deborah Johnson [190, 191] 对计算机伦理的开创性贡献提醒我们，技术从来都不是中立的，而是嵌入到人类实践、责任和制度环境中的。 Shannon Vallor 的 [403] 叙述to ensure systems remain accountable to society. Inês Hipólito and colleagues [173] extended enactivist philosophy into AI, emphasising how cognition and meaning are enacted through sociocultural practices, and how design choices can either reinforce or subvert those norms. Virginia Dignum [107] advanced the field of RAI by arguing for accountability, transparency, and the integration of societal values throughout the AI lifecycle. Deborah Johnson’s [190, 191] pioneering contributions to computer ethics remind us that technologies are never neutral, but embedded in human practices, responsibilities, and institutional settings. Shannon Vallor’s [403] account of技术美德Technomoral Virtues说明技术如何成为道德修养的场所。这些贡献中的每一项都将人工智能重新定位为价值观制定的社会技术参与者，而不是中立的工具。 MaSH Loops 与这些观点产生共鸣，但提出了他们的见解illustrates how technologies become sites of moral cultivation. Each of these contributions repositions AI as a sociotechnical participant in the enactment of values rather than a neutral instrument. MaSH Loops resonates with these perspectives but makes their insights

第一章：Chapter 1:负责任的人工智能中的认识论隆隆声Epistemological Rumbles in Responsible AI

可用于评估：使机器、社会和人类之间的递归反馈变得可见，并显示其价值观在这些层面上得到体现。operational for evaluation: rendering visible the recursive feedback among Machine, Society, and Human, and surfacing whose values are being enacted across those levels.

在 MaSH 循环中，人工智能系统不是在数据集上训练的静态工具，而是递归世界中的动态参与者。它们与人类（人在环，HITL）、机构和社区（社会在环，SITL）以及它们自己不断发展的机器反馈过程（机器在环，MITL）持续互动。 MaSH 框架超越了单独的 HITL 或 SITL。例如，HITL 通常以个人的监督/纠正为中心； SITL强调制度治理。 MaSH Loops 统一了两者并添加了机器自己的学习反馈，因此我们可以评估In a MaSH loop, AI systems are not static tools trained on datasets, but dynamic participants in recursive worlds. They interact continuously with humans (human-in-theloop, HITL), institutions and communities (society-in-the-loop, SITL), and their own evolving machine feedback processes (machine-in-the-loop, MITL). The MaSH framework goes beyond HITL or SITL alone. For example, HITL often centres on oversight/correction by an individual human; SITL stresses institutional governance. MaSH Loops unifies both and adds the machine’s own learning feedback, so we can evaluate跨层次cross-level影响。例如，用户界面选择如何改变用户行为；政策激励如何引导微调目标；或者模型更新如何重塑机构实践。effects. For example, how user interface choices change user behaviour; how policy incentives steer fine-tuning targets; or how model updates reshape institutional practices.

MaSH 循环结构呼应了 Cannon [65] 低带宽对齐（遵循预先指定的指令）和高带宽对齐（参与共享意义构建）之间的区别。传统评估询问系统可以做什么，而行动主义评估则询问系统如何理解什么是重要的以及对谁重要The MaSH loop structure echoes Cannon’s [65] distinction between low-bandwidth alignment (following pre-specified instructions) and high-bandwidth alignment (participating in shared sense-making). Where conventional evaluations ask what a system can do, enactivist evaluation asks how it comes to understand what matters, and to whom.Cannon [65]挑战了价值观是需要编码或优化的固定目标的观念。相反，他提出，价值观是通过系统在特定的动态环境中不断建立相关性来制定的。在这种观点中，一致性并不是要最大化的产出，而是道德参与的新兴产物。 MaSH Loops 体现了这一观点并对其进行了扩展：它们提供了一个框架，用于评估人工智能系统是否可以跨分层且经常相互冲突的领域共同制定价值观：个人经验、集体规范性和机器学习轨迹。Cannon [65] challenges the notion that values are fixed objectives to be encoded or optimised. Instead, he proposes that values are enacted through the system’s ongoing relevance-making within situated, dynamic contexts. In this view, alignment is not an output to be maximised but an emergent product of ethical participation. MaSH Loops embodies this view and extend it: they offer a framework for evaluating whether AI systems can co-enact values across layered and often conflicting domains: individual experience, collective normativity, and machine learning trajectories.

重要的是，MaSH Loops 使“人类价值观”的概念多元化。他们认识到价值观不是铁板一块，而是在个人、文化、社区和机构内部和之间产生的。因此，行动主义评估必须考虑一个系统如何与多元化、有争议和不断发展的价值体系互动，而不是假设一个稳定或普遍的调整目标。通过 MaSH Loops 进行的Enactivist 评估将优先考虑：Importantly, MaSH Loops pluralise the concept of "human values." They recognise that values are not monolithic, but arise within and across individuals, cultures, communities, and institutions. An enactivist evaluation must therefore account for how a system engages with pluralistic, contested, and evolving value systems rather than assuming a stable or universal alignment target. Enactivist evaluation via MaSH Loops would prioritise:

  • 情境响应能力Situated responsiveness超过固定基准。系统是否适当地适应用户、任务和文化背景，而不是优化固定分数？over fixed benchmarks. Does the system adapt appropriately to users, tasks, and cultural context, rather than optimise a fixed score?

  • 历史学习Historical learning超过孤立的测试时间性能。性能是否反映了跨时间的学习（用户、部署、微调），而不仅仅是快照？over isolated test-time performance. Does performance reflect learning across time (users, deployments, fine-tuning), not just a snapshot?

  • 自治和自组织Autonomy and self-organisation过度被动优化。该系统是否能在政策变化、漂移、对抗性提示等扰动下保持一致性并在道德上恢复？over passive optimisation. Does the system maintain coherence and recover ethically under perturbations such as policy changes, drift, adversarial prompts)?

  • 参与意义创造Participation in meaning-making仅靠预测。该系统是否与人和机构共同构建相关含义，而不仅仅是预测？over prediction alone. Does the system coconstruct relevant meaning with people and institutions, rather than merely predict?

  • 复数值Plural values超越一个社会的主导规范。我们能否了解谁的价值观被制定、它们在哪里发生冲突以及如何进行权衡？over dominant norms of one society. Can we see whose values are enacted, where they conflict, and how trade-offs are negotiated?

MaSH Loops 评估人工智能系统如何通过机器、社交和人类反馈来了解重要的事情以及对谁重要，而不是它们达到静态目标的效果。例如，“安全”内容政策（社会）会改变评估者指令（人类），从而驱动微调梯度（机器），然后在下一个周期中塑造用户提示和公共话语（社会）。仅评估模型的输出会错过此周期产生的跨级别价值变化。MaSH Loops evaluates how AI systems come to understand what matters, and to whom, through machine, social, and human feedback, rather than how well they hit a static target. For example, a “safe” content policy (Society) shifts rater instructions (Human), which drives fine-tuning gradients (Machine), which then shapes user prompts and public discourse (Society) in the next cycle. Evaluating only the model’s output would miss the cross-level value shifts this cycle produces.

因此，MaSH Loops 提供了一种将生成式人工智能评估为递归社会技术系统的方法，使行为、责任和价值如何分布在机器、社会和人类流程中，而不是单独位于模型中，变得可见。MaSH Loops therefore provides a way of evaluating generative AI as a recursive sociotechnical system, making visible how behaviour, responsibility, and value are distributed across machine, social, and human processes rather than located in the model alone.

对于基准设计，这意味着将提示、答案锚点、评估者、界面和部署设置视为评估交互的一部分，而不是围绕固定属性的中性包装。基准引发的结果部分取决于交互的进行方式。For benchmark design, this means treating prompts, answer anchors, raters, interfaces, and deployment settings as parts of the evaluative interaction rather than neutral wrappers around a fixed property. What a benchmark elicits is partly shaped by how that interaction is staged.

1.7 结论1.7 Conclusion

本章通过研究功能主义、建构主义和生成主义如何塑造我们对人工智能是什么以及如何评估它的理解，探讨了负责任的人工智能社区内的认识论紧张局势。这些不仅仅是哲学立场，而且是哲学立场。它们支撑着我们如何确定人工智能系统是否有能力、是否符合道德或是否符合人类价值观。功能主义优先考虑效率和性能，可以实现快速基准测试，但往往忽视塑造意义的背景。建构主义挑战我们将人工智能系统视为嵌入社会技术现实中，由历史、偏见和规范塑造的。然而，当面对在其所栖息的生态系统中不断发展的日益自主、生成和交互的人工智能系统时，这两种方法都可能会显得不足。This chapter has explored the epistemological tensions within the Responsible AI community by examining how Functionalism, Constructivism, and Enactivism shape our understanding of what AI is and how it should be evaluated. These are not merely philosophical stances; they underpin how we determine whether an AI system is competent, ethical, or aligned with human values. Functionalism privileges efficiency and performance, enabling rapid benchmarking but often neglecting the contexts that shape meaning. Constructivism challenges us to see AI systems as embedded in sociotechnical realities, shaped by histories, biases, and norms. Yet both approaches can fall short when confronted with increasingly autonomous, generative, and interactive AI systems that evolve within the ecosystems they inhabit.

行动主义提供了一个至关重要的重构。它不仅询问系统输出什么，还询问系统如何在与人类和机构的动态关系中参与并赋予意义。最近的相邻工作朝着类似的方向发展，特别是在法学硕士代理、关于法学硕士合作的社会认知主张的局限性以及人机交互中代理的操作化方面[25,171,428]可供性、参与性意义建构和MaSH循环将评估转向人类、机器和机器之间持续的、递归的共同适应。Enactivism offers a crucial reframing. It asks not only what a system outputs, but how it participates and enacts meaning in dynamic relation to humans and institutions. Recent adjacent work pushes in a similar direction, especially on LLM agency, the limits of social cognition claims about LLM collaboration, and the operationalisation of agency in human– AI interaction [25, 171, 428] Affordances, participatory sense-making, and MaSH Loops shift evaluation toward the ongoing, recursive co-adaptation between humans, machines, and

[47 ]

第一章：Chapter 1:负责任的人工智能中的认识论隆隆声Epistemological Rumbles in Responsible AI

社会。这种从以输出为中心的指标到关系纠缠的转变标志着我们如何构想负责任的人工智能的关键演变。这也是本文的概念核心。society. This shift from output-centric metrics to relational entanglement marks a critical evolution in how we conceive Responsible AI. It is also the conceptual core of this thesis.

当我们进入一个时代，生成式人工智能递归地回到它诞生的社会条件中，塑造多元价值空间并被多元价值空间塑造时，我们需要能够解释这些共同构建的评估框架。 MaSH 循环使这种递归共同制定变得可见，阐明了生成人工智能的衔尾蛇不仅是一个技术再训练周期，而且是一个关于相关性、道德和意义的连续的、多尺度的协商。As we enter an era where Generative AI loops recursively back into the social conditions from which it emerged, shaping and being shaped by pluralistic value spaces, we need evaluation frameworks that can account for these co-constructions. MaSH Loops make this recursive co-enactment visible, illuminating generative AI’s ouroboros not merely as a technical retraining cycle, but as a continuous, multi-scalar negotiation of relevance, ethics, and meaning.
