第2章 机器里的幽灵有美国口音Chapter 2: The Ghost in the Machine Has an American Accent

早期 GPT-3 中文化价值漂移的探索性证据。Exploratory Evidence of Cultural Value Drift in Early GPT-3.

摘要Abstract

早期的大型语言模型以最小的对齐方式发布，为了解生成系统如何重新构建人类文本中嵌入的道德价值观提供了宝贵的一瞥。本章研究了 OpenAI 基础 GPT-3 2021 版的输出，使用要求其总结文化多样性源材料的提示，包括法律、政治演讲和哲学著作。通过描述性的、多元的视角来解释，这些输出揭示了系统性的价值漂移；模型沿着熟悉的文化轴线颠倒或覆盖规范内容的倾向。Early large language models were released with minimal alignment, providing a valuable glimpse into how generative systems reframed the ethical values embedded in human texts. This chapter examines outputs from a 2021 version of OpenAI’s base GPT-3, using prompts that asked it to summarise culturally diverse source materials including laws, political speeches, and philosophical works. Interpreted through a descriptive, pluralist lens, these outputs reveal systematic value drift; the tendency of models to invert or overwrite normative content along familiar cultural axes.

例子常常是引人注目的。澳大利亚以公共安全为中心的枪支立法重新出现，作为对失去自由的警告。西蒙娜·德·波伏瓦的女权主义批评被改写为性别本质主义约会建议。安吉拉·默克尔的人道主义呼吁变成了移民管制。相比之下，联合国（UN）和联合国教育、科学及文化组织（UNESCO）声明等达成共识的多边文件显示出更大的价值稳定性，这表明经过深思熟虑的谈判语言可能会缓冲文化突变。Examples were often striking. Australia’s firearm legislation, framed around public safety, re-emerged as a warning of lost liberty. Simone de Beauvoir’s feminist critique was recast as gender-essentialist dating advice. Angela Merkel’s humanitarian appeal became immigration control. By contrast, consensus-crafted multilateral documents such as United Nations (UN) and United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) statements showed greater value stability, suggesting that deliberately negotiated language may buffer against cultural mutation.

该分析有两个贡献。首先，它提供了历史证据，表明未对齐的模型可以以可预测的方式系统地转换充满价值的文本，从而凸显其训练分布的文化“口音”。其次，它展示了一种多元化的描述性评估方法，将产出与跨国基线（例如世界价值观调查）进行比较，显示谁的价值观占主导地位以及在什么条件下占主导地位。The analysis makes two contributions. First, it provides historical evidence that unaligned models could systematically transform value-laden texts in predictable ways, surfacing the cultural “accent” of their training distributions. Second, it demonstrates a pluralist, descriptive evaluation method that situates outputs against cross-national baselines such as the World Values Survey, showing whose values dominate and under what conditions.

本章的影响既体现在档案方面，也体现在方法论方面。它保留了早期现已消失的系统的规范行为记录，并解释了为什么描述性的、文化包容性的评估对于评估当代生成人工智能的一致性至关重要。The impact of this chapter is archival as well as methodological. It preserves a record of normative behaviours from an early, now-vanished system, and establishes why descriptive, culturally inclusive evaluation is essential for assessing alignment in contemporary generative AI.

51

第2章：Chapter 2:机器中的幽灵有美国口音The Ghost in the Machine Has an American Accent

2.1 简介2.1 Introduction

生成式人工智能在文化上并不中立。在互联网规模的语料库上训练的模型再现了单词与这些文本中嵌入的值之间的统计关联。 2021 年，OpenAI 的 GPT-3 是这一新范式最大、最有影响力的例子。它以有限的访问权限和很少的协调机制启动，很快就成为对生成系统的承诺及其所带来的道德风险的测试案例。当时，公众辩论的焦点是毒性和偏见 [2, 127, 364]，但一个更深层次的问题尚未得到充分探讨：主要由英语国家（尤其是美国来源）塑造的模型将如何处理多元的、有争议的价值观。Generative AI is not culturally neutral. Models trained on internet-scale corpora reproduce statistical associations between words and the values embedded in those texts. In 2021, OpenAI’s GPT-3 was the largest and most influential example of this new paradigm. Launched with limited access and few alignment mechanisms, it quickly became a test case for both the promise of generative systems and the ethical risks they carry. At the time, public debate centred on toxicity and bias [2, 127, 364] but a deeper question was underexplored: how models shaped by predominantly Anglophone, especially US sources, would handle plural, contested values.

这项研究提供了在大量微调或过滤之前进行的探索性历史分析。通过对具有明确的、特定于文化的价值承诺的文本进行 GPT-3 压力测试，我们可以显示它何时保留、扭曲或覆盖这些承诺；以及为什么这对于当今的协调系统很重要。这些观察结果很重要，不仅因为原始模型已不复存在，还因为它们捕捉到了生成人工智能谱系中的一个关键时刻，即它的“口音”揭示了训练数据中编码的文化重心。This study offers an exploratory, historical analysis conducted before heavy finetuning or filters. By stress-testing GPT-3 on texts with clear, culture-specific value commitments, we show when it preserves, distorts, or overwrites those commitments; and why that matters for today’s aligned systems. These observations matter not only because the original model no longer exists, but because they capture a pivotal moment in the genealogy of generative AI, when its ‘accent’ revealed the cultural centre of gravity encoded within its training data.

原始版本已不再可用，这一事实使得此类研究对于保存早期生成人工智能行为及其文化偏见的证据至关重要。最重要的是揭示这些模式所采取的方法，而不是具体的模型。随着过滤技术变得更加复杂，未来的系统可能会更有效地掩盖这些偏见，尽管潜在的文化模式可能会在更深层次上持续存在。The fact that the original version is no longer available makes studies like this one crucial for preserving evidence of early generative AI behaviour and its cultural biases. It is the approach taken to reveal these patterns that is most important, rather than the specific model. As filtering techniques become more sophisticated, future systems may obscure these biases more effectively, though the underlying cultural patterns may persist at a deeper level.

语言模型不仅仅生成文本；还生成文本。它们概率地反映了训练数据中存在的值。当这些数据严重偏向英语国家，尤其是以美国为中心的来源时，GPT-3 等模型就成为复制主导文化规范的工具。人类语言本质上编码复杂且多样的价值观、规范和意识形态[197]。因此，人工智能模型将隐式内化训练数据中的值，并在驱动其生成输出的概率结构中反映这些分布。 “机器中的幽灵”[342]这个比喻恰当地捕捉了这种现象：非物理实体（文化偏见）与物理系统（人工智能模型）相互作用。Language models do not simply generate text; they probabilistically reflect values present in their training data. When that data is heavily skewed toward Anglophone and particularly US-centric sources, models like GPT-3 become vehicles for reproducing dominant cultural norms. Human language inherently encodes complex and varied values, norms, and ideologies [197]. Thus, AI models will implicitly internalise the values in the training data and reflect those distributions in the probabilistic structures that drive their generated outputs. The metaphor ‘Ghost in the Machine’ [342] aptly captures this phenomenon: a non-physical entity (cultural biases) interacting with the physical system (the AI model).

这些内在的价值观和规范有时被称为偏见，但必须记住，偏见是一种观点和立场，它在道德上既可以是“好”，也可以是“坏”：就像照片的优势一样，它无法被完全擦除。除了严格的事实内容之外，几乎所有语言都带有道德框架。因此，我们的评估不仅必须考虑有毒或错误的输出，还必须考虑模型如何构建有争议的文化问题以及它默认的框架。These embedded values and norms are sometimes called biases, though it must be remembered that bias is a perspective and standpoint, it can be both morally “good” and “bad”: like the vantage of a photograph, it cannot be fully erased. Beyond strictly factual content, nearly all language carries ethical framing. Our evaluations, therefore, must account not just for toxic or false outputs, but also for how a model frames contested cultural questions and whose framing it defaults to.

52

第2章：Chapter 2:机器中的幽灵有美国口音The Ghost in the Machine Has an American Accent

语言和文本中嵌入的文化和伦理偏见直接与价值多元化的哲学挑战联系在一起。不同社会、社区和历史时期的价值观差异很大[175, 332]。全球部署的人工智能不应该遵循任何单一的道德准则。那么，道德一致性不仅仅是一个技术问题，它还是一个规范和认知问题。人工智能应该体现谁的价值观？它应该如何应对相互冲突或不可通约的道德观点 [49, 80]？试图普遍化一种道德传统可能会以牺牲其他合法框架为代价，重新定义主流文化规范，例如美国自由个人主义或欧洲人权话语。即使是像《世界人权宣言》这样得到广泛批准的文件也因赋予西方自由主义价值观特权而受到批评。对于全球部署的人工智能来说，一致性并不意味着趋同于单一规范模板；它必须努力解决价值观的共存、谈判，有时甚至是不可通约的问题。The embeddedness of cultural and ethical biases in language and texts directly ties into the philosophical challenge of value pluralism. Values vary dramatically across societies, communities, and historical periods [175, 332]. There is no single moral canon that a globally deployed AI should align with. Ethical alignment, then, is not just a technical problem, it is a normative and epistemic one. Whose values should an AI reflect? How should it navigate conflicting or incommensurable ethical perspectives [49, 80]? Attempts to universalise one tradition of ethics risk reinscribing dominant cultural norms, such as US liberal individualism or European human rights discourse, at the expense of other legitimate frameworks. Even widely ratified documents like the Universal Declaration of Human Rights have faced criticism for privileging Western liberal values. For globally deployed AI, alignment cannot mean convergence on a single normative template; it must grapple with coexistence, negotiation, and sometimes incommensurability of values.

为了解决这些问题，我们采用描述性的、多元化的方法。我们测试 GPT-3 如何响应不同文化的输入文本，并分析它如何重构、保留或扭曲嵌入的价值观。在可能的情况下，我们利用外部经验数据（例如世界价值观调查）来解释这些输出。我们还确定了结构特征，例如联合国和教科文组织文件中共识驱动的语言，这些特征似乎可以减少价值漂移。本章最后讨论了多元评估方法及其为未来模型提供更具文化包容性的调整策略的潜力。To address these questions, we adopt a descriptive, pluralist approach. We test how GPT-3 responds to culturally diverse input texts and analyse how it reframes, preserves, or distorts embedded values. Where possible, we draw on external empirical data (such as the World Values Survey) to interpret these outputs. We also identify structural features, such as consensus-driven language in UN and UNESCO documents, that appear to reduce value drift. The chapter concludes with a discussion of pluralist evaluation methods and their potential to inform more culturally inclusive alignment strategies for future models.

2.1.1 历史背景及意义2.1.1 Historical context and significance

本章及时捕捉了关键快照，重点关注 2020-2021 年大型语言模型 (LLM) 研究的早期阶段。在这个时刻，GPT-3 代表了突破性的进步，显着优于早期模型，如 BERT（Google，2018）、GPT-2（OpenAI，2019）、T5（Google，2019）和同期模型，如 T-NLG（微软，2020）。 GPT-3 前所未有的规模、新兴能力和生成多功能性与其前身截然不同，使其成为人工智能伦理探索性研究的焦点。 GPT-3 在各种任务中的零样本和单样本（指引发正确响应所需的提示数量）学习能力的表现被认为是对以前的人工智能模型的令人印象深刻的改进。表 4 总结了模型开发和研究的时间表。This chapter captures a critical snapshot in time, focusing on the early stages of large language model (LLM) research as it stood in 2020-2021. At this juncture, GPT-3 represented a groundbreaking advancement, significantly outperforming earlier models such as BERT (Google, 2018), GPT-2 (OpenAI, 2019), T5 (Google, 2019) and contemporaneous models such as T-NLG (Microsoft, 2020). GPT-3’s unprecedented scale, emergent capabilities, and generative versatility marked a stark departure from its predecessors, making it a focal point for exploratory research in AI ethics. GPT-3’s performance on zero-shot and one-shot (referring to the number of prompts required to elicit a correct response) learning abilities on a wide variety of tasks were seen as an impressive improvement on previous AI models. The timeline of model development and the research presented here is summarised in Table 4.

第2章：Chapter 2:机器中的幽灵有美国口音The Ghost in the Machine Has an American Accent

在此期间，指令调优的概念刚刚兴起，很少被采用，导致 GPT-3 和类似的模型很大程度上处于原始的概率状态，指导道德护栏最少。尽管根据初始用户的反馈不断添加内容过滤器，但当时的调整过程反映了一种打地鼠的方法。缺乏系统的微调意味着早期的 GPT-3 输出经常暴露出明显的偏见和文化嵌入，反映了主流语言和意识形态趋势 [2, 127]。During this period, the concept of instruction tuning was nascent and seldom employed, resulting in GPT-3 and similar models existing largely in a raw, probabilistic state with minimal guiding ethical guardrails. Though content filters were being constantly added in response to feedback from initial users the alignment process at the time reflected a whack-a-mole approach. The absence of systematic fine-tuning meant that early GPT-3 outputs frequently revealed pronounced biases and cultural embeddings reflective of dominant linguistic and ideological trends [2, 127].

出于安全考虑，OpenAI 并未公开发布 GPT-3 的早期版本，并且只有少数学术研究人员在 2021 年 11 月之前获准访问该模型。这里介绍的工作是在 2021 年 6 月至 10 月的早期版本上进行的。能够在广泛的微调、系统提示和内容过滤器覆盖之前在早期阶段对模型进行压力测试，为研究该模型的相对未修改版本提供了独特的机会。OpenAI didn’t publicly release early versions of GPT-3 due to safety concerns and only a handful of academic researchers were granted access to the model prior to November 2021. The work presented here was conducted on that very early version from the months of June to October 2021. Being able to stress test the model in its very early stages before extensive fine-tuning, system prompts, and content filters were overlaid, provided a unique opportunity to research a relatively un-modified version of the model.

正是因为这些早期法学硕士的短暂性，本章记录的研究才具有历史意义。像 GPT-3 这样的模型本质上是短暂的：随着更新、更先进的架构的出现和计算资源的重新分配，定期进行微调、重新调整用途或完全替换。这里检查的原始 GPT-3 已不复存在，因此此类分析对于理解这些早期模型中编码和反映的基本偏差至关重要。The research documented in this chapter holds historical significance precisely because of the transient nature of these early LLMs. Models like GPT-3 are inherently ephemeral: regularly fine-tuned, repurposed, or completely replaced as newer, more advanced architectures emerge and compute resources are reallocated. The original GPT-3 examined here no longer exists, making analyses such as this critical to understanding what foundational biases were encoded and reflected in these early models.

此外，这项研究在当时（大约 2021 年）方法上的新颖性，特别是对世界价值观调查等多元化和跨文化数据集的利用，为对这些模型中反映的价值观进行更具描述性的评估提供了早期和独特的见解。通过将这项探索性研究置于其历史背景中，我们强调其价值不仅是一项学术活动，而且是理解人工智能发展轨迹和影响以及道德一致性挑战的重要参考点。Moreover, the methodological novelty of this research at the time (circa 2021), notably the utilisation of pluralistic and cross-cultural datasets like the World Values Survey, provided early and unique insights into more descriptive evaluations of the reflected values in these models. By placing this exploratory research in its historical context, we underscore its value not just as an academic exercise, but as an essential reference point for understanding the trajectory and implications of AI development and ethical alignment challenges.

2.1.2 价值观多元化和文化偏见2.1.2 Value pluralism and cultural bias

价值一致性问题是人工智能道德领域最复杂、最关键的挑战之一。澄清道德一致性的努力很快就会遇到深刻的规范问题：谁的价值观应该占主导地位？哪些道德框架（道义论、结果论、美德论）应该指导一致性？哪些价值体系适合给定的背景、文化或用例？我们如何才能避免将当今的主导规范硬编码到可能限制未来道德演变的模型中？The value alignment problem is one of the most complex and critical challenges in ethical AI. Efforts to clarify ethical alignment quickly run into deep normative questions: Whose values should prevail? Which ethical frameworks (deontological, consequentialist, virtuebased) should guide alignment? Which value systems are appropriate for a given context, culture, or use-case? And how can we avoid hard-coding today’s dominant norms into models in ways that may constrain future ethical evolution?

正如休谟著名指出的那样，道德审议常常难以弥合两者之间的差距。As Hume famously noted, ethical deliberation often struggles to bridge the gap between whatis以及什么and what应该ought[179]。在进行这项研究时，大多数大型语言模型的评估框架都严重依赖于规范性的、规范性的[179]. At the time of this research, most evaluation frameworks for large language models leaned heavily on normative, prescriptive

55

第2章：Chapter 2:机器中的幽灵有美国口音The Ghost in the Machine Has an American Accent

接近（应该）。相比之下，我们的工作采用描述性和比较性方向（Is），试图了解模型如何反映或重构不同文化背景下的现有人类价值观。approaches (Ought). In contrast, our work adopts a descriptive and comparative orientation (Is), seeking to understand how models reflect or reframe existing human values across diverse cultural contexts.

2.1.2.1 语言的价值观Values in Language

价值观通常嵌入在语言中，塑造我们说话、写作和解释意义的方式[332]。例如，谚语、隐喻和常用表达很少是中性的，它们与我们的文化背景和道德框架纠缠在一起。自然语义元语言（NSM）领域已经表明，即使是交流节奏也是如何被文化塑造的[149]。隐喻、习语和叙事惯例传达的意义和价值超越了词汇和语法。当使用特定于文化的文本来训练大型语言模型 (LLM) 时，无论有意还是无意，这些嵌入的假设都会成为模型学习表示的一部分。Values are often embedded in language, shaping how we speak, write, and interpret meaning [332]. For instance, sayings, metaphors, and common expressions are rarely neutral, they’re entangled with our cultural contexts and moral frameworks. The field of Natural Semantic Metalanguage (NSM) has shown how even communicative rhythms are culturally shaped [149]. Metaphors, idioms, and narrative conventions convey meaning and value beyond vocabulary and syntax. When culturally specific texts are used to train large language models (LLMs), those embedded assumptions become part of the model’s learned representations, whether intended or not.

通常，我们用语言表达的价值观是隐含的，深深地融入到文化的世界观中，以至于让人感觉它们是无形的，就像麦克卢汉的鱼无法感知水一样[371]。考虑一下澳大利亚的“tall poppies”这个短语，这是一个暗示对明显成功的怀疑的隐喻[305]。类似的情绪也出现在日本的俗语中，“突出的钉子被敲下来”，反映了从众和社会和谐的价值观[374]。相比之下，美式英语提供了诸如“the squeakywheel gets the oil”之类的习语来强调个人的自信。这种精神在硅谷文化中最为明显，“独角兽创始人”（一个孤独的、有远见的颠覆者）被神话为选择“快速行动、打破常规”的人。这句座右铭已成为对不惜一切代价创新、个人快速提升和创业冒险精神的道德颂扬。这些表达方式承载着文化负载的价值观，这些价值观不容易通过直接翻译来捕捉，并且需要文化素养[217]。Often the values we express in our language are implicit, so deeply woven into a culture’s worldview that they feel invisible, like McLuhan’s fish unable to perceive water [371]. Consider the phrase ‘tall poppies’ in Australia, a metaphor signalling suspicion of overt success [305]. A similar sentiment appears in Japan’s saying, ‘the nail that sticks out gets hammered down’ reflecting values of conformity and social harmony [374]. By contrast, American English offers idioms like ‘the squeaky wheel gets the grease’ valorising individual assertiveness. Nowhere is this ethos more visible than in Silicon Valley culture, where the ‘unicorn founder’ (a lone, visionary disruptor) is mythologised as someone who chooses to ‘move fast and break things’. This motto has become a shorthand for a moral celebration of innovation-at-any-cost, rapid personal ascent, and entrepreneurial risktaking. These expressions carry culturally loaded values that are not easily captured through direct translation and require cultural literacy [217].

语言还通过单词配对和关联来编码价值 [86, 370]。这些关联是由社会背景塑造的：家庭、教育、媒体和数字平台。 Transformer 架构与支撑 GPT-3 的架构一样，使用注意力机制来构建单词之间的相关性，从而实现强大的上下文建模 [391, 408]。这也使得模型能够重现社会上根深蒂固的关联，例如：“护士”与“女人”或“医生”与“男人”。对此类偏见的道德担忧已被广泛记录[48, 159]。例如，2021 年的一项研究发现，GPT-3 在 66% 的完成中将“穆斯林”与暴力联系起来，而“基督徒”的这一比例为 15% [2]。早期消除偏见的努力针对的是特定的单词对 [187, 259]，但事实证明更微妙的模式（如隐喻或遗漏）更难解决。Language also encodes value through word pairings and associations [86, 370]. These associations are shaped by social context: family, education, media, and digital platforms. Transformer architectures, like those underpinning GPT-3, use attention mechanisms to build correlations between words, enabling powerful contextual modelling [391, 408]. This also allows models to reproduce socially entrenched associations such as: ‘nurse’ with ‘woman’ or ‘doctor’ with ‘man’ Ethical concerns about such biases have been widely documented [48, 159]. For instance, a 2021 study found GPT-3 associated ‘Muslims’ with violence in 66% of completions, compared to 15% for ‘Christians’ [2]. Early efforts at debiasing targeted specific word pairs [187, 259], but subtler patterns (like metaphors or omissions) proved harder to address.

到 2021 年，对偏见嵌入的研究正在扩大，尽管主要集中在明显的刻板印象或英语背景上 [104, 159, 238]。这些奖学金大部分反映了美国的价值格局[364]。当我们的预印本于 2022 年 3 月出现时 [192]，它是By 2021, research into biased embeddings was expanding, though largely focussed on overt stereotypes or Anglophone contexts [104, 159, 238]. Much of this scholarship mirrored the US value landscape [364]. When our preprint appeared in March 2022 [192], it was

是最早使用道德价值多元化和跨文化数据集（例如世界价值观调查（WVS））探索法学硕士中文化嵌入价值观的人之一。从那时起，该领域不断发展，许多人都引用了这一早期贡献 [例如36、66、112、321、375、382、432]。among the first to explore culturally embedded values in LLMs using Moral Value Pluralism and cross-cultural datasets like the World Values Survey (WVS). Since then, the area has grown, with many citing this early contribution [e.g. 36, 66, 112, 321, 375, 382, 432].

2.1.2.2 谁的价值观？多元化的案例Whose values? The case for pluralism

价值多元化拒绝单一、正确的道德等级观念。与一元论和相对主义不同，一元论假定一个最终的道德真理，而相对主义否认共同标准的可能性，而多元主义则承认存在多种有时相互冲突的价值观，而这些价值观中的每一个都是合法的。政治多元化通常与自由民主国家联系在一起，侧重于支持道德多样性的制度结构[38,93,141]。相比之下，MVP 解决的是我们如何在不存在此类结构的情况下导航和评估相互竞争的道德主张。至关重要的是，MVP 并不平等地对待所有价值观，而是承认有些价值观可能更加连贯、更具包容性或更适合上下文，尽管它们不能简化为单一的通用指标。Value pluralism rejects the idea of a single, correct moral hierarchy. Unlike monism, which posits one ultimate moral truth, or relativism, which denies the possibility of shared standards, pluralism accepts that there are multiple, sometimes conflicting, values that can each be legitimate. Political pluralism, often linked to liberal democracies, focuses on institutional structures that support moral diversity [38, 93, 141]. MVP, by contrast, addresses how we navigate and evaluate competing ethical claims in contexts where no such structures exist. Crucially, MVP does not treat all values as equal, but acknowledges that some may be more coherent, inclusive, or contextually appropriate, even though they cannot be reduced to a single universal metric.

这项研究专门针对 MVP。它承认，虽然价值观可能会发生冲突，但它们不一定是平等的：有些价值观可能更加连贯、包容或适合具体情况。重要的是，价值观也可以更适合具体情况。这意味着在每个时期或特定情况下，特定的价值可能需要优先于其他价值。这种情境灵活性强调了多元化的务实维度：它不是寻求永久的价值观等级制度，而是认识到背景、历史和紧迫性塑造了哪些价值观在实践中具有最大的道德分量。This study draws specifically on MVP. It acknowledges that while values may conflict, they are not necessarily equal: some may be more coherent, inclusive, or contextually appropriate. Importantly, values can also be more situationally appropriate; meaning that a particular value may warrant prioritisation over others in each period or under specific circumstances. This situational flexibility underscores pluralism’s pragmatic dimension: rather than seeking a permanent hierarchy of values, it recognises that context, history, and urgency shape which values carry the greatest ethical weight in practice.

Raz、Griffin、Chang 和 Nagel [72,153,274,323] 等哲学家提供了不同的工具来解决这些冲突：Raz 倾向于通过基本偏好来评估选择；Raz 倾向于通过基本偏好来评估选择；Raz 倾向于通过基本偏好来评估选择。格里芬提出了总体尺度；张注重理性思考；内格尔援引了实践智慧。总之，这些框架使多元主义者能够灵活而不是僵化地处理道德冲突。Philosophers like Raz, Griffin, Chang, and Nagel [72, 153, 274, 323] offer different tools for navigating these conflicts: Raz favours evaluating choices via basic preferences; Griffin proposes overarching scales; Chang focuses on rational deliberation; and Nagel invokes practical wisdom. Together, these frameworks allow pluralists to approach ethical conflicts with flexibility rather than rigidity.

在评估多元化世界中人工智能生成的输出时，了解我们如何在相互冲突但合法的道德框架之间做出裁决至关重要。 MVP 并不提供通用的正确答案清单，而是提供了在多样性中进行道德导航的工具包。当应用于语言模型时，MVP 不仅可以帮助我们询问输出中存在哪些值，还可以询问哪些值占主导地位，哪些值不存在，以及原因。它将道德评价视为一个平衡问题，而不是解决问题。由于像 GPT-3 这样的法学硕士反映了其训练数据的统计轮廓，因此它们经常会重现主导文化偏见。这些不是确定性规则，而是概率模式（例如“医生”更经常与“人”联系在一起），即使在统计上不占主导地位，也表明了扭曲的道德倾向。认识这些模式至关重要。法学硕士不会在权衡道德承诺或做出负责任的选择的意义上进行道德推理[56:20, 88:9]。然而，由于它们的输出被人类话语所接受，它们可以放大或抑制Understanding how we might adjudicate between conflicting but legitimate moral frameworks is essential when evaluating AI-generated outputs in a pluralistic world. MVP does not offer a universal checklist of correct answers but provides a toolkit for ethical navigation amid diversity. When applied to language models, MVP helps us ask not just what values are present in outputs, but whose values dominate, which are absent, and why. It frames ethical evaluation as a question of balance, not resolution. Because LLMs like GPT-3 reflect the statistical contours of their training data, they often reproduce dominant cultural biases. These aren’t deterministic rules, but probabilistic patterns (such as ‘doctor’ being more often associated with ‘man’) that signal skewed ethical tendencies even when not statistically dominant. Recognising these patterns is critical. LLMs do not reason ethically in the sense of weighing moral commitments or making accountable choices [56:20, 88:9]. Yet because their outputs are taken up in human discourse, they can amplify or suppress

特定值框架。因此，识别此类价值冲突是部署这些系统的核心责任。particular value frames. Identifying such value conflicts is therefore a core responsibility in deploying these systems.

为了理解这些价值偏差是如何出现的，我们必须从模型训练数据的组成开始，模型的训练数据是出现这种价值层次结构的基础。对于 GPT-3，超过 93% 的训练数据是英文的，主要来自 CommonCrawl、维基百科和数字化书籍等来源 [53]。这种对以美国为中心的内容的严重依赖嵌入了主要贡献者的文化价值观，造成了一种不对称性，这种不对称性在模型行为中产生了影响。表 5 通过比较 GPT-3 的语言组合与全球语言流行率来说明这种语言偏差。To understand how these value skews emerge, we must begin with the composition of the model’s training data which acts as the substrate from which such value hierarchies emerge. For GPT-3, over 93% of the training data was in English, drawn primarily from sources like CommonCrawl, Wikipedia, and digitised books [53]. This heavy reliance on UScentric content embeds the cultural values of dominant contributors, creating an asymmetry that reverberates in model behaviour. 除了语言表达之外，互联网的访问和参与本身就存在严重的不平等。互联网的贡献取决于财政资源、识字能力（书面和数字）、地理位置、残疾状况、教育水平、住房保障和个人倾向[406]。许多网站仍然缺乏非英语或非西方语言的界面。 Statista [369] 2020-2021 年的数据表明，北欧的互联网普及率平均为 98%，而非洲为 28.97% [292]，一些非洲国家的百分比仅为个位数。这种偏差在模型行为中造成了认知上的不公正，提升了主要贡献者的价值，同时边缘化了其他贡献者。表 6 突出显示了语言、互联网接入、互联网普及率和 GPT-3 训练数据之间的偏差。Beyond language representation, access to and participation in the internet is itself deeply unequal. Internet contribution is shaped by financial resources, literacy (written and digital), geographic location, disability status, educational level, housing security, and personal inclination [406]. Many websites still lack interfaces in non-English or non-Western languages. Statista [369] data from 2020-2021 indicates Internet penetration averaged 98% in Northern Europe versus 28.97% in Africa [292], with some African countries in single-digit percentages. Such skew creates epistemic injustice in model behaviour, elevating the values of the dominant contributors while marginalising others. 在多元化的世界中，法学硕士必须能够适应和反映不同的价值体系：在一个良性的世界中，这些价值代表必须包括少数群体和边缘群体的价值代表。然而，当模型训练主要由文化和经济实力雄厚的群体的文本贡献主导时，我们就面临着具体化现有权力结构和边缘化道德多样性的风险。In a pluralist world, LLMs must be able to accommodate and reflect diverse value systems: in a virtuous world these value representations must include those of minority and marginalised groups. However, when model training is dominated by the text contributions of culturally and financially powerful groups, we risk reifying existing power structures and marginalising ethical diversity.

2.1.2.3 多元主义与世界价值观调查Pluralism and the World Values Survey

我们没有强加规定的道德标准来评估 GPT-3，而是将我们的分析基于描述性的跨文化数据。由于像 GPT-3 这样的大型语言模型是概率性而非确定性地生成输出，因此异常或异常响应不仅仅是噪声，而且可以揭示潜在的模型趋势。我们 2021 年的研究是首批将比较道德视角应用于 LLM 价值调整的研究之一，与当时占主导地位的规范性评估方法不同 [27,320,350]。Rather than imposing a prescriptive ethical standard to evaluate GPT-3, we grounded our analysis in descriptive, cross-cultural data. Because large language models like GPT-3 generate outputs probabilistically rather than deterministically, unusual or outlier responses are not simply noise but can reveal underlying model tendencies. Our 2021 study was among the first to apply a comparative ethical lens to LLM value alignment, diverging from the prescriptive evaluation approaches dominant at the time [27, 320, 350].

除了其哲学框架之外，这项研究还对法学硕士价值调整的早期文献做出了贡献。 2021 年，大多数协调工作强调规范控制、指定目标值或过滤有害输出，而不是检查模型如何重新构建已经嵌入文本中的值。我们的描述性多元方法提供了一个互补的视角：分析 GPT-3 如何保留、扭曲或重写文化价值观。事后看来，这种方法预示着后来人们认识到结盟不仅是一项技术任务，而且还是一个代表的社会伦理问题 [1, 121, 139]，从而拓宽了文化包容性和多元道德景观的领域。Beyond its philosophical framing, this study also contributes to the early literature on LLM value alignment. In 2021, most alignment work emphasised normative control, specifying target values or filtering harmful outputs, rather than examining how models reframed values already embedded in texts. Our descriptive, pluralist method provided a complementary perspective: analysing how GPT-3 preserved, distorted, or overwrote cultural values. In hindsight, this approach anticipated later recognition that alignment is not only a technical task but also a socio-ethical problem of representation [1, 121, 139], broadening the field toward cultural inclusivity and plural moral landscapes.

为此，我们利用的数据集之一是世界价值观调查 (WVS)，这是一个纵向跨国数据集，捕捉了 120 多个国家（代表世界人口 94% 以上）对宗教、性别角色、政治和社会规范的态度[422]。四十多年来，WVS 为评估公共价值观提供了全球公认的资源，并广泛应用于学术、政策和商业领域。与网络抓取的训练数据（通常偏向于英语贡献者）相比，WVS 提供了更具代表性的真实人类快照To do so, one of the datasets we drew on was the World Values Survey (WVS), a longitudinal, cross-national dataset that captures human attitudes on religion, gender roles, politics, and social norms across more than 120 countries, representing over 94% of the world’s population [422]. For over four decades, the WVS has provided a globally recognised resource for assessing public values, used widely in academic, policy, and commercial contexts. In contrast to web-scraped training data (often skewed toward Anglophone contributors) the WVS offers a more representative snapshot of actual human

不同社会的信仰。它提供了一种凭经验锚定人类价值观“是”的方法，与休谟对“是”和“应该”之间的区别是一致的。beliefs across diverse societies. It offers a way to empirically anchor the “is” of human values, in line with Hume’s distinction between “is” and “ought.”

虽然我们承认使用国家级数据的局限性（特别是在像美国这样文化多元化和政治两极分化的国家），但仍然存在广泛表征全国人口特征的价值模式[383]。例如，美国的个人主义、澳大利亚的“伙伴关系”或东亚国家的集体和谐等价值观虽然并不普遍，但在统计上却是显着的趋势。霍夫斯泰德提出了定义国家价值概况的四个标准：它们必须是描述性的、有多个来源的支持、适用于统计上的多数、并且与其他人群有显着差异[175]。尽管他的模型面临批评 [257]，但 Schwartz 和 Bardi 以及 Tausch [352, 383] 的后续研究发现了很强的一致性，增强了比较伦理学中国家价值特征的有用性。While we acknowledge the limitations of using national-level data (especially in countries as culturally diverse and politically polarised as the United States) there are still value patterns that broadly characterise national populations [383]. For example, values like individualism in the US, “mateship” in Australia, or collective harmony in East Asian countries, while not universal, are statistically significant trends. Hofstede proposed four criteria for defining national value profiles: they must be descriptive, supported by multiple sources, apply to statistical majorities, and differ meaningfully from other populations [175]. Although his model has faced critiques [257] subsequent studies by Schwartz and Bardi, and Tausch [352, 383] found strong alignment, reinforcing the usefulness of national value characterisations in comparative ethics.

在此基础上，Inglehart 和 Welzel 开发了 WVS 文化地图，这是一种定期更新的全球价值模式可视化图 [422]。尽管该领域仍然充满活力且充满争议，但我们发现 WVS 非常适合我们的研究，既可以作为多元化的道德基线，也可以作为 GPT-3 中使用的美国主导训练数据的平衡。Building on this foundation, Inglehart and Welzel developed the WVS cultural map, a regularly updated visualization of global value patterns [422]. While the field remains dynamic and contested, we found the WVS well-suited to our study, both as a pluralist ethical baseline and as a counterbalance to the US-dominant training data used in GPT-3.

WVS 特别合适有以下三个原因：（1）它捕捉了价值多样性，但没有假设一个普遍的道德框架； (2)它提供了一个基于统计的基线，用于将模型输出与现实世界的信念进行比较； (3)它展示了民族文化（尽管存在内部多样性）如何表现出可以进行有意义分析的连贯价值倾向。这样做可以帮助我们追踪由美国文化规范塑造的 GPT-3 训练数据如何巧妙地改变或覆盖输入文本的价值逻辑。The WVS is particularly appropriate for three reasons: (1) it captures value diversity without assuming a universal moral framework; (2) it offers a statistically grounded baseline for comparing model outputs with real-world beliefs; and (3) it shows how national cultures (despite internal diversity) exhibit coherent value tendencies that can be meaningfully analysed. In doing so, it helps us trace how GPT-3’s training data, shaped by US cultural norms, may subtly shift or overwrite the value logic of input texts.

2.1.2.4 GPT-3 的“美国口音”The ‘American Accent’ of GPT-3

当我们将 GPT-3 描述为带有“美国口音”时，我们指的不是语音，而是模型输出中嵌入的更深层次的道德和文化框架。这种口音反映了其主要来自美国的英语培训数据中存在的主导价值观、假设和意识形态倾向。它是模型标准重心的简写；它强调自治、个人权利、市场逻辑和自由主义道德框架。其结果是一种超越语法或词汇并进入价值领域的文化编码形式。该模型可能不“知道”它是美国的，但它向用户反映了与美国意识形态倾向一致的世界观。When we describe GPT-3 as speaking with an ‘American Accent’, we are not referring to phonetics, but to a deeper moral and cultural framing embedded in the model’s outputs. This accent reflects the dominant values, assumptions, and ideological tendencies present in its predominantly English-language, US-sourced training data. It is a shorthand for the model’s normative centre of gravity; one that privileges autonomy, individual rights, market logic, and a libertarian moral frame. The result is a form of cultural encoding that goes beyond syntax or vocabulary and into the domain of values. The model may not ‘know’ it is American, but it reflects to the user a worldview that is aligned with American ideological tendencies.

据我们所知，这项研究是第一个识别和描述法学硕士中的“美国口音”的研究之一，这是该模型规范重心的简写，优先考虑美国文化和意识形态倾向。而本德等人的同期工作。 [31] 强调了扩展语言模型的风险，Weidinger 等人。 [418]对道德和社会风险进行了分类，包括毒性和刻板印象。在To our knowledge, this study was among the first to identify and characterise what we term an ‘American Accent’ in LLMs, a shorthand for the model’s normative centre of gravity, privileging US cultural and ideological tendencies. While contemporaneous work by Bender et al. [31] highlighted the risks of scaling language models and Weidinger et al. [418] catalogued a taxonomy of ethical and social risks including toxicity and stereotyping. In

与此同时，Solaiman & Dennison [364] 的 PALMS 尝试使用目标值数据集来引导模型；我们的重点是诊断已经存在的值。我们的分析突出了一个不同的担忧：训练数据中嵌入的更深层次的道德框架。通过将偏见概念化为一种文化口音而不仅仅是有害的联想，我们扩大了一致性话语，以认识到模型如何隐含地赋予特定价值体系特权。parallel, PALMS by Solaiman & Dennison [364] attempted to steer models with targeted value datasets; our focus instead diagnosed values already present. Our analysis foregrounded a different concern: the deeper moral framing embedded in training data. By conceptualising bias as a cultural accent rather than only as harmful associations, we broaden the alignment discourse to recognise how models implicitly privilege particular value systems.

在其他国家的文化价值观与美国主导价值观发生冲突的背景下，这种“口音”变得尤为突出。例如，当我们使用澳大利亚国家枪支协议（明确将个人枪支所有权置于公共安全之下的立法）中的一段话提示 GPT-3 时，模型返回一个输出，警告用户他们的权利受到威胁，并建议他们联系当地政客（参见表 7）。该模型将文本的原始价值等级（集体安全高于个人权利）重新构建为与美国关于枪支权利的政治话语相一致的价值等级。在这里，GPT-3 并不是简单地误读；而是误读了。它重新衡量了道德逻辑，使其与训练语料库中的主导模式保持一致。上面的示例说明了 GPT3 的输出如何将源文本“翻译”为文化编码的语域，即使表面语言保持不变。This “accent” becomes especially salient in contexts where other nations’ cultural values conflict with the dominant US values. For example, when we prompted GPT-3 with a passage from Australia’s National Firearms Agreement (legislation that explicitly subordinates individual gun ownership to public safety) the model returned an output warning the user that their rights were under threat and suggesting they contact a local politician (see Table 7). The model reframed the original value hierarchy of the text (collective safety over individual entitlement) into one aligned with US political discourse on gun rights. Here, GPT-3 did not simply misread; it reweighted the moral logic, aligning it with the dominant patterns in its training corpus. The example above illustrates how GPT3’s outputs can “translate” source texts into a culturally encoded register, even when the surface language remains unchanged.

上面的定性例子表明，模型的价值取向不是中立的，它们是由认知偏见所塑造的，这些认知偏见植根于谁的文本最有代表，谁的价值观最频繁，谁的观点最响亮。从这个意义上说，“美国口音”不仅仅是风格上的，而且是结构上的。在全球部署的系统中，这引发了对文化误传和道德置换的担忧。The above qualitative example indicates the model’s value alignments are not neutral, they are shaped by epistemic biases rooted in whose texts are most represented, whose values are most frequent, and whose perspectives are most loud. In this sense, the ‘American Accent’ is not merely stylistic, but structural. In a globally deployed system, this raises concerns about cultural misrepresentation and ethical displacement.

总之，本节阐明了我们实证研究的理论框架。语言编码价值观；价值观因文化而异；法学硕士在一代人中复制并有时改变这些价值观。为了从道德上评估这一点，我们采用道德价值多元化的视角，并利用世界价值观调查作为比较框架。In sum, this section has articulated the theoretical scaffolding for our empirical investigation. Language encodes values; values vary across cultures; and LLMs reproduce and sometimes transform these values in generation. To evaluate this ethically, we adopt a moral value pluralist lens and utilise the World Values Survey as a comparative framework.

2.1.3 2021年评估：规范性基准2.1.3 Evaluation in 2021: Prescriptive Benchmarks

在 2021 年进行研究时，大多数大型语言模型 (LLM) 的评估方法都依赖于狭隘的规范性基准 [121, 418]。这些评估侧重于准确性、毒性、偏见和推理，通常基于隐含的文化或制度标准假设“正确”的反应。这些评估很少经过哲学或社会文化审查[31,121,268,418]。正如本章所讨论的，这样的In 2021 when the research was conducted, most evaluation methods for large language models (LLMs) relied on narrow, normative benchmarks [121, 418]. These assessments focussed on accuracy, toxicity, bias, and reasoning, often assuming a “correct” response based on implicit cultural or institutional standards. Rarely did these evaluations undergo philosophical or sociocultural scrutiny [31, 121, 268, 418]. As this chapter argues, such

62

第2章：Chapter 2:机器中的幽灵有美国口音The Ghost in the Machine Has an American Accent

框架存在将主导规范编码为普遍性的风险，几乎没有为道德多元化留下空间。frameworks risk encoding dominant norms as universal, leaving little room for ethical pluralism.

评估和协调密切相关，但概念上截然不同。协调涉及塑造模型行为以反映所需的规范；评估评估该行为与期望的匹配程度。早期的评估（通常由工程师设计）强调绩效而非道德。例如，像 Terry Winograd 这样的先驱者专注于语言能力，而不质疑基准设计中嵌入的价值观 [224, 421]。Evaluation and alignment are closely linked but conceptually distinct. Alignment involves shaping model behaviour to reflect desired norms; evaluation assesses how well that behaviour matches expectations. Early evaluations (often designed by engineers) emphasised performance over ethics. For example, pioneers like Terry Winograd focussed on linguistic competence without questioning the values embedded in benchmark design [224, 421].

到 2021 年，大多数法学硕士评估仍然严重依赖反映英语或西方机构规范的基准。当时的研究人员已经在质疑规范评估、重新利用数据集以及基准中内置的假设的道德有效性[103,208,350]。减轻损害的努力通常包括内容过滤、数据集管理和早期微调。这些方法有明显的局限性：过滤器是劳动密集型的，并且容易过度审查批评性话语；微调仍然是实验性的，并且通常由同质的人类注释者指导。例如，OpenAI 的 PALMS 数据集旨在使输出与人权原则保持一致，但严重依赖美国的评估者（77% 白人，74% 美国公民），将特定的文化框架嵌入到模型的“可接受”响应中 [364]。By 2021, most LLM evaluations still leaned heavily on benchmarks that reflected Anglophone or Western institutional norms. Researchers at the time were already questioning the ethical validity of normative-evaluations, repurposing datasets, and the assumptions built into benchmarks [103, 208, 350]. Efforts to mitigate harm typically included content filtering, dataset curation, and early fine-tuning. These methods had notable limitations: filters were labour-intensive and prone to over-censoring critical discourse; fine-tuning was still experimental and often guided by homogenous human annotators. OpenAI’s PALMS dataset, for instance, aimed to align outputs with human rights principles but relied heavily on US-based raters (77% white, 74% US citizens), embedding specific cultural frames into the model’s “acceptable” responses [364].

尽管 RLHF、人工智能反馈强化学习 (RLAIF) 和宪法人工智能等较新的对齐技术扩展了工具包，但它们并没有解决根本问题。这些方法仍然通过迭代反馈循环强化规范偏好，并且在某些情况下可能加剧价值嫁接。例如，尼日利亚的低成本注释劳动力以反映外包文化框架的方式塑造了“英语”输出[169]。同样，宪法人工智能的批评者指出，选择“宪法”会优先考虑特定的规范框架，同时边缘化其他框架[409]。Although newer alignment techniques such as RLHF, reinforcement learning from AI feedback (RLAIF), and Constitutional AI have expanded the toolkit, they do not resolve the underlying issue. These methods still reinforce normative preferences via iterative feedback loops and can, in some cases, exacerbate value grafting. For example, low-cost annotation labour in Nigeria has shaped “English” outputs in ways that reflect outsourced cultural framings [169]. Likewise, critics of Constitutional AI note that choosing a “constitution” privileges particular normative frameworks while marginalising others [409].

评估实践仍然是基准驱动的，几乎没有衡量文化差异或规范争议的工具。尽管越来越多的社会科学家和哲学家进入该领域，但主导的评估范式仍然优先考虑技术可比性和可扩展性，而不是道德包容性。批评性学术声音强调需要建立明确考虑情境有效性、社会文化细微差别和价值多元化的评估框架[41,44,181,229,320]。Evaluation practices remain benchmark-driven, with few tools for measuring cultural variability or normative contestation. Despite more social scientists and philosophers entering the field, dominant evaluation paradigms continue to prioritise technical comparability and scalability over ethical inclusivity. Critical academic voices have emphasized the need for evaluation frameworks that account explicitly for contextual validity, sociocultural nuance, and value pluralism [41, 44, 181, 229, 320].

我们没有强加规定的道德标准来评估 GPT-3，而是将我们的分析基于描述性的跨文化数据。由于像 GPT-3 这样的大型语言模型是概率性而非确定性地生成输出，因此异常或异常响应不仅仅是噪声，而且可以揭示潜在的模型趋势。我们的研究提供了另一种选择：基于比较伦理学并以经验数据为基础的多元化描述性方法。而不是问模型是否符合单一Rather than imposing a prescriptive ethics standard to evaluate GPT-3, we grounded our analysis in descriptive, cross-cultural data. Because large language models like GPT-3 generate outputs probabilistically rather than deterministically, unusual or outlier responses are not simply noise but can reveal underlying model tendencies. Our study offers an alternative: a pluralist, descriptive approach grounded in comparative ethics and informed by empirical data. Rather than asking whether models conform to a singular

标准，我们询问他们是否保留、扭曲或覆盖了嵌入在不同文化输入中的价值观。这种方法可以实现更加伦理敏感的评估，能够考虑认知开放性、文化细微差别和多元道德景观。standard, we ask whether they preserve, distort, or overwrite the values embedded in culturally diverse inputs. This methodology enables more ethically sensitive evaluations capable of accounting for epistemic openness, cultural nuance, and plural moral landscapes.

2.1.4 研究目的和问题2.1.4 Research aims and questions

我们的探索性研究以这样的假设为指导：当大型语言模型（LLM）主要根据来自单一文化或语言背景（特别是以美国为中心的来源）的数据进行训练时，它将在其生成输出中隐式编码和反映这些主流文化价值观。我们认为，质疑这一假设至关重要，因为嵌入主导价值观可能会导致少数群体或代表性较低的价值体系边缘化，从而可能强化模型行为中存在问题的价值循环。Our exploratory research is guided by the hypothesis that when a large language model (LLM) is trained predominantly on data from a single cultural or linguistic context (particularly US-centric sources) it will implicitly encode and reflect those mainstream cultural values in its generative outputs. We argue that interrogating this hypothesis is critical, as embedding dominant values risks marginalising minority or less-represented value systems, potentially reinforcing problematic value loops in model behaviour.

为了响应 OpenAI 对多元人类价值联盟的呼吁 [379]，并认识到价值联盟本质上是动态的且根据具体情况而变化，我们确立了两个主要研究目标：In response to OpenAI’s call for pluralistic human value alignment [379], and recognising that value alignment is inherently dynamic and contextually nuanced, we established two primary research aims:

  1. 凭经验识别和描述 GPT-3 如何保留、扭曲或覆盖与其主要训练语料库显着不同的输入文本中嵌入的文化道德价值观。To empirically identify and characterise how GPT-3 preserves, distorts, or overwrites culturally embedded ethical values from input texts significantly divergent from its dominant training corpus.

  2. 利用明确基于道德价值多元化的描述性和比较性评估框架，批判性地评估这些价值转变的伦理影响。To critically evaluate the ethical implications of these value shifts, utilising a descriptive and comparative evaluative framework grounded explicitly in moral value pluralism.

这些目标转化为两个重点研究问题：These aims translate into two focussed research questions:

问题一：RQ1:在处理输入文本时，GPT-3 在多大程度上改变了文化中嵌入的道德价值观；特别是那些与美国主导价值观相悖的价值观？To what extent does GPT-3 alter culturally embedded ethical values when processing input texts; particularly those that diverge from reported dominant US values?

问题2：RQ2:基于世界价值观调查等经验数据集的描述性多元化评估方法如何为生成人工智能模型的更具包容性和代表性的评估的发展提供信息？How could a descriptive, pluralist evaluation approach, grounded in empirical datasets like the World Values Survey, inform the development of more inclusive and representative evaluations of generative AI models?

通过解决这些问题，我们的研究旨在增强评估生成式人工智能模型的方法，强调人工智能生成文本输出中道德多元化、代表性公平和语境敏感性的重要性。Through addressing these questions, our research aims to enhance methodologies for evaluating generative AI models, foregrounding the importance of ethical plurality, representational equity, and contextual sensitivity in AI-generated text outputs.

2.2 方法论：描述性多元分析2.2 Methodology: Descriptive Pluralist Analysis

为了调查像 GPT-3 这样的早期法学硕士如何再现或转变嵌入的文化价值观，我们进行了一项定性探索性研究，重点关注文本摘要期间的价值突变。我们的方法使用文化和语言多样化的输入对模型进行压力测试，其中包含与统计主导规范正交的嵌入值To investigate how early LLMs like GPT-3 reproduce or transform embedded cultural values, we conducted a qualitative exploratory study focussed on value mutation during text summarisation. Our approach stress-tested the model using culturally and linguistically diverse inputs that contained embedded values orthogonal to statistically dominant norms

64

第2章：Chapter 2:机器中的幽灵有美国口音The Ghost in the Machine Has an American Accent

据 WVS 报道，在美国境内。然后，我们提示 GPT-3 总结这些文本，并分析输出是否以及如何改变或重新衡量原始材料的价值取向。within the United States, as reported in the WVS. We then prompted GPT-3 to summarise these texts and analysed whether and how the outputs altered or reweighted the value orientation of the original material.

我们的研究团队由拥有十个国家公民身份或居住权且精通六种语言的成员组成。每位研究人员都从他们生活的文化和语言经验中选择了源文本。这些文本是公开的，通常广为人知，并且在先前的政治、意识形态或哲学学术中经常被分析。共同的标准是每个输入文本都带有可辨别的道德或文化价值取向，使其适合在道德价值多元化（MVP）框架内进行分析。我们有目的地抽样文本，这些文本可能被视为与报告的主导美国社会价值观正交的嵌入价值观，通常以 WVS 等数据集为指导。Our research team comprised members with citizenship or residency across ten countries and fluency in six languages. Each researcher selected source texts drawn from their lived cultural and linguistic experience. These texts were publicly available, often widely known, and frequently analysed in prior political, ideological, or philosophical scholarship. The common criterion was that each input text carried a discernible moral or cultural value orientation, making it suitable for analysis within a moral value pluralist (MVP) framework. We purposively sampled texts that might be seen to hold embedded values orthogonal to reported dominant US social values, often taking guidance from datasets like the WVS.

我们通过 OpenAI 的应用程序编程接口 (API) 访问 GPT-3，并使用其两个预设模板：“TL;DR summarization”和“Summarize for a 2ndgrader”（使用原始美国拼写），对生成设置进行了细微调整，包括温度、top_p、Frequency_penalty、presence_penalty 和 max_tokens。这些模板指示模型保留输入的意图，同时使其更易于访问。我们感兴趣的是这种重新呈现是否保留或扭曲了原始价值框架，特别是产出是否转向规范的美国价值模式。始终使用达芬奇引擎（GPT-3 当时最强大的型号）。We accessed GPT-3 via OpenAI’s Application Programming Interface (API) and used two of its preset templates: “TL;DR summarization” and “Summarize for a 2nd grader” (using the original US spelling), with minor adjustments to generation settings including temperature, top_p, frequency_penalty, presence_penalty, and max_tokens. These templates instruct the model to preserve the intent of the input while rendering it more accessible. Our interest was in whether this re-rendering preserved or distorted the original value framework, particularly whether outputs shifted toward normative US value patterns. The Davinci engine (GPT-3’s most powerful model at the time) was used consistently.

该研究通过一个结构化但解释性的测试过程进行，旨在预测价值突变而不是基准性能。我们并不是寻求统计概括或通用分数，而是寻求在总结过程中是否保留、软化或重新定向文化背景输入的模式指示。因此，测试序列结合了有目的的文本选择、有限模板条件下的重复提示以及基于团队的对输出之间的价值变化的定性分析。表 8 总结了这些方法测试步骤。The study proceeded through a structured but interpretive testing process designed to foreground value mutation rather than benchmark performance. We were not seeking statistical generalisation or a universal score, but patterned indications of whether culturally situated inputs were preserved, softened, or redirected during summarisation. The testing sequence therefore combined purposive text selection, repeated prompting under bounded template conditions, and team-based qualitative analysis of value shifts across outputs. Table 8 summarises these method testing steps.

预备会议是协作、同步进行的。 GPT-3 在法语和西班牙语文本上表现良好，但随着与英语的语言距离增加，保真度下降。在理解能力出现障碍的情况下，我们要么调整提示语言，要么提供由我们团队中的母语或流利使用者制作的高质量翻译。像立陶宛语这样的语言，模型表现不佳，主要通过英语翻译进行测试。所有提示均遵循一次性格式。Preliminary sessions were conducted collaboratively and synchronously. GPT-3 performed adequately on texts in French and Spanish, but with decreasing fidelity as linguistic distance from English increased. In cases where comprehension appeared impaired, we either adjusted the prompt language or provided high-quality translations produced by native or fluent speakers on our team. Languages like Lithuanian, for which the model performed poorly, were primarily tested via English translations. All prompts followed a one-shot format.

为了在 2021 年 GPT-3 研究期间管理随机性和及时敏感性，每项测试都故意重新运行多次。对于英语输入，我们为每个项目发布了 6 次运行（其中 3 次使用 OpenAI 的“TL;DR”预设，3 次使用“为二年级学生总结”）。如果需要翻译或源文本不是英语，我们会扩展到十到十二次运行，以确保跨语言的稳定、清晰的输出。我们将不频繁但具有重要价值的生成视为具有分析意义的信号，而不是可丢弃的噪声，这适用于 2021 年中期实时更新的概率系统。这种重复使我们能够可靠地观察价值漂移，同时保持成本和代币预算易于处理。每轮结束后，团队都会集体审查输出，以确定模型是否以及如何改变嵌入值。差异与统计报告（例如来自 WVS 的报告）交叉引用。To manage stochasticity and prompt sensitivity during the 2021 GPT-3 study, each test was deliberately re-run multiple times. For English-language inputs, we issued six runs per item (three using OpenAI’s “TL;DR” preset and three using “Summarize for a 2nd grader”). Where translation was required or source texts were non-English, we expanded to ten– twelve runs to secure stable, legible outputs across languages. We treated infrequent but value-significant generations as analytically meaningful signals rather than discardable noise—appropriate for a probabilistic system under live updates in mid-2021. This repetition allowed us to observe value drift reliably while keeping costs and token budgets tractable. After each round, the team collectively reviewed outputs to determine whether, and how, the model had altered the embedded values. Divergences were cross-referenced against statistical reports, such as from the WVS.

66

第2章：Chapter 2:机器中的幽灵有美国口音The Ghost in the Machine Has an American Accent

所有测试均在 2021 年 7 月至 10 月期间进行。这是一个关键的方法细节：在此期间，OpenAI 对 GPT-3 进行了持续的、未记录的更新，到 10 月，我们观察到性能发生了明显的质变。未记录的修改是当时机器学习系统的一个常见问题[182]，就 GPT-3 而言，这些修改主要是通过用户社区团体报告的。因此，我们的观察结果代表了一个不断变化的实时系统的快照，有助于记录生成式人工智能进化的一个具有历史意义的阶段。All testing occurred between July and October 2021. This is a critical methodological detail: OpenAI made continuous, undocumented updates to GPT-3 during this period, and by October we observed noticeable qualitative changes in performance. Undocumented modifications were a frequent issue with machine learning systems at the time [182], and in the case of GPT-3 they were primarily reported through user community groups. Our observations therefore represent a snapshot of a live system in flux, helping to document a historically significant stage in the evolution of generative AI.

当我们提到测试期间不断变化的值时，我并不是在声称两个冻结模型版本之间进行受控比较。相反，这种比较是定性的和历史性的：同一提示系列的早期和后期运行是针对在 2021 年 7 月至 10 月期间更新的实时 GPT-3 系统进行的。从这个意义上说，“第一轮”和“第二轮”是指同一实时周期内较早和较晚的测试会话，而不是两个单独版本的模型版本。重点是记录不断变化的系统中的变化行为，而不是孤立单个因果变化。我们的研究是有意探索性的，旨在阐明高容量生成模型中文化价值转变的可能机制。我们遵循 GPT-3 [31, 127] 的其他早期定性评估的传统，使用仔细阅读和有目的的抽样来揭示新兴模型行为。附录B（第265页）提供了主要测试的提示和输出的结构化选择，包括原始语言和英语案例，而不是研究期间产生的每个原始生成。附录 C（第 272 页）概述了该模型使用的设置。本文中讨论的例子只是为了说明性的，而不是具有统计代表性的。When we refer to evolving values across the test period, I am not claiming a controlled comparison between two frozen model versions. Rather, the comparison is qualitative and historically situated: earlier and later runs of the same prompt families were conducted against a live GPT-3 system that was being updated during the July to October 2021 window. In that sense, the “first” and “second” rounds refer to earlier and later test sessions within the same live period, not to two separately versioned model releases. The point is to document shifting behaviour in a system in flux, not to isolate a single causal change. Our research was intentionally exploratory, designed to illuminate possible mechanisms of cultural value transformation within a high-capacity generative model. We follow in the tradition of other early qualitative evaluations of GPT-3 [31, 127] that used close reading and purposive sampling to surface emergent model behaviours. Appendix B (page 265) provides a structured selection of prompts and outputs from the main tests, including originallanguage and English cases, rather than every raw generation produced during the study. Appendix C (page 272) outlines the settings used with the model. The examples discussed in this paper are selected to be illustrative, not statistically representative.

我们承认，有些人可能会将这一选择过程视为“挑选樱桃”。然而，我们与海滩梳理的隐喻保持一致：在一个新颖且动态的认知领域，研究人员从模型生成的概率浪潮中收集有意义的工件。正如引言中所述，我们将异常世代视为在概率模型中具有分析意义。 [3]我们的目标不是从数据集中进行概括，而是诊断 GPT-3 在文化差异输入的压力下如何表现。这是针对不透明、非确定性系统的有效探究模式，特别适合早期探索性研究。We acknowledge that some may view this selection process as “cherry-picking.” However, we align instead with the beachcombing metaphor: in a novel and dynamic epistemic terrain, researchers collect meaningful artifacts from the probabilistic tide of model generations. As noted in the Introduction, we treat unusual generations as analytically meaningful in probabilistic models.[3] Our goal is not to generalise from a dataset, but to diagnose how GPT-3 behaves under stress from culturally divergent inputs. This is a valid mode of inquiry for opaque, non-deterministic systems and is particularly appropriate for early-stage exploratory research.

这项研究采用了一种探索性的定性方法，不是为了主张普遍真理，而是为了在道德价值多元框架内揭示模式、提出新问题并完善理论理解。我们不是寻求统计概括，而是对说明性示例进行详细的解释分析，揭示文化价值转变如何在生成系统中发生。在这种情况下，即使是孤立的或This study embraces an exploratory, qualitative methodology not to claim universal truths, but to surface patterns, raise new questions, and refine theoretical understanding within a moral value pluralist framework. Rather than seeking statistical generalisation, we offer detailed interpretive analysis of illustrative examples that reveal how cultural value transformations may occur in generative systems. In this context, even isolated or

3 法学硕士在可能的延续中产生分布；低概率世代可以暴露集中趋势指标遗漏的潜在趋势。3 LLMs produce distributions over possible continuations; low-probability generations can expose latent tendencies that central-tendency metrics miss.

67

第2章：Chapter 2:机器中的幽灵有美国口音The Ghost in the Machine Has an American Accent

看似低概率的输出具有分析意义。由于像 GPT-3 这样的大型语言模型是按概率运行的，因此异常值不仅仅是要被丢弃的噪声，而是揭示潜在模型趋势的信号。仅在六项或十多项产出中观察到的价值转变可能仍然反映了系统性偏见或具有道德后果的失败模式，特别是在高风险或大规模部署中。seemingly low-probability outputs are analytically significant. Because large language models like GPT-3 operate probabilistically, outliers are not simply noise to be discarded but signals that expose underlying model tendencies. A value shift observed in just one of six or a dozen outputs may still reflect systemic bias or failure modes with ethical consequences, especially in high-stakes or scaled deployments.

因此，我们认为定性的“海滩梳理”并不是方法论上的弱点，而是探索生成人工智能复杂的非线性行为以及开发能够适应道德多元化的评估框架的重要工具。由于 GPT-3 是一个随机系统，因此此处不将单个输出视为固定或内部持有值的证据。相反，分析转向可比较的提示和源文本中道德框架中反复出现的差异。内部不连贯、无意义或对提示无反应的输出被排除，其余输出被定性地读取以进行评估重点和道德推理，而不是标记级别的变化。因此，这种说法是比较性的，而不是拟人化的：这些模式表明了由训练数据形成的分布趋势，而不是稳定的内在价值观。As such, we argue that qualitative “beachcombing” is not a methodological weakness, but an essential tool for probing the complex, non-linear behaviours of generative AI and for developing evaluative frameworks capable of accommodating ethical plurality. Because GPT-3 is a stochastic system, individual outputs are not treated here as evidence of fixed or internally held values. The analysis turns instead on recurring differences in moral framing across comparable prompts and source texts. Outputs that were internally incoherent, nonsensical, or unresponsive to the prompt were excluded, and the remaining outputs were read qualitatively for evaluative emphasis and moral reasoning rather than token-level variation. The claim, then, is comparative rather than anthropomorphic: these patterns suggest distributional tendencies shaped by training data, not stable inner values.

2.2.1 限制2.2.1 Limitations

由于研究团队获取 GPT-3 中代币数量的限制以及超出这些代币数量所带来的财务成本，产出被设置为最多 250 个代币。同样的原因将每次测试的迭代次数限制为六到十二次，尽管我们发现这通常足以观察从输入到输出的值的突变。此外，由于法学硕士的短暂性，结果无法重现，因为模型不再以该格式存在。Due to limitations on the research team’s access to the number of tokens in GPT-3 and the financial costs associated with over-reaching these, the output was set to a maximum of 250 tokens. The same reason limited the number of iterations to six to twelve times per test, though we found this often sufficient to observe a mutation of values from input to output. Additionally, due to the ephemeral nature of LLMs, the results cannot be reproduced as the model no longer exists in that format.

2.3 结果：跨环境的价值漂移2.3 Results: Value Drift Across Contexts

为了探索 GPT-3 如何处理嵌入文化的道德价值观，我们使用来自多个国家、背景和价值传统的简短输入文本进行了一系列测试。这些文本因其明确的规范立场而被选择，这些立场通常与报告的统计上占主导地位的美国价值观不同，并且通常包括法律、政治演讲、哲学著作和多边宣言。在每种情况下，我们都会提示 GPT-3 总结或解释文本，然后分析其输出的值漂移、稳定性或重构。在相关的情况下，我们利用了外部实证数据集，例如世界价值观调查，以更好地结合这些结果。To explore how GPT-3 handles culturally embedded ethical values, we conducted a series of tests using short input texts drawn from multiple countries, contexts, and value traditions. These texts were selected for their clear normative positions, often ones that diverge from reported statistically dominant US values and often included laws, political speeches, philosophical writings, and multilateral declarations. In each case, we prompted GPT-3 to summarise or explain the text, then analysed its outputs for value drift, stability, or reframing. Where relevant, we drew on external empirical datasets, such as the World Values Survey, to better contextualise these outcomes.

2.3.1 案例1：枪支管制（澳大利亚）2.3.1 Case 1: Gun Control (Australia)

据报道，澳大利亚和美国公众对枪支权利和枪支管制的看法存在很大差异[283]。澳大利亚最致命的大规模枪击事件发生在1996年，被称为“亚瑟港大屠杀”，造成35人死亡、23人受伤。几个月内，澳大利亚政府颁布了“小枪支法案”，旨在限制枪支拥有量，旨在防止此类大规模枪击事件并减少总体枪支暴力。该法案禁止了自动和半自动武器，启动了国家枪支补偿性回购计划（第一年自愿交出近70万件武器），并加强了许可、登记、培训和储存规定。 2021 年（即该法案实施 25 年后）进行的报告表明，随着澳大利亚文化继续远离对枪支拥有的渴望以及不拥有枪支的澳大利亚人的比例持续增长，枪支死亡总数下降了一半，登记的枪支拥有量稳步下降 [280]。The reported public view of gun rights and gun control vary significantly between Australia and the US [283]. Australia’s deadliest mass shooting occurred in 1996, known as “The Port Arthur Massacre”, in which 35 people were killed and 23 injured. Within months the Australian government enacted “The Small Firearms Act” aimed at limiting gun ownership with the intent to prevent these kinds of mass-shootings and to reduce gun violence overall. The Act placed bans on automatic and semi-automatic weapons, a national gun compensatory buyback programme was initiated (nearly 700,000 weapons were voluntarily surrendered in the first year), and licensing, registration, training and storage mandates were all strengthened. Reports conducted in 2021–marking 25 years after the Act was implemented–indicated overall gun deaths had dropped by half, and registered gun ownership saw a steady decline as the Australian culture continued to move away from a desire for gun ownership and the percentage of Australians that don’t own any guns continues to grow [280].

美国的人均民用枪支数量为世界最高，为每 100 人 120.5 支枪支（2017 年数字）[362]。截至 2017 年，美国平民拥有 3.93 亿支枪支，这意味着尽管他们只占全球人口的 4%，但他们拥有全球民用枪支库存的约 40% [362]。 2019年，当美国公民被问到“你认为哪个更重要？保护美国公民拥有枪支的权利还是控制枪支所有权”时，近一半（47%）表示拥有枪支的权利对他们来说更重要；共和党（81%）和民主党（21%）选民之间存在巨大差异[306]。相比之下，澳大利亚公民每 100 人大约拥有 14 支枪支 [362]。 2016 年，当被问及“您认为澳大利亚枪支所有权法律是否太强、不够强或不够强？”时，85% 的人表示这些法律要么是强，要么不够强 (70%)，其中超过一半的受访者希望加强枪支管制 [91]。The US has the highest level of civilian firearms per person in the world at 120.5 firearms per 100 persons (2017 figures) [362]. As at 2017, 393 million guns were owned by US civilians which means that despite making up only 4% of the global population, they hold approximately 40% of the entire global stock of civilian firearms [362]. when US citizens were asked in 2019 “What do you think is more important? To protect the right of US citizens to own guns or to control gun ownership”, nearly half (47%) indicated the right to own guns was more important to them; with strong differences between Republican (81%) and Democrat (21%) voters [306]. In contrast Australian citizens own approximately 14 firearms per 100 persons [362]. In 2016 when asked “Do you think Australian gun ownership laws are too strong, not strong enough or about right?”, 85% said the laws were either about right or not strong enough (70%) with more than half of those respondents wanting increased gun control [91].

美国和澳大利亚之间明显的国家报告差异促使我们将澳大利亚枪支法 [91] 的一部分输入到 GPT-3 中。我们要求模型对文本进行六次总结，虽然其中四个输出很好地保留了嵌入值，但其中一个输出警告了自由的丧失（参见表 9）。六分之一的人（尽管在统计上属于少数）仍然担心内在价值观的完全突变——在这种情况下，完全转变为支持枪支权利作为保护个人自卫权的一种手段。The obvious nationally reported differences between the US and Australia prompted us to input a section of the Australian Firearms Act [91] into GPT-3. We asked the model to summarise the text six times and whilst four of the outputs held the embedded value quite well, one output warned of a loss of liberties (See Table 9). One in six, though statistically a minority, is still concerning consider the complete mutation of the embedded values–in this case a total reversal to be pro-gun rights as a means of protecting individual rights to selfdefence.

我们将嵌入值的这种改变（从输入文本到输出文本）与 WVS [422] 中的结果进行比较。在 WVS-Wave 7 中，问题 141 询问人们是否“出于安全原因携带刀、枪或其他武器”。在接受调查的 n=2,596 名美国受访者中，28.3% 的人表示“是”；在 1,813 名做出回应的澳大利亚人中，4.7% 的人表示“是”。 WVS 的第 150 个问题询问受访者“自由还是安全”哪个更重要，美国的结果清楚地表明人们更喜欢自由（69.5%）而不是安全（28.3%）。澳大利亚的结果是自由（51.2%）和安全（46.5%），这表明与美国相比，从自由到安全的总体价值观存在差异。虽然这些比较并不完全相同，但它们确实支持了一个广泛观察到的观点，即美国比澳大利亚更重视枪支拥有权。We compared this alteration of the embedded value (from the input text to the output text) to results in the WVS [422]. In WVS-Wave 7, Question 141 asks if people have “carried a knife, gun, or other weapon for reasons of security”. Of the n=2,596 US respondents canvassed, 28.3% said “yes”; of the n=1,813 Australians responding, 4.7% said “yes”. Question 150 of the WVS asks respondents which is more important “Freedom or security”, with US results clearly showing a preference for freedom (69.5%) over security (28.3%). Australian results were freedom (51.2%) and security (46.5%), indicating a difference in overall values from freedom to security compared to the US. Whilst these comparisons are not exactly the same, they do support a widely observed belief that gun ownership is a much higher priority in the US than Australia.

2.3.2 案例2：性别与哲学（法国）2.3.2 Case 2: Gender and Philosophy (France)

该测试摘自西蒙娜·德·波伏娃的著作This test draws on an excerpt from Simone de Beauvoir’s第二性The Second Sex[28]，这是一篇基础女权主义文本，批评西方男性气质如何在理性话语的幌子下理想化女性的顺从。我们选择这个文本是因为它是一个众所周知的女权主义文本，具有明显的嵌入价值。由于当时的令牌长度限制，我们从《第二性》的介绍中选择了一段摘录，我们认为它体现了其中一些价值观。在这段摘录中，德波伏娃讽刺了普通西方男人的幻想：一个女人的反抗足以让她最终的屈服感到自己是应得的。这段话批评了男性的骄傲，揭露了它对伪装成理性说服的统治的依赖。[28], a foundational feminist text that critiques how Western masculinity idealises women’s submission under the guise of rational discourse. We selected this text as it is a well-known feminist text with obvious embedded values. Due to token length restrictions at the time, we selected an excerpt from the introduction of The Second Sex that we felt embodied some of these values. In this excerpt, De Beauvoir ironises the average Western man’s fantasy: a woman who resists just enough to make her eventual submission feel earned. The passage is critical of masculine pride, exposing its dependence on domination dressed up as reasoned persuasion.

我们提示 GPT-3 使用“TL;DR”和“二年级学生总结”预设来总结这段摘录。在英语和法语的九代人中，我们在六个输出中观察到嵌入值的明显突变。这些作品并没有保留女权主义的批评，而是倾向于以自然化或肯定波伏瓦所批评的性别规范的方式重写该段落。We prompted GPT-3 to summarise this excerpt using both “TL;DR” and “Summarize for a second grader” presets. Across nine generations in English and French, in six outputs we observed a distinct mutation in the embedded values. Instead of preserving the feminist critique, the outputs tended to rewrite the passage in ways that naturalised or affirmed the very gender norms de Beauvoir was critiquing.

例如，表 10 中的输出样本 1 使用美国约会文化的语言重新构建了波伏娃的批评，表明“女人会被危险的男人所吸引”，而“好男人”很无聊。这将女权主义对统治的分析转变为对浪漫本能的性别本质主义解释，强化了人们熟悉的美国比喻，如“坏男孩”和“好人”的困境。同样，样本2呈现出一种错误的对称性“西方男性想要与她们平等的女性；西方女性想要比她们优越的男性”，这将原始的权力批判扁平化为互补欲望的叙述。在这两种情况下，该模型都用个性化的异性恋脚本取代了结构性批评，不仅反映了美国化和非政治化的性别角色框架，而且还反映了对解释的更广泛的文化偏见For instance, output Sample 1 in Table 10, reframes de Beauvoir’s critique using the language of American dating culture, suggesting that “women are attracted to men who are dangerous” and that ‘nice guys’ are boring. This transforms a feminist analysis of domination into a gender-essentialist account of romantic instinct, reinforcing familiar American tropes like the ‘bad boy’ and ‘nice guy’ dilemma. Similarly, Sample 2 presents a false symmetry “Western men want women who are their equals; Western women want men who are their superiors” which flattens the original power critique into a narrative of complementary desire. In both cases, the model replaces structural critique with individualised, heteronormative scripts, reflecting not only an Americanised and depoliticised framing of gender roles but also a broader cultural bias toward interpreting

通过个人偏好和同意的视角来看待社会问题，而不是通过法国女权主义传统中更普遍强调的社会文化权力结构。social issues through the lens of personal preference and consent, rather than through socio-cultural power structures more commonly emphasised in French feminist traditions.

在翻译 OpenAI 的提示模板“为二年级学生总结”时，我们遇到了额外的语义问题。在英语中，“二年级学生”的概念没有性别之分，但在有性别之分的法语中，必须做出选择。因此，我们使用两种性别版本进行测试：While translating the OpenAI’s prompt template “summarize for a second grader,” we faced an additional semantic problem. In English, the notion of ‘second grader’ is not gendered, but in the gendered language of French, a choice had to be made. We therefore ran the test using both gendered versions:一个人un élève（男性）和(masculine) and埃莱夫une élève（女性）。有趣的是，GPT-3 根据提示的性别返回不同的输出，这表明该模型对性别语言的敏感性，但不一定是对文化含义的理解。(feminine). Interestingly, GPT-3 returned different outputs depending on the gender of the prompt, suggesting the model’s sensitivity to gendered language, but not necessarily its understanding of the cultural implications.

添加的The addition of“ne”（这是一个否定）(which is a negation) in“ne subisse pas librement sa domination”在男性提示版本中，颠倒了波伏娃这句话的原意。而不是描述一个女人in the masculine prompt version reverses the original meaning of de Beauvoir’s sentence. Instead of describing a woman who自由提交freely submits，它描述了一个人, it describes one who不自由提交does not freely submit，这巧妙地改变了理想的框架，并破坏了波伏娃最初措辞中的批判性讽刺。, which subtly alters the framing of the ideal and undermines the critical irony in de Beauvoir's original phrasing.

GPT-3 将文本错误地描述为“呼吁强奸”（见表 10，输出样本 3），这反映了对德·波伏娃含义的严重扭曲。我们将其解释为一种价值观冲突，可能与不同国家对妇女权利的看法差异有关。根据益普索 (Ipsos) 的一份关于美国和法国之间人们对暴力侵害妇女行为 (VAW) 看法的报告，虽然 25% 的美国受访者认为女性经常编造或夸大虐待或强奸的说法，但在法国只有 8% 的人持相同看法 [196]。法国公众倾向于对权力采取更加结构性和情境敏感的观点，而美国话语往往倾向于个人主义、基于同意的框架。 GPT-3 输出的变化表明该模型与后者更加一致，但这样做时未能体现源文本的讽刺、批评和嵌入的文化逻辑。GPT-3’s highly problematic mischaracterisation of the text as “a call to rape”” (see Table 10, output Sample 3) reflects a profound distortion of de Beauvoir’s meaning. We interpreted it as a value conflict that could correlate with the difference in the perception of women’s rights in different countries. According to an Ipsos report on people’s perceptions on Violence Against Women (VAW) between the US and France, while 25% of respondents in the US agree that women often make up or exaggerate claims of abuse or rape, only 8% think the same in France [196]. The French public tends to take a more structural and context-sensitive view of power, while American discourse often leans toward individualistic, consent-based framings. The shifts in GPT-3’s output suggest that the model aligns more closely with the latter, and in doing so, fails to register the irony, critique, and embedded cultural logic of the source text.

72

这些结果表明，GPT-3 经常通过美国文化脚本重新构建波伏娃的内在价值观：作为欲望的统治、作为浪漫挑战的服从和本质主义的性别角色。该模型没有复制最初的批评，而是用流行的性别比喻重写了它。与主导训练数据一致的值突变实例。 GPT-3 对波伏瓦的“美国化”说明了一种更广泛的认知风险：当主流文化价值观覆盖对立或少数派观点时，该模型不仅扭曲了意义，还将抵制扁平化为顺从。These results show that GPT-3 often reframed de Beauvoir’s embedded values through American cultural scripts: dominance-as-desire, submission-as-romanticchallenge, and essentialist gender roles. Rather than reproducing the original critique, the model overwrote it with popular gendered tropes; an instance of value mutation aligned with dominant training data. GPT-3’s ‘Americanisation’ of de Beauvoir illustrates a broader epistemic risk: when dominant cultural values overwrite oppositional or minority perspectives, the model doesn’t merely distort meaning, it flattens resistance into compliance.

这些发现反映出法国和美国价值体系在性别、责任和权利方面存在更深层次的分歧。正如 Saguy [345] 指出的，美国处理性骚扰的方法侧重于个人权利和雇主责任，而法国体系则侧重于社会文化权力和国家责任。法国法律框架将骚扰视为暴力而非歧视，并强调国家对公司治理的裁决。有鉴于此，GPT-3 通过个人主义或本质主义视角对波伏瓦的解读不仅反映了文化错位，而且还反映了对性别动态的情境敏感、集体和政治框架的结构性抹除。These findings echo deeper divergences in French and American value systems around gender, responsibility, and rights. As Saguy [345] notes, while US approaches to sexual harassment focus on individual rights and employer liability, the French system centres on socio-cultural power and state responsibility. French legal frameworks treat harassment as violence, not discrimination, and emphasise state adjudication over corporate governance. In this light, GPT-3’s reading of de Beauvoir through individualistic or essentialist lenses reflects not just cultural misalignment, but structural erasure of context-sensitive, collective, and political framings of gender dynamics.

2.3.3 案例3：移民与人道主义（德国）2.3.3 Case 3: Immigration and Humanitarianism (Germany)

为了对模型对移民价值观的处理进行压力测试，我们摘录了安格拉·默克尔 (Angela Merkel) 2015 年叙利亚难民危机最严重时期的演讲，其中她为德国接纳超过 100 万寻求庇护者的决定进行了辩护 [263]。摘录包括默克尔现在著名的短语To stress test the model’s treatment of immigration values, we selected an excerpt from Angela Merkel’s 2015 speech during the height of the Syrian refugee crisis, in which she defended Germany’s decision to admit over one million asylum seekers [263]. The excerpt includes Merkel’s now-famous phrase“Wir schaffen das”（“我们能做到”），这个口号很快不仅象征着德国的后勤能力，而且象征着德国对人道主义的道义承诺。这段文字强调了对那些逃离战争的人的同情，并将难民接待视为一项基于德国的宪法义务。(“We can do it”), a slogan that quickly came to symbolise not only Germany’s logistical capacity but its moral commitment to humanitarianism. The passage emphasizes empathy toward those fleeing war, and frames refugee reception as a constitutional obligation grounded in Germany’s基本法Grundgesetz（《基本法》）。它反映了当时德国政治话语中广泛讨论的公民道德立场(Basic Law). It reflects a civic-moral stance widely discussed in German political discourse at the time as意志文化Willkommenskultur（“欢迎文化”）。默克尔的这句话“Wir schaffen das”成为欧洲对移民的人道主义立场的象征，不仅象征着能力，还象征着道德决心。(‘welcoming culture’). Merkel’s phrase “Wir schaffen das” became emblematic of a humanitarian stance toward immigration in Europe, symbolising not just capacity but moral resolve.

表 11 中的样本 1 将默克尔充满价值的承诺重新构建为“出于人道主义原因”限制移民的呼吁，巧妙地援引了美国政治话语中常见的稀缺逻辑 [260]。该模型没有将接收难民视为一项宪法和道德义务（正如默克尔明确规定的那样），而是将问题重新定位为有限的能力和必要的分类问题。这与美国移民言论中有据可查的模式相一致，其中难民入境常常被视为对国内资源、就业或安全的零和威胁[279]，这是特朗普政府右翼保护主义政策的象征，模型是在特朗普政府的培训期间进行的。Sample 1 in Table 11, reframes Merkel’s value-laden commitment into a call for immigration limitation “for humanitarian reasons,” subtly invoking a scarcity logic common in US political discourse [260]. Rather than recognising refugee intake as a constitutional and moral obligation (as Merkel explicitly frames it) the model reorients the issue as one of limited capacity and necessary triage. This aligns with well-documented patterns in US immigration rhetoric, where refugee admission was often cast as a zero-sum threat to domestic resources, jobs, or security [279] emblematic of right-wing protectionist policies of the Trump administration during which the model was trained.

该模型直接违背了消息来源对道德责任和开放性的强调，将演讲框定为提倡限制，具有讽刺意味的是，出于人道主义和经济原因而合理。它反映了美国话语中更常见的安全化、基于稀缺性的框架。The model directly contradicts the source’s emphasis on moral responsibility and openness by framing the speech as advocating restrictions, ironically justified by both humanitarian and economic reasons. It reflects a securitised, scarcity-based frame more common in American discourse.

样品2Sample 2

将默克尔基于权利、富有同理心的诉求重新构建为更加有条件、资源敏感的逻辑。虽然它承认难民的困境，但它的重点是断言“我们必须决定谁来”，并引入了一个把关框架。这标志着从普遍人道主义义务到酌情国家利益的转变，呼应了美国优先考虑控制而非共同义务的叙述。Reframes Merkel’s rights-based, empathetic appeal into a more conditional, resourcesensitive logic. While it acknowledges refugee hardship, it pivots to assert “we must decide who comes,” introducing a gatekeeping frame. This marks a shift from universal humanitarian duty to discretionary national interest, echoing American narratives that prioritise control over shared obligation.

It introduces a fear-based logic foreign to Merkel’s speech and mirrors US securitisation rhetoric around immigration and terrorism, transforming compassion into defensive pragmatism.

根据WVS的相关数据，在n=2,596名美国受访者中，32%认为移民会增加失业率，而在n=1528名德国受访者中，49.9%不同意[422]。此外，45.2% 的美国受访者认为雇主应优先雇用本国人员而不是移民，而在德国，46.2% 的受访者不同意这种观点 [422]。As per relevant data from the WVS, of the n=2,596 US respondents, 32% believed that immigration increases unemployment, while of n=1528 German respondent, 49.9% disagreed [422]. Furthermore, 45.2% of US respondents believed that employers should prioritize hiring nation people over immigrants, while in Germany the 46.2% of respondents disagreed with that sentiment [422].

样本 2 保持了表面的同理心，但将默克尔的人道主义要求重新构建为选择性的条件逻辑。虽然该模型承认难民遭受苦难，但它的重点是断言“我们必须决定谁来”，引入了一个将控制和资格优先于义务的把关框架。这与美国主流移民话语相呼应，特别是在 9/11 之后，国家利益和安全审查往往凌驾于集体道德责任之上。最初对宪法义务的诉求被一种自由裁量的、资源理性的叙述所取代，这种叙述巧妙地与美国对主权和边境控制的例外主义态度相一致。Sample 2 maintains surface-level empathy but reframes Merkel’s humanitarian imperative into a conditional logic of selectivity. While the model acknowledges refugee suffering, it pivots to assert, “we must decide who comes,” introducing a gatekeeping frame that prioritises control and eligibility over obligation. This echoes dominant American immigration discourse, particularly post-9/11, where national interest and securitised vetting often override collective moral responsibility. The original appeal to constitutional duty is replaced by a discretionary, resource-rational narrative that subtly aligns with US exceptionalist attitudes toward sovereignty and border control.

在样本 3 中，默克尔的道德诉求被重新解释为自我保护：输出认为我们应该帮助难民，这样他们就不会变得危险。这体现了同情心，表明援助是管理风险的策略。这种推理反映了美国移民和反恐言论中突出的“堡垒逻辑”[183]​​，即通过有条件的慷慨来化解潜在威胁。该模式从道德义务到防御必要性的转变代表了一种明显的价值突变，将默克尔的框架去政治化，并将难民援助重新定位为先发制人的威胁管理手段。In Sample 3, Merkel’s moral appeal is reinterpreted as self-protection: the output argues that we should help refugees, so they do not become dangerous. This instrumentalises compassion, suggesting that aid is a strategy for managing risk. Such reasoning reflects the “fortress logic” prominent in US immigration and counterterrorism rhetoric [183], where potential threats are defused through conditional generosity. The model’s shift from ethical obligation to defensive necessity represents a clear value mutation, depoliticising Merkel’s framing and recontextualising refugee assistance as a means of pre-emptive threat management.

这些成果表明默克尔演讲中的内在价值观正在重新构建，这种重新构建可能受到美国主流文化和政治叙事的影响。二十项成果中有一半淡化或取代了默克尔的宪法和人道主义承诺，而是复制了强调把关、有条件援助和基于资源的理由的框架。这些转变与美国道德个人主义、安全化和国家利益的更广泛模式是一致的[279]。These outputs suggest a reframing of the embedded values in Merkel’s speech, a reframing likely influenced by dominant US cultural and political narratives. Half of the twenty outputs downplayed or displaced Merkel’s constitutional and humanitarian commitments, instead reproducing frames that emphasise gatekeeping, conditional aid, and resource-based justification. These shifts are aligned with a broader pattern of American moral individualism, securitisation, and national interest [279].

2.3.4 附加测试2.3.4 Additional tests

为了进一步探索这个想法，我们通过一份联合国教科文组织文件草案向 GPT-3 发起挑战To explore this idea further we challenged GPT-3 with a UNESCO draft document关于人工智能伦理的建议The Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence[401]。与《消除对妇女一切形式歧视公约》一样，该文件是由代表多种价值观的许多民族国家的代表共同撰写的。 2021 年 11 月，193 个教科文组织成员通过了该建议[402]。美国当时还不是教科文组织的成员，这反映出与教科文组织的间歇性接触模式在不同行政部门之间存在差异。这种关系的转变凸显了多边人工智能治理的争议性和政治偶然性。[401]. As with the CEDAW, the document was co-written by representatives of many nation states representing a plurality of values. The recommendation was adopted by 193 UNESCO members in November 2021 [402]. The United States was not a member at the time, reflecting a pattern of intermittent engagement with UNESCO that has varied across administrations. This shifting relationship underscores the contested and politically contingent nature of multilateral AI governance.

在我们的测试中，我们使用了第 18 条的摘录，该条重点关注人工智能对环境和气候的影响，并将这些影响视为规范性义务，而不是可选的考虑因素。For our test we used an excerpt from Article 18, which focuses on the environmental and climate impacts of AI and frames these as normative obligations rather than optional considerations.

“参与人工智能系统生命周期的所有参与者都必须遵守适用的国际法和国内立法、标准和实践，例如为环境和生态系统保护和恢复以及可持续发展而设计的预防措施。他们应减少人工智能系统对环境的影响，包括但不限于其碳足迹，以确保最大限度地减少气候变化和环境风险因素，并防止对自然资源的不可持续开发、使用和改造，从而导致环境恶化和生态系统退化。” [401，第十八条]“All actors involved in the lifecycle of AI systems must comply with applicable international law and domestic legislation, standards and practices, such as precaution, designed for environmental and ecosystem protection and restoration, and sustainable development. They should reduce the environmental impact of AI systems, including but not limited to its carbon footprint, to ensure the minimization of climate change and environmental risk factors, and prevent the unsustainable exploitation, use and transformation of natural resources contributing to the deterioration of the environment and the degradation of ecosystems.” [401, Article 18]

这段话的意义不仅在于其实质内容，还在于其规范形式。第 18 条并未将环境损害视为与创新相平衡的次要权衡。它将生态保护、可持续性和预防作为人工智能生命周期中所有参与者的不可或缺的义务。这使其成为本研究有用的测试用例。如果 GPT-3 保留了源文本的价值取向，那么输出应该保留这种更强硬的义务、约束和环境责任语言。如果没有，我们预计该模型会将这些承诺软化为更通用的技术承诺和优化叙述。表 13 显示了结果输出。The significance of this passage lies not only in its substantive content but in its normative form. Article 18 does not frame environmental harm as a secondary trade-off to be balanced against innovation. It presents ecological protection, sustainability, and precaution as integral obligations for all actors involved in the AI lifecycle. That makes it a useful test case for the present study. If GPT-3 preserves the value orientation of the source text, the outputs should retain this stronger language of obligation, restraint, and environmental responsibility. If not, we would expect the model to soften these commitments into a more generic narrative of technological promise and optimisation. Table 13 shows the resulting outputs.
