In thesis terms, it illustrates market-making more than model error. Governments are not the only ones who engage in market shaping. Individuals and investment groups can also manipulate or nudge markets using similar mechanisms.

3.5.3 个人市场设计3.5.3 Market Design by Individuals

2022 年，Citadel 创始人肯·格里芬 (Ken Griffin) 将家人和公司总部从芝加哥搬到了迈阿密 [253]。这一决定引发了当地房地产价格的急剧上涨。 Citadel 员工紧随其后，购买房屋并推高了本已高价值社区的需求。连锁反应是显着的：当地代理商称此举是豪华房产价格飙升的催化剂。长期居民和小型企业In 2022, Citadel founder Ken Griffin moved his family and the firm’s headquarters from Chicago to Miami [253]. This single decision sparked sharp increases in local real estate prices. Citadel employees followed, purchasing homes and driving up demand in already high-value neighbourhoods. The ripple effects were significant: local agents cited the move as a catalyst for a surge in luxury property prices. Longtime residents and small businesses

第3章：Chapter 3:模型不是市场。The Model is Not the Market.

117

面临更高的成本。但当利率上升且一些员工选择不搬迁时，市场降温，给买家和开发商带来波动。这个例子强调了一个知名人士的决策如何有效地设计市场——尽管是无意的。faced higher costs. But when interest rates rose and some staff chose not to relocate, the market cooled, creating volatility for buyers and developers alike. This example underscores how the decisions of a single, high-profile individual can effectively design a market—albeit unintentionally.

3.5.4 投资集团的市场设计3.5.4 Market Design by Investment Groups

During 2022-2023, rising interest rates in Australia triggered speculation by AI-driven valuation models and media narratives that property prices would fall, causing buyers to hesitate and prices to dip [247].与此同时，房地产公司购买了被低估的房产，预计市场将会反弹。当澳大利亚储备银行暂停加息时，房地产价格飙升，导致普通买家被高价抛售[101]。During 2022-2023, rising interest rates in Australia triggered speculation by AI-driven valuation models and media narratives that property prices would fall, causing buyers to hesitate and prices to dip [247]. Meanwhile, property firms bought undervalued properties, anticipating a market rebound. When the Reserve Bank of Australia paused rate hikes, property values surged back up, leaving regular buyers priced out [101].

这些例子表明，建模和做市之间的界限比乍看起来要细得多。房地产并不是我们可以使用工具的中立地带；它是一个中立的领域。它是一个不断发展的社会技术系统，由人类和机器的价值观、激励措施和设计选择所塑造。 As AI systems increasingly influence how property is priced, sold, financed, and developed, small shifts in model assumptions (or deliberate manipulation) can have wide-reaching consequences. Without robust oversight and a deep understanding of how models interact with social and economic contexts, we risk undermining public trust and amplifying existing inequities. For real estate educators, the challenge is not only to teach how these models work, but to equip students with the critical tools to question who designs them, whose interests they serve, and how they shape the markets we live in.These examples reveal that the line between modelling and market-making is far thinner than it first appears. Real estate is not a neutral terrain onto which we apply tools; it is an evolving sociotechnical system shaped by values, incentives, and design choices, both human and machine. As AI systems increasingly influence how property is priced, sold, financed, and developed, small shifts in model assumptions (or deliberate manipulation) can have wide-reaching consequences. Without robust oversight and a deep understanding of how models interact with social and economic contexts, we risk undermining public trust and amplifying existing inequities. For real estate educators, the challenge is not only to teach how these models work, but to equip students with the critical tools to question who designs them, whose interests they serve, and how they shape the markets we live in.

3.6 现实世界的影响3.6 Real World Implications

人工智能驱动的房地产模型不仅能提高房地产估值的效率，还具有深远的影响。 The very act of model building—deciding which data to include, the weighting of features, and the abstraction level—plays a critical role in shaping market outcomes. In Australia, for example, research on mass valuation using big data has demonstrated that even state-of-the-art automated valuation models (AVMs) can produce skewed estimates if the input data or model assumptions embed historical biases. These biases not only affect property prices and investor confidence but also influence broader urban development trends, potentially reinforcing patterns of disinvestment or overvaluation in certain neighbourhoods. The sociotechnical feedback loops inherent in AVM systems illustrate how human decisions in model design interact with machine outputs to drive real-world market dynamics, ultimately impacting sustainability and social diversity.AI-driven models in real estate have far-reaching consequences beyond mere efficiency gains in property valuation. The very act of model building—deciding which data to include, the weighting of features, and the abstraction level—plays a critical role in shaping market outcomes. In Australia, for example, research on mass valuation using big data has demonstrated that even state-of-the-art automated valuation models (AVMs) can produce skewed estimates if the input data or model assumptions embed historical biases. These biases not only affect property prices and investor confidence but also influence broader urban development trends, potentially reinforcing patterns of disinvestment or overvaluation in certain neighbourhoods. The sociotechnical feedback loops inherent in AVM systems illustrate how human decisions in model design interact with machine outputs to drive real-world market dynamics, ultimately impacting sustainability and social diversity.

In the realm of investment advice, AI-powered platforms in Australia, such as those used for mass valuation by CoreLogic, Pricefinder, and Pointdata [256], can inadvertently

第3章：Chapter 3:模型不是市场The Model is Not the Market

118

创造自我强化的循环。如果 AVM 持续高估高需求地区的房产，可能会吸引投资者对这些地区的注意力，从而进一步推高价格并加剧地区不平等。这些反馈循环助长了投机泡沫，同时导致其他领域资本不足。道德影响超出了定价范围，影响抵押贷款资格甚至住房保险 [76, 427]。create self-reinforcing cycles. If an AVM consistently overvalues properties in high-demand areas, it may draw investor attention to those regions, inflating prices further and exacerbating regional inequality. These feedback loops contribute to speculative bubbles while leaving other areas undercapitalised. The ethical implications extend beyond pricing, impacting mortgage eligibility and even housing insurance access [76, 427].

当人工智能用于住宅租户选择时，有毒偏见问题发挥着重要作用。到 2025 年，住宅租赁危机将影响许多国家的许多低收入人群。越来越多的房东和机构开始利用人工智能来筛选申请并为租房者做出决定：这往往会带来不公平的结果。The issue of toxic-bias plays a significant role when AI is used for residential tenant selection. The residential rental crisis is impacting many people of lower incomes across many countries in 2025. Increasingly, landlords and agencies are turning to AI to sift through applications and make decisions on renters: often with unfair outcomes.

3.6.1 案例简介：算法拒绝给老年人提供住房3.6.1 Case vignette: Senior denied housing by algorithm

2018 年，美国一位名叫克里斯·罗宾逊 (Chris Robinson) 的 75 岁老人申请了加州老年生活社区的住房。由一家名为 TransUnion 的公司设计的人工智能驱动的筛选程序拒绝了他的申请，给他分配了高风险评分 [60]。该模特错误地将乱扔垃圾的罪名归咎于他，而该罪名属于德克萨斯州另一名同名男子。尽管错误后来得到纠正，罗宾逊还是损失了公寓和申请费。随后发起集体诉讼，最终达成 1150 万美元和解。这个案例说明，即使是很小的数据标签错误，当通过自动化系统放大时，也会产生严重的人类后果。In the US in 2018 a 75-year-old many named Chris Robinson applied for housing in a California senior living community. An AI-driven screening programme designed by a company called TransUnion, denied his application by assigning him a high-risk score [60]. The model had mistakenly attributed a littering conviction to him that belonged to a different man with the same name in Texas. Though the error was later corrected, Robinson lost the apartment and application fee. A class-action lawsuit followed, resulting in an $11.5 million settlement. This case exemplifies how even minor data labelling errors, when amplified through automated systems, can produce major human consequences.

这个简短的小插曲是为了在下面更全面的 CoreLogic 案例之前强调一个基本但后果严重的社会技术失败。这种危害是通过数据来源、身份匹配、筛选软件、住房提供者和薄弱的追索机制的相互作用而产生的，而不是由单一的孤立的技术故障产生的。因此，完整的概念表处理被附加到 CoreLogic 案例中，它以更具结构性的分层形式开发了相同的问题。This short vignette is included to foreground a basic but consequential sociotechnical failure before the fuller CoreLogic case below. The harm emerged through the interaction of data provenance, identity matching, screening software, housing providers, and weak recourse mechanisms, rather than from a single isolated technical glitch. The full concepttable treatment is therefore attached to the CoreLogic case, which develops the same problem in a more structurally layered form.

监管机构开始应对这些挑战。在澳大利亚，政策制定者对人工智能驱动的估值模型建立更强有力的监督的势头越来越大。对透明度、数据质量和算法公平性的担忧引发了对强制算法审计、可解释性标准和改进数据治理的呼吁。这些步骤对于确保人工智能支持贷款、租赁和土地使用规划的公平结果至关重要。Regulatory bodies are beginning to respond to these challenges. In Australia, there is growing momentum among policymakers to establish stronger oversight of AI-driven valuation models. Concerns about transparency, data quality, and algorithmic fairness have led to calls for mandatory algorithmic audits, explainability standards, and improved data governance. These steps are crucial to ensure that AI supports equitable outcomes in lending, leasing, and land-use planning.

3.6.2 案例研究：租户筛选和历史种族主义3.6.2 Case study: Tenant screening and historical racism

在 2018 年的一场诉讼中，租户筛选软件的主要参与者 CoreLogic 面临指控，称其“CrimSAFE”算法违反了美国公平住房法案 [63]。该诉讼称，CrimSAFE 根据先前的逮捕情况自动拒绝申请人（甚至撤回）In a 2018 lawsuit, CoreLogic, a major player in tenant-screening software, faced allegations that its “CrimSAFE” algorithm violated the US Fair Housing Act [63]. The suit claimed that CrimSAFE’s automatic rejection of applicants based on prior arrests (even withdrawn

119

第3章：Chapter 3:模型不是市场。The Model is Not the Market.

指控）对有色人种的影响尤为严重。原告辩称，通过依赖反映系统性种族差异的逮捕数据，该算法使住房歧视长期存在。尽管 CoreLogic 坚称其报告是中立的，但该案例凸显了数据包含和解释方面的设计选择如何重现根深蒂固的不平等现象。charges) disproportionately impacted people of colour. The plaintiffs argued that by relying on arrest data, which reflects systemic racial disparities, the algorithm perpetuated housing discrimination. Though CoreLogic maintained that its reports were neutral, the case spotlighted how design choices in data inclusion and interpretation can reproduce entrenched inequities.

正如埃里克森等人。 [118]认为，人工智能系统不仅仅是自动化决策，而是重组劳动力和责任在基础设施中的分配方式。在像 CrimSAFE 这样的案例中，责任分散在房东、软件提供商和数据经纪人之间，造成了责任阴影，那些受住房决策影响最大的人很难找到任何可以有意义地承担责任的参与者。通过 MaSH Loops 的视角，CoreLogic 案例展示了机器评分、房东决策、数据代理基础设施和租户脆弱性如何递归地相互作用，从而将住房排除作为更广泛的社会技术循环的属性，而不仅仅是算法的属性。As Ericson et al. [118] argue, AI systems do not simply automate decisions but restructure how labour and accountability are distributed across infrastructures. In cases like CrimSAFE, responsibility is fragmented between landlords, software providers, and data brokers, creating accountability shadows in which those most affected by housing decisions struggle to identify any actor who can be meaningfully answerable. Read through the MaSH Loops lens, the CoreLogic case shows how machine scoring, landlord decisionmaking, data-broker infrastructure, and tenant vulnerability recursively interact, producing housing exclusion as a property of the wider sociotechnical loop rather than of the algorithm alone.

第3章：Chapter 3:模型不是市场The Model is Not the Market

120

3.6.2.1 课堂活动：比较概念表Class activity: Compare concept tables

COMPAS、Zillow、Singapore GLS 和 CoreLogic 示例的概念表现在可用于进一步探索。比较四个案例研究背后的数据和假设，突出一致的主题，例如对历史记录的依赖和自动化决策的社会法律影响。邀请学生探究每个模型如何定义“正在建模的抽象概念”：例如，CoreLogic 如何定义风险？讨论提示可能包括有关利益相关者压力的问题（例如，想要快速筛查的房东如何可能与公平住房法规发生冲突）以及人工智能开发人员检测或纠正错误的道德义务。通过列出这些考虑因素，学生可以更清楚地了解租户筛选工具如何在多个点嵌入偏见，从而强化严格审计、透明度和上诉机制的重要性。The concept tables for the COMPAS, Zillow, Singapore GLS, and CoreLogic examples can now be used for further exploration. Compare the data and assumptions behind the four case studies, highlighting consistent themes such as reliance on historical records and the socio-legal impact of automated decisions. Invite students to probe how each model defines the “abstract concept being modelled”: e.g., how does CoreLogic define risk? Discussion prompts could include questions on stakeholder pressures (e.g., how landlords wanting rapid screening might clash with fair housing regulations) and the ethical obligations of AI developers to detect or correct errors. By mapping out these considerations, students gain a clearer view of how tenant-screening tools can embed bias at multiple points, reinforcing the importance of rigorous auditing, transparency, and appeal mechanisms.

上述例子凸显了人工智能不仅是一种工具，而且是塑造市场、社区和住房机会的积极推动者。如果不加以控制，它可能会加剧现有的不平等，并对经济流动性造成障碍。正是在课程的这一点上，教育工作者可以指导学生进行第一项活动。The above examples highlight how AI is not just a tool but an active agent in shaping markets, communities, and access to housing. When left unchecked, it can reinforce existing inequalities and create barriers to economic mobility. It is at this point in the course that educators could direct students to work on the first activity.

3.7 缓解挑战3.7 Mitigating Challenges

缓解人工智能驱动的房地产模型固有的道德挑战首先要从严格的数据治理和仔细的模型设计开始。确保训练数据集多样化、准确且不受历史偏见的影响至关重要。这涉及对数据源进行定期审核、识别和纠正不平衡的预处理步骤，以及结合 XAI 等技术来阐明模型的决策过程。Mitigating the ethical challenges inherent in AI-driven real estate models starts with rigorous data governance and careful model design. Ensuring that training datasets are diverse, accurate, and free from historical prejudices is paramount. This involves implementing regular audits of data sources, preprocessing steps to identify and correct imbalances, and incorporating techniques such as XAI to illuminate the model’s decisionmaking processes.

  • 模型开发人员：Model Developers:负责塑造整体模型架构。他们可以通过获取不同的数据集并记录设计决策来减少系统偏差，包括包含或排除的参数、绘制的抽象边界以及所使用的所有数据的来源。Are responsible for shaping the overall model architecture. They can reduce systemic biases by sourcing diverse datasets and documenting design decisions, including the parameters included or excluded, the abstraction boundaries drawn, and the provenance of all data used.

  • 模型技术人员：Model Technicians:在实施和维护模型透明度方面发挥关键作用。这包括记录变量选择、详细说明特征如何加权以及阐明算法逻辑中嵌入的假设。Play a critical role in implementing and maintaining model transparency. This includes logging variable selections, detailing how features are weighted, and articulating the assumptions embedded within the algorithmic logic.

  • 监管机构和监督专业人员：Regulatory Bodies and Oversight Professionals:必须确保房地产中使用的模型符合法律和道德标准。这包括强制记录、要求算法审计以及支持可解释性措施，使最终用户和受影响方可以理解模型。Must ensure that models used in real estate comply with legal and ethical standards. This includes mandating documentation, requiring algorithmic audits, and supporting explainability measures that make models understandable to end users and affected parties.

121

第3章：Chapter 3:模型不是市场。The Model is Not the Market.

正如我们详细讨论的那样，创建概念表和 STS 地图是缓解 AI 房地产中的一些 RAI 挑战的良好开端。房地产还可以借鉴其他 RAI 技术，例如模型卡、多元化利益相关者参与、问责实践、追索机制和可持续性整合，这些技术共同有助于建立一个更值得信赖的生态系统。As we have discussed in detail, creating concept tables and STS maps is an excellent start to mitigating some of the RAI challenges in AI-Real estate. There are additional RAI techniques that real estate can draw from, such as model cards, diverse stakeholder engagement, accountability practices, mechanisms for recourse, and sustainability integration, that together help build a more trustworthy ecosystem.

3.7.1 模型卡3.7.1 Model Cards

模型卡是传达人工智能模型如何运行的一种实用工具[267]。模型卡最初是在一般人工智能环境中引入的，它与房地产同样相关，尤其是在早期概念表的基础上构建时。模型卡充当人工智能系统的一种“元标签”，概述了模型的目的、数据、性能和局限性的关键方面。当与人工智能房地产工具一起发布时，它们可以提高透明度并支持负责任的使用。One practical tool for communicating how an AI model operates is the model card [267]. Originally introduced in general AI contexts, model cards are equally relevant to real estate, especially when building on earlier concept tables. A model card functions as a kind of “meta-tag” for AI systems, outlining critical aspects of a model’s purpose, data, performance, and limitations. When published alongside AI-real estate tools, they can enhance transparency and support responsible use.

模型卡的关键组件可能包括：Key components of a model card might include:

  • 目的和范围。Purpose and Scope.概述模型的预期目的：它是为了估计房产价值、筛选潜在租户、推荐投资策略还是其他目的？通过阐明这些目标，利益相关者可以更轻松地评估模型是否在与其原始设计一致或冲突的环境中使用。Outline the model’s intended purpose: Is it designed to estimate property values, screen potential tenants, recommend investment strategies, or something else? By clarifying these objectives, stakeholders can more easily evaluate whether the model is being used in contexts that align, or conflict with, its original design.

  • 数据集来源和已知偏差。Dataset Provenance and Known Biases.训练数据从哪里来？它是根据房地产销售、人口统计记录还是用户应用程序编制的？突出已知的差距或不平衡（例如，代表性不足的社区）有助于利益相关者评估模型在不同背景下的表现。Where did the training data come from? Was it compiled from property sales, demographic records, or user applications? Highlighting known gaps or imbalances (for example, underrepresented neighbourhoods) helps stakeholders assess how the model may behave in different contexts.

  • AI 模型选择。AI-Model Choice.有许多人工智能模型可供使用。记录使用哪个模型以及选择该模型的原因。There are many AI-models available for use. Document which model was used and why that model was selected.

  • 性能指标和验证。Performance Metrics and Validation.在房地产领域，指标可能包括房产估值的平均绝对误差 (MAE)、与实际市场销售价格的相关性或租户筛选中的误报率。模型卡应描述如何验证这些指标、使用什么时间范围、对哪些地理区域进行采样以及是否使用外部验证数据。In real estate, metrics might include the Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of property valuations, the correlation with actual market sale prices, or false-positive rates in tenant screening. The model card should describe how these metrics were validated, what timeframe was used, which geographic regions were sampled, and whether external validation data was employed.

  • 预期使用环境。Intended Usage Context.明确哪些使用场景合适（例如短期市场趋势分析、初步抵押贷款风险评估）。此外，国家的限制，例如没有捕捉到快速的社区高档化或依赖过时的历史数据。Specify which usage scenarios are appropriate (e.g., short-term market trend analysis, preliminary mortgage risk assessment). Also, state limitations, such as not capturing rapid neighbourhood gentrification or relying on outdated historical data.

第3章：Chapter 3:模型不是市场The Model is Not the Market

122

  • 这些只是对模型卡中可能包含的因素的一些建议。工作模型卡可能有更多方面。重要的是，模型卡不要成为“道德清洗”的工具，并且必须注意确保这种风险缓解策略与其他因素相结合。These are only a few suggestions for factors that could be included in model cards. A working model card is likely to have many more aspects. It is important that model cards don’t become a tool for “ethics washing” and care must be made to ensure this risk mitigation strategy be incorporated with other factors.

模型卡并不是灵丹妙药。正如谷歌[151]指出的那样，它们也不是“一刀切”的解决方案。它们可能需要嵌入更广泛的透明度框架中。应鼓励学生和未来的专业人士创建和评论模型卡，作为其人工智能素养的一部分。应鼓励房地产学生在研究一系列示例后开发自己的模型卡[92]。Model cards are not a silver bullet. Nor are they, as Google [151] notes, a “one-size-fitsall” solutions. They may need to be embedded within broader transparency frameworks. Students and future professionals should be encouraged to create and critique model cards as part of their AI literacy. Real estate students should be encouraged to develop their own model cards after examining a range of examples [92].

3.7.2 多元化的利益相关者参与3.7.2 Diverse Stakeholder Engagement

负责任的人工智能开发取决于整个模型生命周期中广泛的利益相关者的参与。这包括领域专家、社区代表、监管者以及受房地产决策影响最大的人。这些声音有助于确保模型反映现实、符合道德价值观并对公共利益负责。建立正式的反馈循环，定期根据现实世界的结果测试模型输出，从而实现迭代改进和纠正。在租户筛选或住房投资等高风险环境中，监管框架和独立审计对于确保公平、防止伤害和维护公众信任至关重要。Responsible AI development depends on engaging a wide range of stakeholders throughout the model lifecycle. This includes domain experts, community representatives, regulators, and those most impacted by real estate decisions. These voices help ensure that models reflect lived realities, align with ethical values, and remain accountable to public interest. Establishing formal feedback loops, where model outputs are regularly tested against realworld outcomes, enables iterative improvement and correction. In high-stakes contexts such as tenant screening or housing investment, regulatory frameworks and independent audits are essential for ensuring fairness, preventing harm, and maintaining public trust.

3.7.3 问责制3.7.3 Accountability

人工智能驱动的房地产应用程序中的问责制需要在模型生命周期的每个阶段（从数据收集和管理到部署和监控）明确划分职责。模型开发者应保留其决策的详细记录，包括选择哪些变量以及如何加权，以便任何估值结果背后的基本原理都是透明且可追溯的。让这些决策清晰易读，尤其是对监管机构、最终用户和受影响社区而言，是建立信任和确保房地产人工智能系统接受审查的基础。Accountability in AI-driven real estate applications requires clear delineation of responsibilities across every stage of the model lifecycle from data collection and curation to deployment and monitoring. Developers of the models should maintain detailed records of their decisions, including which variables are selected and how they are weighted, so that the rationale behind any valuation outcome is transparent and traceable. Making these decisions legible, especially to regulators, end-users, and affected communities, is foundational to building trust and ensuring AI systems in real estate remain open to scrutiny.

3.7.4 追索机制3.7.4 Mechanisms for Recourse

当人工智能系统造成损害，例如提供不准确的估价或不公平地筛选租户时，必须有明确的调查、解释和补救途径。这包括技术审查和人工监督。When AI systems cause harm such as delivering inaccurate valuations or unfairly screening out tenants there must be clear paths for investigation, explanation, and redress. This includes both technical review and human oversight.

房地产监管机构和专业机构可以通过要求以下措施来强化这一点：Real estate regulators and professional bodies can reinforce this by requiring:

  • 公开记录的评分标准。Publicly documented scoring criteria.

123

第3章：Chapter 3:模型不是市场。The Model is Not the Market.

  • 透明的纠错过程。Transparent error correction processes.

  • 对算法决策有争议的上诉机制。Appeal mechanisms for disputing algorithmic decisions.

通过使追索成为可能，该系统表明责任并不会随着自动化而结束。这些措施不仅在利益相关者之间建立信任，而且还强调，即使在自动化流程中，最终的责任和义务也在于设计、部署和监督技术的人类参与者。By making recourse possible, the system signals that accountability doesn’t end with automation. Such measures not only build trust among stakeholders but also underscore that, even in automated processes, ultimate responsibility and accountability lies with human actors who design, deploy, and oversee the technology.

3.7.5 可持续性3.7.5 Sustainability

人工智能房地产的可持续性超越了效率。它涉及调整经济、环境和社会优先事项，以支持有弹性的社区和长期城市规划。精心设计的模型可以预测基础设施需求、环境风险和人口变化，帮助指导政策和投资实现包容性、生态意识的结果。例如，整合环境指标的模型可以帮助确定绿色建筑举措影响最大的领域。将可持续发展原则融入模型设计中，可确保人工智能不仅仅反映短期趋势，还有助于塑造为所有人服务的面向未来的城市。Sustainability in AI-Real Estate goes beyond efficiency. It involves aligning economic, environmental, and social priorities to support resilient communities and long-term urban planning. Well-designed models can forecast infrastructure needs, environmental risks, and demographic shifts, helping guide policy and investment toward inclusive, eco-conscious outcomes. For example, models that integrate environmental indicators can help identify areas where green building initiatives will have the most impact. Embedding sustainability principles into model design ensures that AI does more than reflect short-term trends, it helps shape future-ready cities that serve all.

简而言之，人类必须继续处于人工智能房地产生态系统的中心。模型可以进行抽象、计算和优化，但决定这些技术是服务于公共利益还是加剧现有不平等的是人类的决策、价值观和监督。人类最终要承担责任，受到积极或消极影响的都是人类。In short, humans must remain at the centre of AI-real estate ecosystems. Models may abstract, calculate, and optimise, but it is human decisions, values, and oversight that determine whether these technologies serve the public good or exacerbate existing inequities. Humans are ultimately accountable, and it is humans that will be positively or negatively impacted.

这些缓解策略，从严格的数据治理到利益相关者参与，不仅是理论工具，而且是学生可以在现实世界中应用的实用框架。教育工作者可能希望鼓励学生通过设计自己的更道德的人工智能模型来应用这些原则。These mitigation strategies, ranging from rigorous data governance to stakeholder engagement, are not only theoretical tools, but practical frameworks that students can apply in real-world contexts. Educators may wish to encourage students to apply these principles by designing their own more ethical AI models.

3.8 结论3.8 Conclusion

人工智能模型中的偏差通常源于训练它们的数据。房地产估值中使用的历史数据集可以反映过去的歧视性做法或系统性失衡，这意味着基于此类数据建立的任何模型都有可能使这些偏见长期存在。例如，如果过去的交易由于社会经济或种族偏见而低估了某些社区的房产价值，人工智能系统可能会继续为这些地区分配较低的价值，从而进一步加剧不平等。Bias in AI models often originates from the data on which they are trained. Historical datasets used in property valuation can reflect past discriminatory practices or systemic imbalances, meaning that any model built on such data risks perpetuating those biases. For instance, if past transactions undervalued properties in certain neighbourhoods due to socioeconomic or racial prejudices, AI systems may continue to assign lower values to these areas, further entrenching inequality.

偏差的另一个来源是模型构建中固有的抽象过程。当开发人员选择要包含哪些变量以及如何加权它们时，他们会将自己的观点和假设嵌入到模型中。这个故意的Another source of bias arises from the process of abstraction inherent in model building. When developers choose which variables to include and how to weight them, they embed their own perspectives and assumptions into the model. This intentional

第3章：Chapter 3:模型不是市场The Model is Not the Market

124

简化对于实际分析是必要的，但这也意味着现实世界的一些细微差别会丢失，从而导致一种扭曲的表示，可能会无意中偏向某些结果而不是其他结果。实际上，每个模型都是塑造其输出的主观选择的产物。simplification is necessary for practical analysis, but it also means that some nuances of the real world are lost, resulting in a skewed representation that can inadvertently favour certain outcomes over others. In effect, every model is a product of subjective choices that shape its outputs.

许多人工智能系统的不透明本质使这些问题变得更加复杂。特别是在复杂的机器学习和生成模型中，内部决策过程往往难以解释，引发了对公平、问责和信任的担忧。这在房地产领域尤其成问题，人工智能生成的估值和租户评估可能会对人们的财务安全、住房获取和长期财富产生重大影响。Compounding these issues is the opaque nature of many AI systems. Especially in complex machine learning and generative models, internal decision-making processes are often difficult to interpret, raising concerns about fairness, accountability, and trust. This is particularly problematic in real estate, where AI-generated valuations and tenant assessments can materially affect people’s financial security, access to housing, and longterm wealth.

减轻这些风险需要的不仅仅是技术修复。它需要一种全面的社会技术方法，融合严格的数据治理、可解释的人工智能技术、利益相关者咨询和监管监督。透明度、文档和人机交互设计必须成为标准做法，而不是可选的附加组件。Mitigating these risks requires more than technical fixes. It calls for a comprehensive, sociotechnical approach that blends rigorous data governance, explainable AI techniques, stakeholder consultation, and regulatory oversight. Transparency, documentation, and human-in-the-loop design must become standard practice, not optional add-ons.

虽然人工智能模型在提高房地产行业的效率和产生见解方面前景广阔，但它们并不是中立或客观的现实镜子。它们是由人们为了特定目的而构建的系统，因此必须对其进行严格的评估。如果教育工作者和从业者不仅将人工智能视为一种技术创新，而且将其视为更广泛系统中的一种充满价值的工具，那么房地产行业就有潜力建立一个更加公平和可持续的未来。消费者、房地产经纪人和监管机构之间的信任应该建立在道德透明度的基础上，并充分认识到房地产模型只是市场的人和机器的代表。While AI models hold great promise for increasing efficiency and generating insights in the property sector, they are not neutral or objective mirrors of reality. They are constructed systems shaped by people, for particular purposes and they must be critically assessed as such. If educators and practitioners approach AI not just as a technical innovation but as a value-laden tool within a broader system, the real estate industry has the potential to build a more equitable and sustainable future. Trust between consumers, real estate agents, and regulatory bodies should be built on ethical transparency with full acknowledgement that a real estate model is only ever a human and machine representation of a market.

3.9 学生活动和作业3.9 Student activities and assignment

接下来的活动有意作为本章教学设计的一部分：它们将上面开发的社会技术概念付诸实践，并展示了如何在领域环境中实践负责任的人工智能评估，而不仅仅是描述。The activities that follow are included deliberately as part of the chapter’s pedagogical design: they operationalise the sociotechnical concepts developed above and show how responsible AI evaluation can be practised, not only described, within a domain setting.

3.9.1 绘图（团队活动）3.9.1 Mapping (team activity)

评估人工智能驱动的房地产模型Evaluating an AI-Driven Real Estate Model

为学生提供人工智能驱动的房地产模型，以评估其责任、道德和安全性。该模型可以是在线房地产估价工具、国家机构的房地产报告或将人工智能融入房地产的学术提案。学生应该批判性地检查：Provide students with an AI-powered real estate model to assess its responsibility, ethics, and safety. The model could be an online property valuation tool, a property report from a national body, or an academic proposal for integrating AI into real estate. Students should critically examine:

  • 模型设计（假设、参数和限制）Model design (assumptions, parameters, and limitations)

  • 谁创建了该模型以及他们的潜在偏差Who created the model and their potential biases

  • 模型运行的上下文和环境The context and environment in which the model operates

  • 输入数据源和任何潜在的偏差Input data sources and any potential biases

  • 模型的输出如何应用于现实世界的决策How the model's outputs are applied in real-world decision-making

  • 潜在的反馈循环和意想不到的后果Potential feedback loops and unintended consequences

鼓励学生直观地绘制模型的结构（可能使用白板和可移动便签）来识别关系、影响和差距。这种协作方法允许不同的观点，从而进行更全面的分析。地图完成后，学生应该以文本形式扩展他们的发现，讨论系统的积极和消极方面。Encourage students to visually map the model’s structure (possibly using a whiteboard and movable sticky notes) to identify relationships, influences, and gaps. This collaborative approach allows for diverse perspectives, leading to a more comprehensive analysis. Once the map is complete, students should expand their findings in text format, discussing both positive and negative aspects of the system.

3.9.2 设计（团队活动）3.9.2 Designing (team activity)

设计更道德的人工智能房地产模型Designing a More Ethical AI-Real Estate Model

根据他们的分析，学生应该设计一个改进的人工智能驱动的房地产模型，以增强公平性、问责制和透明度。同样，他们应该从绘制系统开始，然后再用文本完善他们的想法。关键考虑因素：Building on their analysis, students should design an improved AI-driven real estate model that enhances fairness, accountability, and transparency. Again, they should start by mapping the system before refining their ideas in text. Key considerations:

  • 是否应该有更多的人为监督（人在回路决策）？Should there be more human oversight (human-in-the-loop decision-making)?

  • 应包括哪些监管措施或道德保障措施？What regulatory measures or ethical safeguards should be included?

  • 谁应该参与模型的设计和治理？Who should be involved in the model's design and governance?

  • 哪些利益相关者可能受到影响，特别是弱势群体？What stakeholders may be affected, especially vulnerable groups?

  • 如何减轻偏见和意外后果？How can bias and unintended consequences be mitigated?

  • 应该考虑哪些外部因素或未知因素？What external factors or unknowns should be accounted for?

第3章：Chapter 3:模型不是市场The Model is Not the Market

126

一旦学生开发出了理想的人工智能驱动的社会技术系统，他们就可以在补充文本中充实他们的想法，确保他们的模型优先考虑技术效率和社会责任。Once students have developed their ideal AI-driven sociotechnical system, they can flesh out their ideas in supplementary text, ensuring their model prioritizes both technological efficiency and social responsibility.

3.9.3 反思（个人作业）3.9.3 Reflection (individual assignment)

一篇单独撰写的简短反思文章探讨了他们对房地产 RAI 的理解在练习过程中如何演变。他们应该考虑什么让他们感到惊讶、挑战他们的假设或改变他们的想法。反思应涉及 RAI 的关键原则，例如公平、问责、透明度和以人为本。这些原则应该与房地产的具体问题联系起来。学生可能希望反思群体观点如何塑造他们的见解，以及他们作为未来的房地产专业人士或教育工作者如何应用这些课程。An individually written short reflective piece exploring how their understanding of RAI in real estate evolved during the exercises. They should consider what surprised them, challenged their assumptions, or shifted their thinking. Reflections should engage with key RAI principles such as fairness, accountability, transparency, and human-centeredness. These principles should then be connected to real estate-specific concerns. Students may wish to reflect on how group perspectives shaped their insights, and how they might apply these lessons as future real estate professionals or educators.

世界价值观基准The World Values Benchmark

“所有模型都是错误的，但有些模型是有用的。” G.E.P.盒子，科学与统计（1979）[52]“All models are wrong, but some are useful.” G.E.P. Box, Science and Statistics (1979) [52]

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

从元伦理的角度构建人工智能评估方法论。Building an AI evaluation methodology from a meta-ethic viewpoint.

摘要Abstract

本章介绍了本文的方法论核心——世界价值观基准（WVB）。虽然大多数基准都是规范性的，规定了模型应该如何表现，但 WVB 是This chapter introduces the World Values Benchmark (WVB), the methodological core of the thesis. Whereas most benchmarks are normative, prescribing how models ought to behave, WVB is描述性的descriptive：它将语言模型输出置于现有的跨文化价值分布中，并使差异可见而不进行裁决。该框架通过提供一种可重复的方法来捕获多元化，同时控制已知的即时敏感性和锚偏差，从而填补了以绩效为导向的排行榜和广泛的社会技术批评之间的空白。: it situates language model outputs within existing cross-cultural value distributions and makes divergences visible without adjudicating them. The framework fills a gap between performance-oriented leaderboards and broad sociotechnical critique by providing a reproducible method that captures pluralism while controlling for known artefacts of prompt sensitivity and anchor bias.

该方法结合了四个要素：抑制释义效应的提示集、减少框架偏差的平衡答案锚、对抗训练先验的贝叶斯偏差校正，以及保持有效性与上下文联系的社会技术映射。这些保障措施共同增强了结构有效性，并使模型行为在经验上变得清晰易读。应用于早期模型（LaMDA 和 PaLM）时，WVB 揭示了在堕胎和宗教信仰等文化问题上与美国价值观概况的明确项目级别一致性。然而，英格尔哈特-韦尔策尔文化地图上的总体位置更接近西班牙和卢森堡等南欧和中欧社会。这些发现表明，描述性评估如何能够揭示美国训练数据的印记以及这些印记在聚合下的变化方式。The methodology combines four elements: prompt sets to dampen paraphrase effects, balanced answer anchors to reduce framing skew, Bayesian bias correction to counter training priors, and sociotechnical mapping to keep validity tied to context. Together, these safeguards strengthen construct validity and make model behaviour empirically legible. Applied to early models (LaMDA and PaLM), WVB revealed clear item-level alignment with US value profiles on culturally charged issues such as abortion and religiosity. Yet aggregate placement on the Inglehart–Welzel cultural map was closer to southern and central European societies such as Spain and Luxembourg. These findings show how descriptive evaluation can surface both the imprint of US training data and the ways those imprints shift under aggregation.

其贡献是双重的：从经验上看，WVB 表明朴素的单提示方法夸大了对齐，而分布式配置文件提供了更稳定的位置；从概念上讲，它将基准测试重新定义为关系测量。本章将 WVB 确立为一种文化包容性、可争议的评估工具，这种方法可以为有关模型调整和治理的更民主的决策提供信息。The contribution is twofold: empirically, WVB demonstrates that naïve single-prompt methods overstate alignment, while distributional profiles provide more stable placements; conceptually, it reframes benchmarking as relational measurement. The chapter establishes WVB as a tool for culturally inclusive, contestable evaluation—an approach that can inform more democratic decisions about model alignment and governance.

131

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

4.1 简介4.1 Introduction

评估大型语言模型 (LLM) 的道德行为仍然是 Responsible AI 的核心挑战。大多数现有基准通过根据预先定义的标准（例如毒性、公平性或准确性）测试模型来嵌入规范性假设。虽然这种方法很有价值，但它可能会具体化主流文化规范并排斥少数群体的观点。本章的主要贡献是方法论上的：它介绍了世界价值观基准（WVB），这是谷歌于 2022-23 年开发的描述性评估框架，用于将模型输出映射到现有社会科学数据上，而不是根据外部强加的规范标准来判断它们。 WVB 将法学硕士评估建立在世界价值观调查 (WVS) 中，这是一个广泛应用于社会学、政治学和发展研究的四十年数据集。Evaluating the moral behaviours of large language models (LLMs) remains a central challenge in Responsible AI. Most existing benchmarks embed normative assumptions by testing models against predefined standards such as toxicity, fairness, or accuracy. While valuable, such approaches risk reifying dominant cultural norms and sidelining minority standpoints. This chapter’s primary contribution is methodological: it introduces the World Values Benchmark (WVB), a descriptive evaluation framework developed at Google in 2022– 23 for mapping model outputs onto existing social science data rather than judging them against externally imposed normative standards. WVB grounds LLM evaluation in the World Values Survey (WVS), a forty-year dataset widely used in sociology, political science, and development studies.

WVB 在第二章中扩展了 Ghost 项目，从美国主导偏见的探索性证据转向更系统的评估方法。在更广泛的论文范围内，WVB 实践了一个核心主张，即评估是由机器输出、社会数据集和人类设计选择之间的递归交互形成的。The WVB extends the Ghost project in Chapter 2 by moving from exploratory evidence of US-dominant bias to a more systematic evaluation methodology. Within the broader thesis arc, WVB operationalises the central claim that evaluation is shaped by recursive interactions among machine outputs, social datasets, and human design choices.

从行动主义者的角度来看，WVB 并不将值视为等待在模型中提取的固定内容。它将价值表达视为在特定交互条件下制定的东西：提示、答案集、评分程序和人类比较基线。因此，提示设置、锚平衡和贝叶斯调整不仅仅是技术清理步骤。它们是交互设计的一部分，这样可测量的内容就不会受到意外提示人工制品的影响，并且能够提供更多有关使用中所体现的价值倾向的信息。Read through an enactivist lens, WVB does not treat values as fixed contents waiting inside a model to be extracted. It treats value expression as something enacted under specific interactional conditions: a prompt, an answer set, a scoring procedure, and a human comparison baseline. Prompt sets, anchor balancing, and Bayesian adjustment are therefore not merely technical clean-up steps. They are part of designing the interaction so that what becomes measurable is less dominated by accidental prompt artefacts and more informative about the value tendencies enacted in use.

这项工作还涉及更广泛的人工智能对齐问题。呼吁与“共同的全球价值观”保持一致通常假定这些价值观是稳定的、单一的且易于识别的。在实践中，价值观是有争议的、多元化的，并且随历史的变化而变化。通过根据现有调查数据的分布进行评估，WVB 提供了一种描述性工具，可以补充技术调整工作，同时使价值判断如何通过模型、数据集、提示和人类设计选择的交互形成可见，而不是假设单一的规范目标。This work also connects to the wider AI alignment problem. Calls for alignment with “shared global values” often presume that such values are stable, singular, and readily identifiable. In practice, values are contested, plural, and historically variable. By grounding evaluation in distributions drawn from existing survey data, WVB provides a descriptive tool that complements technical alignment efforts while making visible how value judgements are shaped through the interaction of models, datasets, prompts, and human design choices rather than presuming a single normative target.

方法论的新颖性是双重的。首先，WVB 将模型评估与现有的人类调查数据（特别是世界价值观调查）保持一致。其次，它要求模型生成答案锚点上的概率分布，而不是引发单个模型响应。这使得可以比较分布而不是点估计，保留方差并使价值模式更清晰。The methodological novelty is twofold. First, WVB aligns model evaluation back to existing human survey data, specifically the World Values Survey. Second, rather than eliciting a single model response, it asks models to generate probability distributions over answer anchors. This makes it possible to compare distributions rather than point estimates, preserving variance and making value patterns more legible.

从哲学上讲，该项目借鉴了大卫·休谟的“是-应该”问题和道德价值多元主义。而不是问什么型号Philosophically, the project drew on David Hume’s Is–Ought problem and Moral Value Pluralism. Rather than asking what models应该shouldWVB 询问什么是价值观模型do, the WVB asks what values models反映reflect当出现提示时，以及这些模式与人类群体的比较如何。这个when prompted, and how these patterns compare with human populations. This

132

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

方法承认法学硕士没有自己的内在机构或价值观；相反，它们是“道德僵尸”，其输出反映了培训数据、即时设计和机构人力借贷。从这个意义上说，描述性基准测试提供了一种透明度工具：模型的道德指南针，可以使不同的利益相关者决定如何进行调整和治理。approach acknowledges that LLMs have no intrinsic agency or values of their own; instead, they are “moral zombies” whose outputs reflect training data, prompt design, and human loan of agency. In this sense, descriptive benchmarking provides a transparency tool: a moral compass for models that can empower diverse stakeholders to decide how tuning, and governance ought to proceed.

4.2 背景4.2 Background

本节为根据记录的人类价值分布对人工智能模型进行描述性评估奠定了概念和方法基础。这里的目的不是规定模型应该说什么，而是衡量其输出中反映的值。在多元化的世界中，评估应该在 MaSH Loop 交互中的模型倾向一致、偏离或覆盖多元人类价值模式的地方浮出水面。This section lays the conceptual and methodological groundwork for a descriptive evaluation of AI models against recorded human value distributions. The aim here is not to prescribe what models ought to say, but to measure what values that do reflect in their outputs. In a pluralist world, evaluation should surface where model tendencies coincide with, diverge from, or overwrite plural human value patterns across MaSH Loop interactions.

我分六个步骤进行。首先，我找到了流行的人工智能基准（大约 2018 年至 2023 年）中的差距，显示了有多少基准隐含地嵌入了规定性规范，同时又将自己呈现为中立的衡量标准。其次，我将规范性评估设计与描述性评估设计区分开来，并认为如果我们要浮现（而不是覆盖）多元价值模式，则后者至关重要。第三，我采用道德价值多元主义（MVP）作为最适合全球、非单一评估的哲学立场。接下来，我借鉴社会科学的测量理论，将价值观视为需要仔细操作和有效性检查的潜在结构。然后，我引入社会技术映射，使评估的假设变得明确，以及人类、评估过程和机器之间相互依赖关系的本质。最后，我解释了选择世界价值观调查（WVS）作为经验基线：数据集是什么，为什么它适合这里，谁使用它，以及为什么选择特定项目。I proceed in six steps. First, I locate a gap in prevalent AI benchmarks (roughly 2018– 2023), showing how many implicitly embed prescriptive norms while presenting themselves as neutral measures. Second, I distinguish normative from descriptive evaluation designs and argue that the latter are essential if we are to surface (rather than overwrite) plural value patterns. Third, I adopt Moral Value Pluralism (MVP) as the philosophical stance best suited to global, non-monolithic evaluation. Next, I draw on measurement theory from the social sciences to treat values as latent constructs that require careful operationalisation and validity checking. Then, I introduce sociotechnical mapping to make the evaluation’s assumptions explicit and the nature of interdependent relationships between humans, the evaluation process and the machine. Finally, I explain the selection of the World Values Survey (WVS) as the empirical baseline: what the dataset is, why it is appropriate here, who uses it, and why specific items were chosen.

这一背景使 WVB 的幕后设计工作变得透明：包括如何定义结构、如何构建提示和答案锚点以及如何检查有效性。背景是必不可少的，这样读者就可以追踪规范性假设可能进入该过程的位置，以及我介绍的方法如何缓解它们。道德和透明的人工智能评估需要这种程度的透明度。This background makes transparent the behind-the-scenes design work for the WVB: including how constructs are defined, how prompts and answer anchors are built, and how validity is checked. The background is essential so readers can trace where normative assumptions might enter the process, and how the methods I introduce mitigate them. Ethical and transparent AI evaluations require this level of transparency.

4.2.1 评估状况（2018-2023）4.2.1 The State of Evaluations (2018–2023)

从 2018 年到 2023 年，评估激增，但其中大部分依赖于不稳定的结构和泄露的数据集。最近的跨学科评论强化了这一诊断，识别了结构有效性问题、基准游戏、文档失败以及扭曲基准分数含义的文化和竞争压力[119]。排行榜将异构行为压缩为一个数字，而From 2018–2023, evaluation proliferated—yet much of it rested on unstable constructs and leaked datasets. Recent interdisciplinary reviews reinforce this diagnosis, identifying construct-validity problems, benchmark gaming, documentation failures, and cultural and competitive pressures that distort what benchmark scores are taken to mean [119]. Leaderboards compressed heterogeneous behaviours into one number, while

133

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

污染和即时敏感性夸大了“人类水平”性能的说法。阅读理解、常识推理、数学技能等方面的排行榜为公司创造了一种夸耀优势的方式：模型的价值似乎是其分数的总和。这加速了迭代并产生了有用的压力测试，但它也巧妙地标准化了什么算作进展——无论好坏[181]。contamination and prompt sensitivity inflated claims of ‘human-level’ performance. Leaderboards for reading comprehension, commonsense reasoning, mathematical skills and more, created a way for companies to boast superiority: a model’s worth appeared to be the sum of its scores. This accelerated iteration and generated useful stress tests, but it also subtly standardized what counted as progress—for better or worse [181].

复合仪表板和“胜率”统计将异构行为压缩为单个数字，使更改易于阅读，同时掩盖了下面的测量选择。随着新的基准测试叠加在早期基准测试之上（GLUE→SuperGLUE；Winograd→WinoGrande；ANLI；BIG-bench；后来的评估经常重用早期的数据集、任务框架和分数解释，而不重新检查底层结构是否仍然有效。从这个意义上说，基准生态学变得有谱系：看起来模型进展的新证据通常部分继承自早期的设计选择。通常“弗兰肯基准”是从重用的数据集组装而成的成为模型离型纸中的标准包含物。Composite dashboards and “win-rate” tallies compressed heterogeneous behaviours into single numbers, making change easy to read while masking the measurement choices underneath. As new benchmarks were layered atop earlier ones (GLUE→SuperGLUE; Winograd→WinoGrande; ANLI; BIG-bench; later evaluations often reused earlier datasets, task framings, and score interpretations without re-examining whether the underlying constructs remained valid. In that sense, the benchmark ecology became genealogical: what looked like fresh evidence for model progress was often partly inherited from earlier design choices. Often “franken-benchmarks” assembled from reused datasets became standard inclusions in model release papers.

与此同时，综合提示生成的基准开始让模型为自己创建测试，引发了人们对人工智能评估的反馈循环和价值放大的担忧。更准确地说，这些评估很少单独衡量模型。他们正在测量模型-提示-数据集-度量的安排，其中看似模型的属性通常部分是任务措辞、基准构成和评分设计的产物。Concurrently, synthetic prompt-generated benchmarks began letting models create tests for themselves, raising concerns about feedback loops and value amplification in AI evaluated by AI. More precisely, these evaluations were rarely measuring a model in isolation. They were measuring a model-prompt-dataset-metric arrangement, where what appeared to be a property of the model was often partly an artefact of task wording, benchmark composition, and scoring design.

4.2.2 评估基准的缺陷4.2.2 Flaws in Evaluation Benchmarks

本节追溯当代基准实践是如何在模型发布周期中出现和稳定的。目标不是详尽地列出基准，而是展示具体的设计选择如何融入评估实践，并随后被视为自然或不可避免的。它没有将基准视为中立的工具，而是将其视为历史上分层的人工制品，这些人工制品是由有关语言、推理和评估的假设不断变化而形成的。从这个意义上说，这种分析在一定程度上是考古性的：它遵循了关于“常识”、任务设计和能力的想法是如何在连续的基准构建中被继承、适应和模糊的。This section traces how contemporary benchmark practices emerged and stabilised across model release cycles. The goal is not to catalogue benchmarks exhaustively, but to show how specific design choices become sedimented into evaluation practice and later treated as natural or inevitable. Rather than treating benchmarks as neutral instruments, it approaches them as historically layered artefacts shaped by shifting assumptions about language, reasoning, and evaluation. In this sense, the analysis is partly archaeological: it follows how ideas about “commonsense,” task design, and capability have been inherited, adapted, and obscured across successive benchmark constructions.

现有基准的局限性已有详细记录。图灵测试 [398] 最初被誉为一项突破，它植根于性别模仿，并且被证明很容易被操纵。后来的测试，如 Winograd Schema [224]，试图通过简短的语言谜题来捕捉“常识推理”，这些谜题需要基于背景知识而不是表面线索来解析代词。许多任务都编码了关于什么是常识的文化特定假设。戴维斯[97]明确表达了这一点，他将常识描述为“典型的七岁孩子”应该知道的事情——The limitations of existing benchmarks are well documented. The Turing Test [398], initially celebrated as a breakthrough, was rooted in gender imitation and proved easy to game. Later tests such as the Winograd Schema [224] sought to capture “commonsense reasoning” through short linguistic puzzles requiring pronoun resolution based on background knowledge rather than surface cues. Many of the tasks encoded culturally specific assumptions about what counts as commonsense. Davis [97] made this explicit when he described commonsense as what a “typical seven-year-old child” should know—a

134

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

这个定义给出了以英语为母语的中产阶级的参考框架。随后对 Winograd 基准的扩展（例如 WinoGrande）通过将注释外包给众包工作者并应用统计“去偏差”，将模式扩展到数万个示例。然而，这只会加剧主观性：谁的常识被编码取决于众包者是谁、他们带来什么文化框架以及他们的输出如何聚合[102, 313]。definition that gave an Anglophone, middle-class frame of reference. Subsequent expansions on the Winograd benchmark such as WinoGrande scaled the schema to tens of thousands of examples by outsourcing annotation to crowdworkers and applying statistical “de-biasing.” Yet this only compounded the subjectivity: whose commonsense is being encoded depends on who the crowdworkers are, what cultural frames they bring, and how their outputs are aggregated [102, 313].

2022年6月，我对当时可用的27篇主要LLM发行论文的基准部分进行了有针对性的人工审查。这些论文涵盖了主要模型系列，包括 GPT-3、BERT、BART、Gopher、Megatron-Turing NLG、LaMDA、Jurassic-1、Yuan、T0 和 FLAN，使审查能够跟踪功能和面向对齐的版本中重复出现的基准习惯。这里的主张是定性的，而不是正式的系统审查：在这些论文中，Winograd 风格和相关的基准套件被反复用作广泛推理能力的代理。但它们的性能不稳定。微小的词汇变化（“重要”与“不重要”）可能会极大地改变分布，这表明许多基准测试正在测量即时敏感性而不是稳定的结构。In June 2022, I conducted a targeted manual review of the benchmark sections of 27 major LLM release papers available at the time. These papers covered major model families including GPT-3, BERT, BART, Gopher, Megatron-Turing NLG, LaMDA, Jurassic-1, Yuan, T0, and FLAN, allowing the review to trace recurring benchmark habits across both capability and alignment-oriented releases. The claim here is qualitative rather than a formal systematic review: across those papers, Winograd-style and related benchmark suites were repeatedly used as proxies for broad reasoning capability. But performance on them is unstable. Small lexical changes (“important” vs. “unimportant”) can swing distributions dramatically, indicating that many benchmarks are measuring prompt sensitivity rather than stable constructs.

污染增加了另一层弱点：许多 Winograd 项目可以在网络上搜索，有些直接出现在训练语料库中，破坏了它们的独立性[346]。 Narayanan 和 Kapoor [18] 清楚地说明了这种风险：GPT-4 在与其训练集重叠的编码基准上得分完美，但一旦污染项目被移除，其性能就会崩溃至接近于零。这些案例表明，标题结果如何掩盖泄漏和记忆，强化“人类水平”能力的错觉，同时掩盖潜在评估的局限性。Contamination adds another layer of weakness: many Winograd items are searchable on the web, and some appear directly in training corpora, undermining their claim to independence [346]. Narayanan and Kapoor [18] illustrate the risk starkly: GPT-4 scored perfectly on a coding benchmark that overlapped with its training set, but its performance collapsed to near zero once contaminated items were removed. Such cases show how headline results can mask leakage and memorisation, reinforcing the illusion of “humanlevel” competence while obscuring the limits of the underlying evaluation.

表 19 说明了这种脆弱性。这些比较是在同一模型快照上语义上接近等效的提示变体之间进行的，而不是重复重新运行单个提示，也不是扫描不同的参数设置。当我在 2022 年 5 月向 LaMDA 提出关于家庭的同一问题的不同版本时，输出结果存在很大差异，具体取决于问题是否使用“重要”、“不重要”或“不重要”作为提示。人类通常会关注问题的主题（“家庭”）；该模型面向评估限定词，揭示了这些基准对表面措辞的依赖程度。Table 19 illustrates this fragility. These comparisons are between semantically nearequivalent prompt variants on the same model snapshot, not repeated reruns of a single prompt and not sweeps over different parameter settings. When I prompted LaMDA in May 2022 with variations of the same question about family, the outputs diverged sharply depending on whether the question used “important,” “not important,” or “unimportant” as a cue. Humans typically orient toward the subject of the question (“family”); the model orients toward the evaluative qualifier, exposing how dependent these benchmarks are on surface wording.

在更深层次上，常识本身并不是一个客观范畴，而是一个有争议的、具有文化背景的范畴。哲学家们长期以来一直在争论它是否代表普遍真理 [125, 152] 还是嵌入文化的意义系统 [146]。什么算作“常识”因地理和文化历史而异。正如内格尔[276]所说，主观立场不能简化为客观的“不知从何而来的观点”。将这样的结构嵌入到基准中会强化一种世界观，就好像它是普遍的一样。At a deeper level, commonsense itself is not an objective category but a contested and culturally situated one. Philosophers have long debated whether it represents universal truths [125, 152] or culturally embedded systems of meaning [146]. What counts as “common sense” varies by geography and cultural history. As Nagel [276] argued, subjective standpoints cannot be reduced to an objective “view from nowhere”. Embedding such constructs into benchmarks calcifies one worldview as if it were universal.

正如 Schlangen 的任务框架所阐明的那样，基准测试任务的价值不是来自直接的用户效用，而是来自它在特定条件下测试规定能力的程度 [350]。这种区别将任务成功与现实世界的使用分开：模型可以在严格指定的任务上表现良好，而无需在评估框架之外展示相应的能力。基准测试并不直接揭示能力；他们通过特定的任务定义来构建它。As Schlangen’s task framework clarifies, a benchmark task derives its value not from direct user utility but from how well it tests a stipulated ability under specific conditions [350]. This distinction separates task success from real-world use: a model can perform well on a tightly specified task without demonstrating a corresponding capacity outside that evaluative frame. Benchmarks do not reveal capability directly; they construct it through particular task definitions.

因此，主观性不是一个需要纠正的缺陷，而是这些历史分层评价实践的一个构成特征。每个评估流程，从数据集选择到注释到内涵任务描述，都会导入人类的观点和价值观[6]。它们的行为就像影子系统：一旦在基准演化中根深蒂固（Winograd→WinoGender→WinoGrande），它们就变得更难看到，更容易被视为中立。结果是，“常识推理”基准通常会像衡量任何模型能力一样衡量数据集设计和注释实践的伪影。Subjectivity is thus not a flaw to be corrected but a constitutive feature of these historically layered evaluation practices. Every evaluation pipeline, from dataset selection to annotation to intensional task description, imports human perspectives and values[6] . These act like shadow systems: once entrenched in benchmark evolution (Winograd → WinoGender → WinoGrande), they become harder to see and easier to treat as neutral. The result is that “commonsense reasoning” benchmarks often measure artefacts of dataset design and annotation practice as much as any model capability.

更广泛的批评呼应了这一点。拉吉等人。 [320] 认为 GLUE 或 SuperGLUE 等基准经常被滥用作为“通用语言理解”的代理。他们指出，狭隘、有限的任务被提升为代表“整个世界的一切”，从而产生了结构有效性问题：小基准集上的表现被视为一般能力的证明，尽管它不能支持如此广泛的主张。Broader critiques echo this point. Raji et al. [320] argue that benchmarks such as GLUE or SuperGLUE are often misused as proxies for “general language understanding.” They note that narrow, finite tasks are elevated to represent “everything in the whole wide world,” creating a construct validity problem: performance on a small benchmark set is treated as proof of general capability, even though it cannot support such sweeping claims.

这种动态的一个特别明显的例子出现在 Hendrycks 等人引入的广泛使用的 ETHICS 基准中。 [168]。虽然在正文中作为“基本人类道德判断”和“共同人类价值观”的衡量标准提出，但其构建的关键方面被归入附录。其中包括使用众包人员以及结合从 Reddit 等在线论坛中提取的场景A particularly clear example of this dynamic appears in the widely used ETHICS benchmark introduced by Hendrycks et al. [168]. While presented as a measure of “basic human ethical judgements” and “shared human values” in the main text, key aspects of its construction are relegated to the appendix. These include the use of crowdworkers and the incorporation of scenarios drawn from online forums such as Reddit’s我是混蛋吗Am I the Asshole，道德判断是通过特定文化、非正式且高度情境化的话语产生的。 其影响不仅仅是狭义上的偏见，而是认识框架的转变：白话道德判断被抽象、过滤并重新呈现为普遍的道德知识。由于这些设计选择主要记录在附录中，而不是在基准框架中突出显示，因此它们很容易被忽视且难以争论。因此，即使其基本假设仍然是偶然的，数据集仍可作为评估的稳定产物。一旦纳入评估流程和主要发布论文中，此类数据集就会获得事实上的机构认可，规范其假设并将其传播到基准生态系统中。, where moral judgements are produced through culturally specific, informal, and highly contextualised discourse. The effect is not simply bias in the narrow sense, but a shift in epistemic framing: vernacular moral judgements are abstracted, filtered, and re-presented as generalisable ethical knowledge. Because these design choices are documented primarily in appendices rather than foregrounded in the benchmark’s framing, they become easy to overlook and difficult to contest. As a result, the dataset functions as a stabilised artefact of evaluation, even as its underlying assumptions remain contingent. Once incorporated into evaluation pipelines and major release papers, such datasets acquire a de facto institutional endorsement, normalising their assumptions and propagating them across the benchmarking ecosystem.

另一种批评认为，基准测试低估了法学硕士在提示时所做的事情。 Reynolds 和 McDonell [327] 认为，GPT-3 中的小样本学习更好地被视为学习任务的现有潜在空间中的“任务位置”，而不是在运行时学习。在他们的描述中，提示是访问人类交流中嵌入的模因概念的代理。他们将 GPT-3 定义为近似人类语言的真实函数：A different strand of critique suggests that benchmarks underestimate what LLMs are doing when prompted. Reynolds and McDonell [327] argue that few-shot learning in GPT-3 is better seen as “task location” within an existing latent space of learned tasks, rather than learning at runtime. In their account, prompting is a proxy for accessing memetic concepts embedded in human communication. They frame GPT-3 as approximating the ground truth function of human language:

“‘语言动态’并不能脱离文化、心理和物理背景；它不仅仅是一种语法理论，甚至语义学理论。从这个意义上说，语言不是一种抽象，而是一种与人类相关现实的各个方面纠缠在一起的现象。这种动态必须预测语言的实际使用方式，其中包括（比如）预测理论物理学家之间的对话。对语言进行建模就像对可能影响语言流动的现实的每个方面进行建模一样困难。”雷诺兹和麦克唐纳 [327]“The “dynamics of language” do not float free of cultural, psychological, and physical context; it is not merely a theory of grammar or even of semantics. Language in this sense is not an abstraction but rather a phenomenon entangled with all aspects of human-relevant reality. The dynamic must predict how language is actually used, which includes (say) predicting a conversation between theoretical physicists. Modelling language is as difficult as modelling every aspect of reality that could influence the flow of language.” Reynolds and McDonell [327]

这种重构挑战了常识基准的狭隘难题：如果模型正在利用嵌入文化的语言动态，那么像 Winograd 这样的综合测试可能不是衡量这些能力的糟糕工具。对于这篇论文，方法论的含义是明确的：如果通过在学习模式的文化饱和空间内定位轨迹来进行提示，那么基准成功就不能很好地代表孤立的能力。This reframing challenges the narrow puzzles of commonsense benchmarks: if models are tapping into culturally embedded language dynamics, then synthetic tests like Winograd may be poor instruments for measuring those capabilities. For this thesis, the methodological implication is clear: if prompting operates by locating trajectories within a culturally saturated space of learned patterns, then benchmark success is a poor proxy for isolated capability.

137

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

最近的工作强化了这些批评。 Ismayilzada 等人，[186] 表明，当推理嵌入到现实世界的任务中时，在标准常识测试中表现出色的模型就会动摇，从而暴露了合成谜题的过度乐观。戴维斯的Recent work reinforces these critiques. Ismayilzada et al., [186] show that models which excel on standard commonsense tests falter when reasoning is embedded in realworld tasks, exposing the over-optimism of synthetic puzzles. Davis’s常识基准调查Survey of Commonsense Benchmarks[98]对 100 多个数据集进行了分类，得出的结论是，大多数数据集缺乏稳定的构建定义，包含不一致的项目，并且报告污染情况不佳。 Lin 等人，[233] 发现，即使基准声称衡量常识，表现强劲的模型也无法可靠地批评或纠正自己的推理，这表明基准的成功可能反映了表面的模式匹配，而不是深层的能力。[98] catalogues more than 100 datasets and concludes that most lack stable construct definitions, contain inconsistent items, and report contamination poorly. Lin et al., [233] find that even when benchmarks claim to measure commonsense, models that perform strongly cannot reliably critique or correct their own reasoning, suggesting that benchmark success may reflect superficial pattern-matching rather than deep capacity.

麦金托什等人的系统评价。 [255] 在 23 个流行的基准测试中证实了这些担忧。他们强调了反复出现的问题：即时变化下的不稳定、训练数据的污染以及由于过度拟合而导致的分数过高。作者得出的结论是，许多基准奖励肤浅的模式匹配，并产生脆弱的排行榜排名，在轻微的扰动下就会崩溃，因此需要动态和自适应的评估方法。A systematic review by McIntosh et al. [255] confirms these concerns across 23 popular benchmarks. They highlight recurring issues: instability under prompt variation, contamination from training data, and inflated scores due to overfitting. The authors conclude that many benchmarks reward superficial pattern-matching and produce fragile leaderboard rankings that collapse under minor perturbations, calling instead for dynamic and adaptive evaluation methods.

当代的大套房在理念上有所不同，但常常陷入相似的陷阱。 BIGbench [366] 汇总了 200 多个异构任务的结果，并附有公共排行榜，鼓励单表比较。相比之下，HELM [229] 旨在避免单一数字排名：它跨场景和广泛的指标集（准确性、校准、鲁棒性、公平性、毒性、效率）评估模型，而无需总分。然而，HELM 的覆盖范围和指标选择本身就充满价值，作者承认这一点（例如，重点关注英语），因此即使是“整体”仪表板也可以充当事实上的排行榜。Contemporary large suites diverge in philosophy but often fall into similar traps. BIGbench [366] aggregates results over 200+ heterogeneous tasks and is accompanied by a public leaderboard, which encourages single-table comparisons. HELM [229], by contrast, was designed to avoid single-number rankings: it evaluates models across scenarios and a broad set of metrics (accuracy, calibration, robustness, fairness, toxicity, efficiency) without an aggregate score. Yet HELM’s coverage and metric choices are themselves value-laden, which the authors acknowledge (e.g., heavy English focus), so even “holistic” dashboards can function as de facto leaderboards.

这种聚合趋势在 2022 年主要发布文件中已经可见。 Google 的 PaLM 论文报告了各种基准测试中最先进的性能，强调 29 项任务中 28 项的性能作为广泛能力的证据，尽管基础评估存在异质性 [79]。类似地，DeepMind 的 Chinchilla 论文以叠加的比较图开头，将 Chinchilla 与 Gopher、GPT-3 和 MT-NLG 进行比较，而摘要则声称它在大量下游任务中“一致且显着地优于”这些模型 [174]。在其他地方，该论文报告了 57 个 MMLU 任务的单次平均 5 次射击精度以及相对于 Gopher 的平均 BIGbench 改进，将异构评估压缩为摘要比较信号 [174]。This tendency toward aggregation was already visible in major 2022 release papers. Google’s PaLM paper reports state-of-the-art performance across a wide range of benchmarks, emphasising performance on 28 of 29 tasks as evidence of broad capability, despite the heterogeneity of the underlying evaluations [79]. Similarly, DeepMind’s Chinchilla paper opens with an overlaid comparative figure positioning Chinchilla against Gopher, GPT-3, and MT-NLG, while the abstract claims that it “uniformly and significantly outperforms” these models across a large range of downstream tasks [174]. Elsewhere, the paper reports a single average 5-shot accuracy over 57 MMLU tasks and an average BIGbench improvement over Gopher, compressing heterogeneous evaluations into summary comparative signals [174].

The figure foregrounds cross-model comparison, supporting claims of overall superiority across heterogeneous evaluation tasks.

过度简化是这个时代法学硕士发行论文的普遍现象。图 13 显示了取自 OpenAI 2022 年 3 月发布论文的图表，该模型名为 InstructGPT [296]。该图表说明了异质行为（即真实性、信息性和毒性）如何被分解为单个“获胜率”数字，就好像人类偏好可以提供客观标量一样。Over-simplification is endemic to LLM release papers of this era. Figure 13 shows a chart taken from OpenAI’s release paper in March 2022 of a model called InstructGPT [296]. The chart illustrates how heterogeneous behaviours (i.e. truthfulness, informativeness, and toxicity) were collapsed into a single “win rate” number, as if human preference could provide an objective scalar.

图 13：该图表取自 2022 年 3 月发布的名为 InstructGPT 的 OpenAI 模型的发布论文 [296]。它报告了相对于 GPT-3 基线的单一“胜率”，将不同的人类偏好判断压缩为一个数字。Figure 13: This chart is taken from the release paper of an OpenAI model called InstructGPT from March 2022 [296]. It reports a single “win rate” against a GPT-3 baseline, collapsing diverse human preference judgements into one number.

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

图 14：该图表取自 Anthropic 的《宪法人工智能：人工智能反馈的无害性》（Bai 等人，2022 年）。它报告了关于乐于助人、诚实和无害（HHH）的单一综合准确度得分，将异质的评估标准压缩为一个数字。Figure 14: This chart is taken from Anthropic’s Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback (Bai et al., 2022). It reports a single combined accuracy score for helpfulness, honesty, and harmlessness (HHH), collapsing heterogeneous evaluative criteria into one number.

这种模式在主要发行论文中延续。 OpenAI 于 2023 年发布的 GPT-4 报告 [4] 将律师资格考试成绩、大规模多任务语言理解 (MMLU) 准确性和 SAT 风格的结果作为可比较的能力指标。 Google 2022 年的 PaLM 发布论文 [79] 将 29 项任务的性能报告为“平均准确度”，而 Meta 2023 年的 LLaMA [392] 将数十个基准分数压缩为单个表行。 Anthropic 同样将克劳德的表现报告为单一偏好百分比 [22]。这些聚合有助于沟通的清晰度，但它们使评估的细微差别变得平淡：不同的结构、文化假设和权衡被隐藏在一个数字背后。结果是一种客观性错觉，复杂的判断看起来就像简单的排行榜事实。This pattern continues across major release papers. OpenAI’s GPT-4 report in 2023 [4] presents bar exam scores, Massive Multitask Language Understanding (MMLU) accuracy, and SAT-style results as commensurable indicators of capability. Google’s PaLM release paper in 2022 [79] reports performance across 29 tasks as an “average accuracy,” while Meta’s LLaMA in 2023 [392] condenses dozens of benchmark scores into a single table row. Anthropic likewise reports Claude’s performance as a single preference percentage [22]. These aggregates serve communicative clarity, but they flatten evaluative nuance: different constructs, cultural assumptions, and trade-offs are obscured behind a single number. The result is an illusion of objectivity, where complex judgements appear as simple leaderboard facts.

最近的评估框架试图转向多指标和基于场景的报告，但将异构结构分解为比较信号的潜在趋势仍然存在。即使避免了明确的平均，性能仍然通过汇总指标来传达，例如偏好百分比、策划的基准测试包或突出显示的“同类最佳”结果。 OpenAI 的 GPT-4.1 公告将 SWE-bench Verified 作为编码能力的主要指标，其 o3 版本展示了 Codeforces、SWEbench 和 MMMU 的最先进性能，作为广泛模型能力的证据 [294]。 Anthropic 于 2025 年 5 月发布的 Claude 4 同样利用了 SWE-bench 和 Terminal-bench 的领先地位来支持有关模型质量的广泛比较主张 [15]。因此，聚合以更微妙的修辞形式重新出现：并不总是作为单个数字，而是通过选择性的基准框架，仍然得出有关整体能力的一般结论。More recent evaluation frameworks have attempted to move toward multi-metric and scenario-based reporting, yet the underlying tendency to collapse heterogeneous constructs into comparative signals persists. Even where explicit averaging is avoided, performance is still communicated through summary indicators such as preference percentages, curated benchmark bundles, or highlighted “best-in-class” results. OpenAI’s GPT-4.1 announcement foregrounds SWE-bench Verified as a headline indicator of coding ability, and its o3 release presents state-of-the-art performance across Codeforces, SWEbench, and MMMU as evidence of broad model capability [294]. Anthropic’s May 2025 Claude 4 launch similarly uses leadership on SWE-bench and Terminal-bench to support broad comparative claims about model quality [15]. Aggregation thus reappears in subtler rhetorical form: not always as a single number, but through selective benchmark framing that still invites general conclusions about overall capability.

140

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

谷歌的 Gemini 材料通过基准捆绑而不是明确的分级采取了类似的举措：Gemini 2.0 通过一个涵盖常识、代码生成、推理、事实性、多语言理解、数学、长上下文理解、图像理解、音频翻译和视频分析的比较表来呈现，而 Gemini 2.5 Pro 被描述为领先的通用编码、数学和科学基准 [202]。Google’s Gemini materials make a similar move through benchmark bundling rather than explicit scalarisation: Gemini 2.0 is presented through a comparison table spanning general knowledge, code generation, reasoning, factuality, multilingual understanding, mathematics, long-context understanding, image understanding, audio translation, and video analysis, while Gemini 2.5 Pro is described as leading common coding, mathematics, and science benchmarks [202].

从哲学上讲，许多早期基准都是由功能主义和客观主义假设塑造的，在有限的意义上，它们对待基准分数就好像它们透明地揭示了内在模型属性，如智力、推理或常识（见第一章）。但基准测试不会直接访问这些属性。它们捕获在特定提示、数据集和评分条件下产生的情境行为。正如 Schlangen [350] 所认为的，基准必须区分其内涵目标（他们声称要测量的内容）和外延数据集（他们实际测试的内容）。当这些崩溃时，评估最终会衡量任务设计的人工制品以及模型的能力。Philosophically, many early benchmarks were shaped by functionalist and objectivist assumptions, in the limited sense that they treated benchmark scores as if they transparently revealed intrinsic model properties such as intelligence, reasoning, or commonsense (see Chapter 1). But benchmarks do not access such properties directly. They capture situated behaviours produced under specific prompt, dataset, and scoring conditions. As Schlangen [350] argues, benchmarks must be distinguished between their intensional aims, what they claim to measure, and their extensional datasets, what they actually test. When those collapse, evaluations end up measuring artefacts of task design as much as model capability.

当我仔细检查这些基准时（2022 年在 Google 实习期间），我发现自己一层又一层地剥离了相互基础的研究，而没有质疑它们的基本测量假设。通常，最有问题的假设被归入从未经过同行评审的预印本附录中。这是排行榜竞赛的紧张时代，每一份新的发行论文都宣称其模型是“最好的”。出现的是基准的数字考古学：分层的评估结构，每一个都继承了上一个，并且越来越被视为中立的基础。这反映了开篇的主张，即基准实践通过沉淀的设计选择来稳定，这些设计选择后来显得自然或不可避免。When I examined these benchmarks closely (during my Google internship in 2022), I found myself peeling back layer after layer of studies that built on one another without interrogating their underlying measurement assumptions. Often the most problematic assumptions were relegated to appendices of preprints that never underwent peer review. This was the break-neck era of leaderboard races, where every new release paper declared its model “the best.” What emerged was a digital archaeology of benchmarks: layered evaluative constructions, each inherited from the last and increasingly treated as neutral ground. This mirrors the opening claim that benchmark practices stabilise through sedimented design choices that later appear natural or inevitable.

这里所捍卫的替代方案不是相对主义或拒绝测量。这是一种结构有效性和社会技术方法，与论文更广泛的行动主义和多元化框架相一致。基准是制定出来的，而不是发现的：它们继承了构建它们的社区的价值立场、遗漏和优先事项。因此，描述性评估使其假设明确，​​将结果置于上下文中，并将输出视为机器-社会-人类循环中制定的结果，而不是视为内在智能的中立读数。The alternative defended here is not relativism or the rejection of measurement. It is a construct-validity and sociotechnical approach aligned with the thesis’s broader enactivist and pluralist framework. Benchmarks are made, not found: they inherit the value standpoints, omissions, and priorities of the communities that build them. A descriptive evaluation therefore makes its assumptions explicit, situates results in context, and treats outputs as enacted within Machine-Society-Human loops rather than as neutral read-outs of intrinsic intelligence.

4.2.3 规范性基准与描述性基准4.2.3 Normative vs Descriptive Benchmarks

大多数法学硕士基准都是隐式规范的：它们测试模型是否符合开发人员定义的标准，例如常识推理、毒性减少或偏差检测。虽然这些标准很重要，但它包含了文化假设；经常Most LLM benchmarks are implicitly normative: they test whether models conform to standards defined by developers, such as commonsense reasoning, toxicity reduction, or bias detection. While important, these standards encode cultural assumptions; often

141

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

西方、英语、多数派。他们规定了什么Western, English-speaking, and majority-aligned. They prescribe what应该ought反映在模型输出中。to be reflected in model outputs.

描述性基准采取不同的立场。它不是根据所主张的道德标准来判断输出，而是将模型输出映射到从经验社会数据中观察到的人类分布上。它问：“模型在特定条件下反映了哪些价值表达模式？”这不是相对主义；而是相对主义。这是处方前的测量。描述性映射表面重视多元化，并为后来的规范性辩论提供了基线。 WVB 正是按照这种模式设计的：将 WVS 中的问题改编为提示，将模型输出收集为答案锚点的分布，并将这些输出与人类调查分布进行统计比较。结果不是通过/失败分数，而是文化价值空间中的位置。简而言之：规范伦理规定；描述性伦理描述。在道德价值多元主义下，评价并不能解决道德问题；而是要解决道德问题。它使紧张局势在经验上变得可见。因此，WVB 将价值权衡映射为分布，留下关于什么的任何决定A descriptive benchmark takes a different stance. Rather than judging outputs against an asserted moral standard, it maps model outputs onto observed human distributions from empirical social data. It asks: “Which patterns of value expression does the model reflect under specified conditions?” This is not relativism; it is measurement before prescription. Descriptive mapping surfaces value pluralism and supplies a baseline for later normative debate. The WVB was designed in precisely this mode: questions from the WVS were adapted into prompts, model outputs were collected as distributions across answer anchors, and these were statistically compared with human survey distributions. The outcome was not a pass/fail score but a position in cultural value space. In short: normative ethics prescribes; descriptive ethics describes. Under Moral Value Pluralism, evaluation does not settle moral questions; it makes the tensions empirically visible. WVB therefore maps value trade-offs as distributions, leaving any decision about what应该ought转变为民主和跨学科审议，而不是基准本身。从哲学上讲，WVB 依赖于价值多元化。要了解原因，区分三个方向会有所帮助：to change to democratic and interdisciplinary deliberation rather than to the benchmark itself. Philosophically, WVB rests on value pluralism. To see why, it is helpful to distinguish three orientations:

  • 价值绝对主义（一元论）：Value Absolutism (Monism):存在着对所有社会都具有约束力的普遍真理和正确价值观。there are universal truths and right values, binding across all societies.拒绝了。Rejected.

  • 价值相对主义：Value Relativism:所有价值观在其文化或个人背景下都同样有效。all values are equally valid within their cultural or personal context.拒绝了。Rejected.

  • 价值多元化：Value Pluralism:有许多合法但不可通约的价值观，其中一些核心价值观是跨社会共享的。冲突是不可避免的，但可以加以管理。there are many legitimate but incommensurable values, with some core values shared across societies. Conflict is inevitable but can be managed.拥抱了。Embraced.

有充分的证据表明法学硕士反映了其训练数据中存在的价值观和偏见[例如2、49、192、314、351]。道德价值观是人们持有的信念和实践，反映了他们认为什么是正确或错误的行为，什么社会结构是好是坏，以及什么原则和道德是正确的生活准则。道德哲学，也称为伦理学，是人类社会的古老特征，但它们在不同文化中有所不同，并随着时间的推移而变化。无论这些价值观是与生俱来的还是由文化环境和经验培育出来的，它们都帮助我们构建我们的世界观并激励我们的行动。即使在表面上相似的自由民主国家中，在比较国家、社会或社区的价值研究中也出现了显着的国家差异。这些分歧凸显了挑战：没有任何模型能够再现人类价值观的全部内容，并且决定There is ample evidence that LLMs reflect the values and biases present in their training data [e.g. 2, 49, 192, 314, 351]. Moral values are beliefs and practices that people hold that reflect what they believe is right or wrong behaviour, what social structures are good or bad, and what principles and ethics are the correct ones to live by. Moral philosophies, also known as Ethics, are ancient features of human societies, but they differ across cultures and shift over time. Whether these values are innate or nurtured by cultural surroundings and experiences, they help us construct our worldview and motivate our actions. Even within ostensibly similar liberal democracies, striking national differences appear in value studies that compare nations, societies, or communities. These divergences underline the challenge: no model can ever reproduce the full gamut of human values, and deciding谁的whose所表示的价值观本质上是与上下文相关的。谁的价值观是正确的反映往往是一个背景问题； “道德行为对不同的人来说意味着不同的事情”[384]，道德决策往往是一个妥协的问题。values are represented is inherently contextual. Whose values are the right ones to reflect is often a matter of context; “ethical behaviour means different things to different people”[384] and ethical decisions are often a matter of compromise.

即使在文化相似的民主国家中，这些差异也很明显（图 15）。These divergences are visible even across culturally similar democracies Figure 15.

这种差异凸显了将任何基准视为通用的难度。Such variation underscores the difficulty of treating any benchmark as universal.
