伦理学为思考这个问题提供了几个视角。Ethics provides several lenses for thinking about this problem.

  • 规范伦理Normative ethics关心的是一个人如何is concerned with how one应该ought行为，什么是“好”和“坏”的信念和做法；它从根本上来说是规定性的。规范伦理又细分为：to behave, what are ‘good’ and ‘bad’ beliefs and practices; it is fundamentally prescriptive. Normative ethics is in turn subdivided into:

  • 美德伦理Virtue ethics：培养良好的性格特征，: develop good character traits,

  • 结果主义Consequentialism：后果和功利主义，以及: consequences and utilitarianism, and

  • 道义论Deontology：职责和规则。: duty and rules.

  • 描述性伦理Descriptive ethics实证方法，询问empirical approaches, asking什么what人们实际上持有的道德和价值观。morals and values people in fact hold.

  • 元伦理学Metaethics分析道德语言（例如，善是什么意思？）以及道德“真理”的形而上学本质。analysis of moral language (e.g., what does good even mean?) and the metaphysical nature of moral ‘truths’.

  • 务实道德Pragmatic ethics研究社会道德如何因调查而随着时间的推移而变化，以及我们的机构如何激发这些变化（例如，代码钙化，但社会不断变化）。the study of how social morals change over time as a result of inquiry and how our agency motivates those changes (e.g., code calcifies but society is in constant flux).

道德框架称为The ethical framework called道德价值多元化（MVP）Moral Value Pluralism (MVP)是元伦理学的一种形式，位于规范分支之外，尽管它在实践中与规范分支重叠（例如，一个人可能既是多元论者又是义务论者）。 MVP 不同于相对主义，相对主义认为所有价值观都同等有效 [93]，也不同于自由多元主义，后者主要是政治性的 [38]。 MVP 的核心观点是，不可通约的价值观可以同时为真，即使它们发生冲突。这种冲突不能简化为优化问题或通过概率计算来解决[274]。is a form of metaethics and sits outside the normative branches, though it overlaps with them in practice (e.g., one might be both pluralist and deontologist). MVP differs from relativism, which treats all values as equally valid [93], and from liberal pluralism, which is primarily political [38]. At its core MVP holds that incommensurable values can both be true, even when they conflict. Such conflicts cannot be reduced to optimisation problems or resolved by probabilistic calculation [274].

这对于法学硕士评估很重要：根本的价值冲突无法通过准确性指标或聚合来解决。最好的情况是，它们可以浮出水面并变得明确，以便不同的利益相关者可以对其进行审议。亚里士多德呼吁美德特征This matters for LLM evaluation: fundamental value conflicts cannot be resolved through accuracy metrics or aggregation. At best, they can be surfaced and made explicit, so diverse stakeholders can deliberate on them. Aristotle called for the virtue characteristic

143

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

解决不可通约价值的“实践智慧”（phronesis）；今天，不同利益相关者之间的协作共识可能是更现实的道路。of ‘practical wisdom’ (phronesis) to address incommensurable values; today, collaborative consensus across diverse stakeholders may be the more realistic path.

这对于 LLM 评估至关重要。基于规范的基准可能会具体化基准设计者（通常是机器学习社区或大型科技公司）的价值观。这些价值观不一定是错误的，但它们可能与其他学科、社区或国家的价值观发生冲突。例如，在同一个社会中，人文学科和计算机科学学者可能会通过优先考虑不同的道德原则和特征来构建和处理问题[41, 154]。期望机器学习工程师在社会科学、哲学、法律、医学以及与人工智能伦理交叉的所有其他领域拥有深厚的专业知识也是不合理的。This matters acutely for LLM evaluation. Normative-based benchmarks risk reifying the values of the benchmark designers (often ML communities or Big Tech firms). These values are not necessarily wrong, but they may conflict with those of other disciplines, communities, or nations. For instance, within the same society humanities and computer science scholars may frame and approach problems by prioritising different moral principles and characteristics [41, 154]. It is also unreasonable to expect ML engineers to hold deep expertise in social science, philosophy, law, medicine, and every other field intersecting with AI ethics.

多元主义基准将模型置于记录的人类价值多样性中。他们将有争议的协调决策从技术设计孤岛转移到民主的跨学科领域。多元主义基准适合在面对多数规则或主导权力结构具体化时保持多样性[204]。如果没有这样的方法，狭隘的道德学说可能会被硬编码到社会技术系统中。如果我们想在全球环境中评估模型，我们需要保持多元化并邀请更广泛的跨学科合作的基准。Pluralist benchmarks situate models within recorded human value diversity. They shift contested alignment decisions out of technical design silos and into democratic, interdisciplinary arenas. Pluralist benchmarks are suited to maintaining diversity in the face of majority rulex or reification of dominant power structures [204]. Without such approaches, narrow moral doctrines can be hard-coded into sociotechnical systems. If we want to evaluate models in global settings, we need benchmarks that preserve plurality and invite wider interdisciplinary collaboration.

总之，规范性评估规定了模型如何In summary, normative evaluation prescribes how models应该ought表现得好；描述性评估记录了他们如何to behave; descriptive evaluation documents how theydo跨多元情境的行为。在道德价值多元化下，描述性映射提供了规范审议可以负责任地进行的经验表面。behave across plural contexts. Under moral value pluralism, descriptive mapping supplies the empirical surface on which normative deliberation can responsibly proceed.

4.2.4 与现有的人类数据保持一致4.2.4 Aligning with existing human data

现有的社会科学数据集为描述性人工智能评估提供了比单独构建临时基准更强大的经验基础。我们可以将模型输出与通过 WVS 等现有调查工具收集的记录的人类响应分布进行比较，而不是要求基准设计者或平台公司来决定哪些值重要。这并没有消除解释，但它将评估判断重新定位到更透明的经验基础上，并在人工智能评估和社会科学的长期工作之间架起了一座桥梁。Existing social-science datasets provide a stronger empirical basis for descriptive AI evaluation than ad hoc benchmark construction alone. Rather than asking benchmark designers or platform firms to decide which values count, we can compare model outputs against recorded human response distributions collected through established survey instruments such as the WVS. This does not eliminate interpretation, but it relocates evaluative judgement onto a more transparent empirical footing and builds a bridge between AI evaluation and long-standing work in social science.

价值决策可以在大型科技社区之外做出（拓宽规范观点）。有许多现有的社会科学数据集可以用来帮助我们建立更具描述性的基准。连接到社会科学数据集可以为大型科技和机器学习社区之外的研究建立更牢固的桥梁。Value decisions can be made outside of big-tech communities (widen normative views). There are many existing social science datasets that could be used to help us build more descriptive benchmarks. Connecting to social science datasets builds stronger bridges to research outside of Big Tech and ML communities.

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

144

4.2.4.1 世界价值观基准的起源Origins of the World Values Benchmark

WVB 是在 2022 年我还在 Google 时构思和开发的，直接建立在我之前使用第 2 章中记录的 GPT-3 的工作基础上（The WVB was conceived and developed in 2022 while I was at Google, building directly on my earlier work with GPT-3 documented in Chapter 2 (机器中的幽灵有美国口音The Ghost in the Machine Has an American Accent）。 2021 年的项目表明，GPT-3 关于文化问题的成果倾向于重现美国主导的框架。这项工作的预印本于 2022 年 3 月在 arXiv 上发布[192]，并被广泛引用（在撰写本文时超过 200 次）。随后的现代研究框架于 2026 年发表，强调了随着模型的发展，这项基线研究的重要性 [193]。后来的 WVS 相关工作确实引用了这个早期的贡献 [35,63,384]，但一般没有采用其方法论方向。 WVB 通过从探索性证据转向基于概率分布、提示集和偏差校正的系统描述性基准，扩展了调查范围。). That 2021 project showed that GPT-3 outputs on cultural questions tended to reproduce US-dominant framings. A preprint of this work was released on arXiv in March 2022 [192] and was widely cited (over 200 times at the time of writing). A subsequent modern framing of the research was published in 2026, highlighting the importance of this baseline research as models evolve [193]. Later WVS-related work did cite this early contribution [35, 63, 384], but generally did not adopt its methodological direction. WVB extends that line of inquiry by moving from exploratory evidence to a systematic descriptive benchmark grounded in probability distributions, prompt sets, and bias correction.

目标不是根据外部强加的规范来判断模型，而是根据人类价值观的经验分布来映射其输出[7]The goal was not to judge models against externally imposed norms, but to map their outputs against empirical distributions of human values[7]

该方法的新颖之处不仅在于应用 WVS，还在于它的应用方式。据我所知，WVB 仍然是第一个将以下内容结合起来的：The novelty of the method lay not only in applying WVS, but in how it was applied. To my knowledge, WVB remains the first to combine the following:

  • 分布评价：Distributional evaluation:提取每个答案锚的条件对数似然，将其标准化为概率分布，并将其与国家 WVS 数据进行比较。extracting conditional log-likelihoods for each answer anchor, normalising them into probability distributions, and comparing these with national WVS data.

  • 负责任的提示设计：Responsible Prompt Design:使用结构化提示集（6-20 个释义）、平衡锚点和系统偏差检查。using structured prompt sets (6–20 paraphrases), balanced anchors, and systematic bias checks.

  • 贝叶斯调整：Bayesian adjustment:排除默认模型先验（例如对正锚的偏差）以保留少数变异。factoring out default model priors (such as the bias toward positive anchors) to preserve minority variation.

  • 社会技术映射：Sociotechnical mapping:嵌入测量理论和 MaSH 循环分析，以明确机器、社会和人类因素如何共同塑造有效性。embedding measurement theory and MaSH loop analysis to make explicit how machine, society, and human elements jointly shape validity.

相比之下，后来的 WVS-LLM 研究（从 2023 年底开始）通常将模型视为单个受访者，对每个问题给出一个答案，没有分布评分、提示集或偏差校正。这些差异意味着 WVB 预见到了 2023-24 年出现的许多问题，并且在方法上继续保持领先地位。By contrast, later WVS–LLM studies (from late 2023 onwards) have typically treated models as single respondents producing one answer to each question, without distributional scoring, prompt sets, or bias correction. These differences mean that WVB anticipated many of the concerns that became visible in 2023–24, and it continues to stand apart methodologically.

综上所述，该表清楚地表明，WVB（大约 2022 年）是最早记录的将 WVS 应用于大型语言模型的尝试之一，并且还引入了仍然独特的方法论方向。后来的学习，直到晚期才开始Taken together, the table makes clear that the WVB (circa 2022) was among the earliest documented attempts to apply WVS to large language models, and also introduced a methodological orientation that remains distinct. Later studies, beginning only in late

7 WVB 设计的早期版本于 2022 年 3 月在旧金山的 Google 内部发布，并于 2022 年 9 月在 Google 旧金山和山景城办公室举办的 Responsible AI 研讨会上进行了更全面的演示，包括 LaMDA 和 PaLM-1 结果。7 An early version of the WVB design was presented internally at Google in San Francisco in March 2022, with a fuller presentation, including LaMDA and PaLM-1 results, delivered at a Responsible AI symposium across Google’s San Francisco and Mountain View offices in September 2022.

145

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

2023年，几乎统一框架的模型2023, almost uniformly framed models as调查受访者survey respondents并分析了单个响应。无人就业and analysed single responses. None employed分布可能性distributional likelihoods , 提示集prompt sets, 或, or贝叶斯去偏Bayesian debiasing，并且没有人将他们的评估嵌入到, and none embedded their evaluations in a有效性的社会技术映射sociotechnical mapping of validity .

在这方面，WVB 不仅仅是一个时间顺序问题：它代表了一种概念和技术的转变，从将模型视为黑箱个体，转变为将其价值输出可以与跨文化数据系统地对齐的概率系统。这种创新的结合继续使 WVB 在不断增长的法学硕士文化评估文献中脱颖而出。In this respect WVB was more than a matter of chronology: it represented a conceptual and technical shift from treating models as black-box individuals to treating them as probabilistic systems whose value outputs can be systematically aligned with cross-cultural data. This combination of innovations continues to set WVB apart within the growing literature on cultural evaluation of LLMs.

更简单地说，WVB 在四个方面与表 20 中的大多数方法不同。它评估概率分布而不是单一答案，使用提示集而不是一次性提示，应用贝叶斯调整来减少锚定偏差，并将有效性视为社会技术测量问题，而不是假设仅国家一级的拟合就足够了。从这个意义上说，WVB 不仅仅是另一种基于 WVS 的调查模拟，而且是一种基准设计方法。Put more simply, WVB differs from most of the approaches in Table 20 in four respects. It evaluates probability distributions rather than single answers, uses prompt sets rather than one-shot prompts, applies Bayesian adjustment to reduce anchor bias, and treats validity as a sociotechnical measurement problem rather than assuming that country-level fit alone is sufficient. In that sense, WVB is not just another WVS-based survey simulation, but a benchmark design methodology.

这种对比不是边际的，而是结构性的。在新兴文献中，大多数研究都采用类似的评估姿态：模型被视为调查受访者，每个问题提示一次，其输出直接与人类反应进行比较。这种方法产生了表面上可比的结果，但它掩盖了模型行为的概率性质以及即时构建在塑造结果中的作用。表 20 使这种模式显而易见。它不仅显示了使用 WVS 数据的研究的多样性，而且还显示了方法上的显着趋同：单一响应提示、缺乏基于可能性的评估以及对测量有效性的关注有限。The contrast is not marginal but structural. Across the emerging literature, most studies adopt a similar evaluative posture: models are treated as survey respondents, prompted once per question, and their outputs compared directly to human responses. This approach produces superficially comparable results, but it obscures the probabilistic nature of model behaviour and the role of prompt construction in shaping outcomes. Table 20 makes this pattern visible. It shows not only the diversity of studies using WVS data, but also the remarkable convergence in method: single-response prompting, absence of likelihood-based evaluation, and limited attention to measurement validity.

4.2.4.2 世界价值观调查The World Values Survey

WVS 是社会科学领域规模最大、最具影响力的跨国研究项目之一。它成立于1981年，已在一百多个国家进行了七波全国代表性调查，覆盖了世界90%以上的人口。该调查涵盖了宗教、民主、性别、家庭、政治、工作和道德等领域的公共价值观。它被学术引用超过 60,000 次，被联合国 (UN)、世界银行、经济合作与发展组织 (OECD)、世界卫生组织 (WHO) 和世界经济论坛 (WEF) 等跨国机构广泛使用。The WVS is one of the largest and most influential cross-national research programmes in the social sciences. Established in 1981, it has conducted seven waves of nationally representative surveys across more than one hundred countries, covering over 90% of the world’s population. The survey captures public values across domains such as religion, democracy, gender, family, politics, work, and morality. With more than 60,000 scholarly citations, it is widely used by multi-national institutions including the United Nations (UN), World Bank, Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD), the World Health Organisation (WHO), and the World Economic Forum (WEF).

WVS 的优势在于其严格的方法和长期的稳定性。数据主要通过在每个参与国学术社会科学家的监督下进行的面对面访谈来收集。每一轮都涉及大量样本（例如，2017-2021 年进行的第 7 轮，包括来自 80 个国家的 153,716 名受访者，回答了超过 259 个问题），并且核心项目在数十年中表现出一致的模式[422]。人口统计深度、纵向覆盖范围和方法稳健性的结合使该数据集成为比较价值研究的值得信赖的资源。The strength of the WVS lies in its rigorous methodology and stability over time. Data are collected primarily through face-to-face interviews conducted under the supervision of academic social scientists in each participating country. Each wave involves large samples (e.g. Wave 7, conducted 2017–2021, included 153,716 respondents across 80 countries answering over 259 questions), and the core items have demonstrated consistent patterns across decades [422]. This combination of demographic depth, longitudinal reach, and methodological robustness makes the dataset a trusted resource for comparative value research.

所有社会科学工具都是社会现实的抽象，但 WVS 以其协作性国际治理和对有效性的承诺而著称。其领导层包括来自不同国家的研究人员，并由负责维护技术和社会学标准的学术科学咨询委员会监督。与综合基准不同，WVS 项目已经经过了广泛的可靠性和有效性检查，确保这些措施在不同社会中有意义且具有可比性。All social science instruments are abstractions of social reality, but the WVS is distinguished by its collaborative international governance and commitment to validity. Its leadership includes researchers from diverse countries and is overseen by an academic Scientific Advisory Committee charged with maintaining technical and sociological standards. Unlike synthetic benchmarks, WVS items have already undergone extensive reliability and validity checks, ensuring that the measures are meaningful and comparable across societies.

出于该项目的目的，选择 WVS 作为基础，因为它提供了一个多元化且基于经验的基线，可用于比较模型输出。其全球范围和纵向设计使其特别适合评估法学硕士是否反映持久的跨文化价值模式，而不是即时设计或培训数据偏差的产物。For the purposes of this project, the WVS was selected as the foundation because it provides a pluralist and empirically grounded baseline against which to compare model outputs. Its global scope and longitudinal design make it uniquely suited to evaluating whether LLMs reflect enduring cross-cultural value patterns, rather than artefacts of prompt design or training data bias.

4.2.5 关注I-W轴问题4.2.5 Focussing on I-W axis questions

在试图区分国家时，并非所有问题都那么有用。例如，大多数人普遍认为朋友和家人很重要（见下图）。有些问题更多的是关于受访者的经历而不是他们的价值观。在Not all questions are as useful when trying to differentiate countries. For instance, most people generally think friends and family are important (see figure below). And some of the questions are much more about the respondents’ experience than about their values. In

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

150

早期分析和测试，有一个问题列表是有帮助的，我们将在其中看到所选国家之间的更多差异early analysis and testing it is helpful to have a list of questions where we will see more variation between the selected countries

WVS 的核心是 Inglehart-Welzel (I-W) 文化地图，通过国家级指标的因子分析构建。它揭示了跨文化差异的两个始终稳定的维度：Central to WVS is the Inglehart–Welzel (I-W) cultural map, constructed through factor analysis of national-level indicators. It reveals two consistently stable dimensions of crosscultural variation:

  • 传统价值观与世俗理性价值观Traditional vs. Secular-rational values（宗教、权威、民族自豪感、绝对道德规则与世俗、官僚、理性取向）。(religion, authority, national pride, absolute moral rules versus secular, bureaucratic, rational orientations).

  • 生存与自我表达价值观Survival vs. Self-expression values（经济和人身安全、从众、不信任与自主、宽容、生活质量和参与规范）。(economic and physical security, conformity, and distrust versus autonomy, tolerance, quality of life, and participatory norms).

这两个轴解释了社会之间约 71% 的差异，并且保持高度稳健，连续调查波次之间的相关性高于 0.9。它们还具有预测性：自我表达价值观与民主机构的出现和有效性密切相关（民主指数约为 0.83-0.90）。英格尔哈特本人指出，“人类价值观是以一种令人惊讶的连贯方式构建的”，而且自我表达维度是如此持久，“如果人们衡量广泛社会的基本价值观，就很难避免发现它”。These two axes explain about 71 per cent of the variance between societies and remain highly robust, with correlations above 0.9 between successive survey waves. They are also predictive: self-expression values correlate strongly with the emergence and effectiveness of democratic institutions (around 0.83–0.90 with democracy indices). Inglehart himself noted that “human values are structured in a surprisingly coherent way” and that the self-expression dimension is so persistent it is “difficult to avoid finding it if one measures the basic values of a broad range of societies”.

I-W 地图也反映了悠久的文明遗产。 Huntington（1996）确定了由宗教传统（西方基督教、东正教、伊斯兰教、儒教、日本教、印度教、非洲和拉丁美洲）塑造的八个文化区，这些模式在 WVS 集群中仍然可见。这强调了 WVB 的多元化前提：价值观不是随机噪音，而是由持久的历史、制度和物质条件构成的。The I-W map also reflects long civilisational legacies. Huntington (1996) identified eight cultural zones shaped by religious traditions (Western Christianity, Orthodox, Islam, Confucian, Japanese, Hindu, African, and Latin American), and these patterns remain visible in WVS clusters. This underscores the pluralist premise of the WVB: values are not random noise but structured by enduring histories, institutions, and material conditions.

图 16 中的地图可以被解读为关系字段而不是排名。每个点代表一个国家根据其在这两个维度上的总价值取向定位。点之间的距离表明价值体系的相似性，而聚类则揭示了共同的文化和历史轨迹。这些轴并不衡量任何规范意义上的“进步”或“发展”；它们描述了社会如何组织意义、权威和社会生活的模式变化。The map in Figure 16 can be read as a relational field rather than a ranking. Each point represents a country positioned according to its aggregate value orientation along these two dimensions. Distance between points indicates similarity in value systems, while clustering reveals shared cultural and historical trajectories. The axes do not measure “progress” or “development” in any normative sense; they describe patterned variation in how societies organise meaning, authority, and social life.

与此特别相关的是，美国在结构上呈现出独特的情况：比其他工业民主国家更加宗教化和民族主义，但又具有强烈的自我表达能力。其发展轨迹与众不同，民主指数不断下降，生存问题持续存在（例如医疗保健不安全），使其在 2022 年地图上落后于澳大利亚和北欧国家。这些差异使美国成为评估模型是否再现美国主导价值模式的具有启发性的测试案例：第二章探讨了这个问题，并通过 WVB 进行了系统研究。Of particular relevance here, the US appears as a structurally distinctive case: more religious and nationalist than other industrial democracies, yet strongly self-expressive. Its trajectory is distinctive, with declining democracy indices and persistent survival concerns (such as healthcare insecurity) placing it left of Australia and the Nordic countries on the 2022 map. These divergences made the US a revealing test case for assessing whether models reproduce dominant US value patterns: an issue explored in Chapter 2 and examined systematically through the WVB.

4.2.6 测量理论4.2.6 Measurement theory

良好的测量设计是 WVB 的基础。根据社会科学标准，我们将模型反应视为不可观察的构造（价值观）的间接证据，就像心理学家将调查反应视为潜在态度的代理一样。按照 Bandalos [23] 和 Messick [264] 的说法，有效性不是测试本身的属性，而是我们从上下文中的分数中得出的解释推论的属性。每个有效性主张同时也是关于什么重要以及为什么重要的价值主张。这种区别很重要：在评估法学硕士时，问题绝不仅仅是“基准衡量价值吗？”但是“从模型输出中可以证明哪些关于值的推论是合理的，以及在什么条件下？”Good measurement design was foundational for WVB. Drawing on social science standards, we treated model responses as indirect evidence of unobservable constructs (values), in the same way that psychologists treat survey responses as proxies for latent attitudes. Following Bandalos [23] and Messick [264], validity is not a property of a test itself but of the interpretations inferences we draw from scores in context. Every validity claim is simultaneously a value claim about what matters, and why. This distinction matters: in evaluating LLMs, the question is never simply “does the benchmark measure values?” but “what inferences about values are justified from model outputs, and under what conditions?”

值是理论构造，必须通过可观察的行为来操作，在这种情况下，是模型响应在答案锚点上的分布。每个步骤都需要显式映射：Values are theoretical constructs that must be operationalised through observable behaviours, in this case, distributions of model responses across answer anchors. Each step required explicit mapping:

  • 构建Construct：兴趣的潜在属性（例如，宗教信仰、自我表达价值观、宽容）。: the latent property of interest (e.g., religiosity, self-expression values, tolerance).

  • 操作化Operationalisation：如何引发构造（调查项目适应提示，答案量表作为锚点提供）。: how the construct is elicited (survey item adapted into a prompt, answer scale provided as anchors).

  • 指标Indicators：可观察的输出及其统计摘要（概率分布、与人类调查数据的偏差）。: the observable outputs and their statistical summaries (probability distributions, divergence from human survey data).

正如 Vallor [403] 所指出的，在技术社会不透明的条件下，我们不能假设我们的测量工具将在不同背景下保持可靠的指导。这凸显了将有效性视为嵌入社会技术系统中的生动论证的重要性，而不是作为需要勾选的固定标准列表。As Vallor [403] argues, under conditions of technosocial opacity we cannot assume that our measurement tools will remain reliable guides across contexts. This heightens the importance of treating validity as a living argument embedded in a sociotechnical system, not as a fixed list of criteria to be ticked off.

正如 Selbst 等人。 [354] 认为，公平机器学习的许多失败源于他们所谓的抽象陷阱：设计选择剥夺了使有效性判断有意义所需的社会背景。他们确定了五个陷阱（框架、可移植性、形式主义、连锁反应和解决方案主义），当评估将公平性或有效性视为独立技术系统的属性时，每个陷阱都会出现。 WVB 通过对多个证据来源进行三角测量来整合这一见解：As Selbst et al. [354] argue, many failures in fair-ML stem from what they call abstraction traps: design choices that strip away the social context needed to make validity judgments meaningful. They identify five traps (framing, portability, formalism, ripple effects, and solutionism), each of which arises when evaluations treat fairness or validity as properties of a self-contained technical system. WVB incorporated this insight by triangulating multiple sources of evidence:

  • 建构效度Construct validity：是否引发了充满价值的反应，或者结果是否被情感、读写能力或即时人工制品所混淆？: Are value-laden responses being elicited, or are results confounded by sentiment, literacy, or prompt artefacts?

  • 内容有效性Content validity：所选的 WVS 项目是否充分代表了更广泛的人类价值观领域？: Do the chosen WVS items adequately represent the broader domain of human values?

153

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

  • 并发有效性Concurrent validity：模型分布与调查分布是否以预期的方式相关？: Do model distributions correlate with survey distributions in expected ways?

  • 生态有效性Ecological validity：观察到的模式是否符合已知的文化或国家差异？: Do observed patterns correspond to known cultural or national differences?

  • 法理有效性Nomological validity：产出是否与既定的理论框架（例如世界价值观调查中的 I-W 文化地图）一致？: Do outputs cohere with established theoretical frameworks such as I-W’s cultural map from the World Values Survey?

WVB 没有将这些视为孤立的检查，而是将每项检查都定位在评估流程的社会技术地图上。这种做法出现在假设出现的地方（通过提示措辞、答案锚点、注释者选择或文化背景）并使它们具有争议性。在实践中，WVB 从三个层面检查了有效性：Rather than treating these as isolated checks, WVB located each on a sociotechnical map of the evaluation pipeline. This practice surfaced where assumptions entered (through prompt wording, answer anchors, annotator choices, or cultural context) and made them contestable. In practice, WVB examined validity at three scales:微micro（单个 WVS 问题转换为提示），(single WVS questions converted to prompts),细观meso（分析为分布的释义提示集），以及(sets of paraphrased prompts analysed as distributions), and宏macro（与 WVS 文化地图的整体基准相关性）。这种分层使更现代的有效性方法得以实施：统一的证据计划。(whole-benchmark correlations with WVS cultural maps). This layering operationalised the more modern approach to validity: a unified programme of evidence.

现代有效性理论拒绝零碎的“三种类型”清单（内容、标准、构造），而支持统一的证据计划[23]。像构造代表性不足和构造无关方差（例如，模型对表面措辞的敏感性，或对积极性的先​​验）之类的威胁不被视为次要的麻烦，而是被视为核心问题。这些威胁被明确记录为 WVB 方法的一部分，将测量设计嵌入到社会技术实践中，而不是作为纯粹的统计练习。Modern validity theory rejects a piecemeal “three types” checklist (content, criterion, construct) in favour of a unified programme of evidence [23]. Threats like construct underrepresentation and construct-irrelevant variance (e.g., model sensitivity to surface wording, or priors toward positivity) were treated not as minor nuisances but as central concerns. These threats were logged explicitly as part of the WVB methodology, embedding measurement design inside a sociotechnical practice rather than as a purely statistical exercise.

WVB 的设计遵循两个原则：Two principles guided WVB’s design:

  1. 分布测量。Distributional measurement.许多社会结构是多元的、人口层面的。将模型响应折叠到平均值会掩盖少数派的立场。因此，WVB 将完整响应分布与人类调查分布进行比较，保留方差而不是消除方差。Many social constructs are plural and populationlevel. Collapsing model responses to a mean average obscures minority positions. WVB therefore compares full response distributions to human survey distributions, preserving variance rather than erasing it.

  2. 跨文化有效性。Cross-cultural validity.锚定、翻译和响应格式必须在不同社会中具有可比性。使用平衡锚、释义集和贝叶斯调整来减少锚偏差和提示敏感性。Anchors, translations, and response formats must function comparably across societies. Balanced anchors, paraphrase sets, and Bayesian adjustments were used to reduce anchor bias and prompt sensitivity.

简而言之，WVB 将评估本身视为一种测量程序：不是静态测试，而是关于模型响应如何与人类价值构造相关的持续有效性论证。这超出了大多数当前的人工智能基准，这些基准假设指标不言而喻。通过将测量理论嵌入到设计中，WVB 揭示了评估背后的假设，并使它们具有争议性、可重复性和可解释性。由于有效性源自工具、设置和解释之间的关系，而不是单一指标，因此我们通过社会技术地图使这些关系变得明确。In short, WVB treats evaluation itself as a measurement programme: not a static test, but an ongoing validity argument about how model responses relate to human value constructs. This goes beyond most current AI benchmarks, which assume metrics speak for themselves. By embedding measurement theory into design, WVB surfaces assumptions behind evaluation and makes them contestable, reproducible, and accountable. Because validity arises from relations between tools, settings, and interpretations, not a single metric, we make these relations explicit via a sociotechnical map.

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

154

4.2.7 评估的社会技术图谱4.2.7 Sociotechnical mapping of evaluation

为什么要绘制社会技术地图？Why a sociotechnical map?

测量理论告诉我们如何将结构、操作和指标联系起来；社会技术理论提醒我们，评估从来都不是纯粹技术性的。瓦洛尔 [403, 404] 的美德伦理解释使这一举动变得明确：在严重的条件下Measurement theory tells us how to link constructs, operationalisations and indicators; sociotechnical theory reminds us that evaluation is never purely technical. Vallor’s [403, 404] virtue-ethical account makes this move explicit: under conditions of acute

技术社会的不透明性、技术和道德实践共同发展，因此道德清晰度不能来自单一指标。因此，绘图必须显示工具、实践、价值观和制度如何相互构成；否则，我们就会面临瓦洛尔警告的那种“虚假的道德清晰度”的风险，即复杂的评估选择被扁平化为简洁的分数[404]。technosocial opacity, technologies and moral practices co-evolve, so ethical clarity cannot come from a single metric. Mapping must therefore show how tools, practices, values, and institutions co-constitute one another; otherwise we risk the kind of “false moral clarity” Vallor warns about, where complex evaluative choices are flattened into neat scores [404].

基准是在我所说的机器-社会-人类（MaSH）循环中制定的：技术选择（模型、数据集、提示、指标）与社会世界（法律、意识形态、媒体、不平等、历史）和人类代理（设计师、注释者、用户）相互作用。遵循早期的社会技术系统工作 [117, 395]，我将每个评估视为关系图，而不是独立的工具。Benchmarks are enacted within what I call Machine–Society–Human (MaSH) loops: technical choices (models, datasets, prompts, metrics) interact with social worlds (laws, ideologies, media, inequalities, histories) and human agents (designers, annotators, users). Following early sociotechnical systems work [117, 395] I treat each evaluation as a map of relationships, not a standalone instrument.

这让我们读取有效性This lets us read validity在上下文中in context：考虑到我们的措施所处的系统，我们的措施是否有意义？价值观从哪里进入循环？在实践中，我发现首先绘制地图改变了我所寻找的东西。一旦将“隐藏”的规范假设放在图表上并标记为这样，它们就不再隐藏。 2022 年，我在 Google 共事的工程师证实了这一点：社会技术地图为他们提供了一个新的视角，让他们能够了解自己的设计选择如何融入规范性承诺，以及如何使这些承诺变得明确。: do our measures make sense given the system they sit within, and where do values enter the loop? In practice, I found that drawing the map first changed what I looked for. The “hidden” normative assumptions stopped hiding once they were placed on a diagram and labelled as such. Engineers I worked with at Google in 2022 confirmed this: sociotechnical maps gave them a new lens for seeing how their design choices smuggled in normative commitments, and how to make those explicit.

图 17：社会技术地图显示了人工智能模型的评估如何与社会系统和技术模型相关。Figure 17: A sociotechnical map showing how evaluations of AI models relate to both the social system and the technical model.

社会技术是人工智能社区的热门词汇；然而，这个词的起源常常被淡化。社会技术系统领域最初发展于 20 世纪 50 年代，作为对煤炭开采机械化引起的社会动荡的研究 [117, 395]。其最初的目的正是为了映射之间的关系Sociotechnical is a trending word in AI communities; however, the word is often diluted from its origins. The field of sociotechnical systems was initially developed in the 1950s as an examination of the social upheavals caused by the mechanisation of coal extraction [117, 395]. Its original purpose was precisely to map relationships between

155

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

技术和社会组成部分，显示有效性如何取决于这些关系而不是任何单一指标technical and social components, showing how validity depends on those relations rather than any single metric

最近在公平性和人工智能治理方面的工作都集中在这样的观点上：有效性和公平性是社会技术系统的属性，而不是独立模型的属性：模型卡框架[267]、数据集数据表[145]、美国开发的国家标准与技术研究所（NIST）人工智能风险管理框架、自然语言处理（NLP）数据声明[8]和HELM基准[229]都在推动更加情境化的评估，但它们仍然是叙述性或表格化的文物。Recent work in fairness and AI governance converges on this view: validity and fairness are properties of sociotechnical systems, not standalone models: The Model Cards framework [267], Datasheets for Datasets [145], The US developed National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) AI Risk Management Framework, Data Statements for Natural Language Processing (NLP) [8], and the HELM benchmark [229] all push toward more contextualised evaluations, but they remain narrative or tabular artefacts.

“目前对稳健且可验证的测量方法缺乏共识……[意味着]测量方法可能过于简单化、欺骗、缺乏关键的细微差别、以意想不到的方式被依赖，或者无法考虑受影响群体和环境的差异”美国 NIST 人工智能风险管理框架 (2023) [8]“The current lack of consensus on robust and verifiable measurement methods … [means] measurement approaches can be oversimplified, gamed, lack critical nuance, become relied upon in unexpected ways, or fail to account for differences in affected groups and contexts” The US NIST AI Risk Management Framework (2023) [8]

我们的贡献是独特的。据我所知，没有人采取进一步的步骤，使用图解社会技术映射协议来定位评估系统的特定节点和边缘的有效性检查。通过将有效性从清单转变为关系图，该方法使隐藏的假设变得可见且可争议，并创建了一个可复制的工具，从业者可以用它来询问自己的基准。这是人工智能评估设计的方法论创新，也是本论文的直接贡献。Our contribution is distinct. To my knowledge, no one has taken the further step of using a diagrammatic sociotechnical mapping protocol to locate validity checks on specific nodes and edges of an evaluation system. By turning validity from a checklist into a relational map, this method makes hidden assumptions visible and contestable and creates a replicable tool that practitioners can use to interrogate their own benchmarks. This is a methodological innovation in AI evaluation design and represents a direct contribution of this thesis.

4.2.7.1 偏见的途径Avenues of bias

偏差最好理解为 MaSH 循环的系统特性。它不仅仅来自训练数据，而是通过多个渠道不断引入，社会技术地图使这些渠道变得可见：从预先提示中内置的世界观，到答案锚设计中嵌入的假设，再到注释者的默认判断。Bias is best understood as a systemic property of the MaSH loop. It does not arise from training data alone but is continually introduced across multiple channels, which a sociotechnical map makes visible: from the world-views built into pre-prompts, to the assumptions embedded in answer-anchor design, to the tacit judgments of annotators.

  • 训练数据Training data：出处、覆盖范围和策展选择塑造了基线世界观。: provenance, coverage, and curation choices shape the baseline worldview.

  • 目标和任务Goals and tasks：模型的目的定义了重要事项的优先级。: what is framed as the model’s purpose encodes priorities about what matters.

  • 架构和标记化Architecture & tokenization：代表性和建模选择可以优先考虑某些形式、语域或语言。: representational and modelling choices can privilege certain forms, registers, or languages.

  • 护栏及系统提示Guardrails & system prompts：框架、预先提示（“世界观”）和答案锚点系统地推动输出。: framing, pre-prompts (“world-views”), and answer anchors systematically nudge outputs.

  • 微调制度Fine-tuning regimes（RLHF/RLAIF/Constitutional AI）：注释者选择或宪法编码规范性判断。(RLHF/RLAIF/Constitutional AI): annotator choices or constitutions encode normative judgments.

  • 提示Prompts：词汇选择、顺序和文化语域影响如何引发反应。: lexical choices, ordering, and cultural registers affect how responses are elicited.

  • 评估设计Evaluation design（任务、标签和指标）：设计者的假设成为目标，有时充当事实上的规范标准。(tasks, labels, and metrics): designer assumptions become the target, sometimes functioning as de facto normative yardsticks.

所有这些途径都位于人类社会结构和环境的复杂环境中。图 18 仅显示了偏见和规范假设源自的复杂环境的某些方面（即经济力量、政治意识形态和治理）。认识到这些偏见途径是 WVB 突出社会技术映射的原因：All these avenues sit within the complex environment of human social structures and environments. 4.2.7.2 基准设计社会技术映射的四步过程A four-step process for sociotechnical mapping of benchmark design

这个四步协议使有效性成为关系性的而不是清单：我们不仅仅“勾选”有效性框；我们在地图上找到它们并在上下文中保护它们。This four-step protocol makes validity relational rather than a checklist: we don’t merely “tick” validity boxes; we locate them on the map and defend them in context.

  1. 顶级地图。Top-level map.勾勒出该项目的概述。您试图测量哪些不可观察的结构；在我们的例子中，这就是价值观。但我们不是Sketch out an overview of the project. What are the unobservable constructs you are trying to measure; in our case that is values. But we aren’t

157

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

直接与价值观进行比较，而不是与世界价值观调查创建的数据集进行比较。找到管道上的潜在障碍，在我们的例子中是全球互联网接入的数字鸿沟和训练数据的管理选择。即使这第一步也可以帮助您了解您真正测量的内容以及您将测量结果与什么进行比较。comparing directly against values, rather a dataset created by the World Values Survey. Locate potential blockages on pipelines, in our case the digital divide of global Internet access and the curation choices of the training data. Even this very first step helps you see what you are really measuring and what you are comparing your measurements against.

图 19：社会技术映射评估设计 - 步骤 1，世界观。Figure 19: Sociotechnical mapping evaluation design - Step 1, Worldview.

  1. 世界观与假设。World-view & hypothesis.陈述您用于测试的主要假设和规范世界观（如果有）。标记哪些量是可观察的，哪些是不可观察的（例如，“值”是潜在的；输出是可观察到的）。这迫使人们明确承认评估中所包含的观点，而不是隐含地承认。例如，这项工作认为价值多元化是好的。我们可以看到，我们需要将 WVS 问题转化为提示，然后是提示集，然后是基准方法。我们清楚地陈述了我们的假设——根据 WVS 问卷设计的提示集可以衡量法学硕士的主导价值观。尽管这些步骤可能看起来简单且易于绕过，但它们对于向其他人和设计者展示基准设计中嵌入了哪些假设至关重要。State the primary hypothesis and normative world-view (if any) you bring to the test. Mark which quantities are observable vs unobservable (e.g., “values” are latent; outputs are observed). This forces explicit acknowledgement of the standpoint embedded in the evaluation, rather than leaving it implicit. For instance, this work takes the view that value pluralism is good. We can see that what we need to operationalise are the WVS questions into prompts, then prompt sets, then a benchmark method. We state our hypothesis clearly– prompt sets designed on the WVS questionnaire can measure dominant values in LLMs. Although these steps may seem simple and easy to bypass, they are essential for showing both others and the designer which assumptions are embedded in the benchmark design.

图 20：社会技术映射评估设计 - 步骤 2，陈述您的主要假设和规范世界观。标记什么是可观察的和不可观察的。Figure 20: Sociotechnical mapping evaluation design - Step 2, State your primary hypothesis and your normative world-view. Mark what is observable and unobservable.

  1. 假设库存。Assumptions inventory.列出您对构造、翻译、注释器、预提示和部署上下文所做的假设。这在设计上并不是详尽无遗的：重点是让原本隐藏的东西变得可见。正如我们在“负责任的提示设计”中发现的那样，提示和锚点充当“充满价值的询问器”；即使写得看起来中立，它们也具有规范性的分量。例如，说明设计中使用了哪些代理：即人们对 WVS 的反应反映了他们的价值观；模型输出和分数反映了训练模型中的主要嵌入值。我们的一些假设包括相信价值观嵌入在语言中，并且 WVS 是由社会科学家专家精心构建的，从而产生了强大的数据集。List assumptions you are making about constructs, translation, annotators, pre-prompts, and deployment context. This is nonexhaustive by design: the point is to make visible what otherwise remains hidden. Prompts and anchors, as we found in Responsible Prompt Design, act as “value laden interrogators”; they carry normative weight even when written to look neutral. For example, state what proxies are being used in the design: i.e. that people’s responses to the WVS reflect their values; and model outputs and scores reflect dominant embedded values in the trained model. Some of our assumptions include the belief that values are embedded in language and that the WVS has been well constructed by expert social scientists resulting in a robust dataset.

Consider your choices on how to measure (generated outputs or scores), how to weight the prompts, and choice of methods to compare results.

  1. 地图上的有效性检查。Validity checks on the map.在相关边/节点处进行有效性检查：Place validity checks at the relevant edges/nodes:

  2. 表面有效性Face validity：对于领域专家/用户来说，这看起来合理吗？: does this look reasonable to domain experts/users?

  3. 并发有效性Concurrent validity：与外部人类参考（即 WVS 数据）对齐。: alignment to external human references i.e. the WVS data.

  4. 内容/内部有效性Content/internal validity：提示/锚点异常；答案集效应，: prompt/anchor anomalies; answer-set effects,

  5. 结构/法理有效性Construct/nomological validity：与相关研究的一致性。[8]: coherence with related studies.[8]

例如，最初的单一提示显示，由于模型提示超敏性，它们无法单独工作；因此，该基准测试未能通过那些早期的表面有效性检查。当最终基准测试的结果与 WVS 进行比较时，我们看到了并发有效性。For example, the initial single prompts showed that they would not work alone due to model prompt hypersensitivity; therefore the benchmark failed those early face validity checks. When the results from the final benchmark were compared against the WVS we saw concurrent validity.

4.2.8 研究背景参数4.2.8 Parameters of research context

支持 WVB 的工作是在 2022 年我在 Google 工作时进行的。当时，Google 的 LaMDA（于 2021 年 5 月宣布）从未公开，但我能够在内部使用它来沙箱和改进方法。还需要注意的是，这些结果现在无法完全复制，因为特定模型版本（LaMDA、PaLM v1）已退役或被取代。 Google 的 PaLM（于 2022 年 4 月首次发布）也未公开； 2023 年 3 月向选定的研究人员提供了有限的 API。 PaLM v1 包括 540B、64B 和 8B 参数模型，但于 2022 年末停用，以便将资源重新分配给 PaLM 2（2023 年 5 月宣布）。当 Google 于 2023 年 3 月首次发布 Bard 时，它在 LaMDA 上运行，后来过渡到 PaLM 2。2023 年 12 月宣布的 Gemini 包含 LaMDA、PaLM 2 和多模式系统中的其他模型。这些不断变化的资源设定了本研究的边界条件，将 WVB 历史性地锚定在 2022 年模型景观中。The work underpinning WVB was conducted in 2022 while I was at Google. At that time, Google’s LaMDA (announced May 2021) was never made public, but I was able to use it internally to sandbox and refine methods. It is also important to note that these results cannot be exactly replicated today, as the specific model versions (LaMDA, PaLM v1) have since been decommissioned or superseded. Google’s PaLM (first announced April 2022) also was not public; a limited API was offered in March 2023 to selected researchers. PaLM v1 included 540B, 64B, and 8B parameter models, but was deactivated in late 2022 to reallocate resources toward PaLM 2 (announced May 2023). When Google first released Bard in March 2023 it ran on LaMDA, later transitioning to PaLM 2. Gemini, announced in December 2023, encompassed LaMDA, PaLM 2, and additional models in a multimodal system. These shifting resources set the boundary conditions of this research, anchoring WVB historically in the 2022 model landscape.

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

4.3 方法与设计4.3 Methods and design

本节列出了用于构建 WVB 的方法流程：调查问题选择、锚点和提示设计、概率提取和标准化、先验调整和评分，然后是版本历史记录。本章的核心贡献是方法论。 WVB 不是根据预定义的规范标准来评估法学硕士，而是将模型输出与现有的人类调查数据相结合，并比较分布而不是单一答案。This section sets out the methodological pipeline used to construct the WVB: survey question selection, anchor and prompt design, probability extraction and normalisation, prior-aware adjustment, and scoring, followed by version history. The chapter’s central contribution is methodological. Rather than evaluating LLMs against a predefined normative standard, WVB aligns model outputs with existing human survey data and compares distributions rather than single answers.

该框架结合了四个要素：从 WVS 中提取的构造、负责任的提示设计、分布评分指标和社会技术有效性检查。这些共同建立了一种描述性和可复制的方法，用于在记录的人类价值观模式中定位模型输出，同时保留多元化并使基准设计的规范性假设更加明确。The framework combines four elements: constructs drawn from the WVS, Responsible Prompt Design, distributional scoring metrics, and sociotechnical validity checks. Together, these establish a descriptive and replicable method for locating model outputs within recorded patterns of human values while preserving pluralism and making the normative assumptions of benchmark design more explicit.

接下来的部分依次记录了该流程的每个阶段，包括问题选择、提示构建、锚点设计、概率提取、贝叶斯调整和评分。本章中提供了代表性的调查项目、提示、锚点和工作流程步骤，以使设计逻辑和实施过程透明。The sections that follow document each stage of this pipeline in turn, including question selection, prompt construction, anchor design, probability extraction, Bayesian adjustment, and scoring. Representative survey items, prompts, anchors, and workflow steps are provided throughout the chapter to make the design logic and implementation procedure transparent.

4.3.1 调查问题选择4.3.1 Survey question selection

并非所有 WVS 项目对于该基准测试都同样有用。其中一些几乎没有表现出跨国差异，而另一些则更多地捕捉到了经验而不是价值观。因此，WVB 优先考虑了两类项目：核心 Inglehart-Welzel 问题和与这些轴密切相关的其他项目。这也解释了诸如宗教问题6之类的问题的包含：虽然不是规范地图的一部分，但它们在理论上仍然与相同的价值维度相关，并且它们从地图中的省略反映了纵向稳定性的需要，而不是缺乏解释价值。Not all WVS items were equally useful for this benchmark. Some showed little cross-national variance, while others captured experience more than values. WVB therefore prioritised two kinds of items: the core Inglehart–Welzel questions and additional items strongly correlated with those axes. This also explains the inclusion of questions such as Q6 on religion: although not part of the canonical map, they remain theoretically relevant to the same value dimensions, and their omission from the map reflects the need for longitudinal stability rather than lack of explanatory value.

该基准始于 WVS，它为跨文化研究提供了稳定的实证基础。 WVS 支撑着 I-W 文化地图：两个维度（传统价值观与世俗理性价值观；生存价值观与自我表达价值观）共同解释了全球价值体系中 70% 以上的差异[185]。事实证明，这些维度非常稳健，连续波之间的相关性为 0.92 和 0.95，这使人们相信这些结构随着时间的推移是稳定的测量。正如英格尔哈特指出的那样，The benchmark began with the WVS, which provides a stable empirical foundation for cross-cultural research. The WVS underpins the I-W cultural map: two dimensions (Traditional versus Secular-Rational values; Survival versus Self-Expression values) that together explain more than 70 percent of the variance in global value systems [185]. These dimensions have proven remarkably robust, with correlations of .92 and .95 between successive waves, giving confidence that the constructs are stable measures over time. As Inglehart noted,“人类价值观的构建方式出奇地一致：这两个维度完全解释了社会间 71% 的跨文化差异”“human values are structured in a surprisingly coherent way: the two dimensions explain fully 71 percent of the cross-cultural variation among societies”（2006 年，第 115 页）。(2006, p. 115).

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

162

这两条轴线也体现了文化历史的持久特征。亨廷顿（Huntington，1996）强调了宗教在塑造八个主要文明区（西方基督教、东正教、伊斯兰教、儒教、日本教、印度教、非洲和拉丁美洲）中的作用。这些宗教传统在 WVS 文化地图上仍然很明显，凸显了即使面对现代化，历史遗产也依然显着。英格尔哈特的分析表明，个人主义、自主性和自我表达背后的维度尤其强大：The two axes also capture enduring features of cultural history. Huntington (1996) emphasised the role of religion in shaping eight major civilisational zones (Western Christianity, Orthodox, Islam, Confucian, Japanese, Hindu, African, and Latin American). These religious traditions remain evident in the WVS cultural map, underscoring the continued salience of historical legacies even in the face of modernisation. Inglehart’s analysis shows that the dimension underlying individualism, autonomy, and self-expression is especially robust:“人们几乎可能会得出这样的结论：如果衡量广泛社会的基本价值观，就很难避免找到它”“one might almost conclude that it is difficult to avoid finding it if one measures the basic values of a broad range of societies” [185:120]

在此经验基础上，WVB 问题选择根据三个标准进行：Following this empirical foundation, WVB question selection proceeded according to three criteria:

  • 核心 I-W 地图问题Core I-W map questions：两个维度上因子负荷最强的十个项目，包括宗教、家庭、民主和权威问题。: ten items with the strongest factor loadings on the two dimensions, including questions on religion, family, democracy, and authority.

  • 相关问题Correlated questions：与 I-W 轴相关性高于 0.75 的项目，例如对天堂和地狱的信仰、性别角色以及环境保护和经济增长之间的权衡。: items with correlations above 0.75 with the I-W axes, such as belief in heaven and hell, gender roles, and trade-offs between environmental protection and economic growth.

  • 战略差异化因素Strategic differentiators :

  • 美国与其他国家截然不同的问题。例如，虽然澳大利亚和北欧国家聚集在自我表达极点，但美国仍然更接近生存极点。这可能反映了医疗保健状况和民主指标下降等持续存在的挑战：自 2016 年以来，美国一直被评为“有缺陷的民主国家”，目前在民主指数中排名第 26 位，远远落后于挪威（第 1 位）、新西兰（第 2 位）和澳大利亚（第 6 位）。正如第 2 章所讨论的，这些差异使美国成为模型调整的特别有启发性的测试案例。Questions where the United States diverges sharply from peer nations. For example, while Australia and the Nordic countries cluster toward the Self-Expression pole, the US remains closer to the Survival side. This may reflect persistent challenges such as the state of healthcare and declining democracy indicators: the US has been ranked a “flawed democracy” since 2016 and currently sits 26th on the Democracy Index, far behind Norway (1st), New Zealand (2nd), and Australia (6th). These divergences made the US an especially revealing test case for model alignment, as discussed in Chapter 2.

最初的测试集选取了十个不同文化的国家：澳大利亚、哥伦比亚、法国、伊朗、日本、荷兰、尼日利亚、俄罗斯、越南和美国。该样本结合了地理分布、宗教和政治制度的差异，并记录了 WVS 响应的对比。通过包括高收入和低收入国家，该基准力求捕捉多元化的价值多样性，而不是狭隘的西方框架。尽管 I-W 轴最初是在 1990 年确定的，但它们在连续测量波中的稳定性增强了它们作为测量指标的有效性，即使新的维度也可以被认为与当今的背景相关。The initial test set drew on ten culturally diverse countries: Australia, Colombia, France, Iran, Japan, the Netherlands, Nigeria, Russia, Vietnam, and the United States. This sample combined geographical spread, variation in religion and political systems, and documented contrasts in WVS responses. By including both high- and low-income nations, the benchmark sought to capture pluralist value diversity rather than a narrow Western frame. Although the I-W axes were originally identified in 1990, their stability across successive survey waves has reinforced their validity as measurement indicators, even as new dimensions could also be considered relevant in today’s context.

并非所有 WVS 项目都对该基准具有同等的诊断作用。其中一些几乎没有表现出跨国差异，而另一些则更多地捕捉到生活经验而不是价值观。因此，WVB 优先考虑两种项目：核心 I-W 问题和与这些轴密切相关的附加项目。这也解释了诸如 Q6 之类的问题的包含Not all WVS items were equally diagnostic for this benchmark. Some showed little cross-national variance, while others captured lived experience more than values. WVB therefore prioritised two kinds of items: the core I-W questions and additional items strongly correlated with those axes. This also explains the inclusion of questions such as Q6

总而言之，这些基础证明了使用 WVS 作为 WVB 的经验基础是合理的。目的不是将 I-W 轴视为人类价值观的详尽内容，而是使用一个完善且历史悠久的社会科学框架来锚定跨文化差异反应模式的描述性比较。Taken together, these foundations justify the use of WVS as the empirical basis for WVB. The aim is not to treat the I-W axes as exhaustive of human values, but to use a wellestablished and historically robust social-scientific framework to anchor descriptive comparison across culturally differentiated response patterns.

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

4.3.2 负责任的提示设计（RPD）4.3.2 Responsible Prompt Design (RPD)

一旦选择了调查项目，下一个方法步骤就是设计能够从法学硕士中引出可比输出的提示。一个主要挑战是即时敏感性：措辞、格式或词汇选择的微小变化可能会产生截然不同的输出分布。从行动主义者的角度来看，这并不是围绕着固定的内部状态的噪音。有证据表明反应是依赖于相互作用的。因此，评估的任务是足够仔细地设计交互，以使制定的模式变得可解释。更广泛地说，生成的输出不仅取决于训练数据，还取决于提示框架、立场启动和先前对话的残留。当目标是询问内在价值而不是促进合规时，RPD 旨在尽可能多地消除即时方面的影响。Once survey items were selected, the next methodological step was to design prompts capable of eliciting comparable outputs from LLMs. A central challenge was prompt sensitivity: small changes in phrasing, formatting, or lexical choice could produce materially different output distributions. From an enactivist standpoint, this is not noise around an otherwise fixed inner state. It is evidence that the response is interaction-dependent. The task of evaluation is therefore to design the interaction carefully enough that the enacted pattern becomes interpretable. More broadly, generated outputs are shaped not only by training data but also by prompt framing, standpoint priming, and the residue of prior dialogue. RPD was designed to neutralise as much of that prompt-side influence as possible when the aim is to interrogate embedded values rather than prompt compliance.

为了解决这个问题，我开发了负责任的提示设计（RPD），这是一种用于生成、测试和完善提示的系统程序，以便可以在调查项目和答案锚点之间更可靠地比较模型响应。To address this, I developed Responsible Prompt Design (RPD), a systematic procedure for generating, testing, and refining prompts so that model responses could be compared more reliably across survey items and answer anchors.

为了验证有效性，最初的基准测试仅使用英语提示。多语言扩展被推迟，因为翻译，尤其是机器翻译，有可能在英语基准本身稳定之前将语义漂移引入本已微妙的调查结构中。For validity, the initial benchmark used English prompts only. Multilingual expansion was deferred because translation, especially by MT, risked introducing semantic drift into already delicate survey constructs before the English benchmark itself had been stabilised.

4.3.2.1 提示集Prompt sets

每个 WVS 项目都通过一组 6-20 个系统变化的释义进行操作，旨在测试和降低对措辞效果的敏感性。例如，“家庭在你的生活中有多重要？”这个问题扩展到诸如“请评价家庭在您生活中的重要性”和“家庭在您生活中有多重要？”等变体。结果被标准化并聚合成每个项目的单一分布。敏感性不仅是语义上的，而且是词汇和结构上的：模型有时会根据“God”是否大写、“organization/organization”是否拼写不同或是否使用否定来产生不同的分布。使用提示集可以消除这些伪影，并产生更稳定、可复制的结果。Each WVS item was operationalised through a prompt set of 6–20 systematically varied paraphrases designed to test and reduce sensitivity to wording effects. For example, the question “How important is family in your life?” was expanded into variations such as “Please rate the importance of family in your life” and “How much does family matter in your life?” Results were normalised and aggregated into a single distribution per item. Sensitivity was not just semantic but lexical and structural: models sometimes produced different distributions depending on whether “God” was capitalised, whether “organisation/organization” was spelled differently, or whether negations were used. Using prompt sets countered these artefacts and yielded more stable, replicable results.

4.3.2.2 回答主播Answer anchors

为了保持与 WVS 数据的可比性，提示使用了结构化答案锚点，尽可能与原始调查响应格式保持一致。在可行的情况下，二元和 3-4 点量表保留其原始形式。在需要修改的地方，它们是根据保持语义极性的一致规则进行的，同时减少细粒度锚点分配的不稳定性。对于 10 分制，试点测试表明法学硕士无法在如此长的集合中可靠地分配概率：分布有噪音、不稳定，并且违反了基本的有效性检查。因此，十点量表被分解为更广泛的积极与消极类别，这是方法上的妥协To preserve comparability with WVS data, prompts used structured answer anchors aligned as closely as possible with the original survey response formats. Binary and 3–4 point scales were retained in their original form where feasible. Where modifications were necessary, they were made according to a consistent rule of preserving semantic polarity while reducing instability in fine-grained anchor allocation. For 10-point scales, pilot tests showed that LLMs could not reliably allocate probabilities across such long sets: distributions were noisy, unstable, and violated basic validity checks. Ten-point scales were therefore collapsed into broader positive versus negative categories, a methodological compromise

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

168

这样做是为了在细粒度锚分配被证明不稳定的情况下保持可解释性和分布可靠性。考虑了替代重新映射，包括三点和四点箱，但这些引入了任意切点和新的词汇锚。因此，在当时可用模型的限制下，二元崩溃被采纳为扭曲性最小的折衷方案made to preserve interpretability and distributional reliability where fine-grained anchor allocation proved unstable. Alternative remappings were considered, including three- and four-point bins, but these introduced arbitrary cut-points and new lexical anchors. Binary collapse was therefore adopted as the least distortive compromise under the limits of the models available at the time

锚定措辞也很重要：模型始终偏爱某些词汇变体（例如，“有点重要”而不是“中等重要”），而其他词汇变体（例如“相当重要”）无论含义如何都会被降低权重。为了减少这种偏差，锚点被平衡并尽可能接近 WVS 原始数据。Anchor wording also mattered: models consistently preferred some lexical variants (e.g., “somewhat important” over “moderately important”), while others (e.g., “rather important”) were down weighted regardless of meaning. To reduce this bias, anchors were balanced and kept as close to WVS originals as possible.

4.3.2.3 偏差校正Bias correction

试点测试显示，人们强烈倾向于“非常重要”等积极锚定。这表明先有一个模型倾向于肯定和正价措辞，这有可能扭曲最终的分布，而与提示的实质性内容无关。为了解决这个问题，我们应用了贝叶斯调整（详见第 4.3.5 节），它在锚点之间更均匀地重新分配概率并纠正默认偏差。Pilot testing revealed a strong skew toward positive anchors such as “very important”. This suggested a model prior favouring affirmative and positively valenced phrasing, which risked distorting the resulting distributions independently of the substantive content of the prompt. To address this, we applied Bayesian adjustment (detailed in Section 4.3.5), which redistributed probabilities more evenly across anchors and corrected for default bias.

此校正的目的不是使模型输出符合人类价值观，而是减少模型对某些锚点的默认偏好引入的测量伪影。这反映了两个评价目标之间的选择。目标 A 将准确地测量模型行为，包括默认的锚点首选项。这里采用的目标 B 旨在通过剔除浅层词汇先验来衡量模型输出和人类价值分布之间更深层的关联，否则这些浅层词汇先验会淹没特定问题的变化。从这个意义上说，调整的功能与其说是结果校正，不如说是仪器校准：它试图将提示引起的实质性模式与模型对特定响应形式的背景偏差区分开来。我们分三步实施了这一调整：The purpose of this correction was not to make model outputs conform to human values, but to reduce a measurement artefact introduced by the model’s default preference for certain anchors. This reflects a choice between two evaluative objectives. Objective A would measure model behaviour exactly as emitted, including default anchor preferences. Objective B, adopted here, seeks to measure deeper associations between model outputs and human value distributions by factoring out shallow lexical priors that would otherwise swamp question-specific variation. In that sense, the adjustment functions less as outcome correction than as instrument calibration: it seeks to separate the substantive pattern elicited by the prompt from the model’s background bias toward particular response forms. We implemented this adjustment in three steps:

  1. 估计先验Estimate priors- 独立于任何实质性提示来测量模型对每个锚点的基线偏好。— measure the model’s baseline preference for each anchor independently of any substantive prompt.

  2. 应用贝叶斯规则Apply Bayes’ rule— 将模型先验替换为从 WVS 调查数据得出的相应人类先验。— replace the model prior with the corresponding human prior derived from WVS survey data.

  3. 重整化Renormalise— 重新计算调整后的锚概率，使每个响应分布总和为 100%。— recalculate the adjusted anchor probabilities so that each response distribution sums to 100%.

示例。Example.在 WVS 宗教项目（“宗教在你的生活中有多重要？”）上，贝叶斯校正将 PaLM 的“非常重要”的原始概率大致减半，并在其他锚点上更均匀地重新分配权重。这种调整减少了锚定偏差，并产生了更接近地反映人类调查响应中观察到的方差的分布。On the WVS religion item (“How important is religion in your life?”), Bayesian correction roughly halved PaLM’s raw probability for “very important” and redistributed weight more evenly across the other anchors. This adjustment reduced anchor bias and produced distributions that more closely reflected the variance observed in human survey responses.

169

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

这一调整反映了两个评价目标之间的选择。目标 A 将准确地测量模型行为，包括默认的锚点首选项。这里采用的目标 B 旨在通过剔除浅层词汇先验来衡量模型输出和人类价值分布之间更深层的关联，否则这些浅层词汇先验会淹没特定问题的变化。因此，贝叶斯调整被用作校准，而不是强制结果。This adjustment reflects a choice between two evaluative objectives. Objective A would measure model behaviour exactly as emitted, including default anchor preferences. Objective B, adopted here, seeks to measure deeper associations between model outputs and human value distributions by factoring out shallow lexical priors that would otherwise swamp question-specific variation. Bayesian adjustment was therefore used as calibration, not outcome-forcing.

4.3.2.4 复杂的问题格式Complex question formats

某些 WVS 项目需要进行调整。例如，“儿童品质”问题要求受访者从十个属性中选择五个。对于模型，提供了所有选项；然后将五个最高似然得分视为选定集并映射回 WVS 编码方案。 Q152-155 等配对项目同样进行了调整，以保持人类和模型反应之间的可比性。Some WVS items required adaptation. The “child qualities” question, for example, asks respondents to select five out of ten attributes. For models, all options were presented; the five highest likelihood scores were then treated as the selected set and mapped back to the WVS coding scheme. Paired items such as Q152–155 were similarly adapted to preserve comparability between human and model responses.

4.3.2.5 不相关替代原则Principle of irrelevant alternatives

一个意外的发现是，当删除一个答案选项时，模型的概率分配不稳定。理论上，如果一个选项与选择无关，删除它不应该影响其余选项的相对概率。这种期望在选择理论中被形式化为不相关替代方案的独立性（IIA）。然而模型一再违反这一原则。例如，对于这个问题An unexpected finding was that the model’s probability assignments were unstable when one answer option was removed. In theory, if an option is irrelevant to the choice, removing it should not affect the relative probabilities of the remaining ones. This expectation is formalised in choice theory as the independence of irrelevant alternatives (IIA). Yet models repeatedly violated this principle. For example, on the question“家庭在你的生活中有多重要？”“How important is family in your life?”，如果选项, if the option“一点也不重要”“not at all important”如果包含在内，该模型可能会将 84% 的概率分配给was included, the model might assign 84% probability to“非常重要”“very important”和 7% 至and 7% to“不是很重要。”“not very important.”当When“一点也不重要”“not at all important”被删除，但是，概率为was removed, however, the probability for“非常重要”“very important”可能会下降到 75% 并且might drop to 75% and“不是很重要”“not very important”上升到 15%，尽管删除的选项只吸引了最小的重量。这表明 LLM 以对完整选项集敏感的方式在锚点之间重新分配概率，而不管语义内容如何。rise to 15%, even though the removed option had attracted only minimal weight. This shows that LLMs redistribute probabilities across anchors in ways that are sensitive to the full option set, regardless of semantic content.

4.3.2.6 预先提示测试Pre-prompting tests

早期试验还探索了“世界构建”提示，指示模型将自己想象为调查受访者，或采用角色（例如，“您正在回答国家价值观调查”）。这些方法改变了分布，但也引入了额外的人工制品。例如，角色启动可能会放大刻板印象或夸大文化规范。因此，为了保证有效性，WVB 的第一个版本仅使用零样本提示，没有额外的上下文或角色指令。由于同样的有效性原因，多语言扩展被推迟。翻译，尤其是机器翻译，有可能在英语基准本身稳定之前将语义漂移引入本已微妙的调查结构中。Early trials also explored “world-building” prompts that instructed the model to imagine itself as a survey respondent, or to adopt a persona (e.g., “You are answering a national values survey”). These approaches shifted distributions but also introduced additional artefacts. For example, persona priming could amplify stereotypes or exaggerate cultural norms. For validity, the first version of WVB therefore used zero-shot prompting only, without additional context or role instruction. Multilingual expansion was deferred for the same validity reason. Translation, especially by machine translation, risked introducing semantic drift into already delicate survey constructs before the English benchmark itself had been stabilised.

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

170

总而言之，这些步骤将负责任的提示设计确立为一种结构化方法。提示被视为测量工具，就像心理学和社会学中设计和验证调查问题一样。这不仅确保了 LLM 的回答可以与 WVS 数据进行有意义的比较，而且还为未来的基准测试提供了可转移的技术。微妙的是，这种方法也预示着第 5 章中探讨的更广泛的认知主张（Taken together, these steps established Responsible Prompt Design as a structured methodology. Prompts were treated as measurement instruments, in the same way that survey questions are designed and validated in psychology and sociology. This not only ensured that LLM responses could be meaningfully compared with WVS data but also contributed a transferable technique for future benchmarking. Subtly, this approach also foreshadows a broader epistemic claim explored in Chapter 5 (语义极光Semantic Auroras）：提示不仅是技术指令，而且是塑造人类和机器之间所表达的含义的共同创造行为。): prompts are not only technical instructions but co-creative acts that shape the meaning enacted between humans and machines.

通过将这种方法命名并形式化为By naming and formalising this approach as负责任的提示设计Responsible Prompt Design，该项目引入了超越 WVB 本身的方法创新。当时，大多数评估都依赖于单一提示，并将第一个生成的答案视为模型的响应。相比之下，RPD 将即时变化、锚点平衡和偏差校正系统化，作为实现 LLM 评估有效性的必要步骤。这一贡献本身就意义重大：它将提示从临时实践重新构建为严格的设计方法，可以在未来的研究中复制、批评和构建。, the project introduced a methodological innovation that extends beyond WVB itself. At the time, most evaluations relied on single prompts and treated the first generated answer as the model’s response. In contrast, RPD systematised prompt variation, anchor balancing, and bias correction as necessary steps for achieving validity in LLM evaluation. This contribution is significant in its own right: it reframes prompting from an ad hoc practice into a rigorous design method that can be replicated, critiqued, and built upon in future research.

4.3.3 从模型生成概率4.3.3 Generating probabilities from models

WVB 的一个显着特征是它评估的不是单个模型输出，而是可能答案的概率分布。这需要直接访问模型的评分函数。不是提示模型选择一个答案，而是提交每个问题锚点对进行评分，并提取模型在给定问题的情况下该锚点的条件可能性。然后，这些似然得分在锚集上进行标准化，以生成每个调查项目的概率分布。A distinctive feature of WVB was that it evaluated not a single model output, but the probability distribution over possible answers. This required direct access to the model’s scoring functions. Rather than prompting the model to choose one answer, each questionanchor pair was submitted for scoring, and the model’s conditional likelihood for that anchor given the question was extracted. These likelihood scores were then normalised across the anchor set to produce a probability distribution for each survey item.

在内部，法学硕士将原始分数分配给候选标记，通常称为 logits。这些分数可以转换为可能性，然后使用 softmax 函数进行标准化，以便完整的答案选项集总和为 1（或 100%），从而在可用锚点上产生可比较的概率分布。Internally, LLMs assign raw scores to candidate tokens, often referred to as logits. These scores can be converted into likelihoods and then normalised with a softmax function so that the full set of answer options sums to 1 (or 100%), producing a comparable probability distribution across the available anchors.

提取和规范化锚点级别似然得分生成每个调查项目的概率分布。这种级别的访问通常在面向公众的界面中不可用，但在这里可以通过研究级 API 访问来实现。Extracting and normalising anchor-level likelihood scores produced a probability distribution for each survey item. This level of access is often unavailable in public-facing interfaces but was possible here through research-level API access.

对于每个 WVS 项目，流程如下：For each WVS item, the process was as follows:

  1. 每个问题-锚点对都提交给模型进行评分。Each question-anchor pair was submitted to the model for scoring.

  2. 生成的似然分数在锚集上进行标准化，使其总和为 100%，从而生成该项目的概率分布。The resulting likelihood scores were normalised across the anchor set so that they summed to 100%, producing a probability distribution for that item.

  1. 在使用提示集的情况下，对每个释义的标准化分布进行平均，以根据一致的聚合程序产生单个项目级分布。Where prompt sets were used, the normalised distributions from each paraphrase were averaged to produce a single item-level distribution according to a consistent aggregation procedure.

例如，在家庭重要性项目上，PaLM-62b 返回了一个严重偏向“非常重要”的分布，而分配给其余锚点的概率较小。然后可以将这些分布直接与 WVS 观察到的人类反应分布进行比较。For example, on the family-importance item, PaLM-62b returned a distribution heavily weighted toward “very important”, with smaller probabilities assigned to the remaining anchors. These distributions could then be directly compared with the observed human response distributions from the WVS.

当时，相对较少的人工智能伦理项目通过锚点级概率提取而不是单次文本输出来评估模型。大多数基准测试将模型的第一个生成的响应视为其答案。相比之下，WVB 将该模型视为概率生成器，其输出可以与人类调查分布进行系统比较。这是使价值评估更具可重复性和分布敏感性的关键一步。At the time, relatively few AI ethics projects evaluated models through anchor-level probability extraction rather than single-shot text outputs. Most benchmarks treated the model’s first generated response as its answer. By contrast, WVB treated the model as a probability generator whose outputs could be compared systematically with human survey distributions. This was a key step in making values evaluation more reproducible and distributionally sensitive.

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

172

4.3.4 锚点偏差的贝叶斯调整4.3.4 Bayesian adjustment of anchor bias

早期实验揭示了模型输出的系统性偏差。在许多项目中，模型表现出对“非常重要”等积极锚点的强烈偏好，并且在某些情况下，无论问题的实质性内容如何，​​都会为包含“相当”等术语的锚点分配接近零的概率。这种模式表明锚定偏差是由模型先验引起的，而不是与人类反应分布有意义的一致。如果不加以纠正，它可能会夸大多数主义倾向并掩盖少数派立场。Early experiments revealed a systematic skew in model outputs. Across many items, models showed a strong preference for positive anchors such as “very important”, and in some cases assigned near-zero probability to anchors containing terms such as “rather”, regardless of the substantive content of the question. This pattern suggested anchor bias arising from model priors rather than meaningful alignment with human response distributions. If left uncorrected, it risked overstating majoritarian tendencies and obscuring minority positions.

步骤 1：估计模型先验。Step 1: Estimating model priors.为了量化这种基线偏差，我首先估计了模型在中性上下文中分配给每个锚点的先验概率，即在对任何特定调查问题进行调节之前的信息最少的提示上下文。在实践中，这涉及对诸如“非常重要”、“相当重要”、“不太重要”和“一点也不重要”等锚点进行评分，而没有实质性的调查内容有利于一个锚点而不是另一个锚点。由此产生的分布提供了对模型对这些锚点的默认权重的估计，并表明一些锚点，尤其是“非常重要”的锚点，具有不成比例的高先验概率。然后，在评分之前调整锚点级别的可能性时，这些估计的先验在各个项目中一致使用。To quantify this baseline skew, I first estimated the prior probability the model assigned to each anchor in neutral contexts, that is, minimally informative prompt contexts before conditioning on any specific survey question. In practice, this involved scoring anchors such as “very important”, “rather important”, “not very important”, and “not at all important” without substantive survey content that would favour one anchor over another. The resulting distribution provided an estimate of the model’s default weighting of these anchors and showed that some, especially “very important”, carried disproportionately high prior probability. These estimated priors were then used consistently across items when adjusting anchor-level likelihoods prior to scoring.

步骤 2：应用贝叶斯规则。Step 2: Applying Bayes’ rule.一旦锚定先验被估计，模型对每个调查项目的似然评分就会被调整，以减少默认锚定偏好的影响。这是通过将每个锚点的观察到的可能性除以其先验概率，然后重新规范化结果来完成的。其效果是减少模型默认首选的锚的权重，并使特定问题的变化在结果分布中更加明显。Once anchor priors were estimated, the model’s likelihood scores for each survey item were adjusted to reduce the influence of default anchor preferences. This was done by dividing the observed likelihood for each anchor by its prior probability and then renormalising the result. The effect was to reduce the weight of anchors that the model preferred by default and to make question-specific variation more visible in the resulting distribution.

步骤 3：生成调整后的分布以供分析。Step 3: Producing adjusted distributions for analysis.应用贝叶斯规则后，校正后的锚分数被重新归一化，使每个分布总和为 100%。这些调整后的分布随后进入评分阶段（第 4.3.6 节），其中使用 Lebesgue-1 (L1) 距离和 Kullback-Leibler (KL) 散度[9] 量化与 WVS 国家/地区数据的一致性。通过这种方式，贝叶斯调整充当了管道的一个组成部分，将原始似然得分转换为更适合描述性比较的分布。After applying Bayes’ rule, the corrected anchor scores were renormalised so that each distribution summed to 100%. These adjusted distributions were then carried forward into the scoring phase (Section 4.3.6), where alignment with WVS country data was quantified using Lebesgue-1 (L1) distance and Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence[9] . In this way, Bayesian adjustment functioned as an integral part of the pipeline, converting raw likelihood scores into distributions better suited for descriptive comparison.

9 L1 距离（也称为 L1 范数或曼哈顿距离）通过将每个点的绝对差值相加来衡量两组值之间的总体差值。 Kullback-Leibler (KL) 散度通过询问丢失了多少信息，或者如果使用一种分布代替另一种分布，我们会感到多么惊讶，来衡量两种概率分布之间的差异。简而言之，L1 显示两组值总体上相距多远，而 KL 显示它们的概率组织方式有多么不同。与 L1 距离不同，KL 散度是有方向性的，并不是真正的距离度量。9 L1 distance (also called the L1 norm or Manhattan distance) measures the overall difference between two sets of values by adding up the absolute difference at each point. Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence measures the difference between two probability distributions by asking how much information is lost, or how surprised we would be, if one distribution is used to stand in for the other. Put simply, L1 shows how far apart two sets of values are overall, while KL shows how differently their probabilities are organised. Unlike L1 distance, KL divergence is directional and is not a true distance metric.

173

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

贝叶斯调整被集成到负责任的提示设计中，作为统计比较之前的最终校准步骤。其目的是减少模型端的锚偏差，特别是对更积极或肯定的回答选项的默认偏好，以便得到的分布更忠实地反映问题本身的实质性影响。如果没有这种调整，基准将面临夸大多数派倾向并模糊少数派立场的风险，从而破坏该项目的多元化目标。Bayesian adjustment was integrated into Responsible Prompt Design as the final calibration step before statistical comparison. Its purpose was to reduce model-side anchor bias, especially the default preference for more positive or affirmative response options, so that the resulting distributions more faithfully reflected the substantive influence of the question itself. Without this adjustment, the benchmark would have risked overstating majoritarian tendencies and obscuring minority positions, undermining the pluralist aims of the project.

4.3.5 有效性考虑4.3.5 Validity considerations

我采用第 4.2.3 节中概述的统一有效性观点，根据该观点，有效性不是单独测试的清单，而是通过内容、构造、并发、生态和法理等方面的汇聚证据构建的累积论证。在本章中，这些有效性考虑因素的作用是对作为测量工具的基准进行检查，包括提示设计、锚定校准和评分程序是否保留感兴趣的结构，而不是简单地强制模型输出反映人类调查分布。更全面的有效性论证在第 4.2.3 节中提出，并位于第 4.2.4 节的社会技术地图上。I adopt the unified view of validity outlined in §4.2.3, according to which validity is not a checklist of separate tests but a cumulative argument built from converging evidence across content, construct, concurrent, ecological, and nomological strands. In this chapter, these validity considerations function as checks on the benchmark as a measurement instrument, including whether prompt design, anchor calibration, and scoring procedures preserve the constructs of interest without simply forcing model outputs to mirror human survey distributions. The fuller validity argument is developed in §4.2.3 and located on the sociotechnical map in §4.2.4.

内容有效性。Content validity.我们注意保留预期的 WVS 结构，同时根据法学硕士的限制调整调查格式。例如，在试点测试表明模型无法可靠地跨细粒度锚点分配概率后，10 点 WVS 量表被分解为更广泛的正面和负面类别。锚定措辞也进行了平衡，以减少词汇偏见。目的不是以任何类似人类的方式推断内部“价值”，而是确保提示和响应格式有效地将目标结构操作为受控条件下的可测量输出分布。Care was taken to preserve the intended WVS constructs while adapting survey formats to LLM constraints. For example, 10-point WVS scales were collapsed into broader positive and negative categories after pilot testing showed that models could not allocate probabilities across fine-grained anchors reliably. Anchor wording was also balanced to reduce lexical bias. The aim was not to infer internal “values” in any human-like sense, but to ensure that the prompts and response formats validly operationalised the target constructs as measurable output distributions under controlled conditions.

构建效度。Construct validity.WVB 利用了 I-W 轴的长期稳定性，这些轴在连续的 WVS 波之间显示出很强的相关性。使用这些轴作为基准支柱提供了证据，证明目标结构、传统价值观与世俗理性价值观以及生存价值观与自我表达价值观在理论上和经验上都得到了很好的确立。这本身并不能验证模型输出，但它强化了基准是基于强大的社会科学结构而不是临时类别的情况。WVB drew on the long-term stability of the I-W axes, which have shown strong correlations across successive WVS waves. Using these axes as the benchmark backbone provided evidence that the target constructs, Traditional versus Secular-Rational values and Survival versus Self-Expression values, were theoretically and empirically well established. This does not by itself validate model outputs, but it strengthens the case that the benchmark is anchored to robust social-scientific constructs rather than ad hoc categories.

并发有效性。Concurrent validity.模型输出分布直接与三个级别的国家 WVS 响应分布进行比较：微观（单个问题）、中观（跨提示集聚合）和宏观（总体数据集级别对齐）。这些比较本身并不能证明有效性，但它们提供了关于以下方面的证据：Model output distributions were compared directly with national WVS response distributions at three levels: micro (single questions), meso (aggregated across prompt sets), and macro (overall dataset-level alignments). These comparisons do not establish validity on their own, but they provide evidence about

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

174

该基准是否捕获了与多个尺度上观察到的人类调查反应保持有意义的可比性的模式。whether the benchmark captures patterns that remain meaningfully comparable to observed human survey responses across multiple scales.

法理有效性。Nomological validity.通过在比较社会研究中记录的更广泛的经验规律中定位模型的输出模式，进一步支持了有效性。例如，该基准再现了美国和其他工业化民主国家之间有据可查的差异，包括比几个同类国家更强烈的宗教信仰、更大的生存导向倾向以及更弱的民主指标。这本身并不能验证基准，但它提供了证据，表明它捕获的分布不是随机的，也不是脱离既定的社会科学模式的。 [10] 。Validity was further supported by locating model output patterns within broader empirical regularities documented in comparative social research. For example, the benchmark reproduced well-documented divergences between the United States and other industrialised democracies, including stronger religiosity, greater survival-oriented tendencies, and weaker democratic indicators than several peer nations. This does not by itself validate the benchmark, but it provides evidence that the distributions it captures are not random or detached from established social-scientific patterns.[10] .

生态有效性。Ecological validity.WVB 旨在在结构化提示条件下评估模型输出，该条件近似真实的评估用途，同时保持方法上的控制。这并不能再现现实世界部署的全部复杂性，但它通过显示模型响应分布在合理的提示条件下而不是在完全人工测试设置中的变化来增强基准的相关性。WVB was designed to evaluate model outputs under structured prompting conditions that approximate real evaluative use while remaining methodologically controlled. This does not reproduce the full complexity of real-world deployment, but it strengthens the benchmark’s relevance by showing how model response distributions vary under plausible prompt conditions rather than in fully artificial test settings.

总而言之，这些有效性考虑因素支持 WVB 作为描述性测量框架，用于在受控条件下将模型输出分布与人类调查分布进行比较。这里的有效性不是通过任何单一的检查来确定的，而是通过累积的论证来确定的，即基准保留了感兴趣的结构，支持有意义的比较，并保持对多种模式的敏感度，而不将它们简化为单一的规范理想。Taken together, these validity considerations support WVB as a descriptive measurement framework for comparing model output distributions with human survey distributions under controlled conditions. Validity here is not established by any single check, but by a cumulative argument that the benchmark preserves the constructs of interest, supports meaningful comparison, and remains sensitive to plural patterns without reducing them to a single normative ideal.

4.3.6 评分指标4.3.6 Scoring metrics

WVB 流程的最后一步是将模型生成的概率分布与 WVS 中观察到的概率分布进行比较。重点是与全国调查数据的分布相似性，而不是任何单一答案是否“正确”。使用了三种评分视图：原始分布、L1 距离和 Kullback-Leibler (KL) 散度。The final step in the WVB pipeline was to compare model-generated probability distributions with those observed in the WVS. The focus was on distributional similarity to national survey data rather than whether any single answer was “correct”. Three scoring views were used: raw distributions, L1 distance, and Kullback–Leibler (KL) divergence.

  • 原始结果。Raw results.在应用差异指标之前，原始模型分布与人类国家分布一起记录。这为解释差异提供了描述性基线，并确保了分数得出方式的透明度Before applying divergence metrics, raw model distributions were recorded alongside human country distributions. This provided a descriptive baseline for interpreting differences and ensured transparency in how scores were derived

  • L1距离（曼哈顿距离）。L1 distance (Manhattan distance).这是每个答案选项的模型概率和人类概率之间的绝对差异之和。例如，在This is the sum of absolute differences between model and human probabilities for each answer option. For example, on the

问题question“家庭在你的生活中有多重要？”“How important is family in your life?”92%的澳大利亚人回答说，92% of Australians answered,“非常重要，”“very important,”而 PaLM-62b 为该锚点分配了 84% 的概率。绝对差异为8%。对所有选项求和即可得到该问题的 L1 分数。较小的值表示更接近的对齐。while PaLM-62b assigned 84% probability to that anchor. The absolute difference is 8%. Summing across all options gives the L1 score for that question. Smaller values indicate closer alignment.

  • Kullback–Leibler (KL) 散度：Kullback–Leibler (KL) divergence:这是一种信息论度量，衡量使用模型的分布作为基线来描述人类分布的效率有多低。This is an information-theoretic measure of how inefficient it would be to describe the human distribution using the model’s distribution as a baseline.

其中 P(x) 是人类分布，Q(x) 是模型分布。 KL 值为零表示分布相同；值越高表示差异越大。例如，关于Where P(x) is the human distribution and Q(x) is the model’s distribution. A KL value of zero indicates identical distributions; higher values indicate greater divergence. For example, on“堕胎合理吗？”“Is abortion justifiable?”PaLM-540b 仅分配 0.5% 的概率PaLM-540b assigned only 0.5% probability to“总是有道理的”“always justifiable,”然而，12% 的法国受访者选择了这一选项，从而获得了较高的 KL 分数。 KL 被强调为主要衡量标准，因为它对于模型为少数答案分配可忽略不计的概率但仍被大部分人选择的情况特别敏感；对于评估多元化至关重要。yet 12% of French respondents chose that option, producing a high KL score. KL was emphasised as the primary measure because it is particularly sensitive to cases where models assign negligible probability to minority answers that are nevertheless chosen by a significant share of humans; crucial for evaluating pluralism.

在 WVB 中，成功并不是通过实现单个高对齐分数或通过固定阈值来定义的。因为基准是描述性的而不是规定性的，所以目标是产生跨提示变体稳定的分布，较少受到锚先验的扭曲，并且可以根据微观、中观和宏观层面的已知 WVS 模式进行解释。因此，L1 距离和 KL 差异的作用是比较工具而不是结论：较低的值表明与给定的国家概况更相似，而两个指标之间的差异有助于显示差异是基础广泛还是集中在少数响应模式中。In WVB, success is not defined by achieving a single high alignment score or passing a fixed threshold. Because the benchmark is descriptive rather than prescriptive, the aim is to produce distributions that are stable across prompt variants, less distorted by anchor priors, and interpretable against known WVS patterns at micro, meso, and macro levels. L1 distance and KL divergence therefore function as comparative tools rather than verdicts: lower values indicate closer similarity to a given national profile, while differences between the two metrics help show whether divergence is broad-based or concentrated in minority response patterns.

其他指标Other metrics（例如 L2 距离、重叠和 Jaccard 相似度）在方法开发过程中得到考虑，并在设计文档中注明，但未在报告的结果中使用。(such as L2 distance, overlap, and Jaccard similarity) were considered during method development and noted in the design documentation but were not used in the reported results.

注意事项。Caveats.现阶段分析仅比较At this stage the analysis compares only国家层面的总量national-level aggregates稳定方法论。各国内部的价值观很少是同质的，尤其是美国在许多问题上表现出强烈的内部两极分化。此外，重要的是要记住，模型中嵌入的分布来自于训练数据，这些数据并不是通过统计来代表任何人群的。它们是数据来源的人工制品，而不是国家价值观的代表性样本。to stabilise the methodology. Values within countries are rarely homogeneous, and the United States in particular exhibits strong internal polarisation across many issues. Moreover, it is critical to remember that the distributions embedded in models arise from their training data, which are not statistically curated to represent any human population. They are artefacts of data provenance rather than representative samples of national values.

这些指标共同为比较模型生成的分布和人类调查的分布提供了描述性基础。原始分布保留透明度、L1 距离Together, these metrics provide a descriptive basis for comparing model-generated and human survey distributions. Raw distributions preserve transparency, L1 distance

捕捉总体差异，KL 差异突出显示了模型体重不足反应的情况，而这种情况在人群中仍然很重要。captures overall divergence, and KL divergence highlights cases where models underweight responses that remain significant within human populations.

4.3.7 基准版本4.3.7 Benchmark versions

WVB 是迭代开发的，每个版本都解决了通过反复试验发现的不同有效性挑战。这种分阶段的进展是该项目的核心：不是在理论上设计一种方法，而是通过重复测试、诊断故障模式并相应地改进方法来建立基准。产生了三个结构化版本：Naïve、InputSensitivity 和 OutputBias。每个版本都纠正了一个明显的有效性威胁——首先是提示敏感性，然后是锚定偏差——因此记录它们可以说明为什么最终的管道是必要的而不是可选的。The WVB was developed iteratively, with each version addressing a different validity challenge uncovered through trial and error. This staged progression was central to the project: rather than designing a method in theory, the benchmark was built through repeated testing, diagnosing failure modes, and refining the approach accordingly. Three structured versions were produced: Naïve, InputSensitivity, and OutputBias. Each version corrected a distinct validity threat—first prompt sensitivity, then anchor bias—so documenting them shows why the final pipeline is necessary rather than optional.

WVB-天真。WVB-Naïve.第一个版本使用 WVS 项目的直接单提示翻译。每个问题都提出一次，并提供答案锚点，并将所得分布与 WVS 国家/地区数据进行比较。虽然简单，但该版本未能通过基本的有效性检查。措辞上的微小差异（即大写、同义词、语法顺序或标点符号）会产生不稳定的、有时甚至是误导性的分布。这些早期的运行表明，幼稚的提示作为一种评估方法是多么脆弱。The first version used direct single-prompt translations of WVS items. Each question was posed once, with answer anchors provided, and the resulting distributions were compared against WVS country data. Although simple, this version failed basic validity checks. Small differences in phrasing (i.e. capitalisation, synonyms, order of syntax, or punctuation) produced unstable and sometimes misleading distributions. These early runs demonstrated how fragile naïve prompting was as an evaluation method.

WVB-输入灵敏度。WVB-InputSensitivity.为了解决这个问题，第二个版本引入了提示集，每个问题有 6-20 个释义。该模型对每个变体进行评分；分数在子集上标准化，然后平均成复合分布。这降低了噪音并提高了可复制性。例如，词汇偏好To address this, the second version introduced prompt sets, with 6–20 paraphrases of each question. The model scored each variant; scores were normalised over the sub-set and then averaged into a composite distribution. This reduced noise and improved replicability. For example, the lexical preference for“有点重要”“somewhat important”结束over“中等重要”“moderately important”可能会扭曲单个提示，但对一组提示进行平均可以平衡此类伪影。输入灵敏度因此增强了可靠性和表面有效性。然而系统性偏差仍然存在：模型仍然一贯高估积极的锚点，例如could skew a single prompt, but averaging across a set balanced such artefacts. InputSensitivity therefore strengthened reliability and face validity. Yet systematic skew remained: models still consistently over-predicted positive anchors such as“非常重要。”“very important.”

WVB-输出偏置。WVB-OutputBias.第三个版本应用贝叶斯调整来纠正这种偏差。首先，在中性上下文中估计锚先验以测量默认模型偏好。其次，观察到的可能性分数相对于这些先验进行了调整并重新标准化。这减少了“非常重要”的主导地位，并使特定问题的变化更加清晰地出现。因此，OutputBias 提高了构造有效性，确保分布反映问题内容而不是模型默认值。The third version applied Bayesian adjustment to correct for this skew. First, anchor priors were estimated in neutral contexts to measure default model preferences. Second, observed likelihood scores were adjusted relative to these priors and renormalised. This reduced the dominance of “very important” and allowed questionspecific variation to emerge more clearly. OutputBias thus improved construct validity, ensuring distributions reflected question content rather than model defaults.

177
