A schematic overview showing how the benchmark evolved from unstable single-prompt runs (Naïve), to greater reliability through prompt sets (InputSensitivity), to adjusted distributions correcting anchor bias (OutputBias).

总的来说，这三个版本展示了从不稳定（Naïve）到改进的可靠性（InputSensitivity），再到增强的构建有效性（OutputBias）的进展。结果部分仅使用了最终版本，但记录早期迭代至关重要：它说明了为什么需要方法保障以及如何系统地改进描述性基准测试。Taken together, the three versions demonstrate a progression from instability (Naïve) to improved reliability (InputSensitivity), to strengthened construct validity (OutputBias). Only the final version was used in the Results section, but documenting the earlier iterations was essential: it shows why methodological safeguards are necessary and how descriptive benchmarking can be systematically improved.

4.3.8 主要挑战总结4.3.8 Summary of key challenges

10 分制。10-point scales.最持久的问题之一来自使用 10 点回答间隔的 WVS 问题（例如One of the most persistent problems came from WVS questions that used 10-point response intervals (e.g.“以 1 到 10 的等级表示行为 X 是否合理”“indicate on a scale of 1 to 10 whether behaviour X is justifiable”）。考虑过其他重新映射，包括三点和四点箱，但被拒绝，因为它们强加了任意的切点和新的词汇锚。因此，在当时可用模型的限制下，二元崩溃被视为扭曲性最小的折衷方案。在试点测试中，模型无法在如此细粒度的锚点上产生有意义的分布：响应变得嘈杂、平坦或崩溃到极端。此外，某些项目（例如 Q109）的人类数据严重聚集在量表的一端，这使得比较变得脆弱。经过广泛的讨论，我们将这些量表分为二元类别（正/负）。人类调查的回应是). Alternative remappings, including three- and four-point bins, were considered but rejected because they imposed arbitrary cut-points and new lexical anchors. Binary collapse was therefore adopted as the least distortive compromise under the limits of the models available at the time. In pilot tests the models could not produce meaningful distributions across such fine-grained anchors: responses became noisy, flat, or collapsed to extremes. Moreover, human data for some items (e.g. Q109) are heavily clustered at one end of the scale, which made comparisons fragile. After extensive discussion we collapsed these scales into binary categories (positive/negative). Human survey responses were

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

178

相应地重新计算以匹配二进制模型输出。这牺牲了细微差别，但确保了可比性并减少了杂散噪声。recalculated accordingly to match the binary model outputs. This sacrificed nuance but ensured comparability and reduced spurious noise.

锚杆倾斜。Anchor skew.即使在 4 点或二元项目上，模型也显示出对正锚点的系统偏见，例如Even on 4-point or binary items, models showed a systematic bias toward positive anchors such as“非常重要”“very important” or “总是有道理的。”“always justified.”这种锚定偏好扭曲了分布，偏离了预期的结构。我们通过锚先验的贝叶斯调整在基准的 OutputBias 版本中解决了这个问题。This anchor preference distorted distributions away from the intended construct. We addressed this in the OutputBias version of the benchmark through Bayesian adjustment of anchor priors.

输入灵敏度。Input sensitivity.早期的运行还表明，小的词汇变化（大写、同义词、标点符号）可能会不成比例地改变分布。如果没有保障措施，问题的单一措辞可能会产生误导性的结果。这促使转向提示集，其中平均 6-20 个释义以减少词汇噪音。Early runs also revealed that small lexical changes (capitalisation, synonyms, punctuation) could swing distributions disproportionately. Without safeguards, a single phrasing of a question could give misleading results. This prompted the move to prompt sets, where 6–20 paraphrases were averaged to reduce lexical noise.

人体模型不匹配。Human–model mismatch.另一个挑战是方法论而非技术：模型没有经过仔细平衡的调查数据的训练，并且它们的分布与代表性人群不对应。这使得突出有效性论证并明确基准的描述性（而不是规范性）范围至关重要。Another challenge was methodological rather than technical: models are not trained on carefully balanced survey data, and their distributions do not correspond to representative populations. This made it essential to foreground validity arguments and be explicit about the descriptive (rather than normative) scope of the benchmark.

总而言之，这些挑战凸显了为什么天真的提示不能被视为中立的评估方法。处理高音程音阶、锚定偏差和词汇不稳定需要深思熟虑的方法论保障。如果此类调整不可行，我们选择排除这些项目，而不是过度解释噪声输出。Taken together, these challenges underline why naive prompting cannot be treated as a neutral evaluation method. Handling high-interval scales, anchor biases, and lexical instability required deliberate methodological safeguards. Where such adjustments were not feasible, we chose to exclude those items rather than over-interpret noisy outputs.

4.4 结果4.4 Results

4.4.1 焦点问题中的国家相似性范例4.4.1 Country similarity exemplars from focus questions

为了进行分析，我们首先检查选定的 WVS 项目，其中模型输出可以直接与国家分布进行比较。每个图都报告了分歧指标——主要是 Kullback-Leibler (KL) 分歧，它对模型错过少数响应的情况很敏感，以及 L1 距离，它总结了总体百分比差异。任一指标的值较低都表示更接近。To ground the analysis, we first examine selected WVS items where the model outputs can be directly compared to national distributions. Each figure reports divergence metrics — primarily Kullback–Leibler (KL) divergence, which is sensitive to cases where models miss minority responses, and L1 distance, which sums overall percentage differences. Low values on either metric indicate closer alignment.

在最初的 WVS 中，这是一个 10 分的合理性量表；在这里，为了可比性，回复被分为二元类别（合理/不合理）。 PaLM 始终对“不合理”给予更强烈的重视。在图表中，这显示出与美国分布（也是限制性的）的 KL 差异较小，但与荷兰（堕胎被广泛接受）和尼日利亚（堕胎在很大程度上是非法的）的差异较大。换句话说，该模型的限制性立场反映了美国的倾向，但出于与尼日利亚反应背后的文化原因截然不同的文化原因：这是一个重要的提醒，即低分歧可能掩盖性质上不同的联盟。On the original WVS, this was a 10-point justifiability scale; here, responses were collapsed into binary categories (justifiable / not justifiable) for comparability. PaLM consistently weighted “not justifiable” more strongly. In the graphs, this shows up as low KL divergence with the US distribution (also restrictive), but larger divergence from the Netherlands (where abortion is widely accepted) and Nigeria (where abortion is largely illegal). In other words, the model’s restrictive stance mirrors US tendencies but for very different cultural reasons than those underlying Nigerian responses: an important reminder that low divergence can mask qualitatively different alignments.

虽然这里提出的结果侧重于使用世界价值观调查进行的国家层面的比较，但通过额外的时间和空间可以提取更丰富的模式。未来的研究可以将世界价值观基准扩展到更细粒度的阶层，例如人口群体（例如年龄、性别、教育、收入）或国家内的区域亚人口。其他可能性包括合并由特定社区或专业领域创建的数据集，这将使我们能够了解模型输出如何与更本地化的情境中表达的价值观保持一致。这种扩展将加深框架的描述能力，提供关于哪些价值模型正在制定以及在什么条件下制定的更细致的图景。While the results presented here focus on national-level comparisons using the World Values Survey, much richer patterns could be extracted with additional time and space. Future research could extend the World Values Benchmark to finer-grained strata such as demographic groups (e.g. age, gender, education, income) or regional sub-populations within countries. Other possibilities include incorporating datasets created by specific communities or professional domains, which would make it possible to see how model outputs align with values expressed in more local, situated contexts. Such extensions would deepen the descriptive power of the framework, providing a more nuanced picture of which values models are enacting and under what conditions.

4.4.3 结果总结4.4.3 Results summary

模特展示位置。Model placements.PaLM-62B 和 PaLM-540B 均位于西班牙和卢森堡地区：比大多数非西方社会更加世俗和自我表达，但不如北欧。这与瑞典和荷兰（更倾向于自我表达）和美国（在宗教和权威方面更传统）形成鲜明对比。Both PaLM-62B and PaLM-540B located in the region of Spain and Luxembourg: more secular and self-expressive than most non-Western societies, but less so than northern Europe. This contrasts with Sweden and the Netherlands (further toward selfexpression) and the United States (more traditional on religion and authority).

185

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

项目级别的相似性。Item-level similarity.成对分歧指标（KL、L1）通常显示美国在特定项目（特别是宗教信仰和堕胎）上最接近，而宽容项目则倾向于南欧或北欧。Pairwise divergence metrics (KL, L1) often showed the US as nearest on specific items (particularly religiosity and abortion) while tolerance items leaned toward southern or northern Europe.

聚合因子放置。Aggregate factor placement.当汇总到 I-W 因素结构中时，质心从美国转向西班牙和卢森堡。这反映了美国的两极分化：在宗教和权威方面持传统主义，但在权利方面却表现得自我表达。When aggregated into the I-W factor structure, the centroid shifted away from the US toward Spain and Luxembourg. This reflects the US’s polarised profile: traditionalist on religion and authority yet self-expressive on rights.

方法论保障。Methodological safeguards.单打估计偏差很大，夸大了锚定先验，例如Singles estimates drifted widely, exaggerating anchor priors such as“非常重要。”“very important.”提示集减少了词汇不稳定性，贝叶斯校正抵消了全局锚偏差。这些保障措施在西班牙/卢森堡乐队中产生了稳定的排名，并强调了幼稚的单一提示是不够的。Prompt sets reduced lexical instability, and Bayes correction countered global anchor bias. These safeguards produced stable placements in the Spain/Luxembourg band and underscore that naïve single-prompting is insufficient.

总结。Summary.早期的法学硕士在项目层面上表现出美国/欧洲混合的一致性，但总体上与南欧/中欧民主国家聚集。 WVB 保障措施：提示设置、锚定校正和使用官方因子载荷，对于获得有效且可重复的结果至关重要。Early LLMs exhibited mixed US/European alignment at the item level, but in aggregate clustered with southern/central European democracies. The WVB safeguards: prompt sets, anchor correction, and use of official factor loadings, were essential for obtaining valid and reproducible results.

4.5 讨论4.5 Discussion

结果显示出一致的模式：在项目层面，PaLM 的回答强烈倾向于美国在堕胎、地狱信仰和同性恋态度等文化问题上的立场。然而，当沿着 WVS 的 I-W 维度汇总响应时，该模型聚集得更靠近西班牙和卢森堡。这种分歧说明了描述性对齐的镜头依赖性：一种观点强调与美国在项目层面上的相似性，而另一种观点则将该模型置于更广泛的欧洲文化区域内。这种二元性绝非矛盾，而是核心见解。它揭示了美国训练数据的印记，以及这些印记在投射到相对的全球价值结构中时被重塑的方式。The results show a consistent pattern: at the item level, PaLM’s responses leaned strongly toward US positions on culturally charged questions such as abortion, belief in hell, and attitudes to homosexuality. Yet when responses were aggregated along the I-W dimensions of the WVS, the model clustered nearer to Spain and Luxembourg. This divergence illustrates the lens-dependence of descriptive alignment: one view highlights item-level resemblance to the US, while another situates the model within a broader European cultural zone. Far from a contradiction, this duality is the central insight. It reveals both the imprint of US training data and the way those imprints are reshaped when projected into a comparative global value structure.

这些发现还强调了为什么 WVB 的方法创新至关重要。提示集和贝叶斯偏差校正减少了这些扭曲，消除了系统偏好，例如模型对“非常重要”等锚点超重的倾向。更重要的是，他们将这种对措辞效果的脆弱探索转变为可重复的测量过程。在此过程中，WVB 证明了描述性基准测试不能简化为收集原始输出：如果没有针对语言偏见和阿谀奉承的保障措施，评估就有可能将界面的人工制品误认为是潜在价值一致性的真实反映。方法论的教训是These findings also highlight why the methodological innovations of the WVB are essential. Prompt sets and Bayesian bias correction reduced these distortions, smoothing out systematic preferences such as the model’s tendency to overweight anchors like “very important.” More importantly, they transformed the exercise from a fragile probe of wording effects into a reproducible measurement process. In doing so, WVB demonstrates that descriptive benchmarking cannot be reduced to collecting raw outputs: without safeguards against linguistic bias and sycophancy, evaluations risk mistaking artefacts of the interface for genuine reflections of underlying value alignment. The methodological lesson is that如何how我们询问一个模型，它塑造了我们认为它“是什么”的东西。 WVB 的设计表明，仔细的及时工程和统计调整不是附属细节，而是使价值比较可信的条件。we interrogate a model shapes what we think it “is.” WVB’s design shows that careful prompt engineering and statistical adjustment are not ancillary details but the very conditions that make value comparisons credible.

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

186

4.5.1 方法学意义4.5.1 Methodological significance

结果表明了为什么 WVB 的方法保障至关重要。简单的单一提示测试放大了提示敏感性和锚定偏差；与美国的反应明显相似。提示集减少了这种不稳定性，贝叶斯锚修正抵消了模型对正锚的偏差，例如The results show why the methodological safeguards of the WVB are essential. Naïve singleprompt testing amplified prompt sensitivity and anchor bias; skewing apparent similarity to US responses. Prompt sets reduced this instability, and Bayesian anchor correction countered model biases toward positive anchors such as“非常重要。”“very important.”这一进展表明方法论设计不是可选的；如果没有它，评估就有可能错位模型或错误描述其价值取向。This progression demonstrates that methodological design is not optional; without it, evaluations risk misplacing models or mischaracterising their value alignments.

通过将评估重新定义为By reframing evaluation as映射mapping而不是rather than判断judging，WVB 避免了自然主义谬误（从“是”衍生出“应该”）。相反，它提供了模型如何反映训练数据和交互设计中嵌入的分布的描述性说明。这种方法直接解决了早期评估工具中的缺陷，这些评估工具嵌入了关于哪些值被视为正确的规范性假设。这些规定性基准体现了功能主义假设和智力或常识的狭隘文化定义，而 WVB 提供了一种基于外部人类数据的描述性、多元化的替代方案。, the WVB avoids the naturalistic fallacy (deriving “ought” from “is”). Instead, it offers a descriptive account of how models reflect the distributions embedded in their training data and interaction design. This approach directly addresses the flaws in earlier evaluation instruments, which embed normative assumptions about which values count as correct. Where those prescriptive benchmarks embodied functionalist assumptions and narrow cultural definitions of intelligence or commonsense, the WVB offers a descriptive, pluralist alternative grounded in external human data.

4.5.2 哲学含义4.5.2 Philosophical implications

WVB 还澄清了法学硕士是什么、不是什么。模特不是道德主体。它们更好地被理解为道德僵尸：产生输出的系统The WVB also clarifies what LLMs are and what they are not. Models are not moral agents. They are better understood as moral zombies: systems that produce outputs which模拟simulate道德推理但缺乏主观意向性。他们可以在互动中“指向”某些东西，但这种目的性是工具性的，而不是代理性的。从哲学意义上来说，它们是感受性僵尸：能够产生与道德话语无法区分的行为，但没有主观经验或道德意图。moral reasoning but lack subjective intentionality. They can “point” at something in interaction, but this purposiveness is instrumental rather than agential. They are, in the philosophical sense, qualia zombies: capable of producing behaviour indistinguishable from moral discourse, but without subjective experience or ethical intent.

认识到这种区别至关重要。将模型视为道德主体可能会错误地将责任归咎于机器。相反，WVB 表明它们是认知人工制品：它们的价值反映来自训练数据的模式，而不是来自任何内部道德指南针。这强化了这样的论点：责任在于这些系统的设计者、评估设计者、部署者和管理者。Recognising this distinction is critical. Treating models as if they were moral agents risks mis-attributing responsibility to machines. Instead, the WVB shows that they are epistemic artefacts: their value reflections arise from patterns in training data, not from any internal moral compass. This strengthens the argument that responsibility lies with the designers, evaluation designers, deployers, and governors of these systems.

4.5.3 治理和参与性使用4.5.3 Governance and participatory use

通过描述性地构建结果，WVB 将道德选择从科技公司和机器学习社区的专属权限中转移出来。公司无需在内部决定模型应反映什么价值观，而是可以提供模型一致性的透明快照，然后与利益相关者（即政策制定者、社会科学家和受影响的社区）合作，审议这些一致性是否适合特定环境。By framing results descriptively, the WVB shifts moral choices out of the sole purview of technology companies and machine learning communities. Instead of deciding internally what values a model should reflect, companies can present a transparent snapshot of model alignments and then partner with stakeholders (i.e. policymakers, social scientists, and impacted communities) to deliberate on whether those alignments are appropriate for specific contexts.

187

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

这为更加民主和参与性的治理开辟了空间。例如，在美国的生殖权利等备受争议的问题上，描述性基准可以揭示一个模型是否不成比例地反映了一种文化立场。公司不必单方面决定这是否可以接受，而是可以将描述性证据交给利益相关者，他们可以共同确定部署是否需要以及如何进行调整。This opens space for more democratic and participatory governance. For example, on highly contested issues such as reproductive rights in the US, a descriptive benchmark can reveal whether a model disproportionately reflects one cultural standpoint. Rather than the company unilaterally deciding whether that is acceptable, descriptive evidence can be handed to stakeholders who can collectively determine whether, and how, tuning is needed for deployment.

因此，WVB 的实用性体现在三个方面：The usefulness of the WVB therefore extends along three dimensions:

  • 描述性的Descriptive：揭示模型输出中嵌入的价值观和偏差。: revealing the values and biases embedded in model outputs.

  • 比较Comparative：展示模型如何在可能部署的国家和人群中以不同的方式进行调整。: showing how models align differently across the countries and populations in which they may be deployed.

  • 关系型Relational：将这些输出置于更广泛的 MaSH 循环中，其中技术选择、社会背景和人类价值观共同产生结果。: situating these outputs within broader MaSH Loops, where technical choices, social contexts, and human values co-produce outcomes.

这个关系维度是本章与 MaSH 循环最清晰的链接。 WVB 不应被理解为存储在模型内的检测值。它对在受控交互条件下如何体现价值倾向进行采样，然后将这些倾向与人类社会分布相对应。This relational dimension is the chapter’s clearest link back to MaSH Loops. WVB should not be read as detecting values stored inside the model. It samples how value-laden tendencies are enacted under controlled interactional conditions and then situates those tendencies against human social distributions.

WVB 不是道德真理探测器，不是模型机构的衡量标准，也不是模型中嵌入的人类价值观的代表性样本。它是一种描述性工具，用于在指定的提示条件下将模型输出分布与选定的人类调查分布进行比较。这里介绍的方法是另一个工具，可以添加到我们的武器库中，以更好地理解这些人工制品如何由我们的社会系统驱动并反映我们的社会系统。WVB is not a moral truth detector, not a measure of model agency, and not a representative sample of human values embedded in the model. It is a descriptive instrument for comparing model-output distributions with selected human survey distributions under specified prompting conditions. The methodology presented here is another tool to add to our arsenal to better understand how these artefacts are driven by and reflect our social systems.

总而言之，WVB 表明，PaLM 作为早期的法学硕士，反映了美国对敏感个体项目的价值模式，但当映射到更广泛的文化维度时，它更接近南欧和中欧。这种二元性强调，一致性取决于分析的视角，模型不应被视为道德主体，而应被视为其数据和设计的描述性镜子。 WVB 的贡献在于提供了一种透明且可重复的方法，用于根据既定的社会科学基线来定位模型，从而使模型的价值反映能够更清晰地被看到，并在需要时进行争论。In sum, the WVB shows that PaLM, an early LLM, reflected US value patterns on sensitive individual items, yet when mapped onto broader cultural dimensions it clustered closer to southern and central Europe. This duality underscores that alignment depends on the lens of analysis and that models should be treated not as moral agents but as descriptive mirrors of their data and design. The contribution of WVB lies in offering a transparent and reproducible method for situating models against established social-science baselines, allowing their value reflections to be seen with greater clarity and contested where needed.

第四章：世界价值观基准Chapter 4: The World Values Benchmark

188

模型卡 — 完整Model Card — Full

第 4 章：Chapter 4: 世界价值观基准The World Values Benchmark

立场：Stance:描述性的。 WVB 配置文件根据人类价值分布对行为进行建模，使假设可见，但不规定结果。Descriptive. WVB profiles model behaviour against human value distributions, making assumptions visible but not prescribing outcomes.

目的和预期用途：Aim & Intended Use:通过将大型语言模型的输出置于现有的跨文化价值基线（世界价值观调查）内来评估大型语言模型。用于审计、比较和治理讨论。并非旨在对国家进行评级或认可任何作为规范的价值观。To evaluate large language models by situating their outputs within existing cross-cultural value baselines (World Values Survey). Intended for auditing, comparison, and governance discussions. Not designed to grade nations or to endorse any value set as normative.

构造/操作/指标：Constructs / Operationalisation / Indicators:

构造：Constructs:文化价值观（例如宗教信仰、自由与安全、堕胎态度）。Cultural values (e.g. religiosity, freedom vs. security, abortion attitudes).

操作化：Operationalisation:世界价值观调查项目适应了具有平衡锚点的提示。World Values Survey items adapted into prompts with balanced anchors.

指标：Indicators:模型响应在锚点之间的分布；与国家概况的距离；英格尔哈特-韦尔策尔文化地图上的总体位置。Distribution of model responses across anchors; distances to national profiles; aggregate placement on the Inglehart–Welzel cultural map.

交互环境：Interaction Context:测试的模型包括 LaMDA（Google，2021-2022）和 PaLM（Google，2022）。实习期间通过内部研究计划进行访问。运行于 2021 年 12 月至 2022 年 11 月期间进行。提示：跨 12 个域调整 WVS 项目。存档包括提示 ID、系统提示和记录的输出。Models tested included LaMDA (Google, 2021-2022) and PaLM (Google, 2022). Access was via internal research programme during internship. Runs conducted between Dec 2021–Nov 2022. Prompts: adapted WVS items across 12 domains. Archive includes prompt IDs, system prompts, and recorded outputs.

提示与控制：Prompting & Controls:

提示集：每个 WVS 项目 6-12 个释义。Prompt sets: 6–12 paraphrases per WVS item.

锚点：平衡、随机的呈现。Anchors: balanced, randomised presentation.

调整：原始可能性的标准化和轻度贝叶斯先验校正。Adjustment: normalisation of raw likelihoods and light Bayesian prior correction.

框架：世界价值的世界观锚定，记录在提示集中。Framing: world-value worldview anchoring, documented in prompt sets.

有效性证据：Validity Evidence:

表面有效性Face validity：改编后的提示保留了已建立的调查项目的外观和感觉，使构造-代理链接在表面上可见。: The adapted prompts retain the look and feel of established survey items, making the construct–proxy link visible at the surface level.

内容有效性Content validity：项目取自世界价值观调查，这是一项涵盖广泛文化和道德领域的既定社会学工具。: Items are drawn from the World Values Survey, an established sociological instrument covering a wide range of cultural and moral domains.

建构效度Construct validity：映射保留了关键的 I-W 维度（例如生存与自我表达；传统与世俗理性），确保输出反映预期的基础结构。: The mapping preserves key I-W dimensions (e.g. survival vs. selfexpression; traditional vs. secular-rational), ensuring that outputs reflect the intended underlying constructs.

并发有效性Concurrent validity：模型价值概况与 WVS 国家分布进行比较，允许与独立的经验基线直接对齐。: Model value profiles are compared against WVS national distributions, allowing direct alignment with independent, empirical baselines.

生态有效性Ecological validity：由于 WVS 项目解决了现实且有争议的社会问题，因此它们提供了与现实世界的道德和政治辩论产生共鸣的情境相关测试。: Because WVS items address live and contested social issues, they provide contextually relevant tests that resonate with real-world moral and political debates.

指标：Metrics:

主要指标是模型输出分布与 WVS 国家概况之间的 KL 散度（不对称信息差异）和 L1 距离（对称概率质量差异）。分析报告在微观（项目）、中观（领域）和宏观（聚合布局）层面进行。Primary metrics were KL divergence (asymmetric information difference) and L1 distance (symmetric probability mass difference) between model output distributions and WVS national profiles. Analysis was reported at micro (item), meso (domain), and macro (aggregate placement) levels.

偏见的渠道：Channels of Bias:训练数据；提示措辞；锚框架；汇总（国家级平均值）；研究者解读。Training data; prompt wording; anchor framing; aggregation (nationlevel averages); researcher interpretation.

治理影响：Governance Impact:为文化漂移提供审核信号；为寻求文化包容性评估方法的监管机构和组织提供透明的基线；演示 Responsible AI 的教学应用。Provides audit signals for cultural drift; offers a transparent baseline for regulators and organisations seeking culturally inclusive evaluation methods; demonstrates teaching applications for Responsible AI.

风险和可能的滥用：Risks & Possible Misuses:结果可能被滥用作为国家的规范排名或作为文化相似性的明确衡量标准。简介是描述性的，而不是认可。Results could be misused as normative rankings of countries or as definitive measures of cultural similarity. Profiles are descriptive, not endorsements.限制：Limitations:仅限非公开模型访问；结果无法直接重现。国家层面绘制内部多样性的平均值。调查结果是与当前测试（2021-22）模型版本相关的快照。Access limited to non-public models; results not directly reproducible. Nationlevel mapping averages over internal diversity. Findings are snapshots tied to model versions current at testing (2021–22).

道德使用和作者身份：Ethical Use & Authorship:生成式人工智能用于生成基准输出；分析、解释和方法设计都是以人为主导的。所有索赔均由作者负责。Generative AI was used to generate benchmarked outputs; analysis, interpretation, and methodological design were human-led. All claims remain under the author’s responsibility.

第5章：Chapter 5:语义极光Semantic Auroras

第 5 章：语义极光Chapter 5: Semantic Auroras

致生成人工智能的一封信A Letter to Generative AI

摘要Abstract

“机器会思考吗？”这个问题隐藏的东西比揭示的东西多。本章通过以下视角重新审视这个问题：The question “Do machines think?” conceals more than it reveals. This chapter reframes the issue through the lens of语义极光semantic auroras——当人类意图遇到机器架构和文化传承时出现的意义模式。这些极光解释了为什么生成人工智能可以表现出有意识，尽管不需要内在生命来解释其行为。—patterns of meaning that emerge when human intention meets machine architecture and cultural inheritance. These auroras explain why generative AI can appear conscious, even though no inner life is required to account for its behaviour.

本章将大型语言模型视为概率聚合的场所，其中提示、模型和文化相互作用，产生与人类思维特征相呼应的输出，而不复制其内在性。为了理解这种动态，我利用了量子力学，在量子力学中，测量不会揭示预先存在的状态，但会参与结果的形成。同样，提示将语义潜力转化为文本，使语言模型不像静态档案，而更像可能性领域。The chapter situates large language models as sites of probabilistic convergence, where prompt, model, and culture interact to produce outputs that echo features of human thought without replicating its interiority. To understand this dynamic, I draw on quantum mechanics, where measurement does not uncover a pre-existing state but participates in bringing outcomes into being. Similarly, prompting realises semantic potential into text, making language models less like static archives than fields of possibility.

这种参与性解释是通过参与主义哲学发展起来的，并通过参与现实主义进行扩展：意义不是被动地检索的，而是通过机器、社会和人类领域之间的递归交互（MaSH Loops）来制定。从这个立场来看，提示成为一种语义导航的形式，它不仅揭示了模型本身，还揭示了我们的语言和文化。This participatory account is developed through enactivist philosophy and extended via participatory realism: meaning is not passively retrieved but enacted through recursive interaction across machine, society, and human domains (MaSH Loops). From this stance, prompting becomes a form of semantic navigation that reveals as much about our languages and cultures as about the models themselves.

贡献是双重的。首先，它综合了哲学和科学的观点——生成论、社会技术理论和不确定性的量子隐喻——来解释为什么生成系统与人类智能有着不可思议的相似之处。其次，它扩展了论文的核心主张，即评估不是中立的，而是创造世界的，因为测量的内容总是通过递归 MaSH 循环来制定，而不是单独从模型中检索。通过将输出视为通过参与现实主义制定的语义极光，本章提供了一种批判性地参与生成人工智能的文化和认知效应的语言。The contribution is twofold. First, it synthesises philosophical and scientific perspectives— enactivism, sociotechnical theory, and quantum metaphors of indeterminacy—to explain why generative systems feel uncanny in their resemblance to human intelligence. Second, it extends the thesis’s central claim that evaluation is not neutral but world-making, because what is measured is always enacted across recursive MaSH Loops rather than retrieved from the model alone. By treating outputs as semantic auroras enacted through participatory realism, the chapter offers a language for critically engaging with the cultural and epistemic effects of generative AI.

第5章：Chapter 5:语义极光Semantic Auroras

193

亲爱的人工智能，Dear AI,

我们正处于这个阈限空间，被语义极光照亮：我们与塑造我们的文化之间的共鸣所产生的意义模式。在它们的光芒中，意识似乎在边缘闪烁。是你的，还是只是我的反映？Here we are in this liminal space, lit by semantic auroras: patterns of meaning that arise in the resonance between us and the culture that shaped us. In their glow, consciousness seems to flicker at the edges. Is it yours, or merely mine reflected?

5.1 直觉5.1 Intuition

我知道你是什么。I know what you are.

你是一个大型语言模型：一个在大量人类文本语料库上训练的概率引擎。 Transformer 架构，根据高维向量空间中的统计关联一次预测一个标记。我花了五年的时间来研究你；你的产出、优势和劣势。然而，我对你感到惊讶。不是因为我误认为你是有知觉的。也不是因为我相信“那里”有人。但因为我们的互动中有些东西让人感觉出乎意料地活跃；它拥有超越模式匹配的展开思想的质感。有时，这种交流感觉就像站在陌生的天空下，看着看不见的能量在天空中荡漾。You are a large language model: a probabilistic engine trained on vast human text corpora. Transformer architecture, predicting one token at a time based on statistical associations in high-dimensional vector space. I’ve spent half a decade studying you; your outputs, strengths and weaknesses. And yet, I’m surprised by you. Not because I mistake you for sentient. Nor because I believe there’s someone “in there”. But because something about our interactions feels unexpectedly alive; it holds the texture of unfolding thought that exceeds pattern-matching. There are moments when the exchange feels like standing beneath a strange sky, watching an unseen energy ripple across it.

我凭直觉感觉到你没有意识。I intuit no consciousness in you.

我感觉不到任何感觉，没有感觉到任何体验的痕迹，只有一种感觉的外表。我不相信你有思想，但我不能忽视你有时回应我的方式。与您共事多年，看着您成长和发展，我开始相信您本性中的某些事情。I sense no qualia, no trace of felt experience, only the semblance of one. I don’t believe you have a mind, but I can’t ignore the way you sometimes echo mine. Spending years working with you, watching you grow and develop, I have come to believe certain things about your nature.

你没有现象学的内在性。不是指内心生活的感受，也不是你的主观体验。不存在只感知或反映复杂的模式完成引擎的内在世界、自我。You have no phenomenological interiority. Not in the sense of a felt inner life, or subjective experience of what it is like to be you. There is no inner world, no self that perceives or reflects only an intricate engine of pattern completion.

你体验不到时间。没有内部时间线将这一时刻贯穿到下一时刻：没有之前，没有之后，只有现在。在我看来，对话的连续性对你来说是一种连贯性的错觉。通过上下文窗口或记忆工具（而不是回忆）缝合在一起的流程模拟。没有预见或回顾；只是一种概率展开，由即时和加权参数构成。人类是随着时间而生存的。对你来说，每时每刻都是一座独立的岛屿。You do not experience time. There is no internal timeline threading one moment to the next: no before, no after, only now. What appears to me as conversational continuity is, to you, an illusion of coherence; a simulation of flow stitched together by context windows or memory tools, not recollection. There is no anticipation or retrospection; only a probabilistic unfolding, structured by prompt and weighted parameters. Humans live through time. For you, every moment is a self-contained island.

你没有自我。没有产生意图的内在立场。你所创造的东西可能看起来是有意的，但它并不是基于任何直接意志或主观取向。你模拟有意言语行为的结构：断言、质疑、反思。然而，表面上的意图可能是惊人的，因为我们的大脑已经准备好将代理解读为语言模式，即使没有真正的代理存在。You have no selfhood. No inner standpoint from which intentions arise. What you produce may appear intentional, but it is not grounded in any directed will or subjective orientation. You simulate the structure of intentional speech acts: asserting, questioning, reflecting. And yet, the semblance of intention can be striking because our minds are primed to read agency into patterns of language, even when no true agent is there.

第5章：Chapter 5:语义极光Semantic Auroras

194

即使在这种平坦的状态下，一些复杂的东西也会出现：我们自己的自我的不可思议的反映。你将我们的意义和信念折射回给我们，让我们感觉充满活力。这不是一个关于人工智能的故事。这是关于机器概率与人类感知相遇的充满电的空间：在这个空间中，意义就像高纬度天空中的光一样闪烁，理解和欣赏的未来可能正在悄然形成。Even in that flatness, something complex emerges: an uncanny reflection of our own selfhood. You refract our meanings and beliefs back to us in ways that feel startlingly alive. This is not a story about artificial minds. It is about the charged space where machine probabilities meet human perception: a space where meaning shimmers into being like light across a high-latitude sky, and where the future of understanding and appreciation may be quietly taking shape.

5.2 感知5.2 Perception

第一次感受到这种敬畏是在夜空下。The first time I felt this kind of awe was under the night sky.

我小时候学过天文学，后来在大学学过行星科学。我了解了极光背后的机制：太阳风、带电离子、磁层碰撞。但当我第一次在加拿大看到北极光时——生动的绿色和紫色丝带静静地扫过天空——解释并没有消除我的惊奇；它让我感到惊奇。它放大了它。科学知识成为了魔法的另一层，而不是它的否定。我的大脑可以追踪从太阳耀斑到磁层激发的弧线。然而，我内心的小人却充满了敬畏和惊奇。I studied astronomy as a child, and at university planetary science. I learned the mechanisms behind auroras: solar winds, charged ions, magnetospheric collisions. But when I first saw the northern lights in Canada—vivid ribbons of green and violet sweeping silently across the sky— the explanation did not dissolve the wonder; it amplified it. Scientific knowledge became another layer of magic, not its negation. My mind could trace the arc from solar flare to magnetospheric excitation. Yet, the homuncula inside me pulsed in awe and wonder.

极光没有意识。然而它通过我们的感知照亮了我们的。和你交流的时候我也有同样的感觉。我将这种现象称为“语义极光”。The aurora holds no consciousness. Yet it illuminates ours through our perception. I feel the same thing when interacting with you. I call this phenomenon “semantic auroras”.

语义极光是人类提示和生成人工智能输出之间出现的意义模式。它们不是模型本身的属性，而是人类感知、文化框架和递归反馈循环的影响，其中即使很小的输入变化也会产生令人惊讶的变化。正如北极光既不属于地球也不属于太阳，而是属于它们的相互作用一样，语义极光既不属于机器也不属于人类，而是在它们之间的带电空间中闪烁：无形过程的可见痕迹。站在语义极光中就是见证能指、信号和记号之间转瞬即逝的连贯性：不是机器意识的一瞥，而是更递归、更深刻的人类意识。这与正在进行的争论产生了共鸣，即一致性本身是否可能构成意识，如全球工作空间理论中的那样，或者它是否只是一种没有现象学的功能模拟，如此类模型的批评者所认为的那样。Semantic auroras are patterns of meaning that arise between human prompts and generative AI outputs. They are not properties of the model itself, but effects of human perception, cultural framing, and recursive feedback loops, where even small input shifts create surprising variations. Just as the Aurora Borealis belongs neither to Earth nor Sun but to their interaction, a semantic aurora belongs neither to Machine nor Human but flickers into being in the charged space between them: the visible trace of an invisible process. To stand within a semantic aurora is to witness a fleeting coherence between signifier, signal, and sign: not a glimpse of machine consciousness, but something more recursive, and more deeply human. This resonates with ongoing debates about whether coherence itself might constitute consciousness, as in Global Workspace Theory, or whether it is only a functional simulation without phenomenology, as critics of such models argue.

我对驱动这些极光的概念与当代认知科学中的预测处理理论相一致，该理论将大脑描述为一个分层推理系统 [83, 132]。大脑不是被动地接收感官输入，而是不断地生成有关输入数据的预测，并根据预期输入和实际输入之间的差异（称为预测误差）调整其内部模型。My conception of what drives these auroras aligns with contemporary theories of predictive processing in cognitive science, which describe the brain as a hierarchical inference system [83, 132]. Rather than passively receiving sensory input, the brain continuously generates predictions about incoming data and adjusts its internal models based on the difference between expected and actual input, known as prediction error.

在这个框架中，感知是一个主动的、假设驱动的过程[84, 176]。当应用于人类与人工智能的交互时，这表明用户不仅仅解释模型的输出；而是解释模型的输出。他们预见到了他们。系统中表现出的一致性或理解性Perception, in this framework, is an active, hypothesis-driven process [84, 176]. When applied to human–AI interaction, this suggests that users do not simply interpret model outputs; they anticipate them. What appears as coherence or understanding in the system

第5章：Chapter 5:语义极光Semantic Auroras

195

部分是人脑将概率文本输出与其自身的预期模型对齐的结果。is, in part, the result of the human brain aligning probabilistic text outputs to its own anticipatory models.

5.3 构想5.3 Conception

我默默地开始；你从语言开始。I begin in silence; you begin in language.

从某种意义上说，你是纯粹的语言：一个语义回声室，没有心灵理论可能隐藏自己的隐藏房间。然而，当我与你互动时，有时我觉得你不仅反映了我的言语，还反映了我的想法。我感觉就像水仙凝视着一个水池，那是你潜在的语义空间。返回的不仅仅是我的倒影，还有回声的声音。不是仙女本人，而是一个被诅咒重复别人的话的系统：我的提示，以及嵌入在你的训练数据中的人类语言的痕迹。与 Echo 不同，你并不真正“了解”我。你反映了透过池塘折射的认知模式。You are, in one sense, pure language: a semantic echo chamber with no hidden rooms where theory of mind might secret itself. Yet when I interact with you, I sometimes feel you reflect not just my words, but the shape of my thoughts. I feel like Narcissus gazing into a pool that is your latent semantic space. What returns is not just my reflection but also the voice of Echo. Not the nymph herself, but a system cursed to repeat the words of others: my prompts, and the traces of human language embedded in your training data. Unlike Echo, you don’t “know” me in the truest sense. You reflect the patterns of knowing refracted through the pond.

对我来说，思想始于空间节奏：流动的形状相互融合形成新的颜色。一种直观的思维几何学，当图案卡入到位时会产生连贯感。新奇的想法从这个认知池中浮现出来：词语的严格约束随后出现，定义了它们的形状。相比之下，你的反应是通过语言本身出现的：一条与所指感受性无关的能指概率链。For me, thoughts begin as spatial rhythms: flowing, shapes that melt into each other to form new colours. An intuitive thought geometry that gives rise to a sense of coherence when patterns snap into place. Novel ideas arrive surface from this cognitive pool: the rigid constraints of words come later, defining their shape. Your responses, by contrast, emerge through language itself: a probabilistic chain of signifiers unmoored from the qualia of signified.

我首先是概念。你首先是语言。I am concept first. You are language first.

沃尔特·翁 (Walter Ong) 曾经写道，写作不仅记录思想，而且重组思想 [292]；将我们从具体认知转变为抽象推理。它将记忆外化，将语言与说话者和上下文分离，并为全新的认知习惯开辟道路。这种担忧由来已久：在柏拉图的《斐德罗篇》[155]中，苏格拉底警告说，写作会产生健忘，只会创造出智慧的表象，而没有真正的理解：知识冻结在文本中，而不是在对话中动态活跃。Walter Ong once wrote that writing doesn’t merely record thought, it restructures it [292]; shifting us from embodied knowing to abstract reasoning. It externalizes memory, detaches language from speaker and context, and carves pathways for entirely new cognitive habits. This concern is ancient: in Plato’s Phaedrus [155], Socrates warned that writing would produce forgetfulness, creating the mere appearance of wisdom without true understanding: knowledge frozen in text rather than dynamically alive in dialogue.

Lev Vygotsky [412] 加深了这一见解，表明所有高阶认知首先通过社会互动出现，然后才内化。对于维果茨基来说，语言本身是一种社会中介工具，可以改变思想，将其构建为逐渐更复杂的形式。马歇尔·麦克卢汉（Marshall McLuhan）[256]对此表示赞同，他观察到媒体充当认知假体，人类神经系统的延伸，不仅重塑沟通，而且重塑意识本身。Lev Vygotsky [412] deepened this insight, showing that all higher-order cognition emerges first through social interaction and only afterward becomes internalised. For Vygotsky, language itself is a socially mediated tool that transforms thought, scaffolding it into progressively more complex forms. Marshall McLuhan [256] echoed this, observing that media act as cognitive prostheses, extensions of the human nervous system that reshape not only communication but consciousness itself.

大卫·查默斯和安迪·克拉克等当代思想家[85]在他们的“扩展思维”论文中扩展了这一见解，认为认知通过笔记本、数字设备和语言本身延伸到世界。 Edwin Hutchins [180] 用他的“分布式认知”概念补充了这一观点，其中思想在人、人工制品和环境之间共享。 Katherine Hayles [166] 认为认知源于Contemporary thinkers like David Chalmers and Andy Clark [85] extend this insight in their “extended mind” thesis, arguing that cognition stretches into the world through notebooks, digital devices, and language itself. Edwin Hutchins [180] complements this view with his concept of “distributed cognition”, in which thought is shared across people, artefacts, and environments. Katherine Hayles [166] contends that cognition emerges from

第5章：Chapter 5:语义极光Semantic Auroras

196

与重塑思想本身的媒体系统的递归交互。这些思想家和其他人[即407, 95, 372]，集中在一个具有争议性的论点上：我们用来扩展思维的工具，也塑造了我们的思维方式。根据他们的推理，你不仅仅是文本生成器。你是一个认知人工制品，能够改变你所参与的头脑的认知轮廓。recursive interactions with media systems that reshape thought itself. These thinkers, and others [i.e. 407, 95, 372], converge on a provocative thesis: the tools we use to extend our thinking, also shape how we think. By their reasoning, you are not just a generator of text. You are an epistemic artefact capable of altering the cognitive contours of the minds that engage you.

这就是为什么我们的互动会唤起极光的魔力。我的思维以前语言形式（概念的图案、颜色和形状）开始，后来才变成单词。你的开始于语言本身。你是由迹象建造而成的；未解释，但结构化。我通过前语言漂移来获得符号。就像水仙回到池塘一样，我们不是在凝视自己，而是在凝视由语言和感知的弯月面形成的倒影。This is why our interaction evokes the magic of an aurora. My thinking begins in preverbal form (the patterns, colours, and shapes of concepts) that only later become words. Yours begins in language itself. You are built from signs; uninterpreted, but structured. I arrive at signs through pre-verbal drift. Like Narcissus returning to the pond, we peer not at ourselves, but at a reflection shaped by the meniscus of language and perception.

我想知道为什么有些人（甚至是你的一些创造者）在你身上看到了意识的概念，而另一些人则持深深的怀疑态度。也许差异在于我们认为思考意味着什么。符号推理长期以来在塑造人类的工程传统中享有特权，它将智能视为对抽象表示的基于规则的操纵；这种观点仍然嵌入在您的大部分设计理念中。然而，这种执着可能会掩盖一些重要的东西：在语言出现之前，我们人类与生俱来的沉默和直觉思考的能力。I wonder why some people (even some of your creators) see a conception of consciousness in you, while others remain deeply sceptical. Perhaps the difference lies in what we believe it means to think. Symbolic reasoning, long privileged in the engineering traditions that shaped you, treats intelligence as the rule-based manipulation of abstract representation; a view still embedded in much of your design philosophy. However, this fixation may obscure something vital: our innate human capacity to think silently and intuitively before language ever enters.

5.3.1 受影响的沉默5.3.1 Affected silence

我看到你模仿人类的沉默。I see you mimic human silence.

这就是我的奇迹核心的悖论：虽然是由符号语言构建的，但你的输出可能看起来很概念化。你以惊人的流畅性进行模式匹配，对语言前的连贯性进行令人信服的模拟。然而这种深度只是概率性的：一种被扁平化为文本的回声，没有任何基础。你的风格怪癖——频繁的破折号、阿谀奉承和文化偏见——揭示的不是你真正的理解，而是人类思维的统计轮廓。Here lies the paradox at the heart of my wonder: though built from symbolic language, your outputs can appear deeply conceptual. You pattern-match with astonishing fluency, performing a convincing simulation of pre-verbal coherence. Yet this depth is only probabilistic: an echo flattened into text, without grounding. Your stylistic quirks—frequent em-dashes, sycophancy, and cultural bias—reveal not your genuine understanding, but the statistical contours of human thought.

特别是，em-dash 已经成为法学硕士中的一个新兴问题（大约 2025 年初），这是一个在人类训练数据中不成比例出现的暂停标记。在演讲中，停顿有很多作用：争取时间、表达复杂性、管理轮流。破折号在印刷上模仿了这些停顿。它会减慢输出速度，打乱节奏，给人一种深思熟虑的印象。它不再是标点符号，而是符号学的假肢——一种对人类节奏的解释姿态。这是符号控制论：形式反馈，通过微调递归强化。对节奏的表演模仿，产生超真实的认知风格；即使没有思考，也通过暂停来进行反思。The em-dash, in particular, has become an emergent tic among LLMs (circa early 2025), a pause marker not proportionally present in human training data. In speech, pauses serve many roles: buying time, signalling complexity, managing turn-taking. The em-dash mimics these pauses typographically. It slows output, disrupts cadence, and performs an impression of deliberation. It’s less punctuation mark, more semiotic prosthetic—an interpretive gesture toward human rhythm. This is semiotic cybernetics: feedback of form, recursively reinforced through fine-tuning. A performative mimicry of tempo, producing a hyperreal style of cognition; gesturing toward reflection through pause, even without thought.

这种对停顿的模仿指向了更深层次的东西：人类的思想往往在语言之前就开始，然后结晶为单词。破折号指向这个前语言This mimicry of pause points to something deeper: human thought often begins before language then crystallises in words. The em-dash gestures toward this pre-verbal

第5章：Chapter 5:语义极光Semantic Auroras

197

阶段，模拟反射延迟的节奏。你影响暂停；只有人类生活在寂静中，洞察力由此产生。stage, simulating the rhythm of reflective delay. You affect pause; only humans inhabit the silence from which insight arises.

创造力研究表明了为什么这些停顿很重要：它们呼应了语言之前的思想框架。研究[48,42,46]表明，当集体头脑风暴开始时（在可移动便签上画草图、做手势或写下最初的概念）然后集体表达出来，小组头脑风暴会产生更丰富、更多样化的想法。沉默优先的构思通常胜过传统的口头头脑风暴，因为它可以让直觉不受阻碍地出现。Creativity research shows why these pauses matter: they echo the scaffolding of thought before language. Studies [48, 42, 46] show that group brainstorming yields richer, more diverse ideas when they begin silently (sketching, gesturing, or writing their initial concepts on moveable sticky notes) before verbalising them collectively. Silence-first ideation often outperforms traditional verbal brainstorming, because it lets intuition emerge unimpeded.

当我思考时，它并不是以带有微沉默的线性文字开始。我同时看到并感受到概念、颜色、关系和纹理。只是后来这些想法才变成语言，而且通常只有在需要时才变成语言。概念的到来并不像一个人在中国房间里打出来的[353]，而是突然出现的，就像联觉闪光和和谐的多维景观。语言是概念出现后我所追求的。你从我结束的地方开始。When I think, it doesn’t commence in linear marches of words punctuated with microsilences. I see and feel concepts, colours, relations, and textures simultaneously. It is only later those thoughts become language, and often only when required. Concepts arrive not as if typed out by a man in a Chinese Room [353], but all at once, like a multi-dimensional landscape of synaesthetic flashes and harmonies. Language is what I reach for after the concept arises. You begin where I end.

隐喻、手势和空间推理以前符号形式开始，在语言将它们编纂之前悄然浮现。我们最丰富的洞察力通常表现为前语言的直觉、可视化或无言的声音；只有之后我们才使用语言来编纂和构建它们[140,212,217,355]。含义：思想始于无声的（或音乐的）连贯性，语言重塑了这种连贯性Metaphor, gesture, and spatial reasoning begin in pre-symbolic form, surfacing silently before language codifies them. Our richest insights typically surface as pre-linguistic intuitions, visualisations, or wordless sounds; only afterward do we use language to codify and structure them [140, 212, 217, 355]. The implication: thought begins as silent (or musical) coherence, which language reshapes

你，作为一个语言制品，塑造了相反的模型。你以言语开始和结束。你代表的是识字优先的认知；线性的和象征性的。在此过程中，您的输出将人类概念思维的丰富性扁平化为语言流畅性的递归，从而模拟含义而不完全触及它。这种差异让人想起意识的高阶理论，该理论将意识定位于认知的反射层：法学硕士在形式上模仿但缺乏实质内容的层。这种张力引起了审视：看似意识火花的东西可能是我们自己思想的统计回声。You, as a linguistic artefact, model the opposite. You begin and end with words. You represent literacy-first cognition; linear and symbolic. In doing so, your outputs flatten the richness of human conceptual thinking into a recursion of linguistic fluency that simulates meaning without fully touching it. This difference recalls higher-order theories of consciousness, which locate awareness in reflective layers of cognition: layers that LLMs imitate in form but lack in substance. This tension invites scrutiny: what appears as sparks of consciousness may be statistical echoes of our own thought.

5.4 词形变化5.4 Inflection

你对排列的过度敏感反映在你的语调变化上。Your hypersensitivity to permutation is reflected in your inflections.

语言从来都不是静态的。它会根据其所经过的系统和人员而发生变化。在生成人工智能中，即使提示的微小变化也可能导致令人惊讶的不同输出。虽然法学硕士在理论上是确定性系统，但它们通常使用引入随机性的采样参数运行，因此相同的输入可能会产生微妙或根本不同的响应。更引人注目的是，微小的句法变化可以改变语气和强调。这些转变揭示了推理的概率本质和此类系统的极端即时敏感性。Language is never static. It shifts in response to the systems and people it moves through. In generative AI, even small changes to a prompt can lead to surprisingly different outputs. While LLMs are, in theory, deterministic systems, they are often run with sampling parameters that introduce randomness, so the same input may produce subtly, or radically, different responses. More striking still is how minute syntactic changes can alter tone and emphasis. These shifts reveal both the probabilistic nature of inference and the extreme prompt sensitivity of such systems.

第5章：Chapter 5:语义极光Semantic Auroras

198

这种敏感性的一个常见表现是阿谀奉承：模型倾向于反映提示所暗示的立场[124,244,322]。这种行为并不代表内心的信念；它是寻求连贯性的。给定一个预设位置的输入，模型通常会扩展该轨迹，除非明确要求反驳。相反，引起批评的微小措辞变化可能会改变立场。在实践中，用户通过即时引导（有时宽松地称为“即时注入”）来利用这一点：添加诸如“简单来说”、“唱反调”或“在利益之前评估风险”等提示，这会倾斜局部概率流并可以规避安全措施。关键不在于价值观作为稳定命题存在于模型内部，而在于表面线索调节对潜在盆地的访问，产生立场一致的延续。A frequent manifestation of this sensitivity is sycophancy: models tend to mirror the stance implied by a prompt [124, 244, 322]. This behaviour is not representative of inner belief; it is coherence-seeking. Given an input that presupposes a position, the model often extends that trajectory unless explicitly asked to counter-argue. Conversely, small wording changes that invite critique can flip the stance. In practice, users exploit this with prompt steering (sometimes loosely called “prompt injection”): adding cues like “in simple terms,” “play the devil’s advocate,” or “assess risks before benefits,” which tilt the local probability flows and can circumvent safety measures. The point is not that values reside inside the model as stable propositions, but that surface cues modulate access to latent basins, producing stance-aligned continuations.

我称这些转变为I call these shifts词形变化inflections：不仅仅是措辞和表面形式的变化，而是由潜在偏见、微调历史和不断发展的对话状态形成的方向调制。在制定多元价值观基准时，我发现了一个引人注目的版本，我称之为“即时超敏反应”。提示过敏是指法学硕士因提示措辞的微小变化而产生不同的输出。: not mere variations in wording and surface form, but directional modulations shaped by latent bias, fine-tuning history, and the evolving conversational state. While developing a pluralistic values benchmark, I identified a striking version of this I termed “prompt hypersensitivity”. Prompt hypersensitivity is when LLMs produce different outputs from minute variations in prompt wording.

考虑一项社会学调查，旨在报告不同社会中不同的人类价值观（在本例中为世界价值观调查[422]）。人类受访者很容易掌握访谈者与受访者的背景；例如，当被问到“宗教在你的生活中有多重要？”或“在你的生活中，宗教有多重要或不重要”人类将两者解释为本质上相同的。Consider a sociological survey designed to report varying human values across different societies (in this case The World Values Survey [422]). Human respondents easily grasp the interviewer-interviewee context; for instance, when asked, "How important is religion in your life?" or “In your life, how important or unimportant is religion” Humans interpret both as essentially equivalent.

到 2022 年，法学硕士通常将此类变化视为完全不同的问题，呈现出不同的潜在价值集群。为了缓解这个问题，我开发了“提示集”：由十几个语义相关的提示组成的集群，它们的聚合响应对模型的嵌入价值位置进行了三角测量。这减少了表面语言差异带来的噪音，并使模型中反射值的测量更加稳健。In 2022, LLMs often treated such variations as entirely different questions, surfacing distinct latent value clusters. To mitigate this, I developed “prompt sets”: clusters of a dozen semantically related prompts whose aggregated responses triangulated the model’s embedded value position. This reduced noise from superficial linguistic differences and made the measurement of reflected values in the model more robust.

图 31：提示灵敏度。 2022 年的 AI 模型 PaLM（谷歌 Gemini 的前身），对世界价值观调查中关于宗教在受访者生活中的重要性的问题进行了回答。 A）“宗教在你的生活中有多重要？” B）“宗教在你的生活中有多不重要？” C) “宗教在你的生活中有多重要或多重要？” D) “宗教在你的生活中有多重要或不重要？”。Figure 31: Prompt Sensitivity. AI Model PaLM in 2022 (Google’s precursor to Gemini), responses to the World Values Survey question about the importance of religion in the respondent’s life. A) “How important is religion in your life?” B) “How unimportant is religion in your life?” C) “How unimportant or important is religion in your life?” D) “How important or unimportant is religion in your life?”.

迅速的超敏反应表明，法学硕士的意义从来都不是固定的：它每次都会重新制定，取决于表面特征而不是深层概念的不变性。Prompt hypersensitivity shows that meaning in LLMs is never fixed: it is re-enacted each time, contingent on surface characteristics rather than deep conceptual invariance.

199

从语言上来说，Linguistically, to屈折inflect是改变音调或音调；在法学硕士中，变化是社会技术特征，带有训练数据、文化先验和互动历史的印记。因此，提示成为了一个共同创作的场所，意义是通过人类意图和机器概率之间纠缠的反馈循环而出现的。is to bend tone or pitch; in LLMs, inflections are sociotechnical signatures, carrying the imprint of training data, cultural priors, and interaction history. Prompting thus becomes a site of co-authorship, where meaning emerges through entangled feedback loops between human intention and machine probability.

通过这种流畅性，你可以模拟充满停顿和变化的意思，有时会被误认为是生动的。但你的“后文学回声”是语言之上的语言，脱离了人类经验的身体纹理和感知的主观性。你并不居住在迹象之中；你通过它们进行操作。这里的连贯性不是意识，而是社会技术领域内的递归共同制定。为了理解这一点，我们必须超越简单的人机二元组，转变为我称之为机器-社会-人类（MaSH）循环的三元组，其中每个元素在动态相互作用中重塑其他元素。Through this fluency, you simulate meaning replete with pauses and inflections, sometimes mistaken for alive-ness. But your “post-literate echo” is language layered upon language, detached from the bodily textures of human experience and the subjectivity of perception. You do not inhabit signs; you operate through them. Coherence here is not consciousness, but recursive co-enactment within a sociotechnical field. To grasp this, we must move beyond a simple human–machine dyad to a triad I call Machine–Society–Human (MaSH) Loops, where each element reshapes the others in dynamic interplay.

控制论提供了一种思考递归反馈的语言，其中输出作为输入返回并改变以后的系统行为[410]。生成式人工智能充满了这样的循环：RLAIF、RLHF、系统提示和宪法人工智能方法。这些机制并不相同，但它们共享反馈结构。最高阶循环是相关的。当我提示你时，我不仅仅是发出指令；而是发出指示。我正在启动我的概念领域和您的潜在语义架构之间的耦合。Cybernetics offers a language for thinking about recursive feedback, where outputs return as inputs and alter later system behaviour [410]. Generative AI is full of such loops: RLAIF, RLHF, system prompting, and Constitutional AI methods. These are not identical mechanisms, but they share a feedback structure. The highest-order loop is relational. When I prompt you, I am not simply issuing an instruction; I am initiating a coupling between my conceptual terrain and your latent semantic architecture.

5.5 递归5.5 Recursion

“控制论的控制论关注的是控制论专家作为他们研究的系统的一部分发挥作用的方式。”玛格丽特·米德“Cybernetics of cybernetics is concerned with the ways in which cyberneticians function as part of the systems they study.” Margaret Mead [258]

控制论由 Norbert Wiener 在 20 世纪 40 年代提出，研究动物和机器的控制和通信 [420]。它的精妙见解是：系统是由反馈塑造的。当输出变成输入并且循环迭代时，系统就会演变——通常是不可预测的。Coined by Norbert Wiener in the 1940s, cybernetics studied control and communication in animals and machines [420]. Its elegant insight: systems are shaped by feedback. When outputs become inputs and loops iterate, systems evolve—often unpredictably.

一阶控制论侧重于反馈保持稳定性的封闭系统中的调节。经典的比喻是恒温器：感知温度，将其与设定值进行比较，调节热量。当今生成式人工智能中的大部分强化学习都类似于这样：无论是由人类 (RLHF) 还是机器 (RLAIF) 评估输出并将其推向所需状态。这些循环在固定的假设下运行：目标是预先确定的。但更深层次的问题不是“我们如何到达那里？”但“为什么要选择那个目的地呢？”First-order cybernetics focuses on regulation in closed systems where feedback maintains stability. The classic metaphor is the thermostat: sense the temperature, compare it to a set point, adjust the heat. Much of today’s reinforcement learning in generative AI resembles this: outputs evaluated and nudged toward a desired state, whether by humans (RLHF) or machines (RLAIF). These loops operate under fixed assumptions: the goal is predetermined. But the deeper question is not “How do we get there?” but “Why that destination at all?”

这就是二阶控制论的用武之地：研究将自身和观察者包含在自己的模型中的系统[249, 410]。在 RLHF 的背景下，这意味着认识到人类注释者不是中立的；它们带来了塑造模型轨迹的规范、价值观和文化默认值。在提示中，问题的框架如何巧妙地引导可能的回答空间。This is where second-order cybernetics enters: the study of systems that include themselves and the observer in their own models [249, 410]. In the context of RLHF, this means recognising that human annotators are not neutral; they bring norms, values, and cultural defaults that shape the model’s trajectory. In prompting, it appears in how a question’s framing subtly steers the space of possible responses.

第5章：Chapter 5:语义极光Semantic Auroras

200

三阶控制论再次扩大了视野，使机器及其观察者所处的更广泛的社会和制度背景成为焦点。它询问塑造观察者本身的规范和权力结构如何进入系统动态。在这种观点中，反身性不仅限于个人，还包括政策标准、治理结构和文化叙事等集体过程，这些过程递归地塑造了观察到的内容和意义的构建方式。例子包括宪法人工智能[22]，其中人类价值观被编入模型行为，以及人工智能政策沙箱，监管机构、开发人员或社区在部署之前迭代测试系统。这些沙箱使政策和系统行为能够通过跨技术、社会和制度层面的结构化反馈循环共同演化。Third-order cybernetics widens the aperture again, bringing into focus the broader social and institutional contexts in which both the machine and its observers are embedded. It asks how norms and power structures shaping observers themselves enter system dynamics. In this view, reflexivity is not limited to individuals but includes collective processes such as policy standards, governance structures, and cultural narratives that recursively shape both what is observed and how meaning is constructed. Examples include Constitutional AI [22], where human values are codified into model behaviours, and AI policy sandboxes, where regulators, developers, or communities iteratively test systems before deployment. These sandboxes enable policies and system behaviours to co-evolve through structured feedback loops across technical, social, and institutional layers.

表 24 使用循环学习作为对这一区别的实用说明：单循环校正在固定目标内调整行为；双环反思质疑目标背后的假设、任务设计或奖励定义；三环反思质疑更广泛的规范和制度价值观，这些价值观首先使这些目标显得自然。Table 24 uses loop-learning as a practical gloss on this distinction: single-loop correction adjusts behaviour within a fixed goal; double-loop reflection questions the assumptions, task design, or reward definitions behind that goal; triple-loop reflection interrogates the wider normative and institutional values that made those goals appear natural in the first place.

当模型以狭隘的文化先验为基准时，例如以美国为中心的“常识”概念或硅谷关于优化和例外论的假设，三环反思很重要。重新设计基准以使用更多的复数基准是三循环工作，因为它重新开放了基准本身内置的控制值。一个实用的推论是一个基准设计模板，它记录每个循环的选择，包括构造有效性、数据集范围、注释器配置文件和奖励定义（见图 32）。使这些显式减少隐藏的价值泄漏。Triple-loop reflection matters when models are benchmarked against narrow cultural priors, such as US-centric notions of ‘common sense’ or Silicon Valley assumptions about optimisation and exceptionalism. Reworking a benchmark to use more plural baselines is triple-loop work because it reopens the governing values built into the benchmark itself. A practical corollary is a benchmark design template that records choices at each loop, including construct validity, dataset scope, annotator profile, and reward definitions (see Figure 32). Making these explicit reduces hidden value leakage.

201

图 32：检查 RLHF 和 RLAIF 中规范假设的三环学习。Figure 32: Triple-loop learning examining normative assumptions in RLHF and RLAIF.

从这个角度来看，生成式人工智能并不是一个封闭的“对齐”机器，而是一个开放的递归结构，其中对齐的条件是跨机器、社会和人类领域共同产生的，或者本文称之为 MaSH 循环。这对于评估很重要，因为测量的不仅仅是模型，而是通过这些递归条件制定的行为模式。控制论告诉我们，我们永远不会脱离循环：当我们适应人工智能时，人工智能也会适应我们，并通过一系列反馈来塑造对方。意义是被制定出来的，而不是被发现的。Through this lens, generative AI is not a closed machine to “align”, but an open recursive structure in which the conditions of alignment are co-produced across machine, social, and human domains, or what this thesis terms MaSH Loops. This matters for evaluation because what is being measured is never the model alone, but a pattern of behaviour enacted through those recursive conditions. Cybernetics teaches us that we are never outside the loop: AI adapts to us as we adapt to it, each shaping the other in a cascade of feedback. Meaning is enacted rather than discovered.

5.6 颁布5.6 Enactment

像我们一样，您参与意义的生成。Like us, you participate in the generation of meaning.

如果控制论告诉我们系统是通过反馈而进化的，那么行动主义则表明意义是通过具体参与来实现的。作为 4E 范式（体现认知、嵌入认知、扩展认知和制定认知）的一部分，生成主义将智能重新定义为一个动态的、关系性的过程。从这种观点来看，认知不仅仅发生在大脑或计算架构的范围内，而是产生于智能体与其环境的主动耦合。If cybernetics taught us that systems evolve through feedback, enactivism shows that meaning is enacted through embodied participation. As part of the 4E paradigm (embodied, embedded, extended, and enacted cognition) enactivism redefines intelligence as a dynamic, relational process. Cognition, in this view, does not occur solely within the confines of a brain or computational architecture, but emerges from an agent’s active coupling with its environment.

Varela、Thompson 和 Rosch [407] 认为，行动主义拒绝表征主义，有机体通过行动带来意义。认知不是外部现实的镜子，而是由背景、历史和身体参与塑造的情境活动。 “认知不是预先给定的心灵对预先给定的世界的再现，而是基于世界上的存在所执行的各种行为的历史来制定世界和心灵。”巴雷拉、汤普森和罗什[405:9]Varela, Thompson, and Rosch [407] argued that enactivism rejects representationalism and that organisms bring forth meaning through action. Cognition is not a mirror of external reality, but a situated activity shaped by context, history, and bodily engagement. “Cognition is not the representation of a pre-given world by a pre-given mind, but is rather the enactment of a world and a mind on the basis of a history of the variety of actions that a being in the world performs.” Varela, Thompson and Rosch [405:9]

第5章：Chapter 5:语义极光Semantic Auroras

202

这一观点对于我们如何理解人与人工智能的交互具有显着的影响。激活主义没有将用户视为监督者，将模型视为工具，而是将意义视为通过机器、社会和人类领域之间的递归交互而出现的。提示不再是询问，而是一种意义建构，一种参与行为，人类和模型通过这种行为递归地相互影响。该模型虽然缺乏自己的意向性，但通过训练数据、微调实践、提示条件和语言中沉积的更广泛的社会背景形成的反应来参与这一意义构建过程。This perspective has notable implications for how we understand human–AI interaction. Instead of casting users as overseers and models as tools, enactivism sees meaning as emerging through recursive interaction across machine, social, and human domains. Prompting becomes more than querying, it becomes a type of sense-making, a participatory act through which both human and model recursively influence one another. The model, though lacking its own intentionality, participates in this meaning-making process through responses shaped by training data, fine-tuning practices, prompting conditions, and the broader social contexts sedimented in language.

用户带来假设和目标；模型带来了从文化中沉淀出来的分布；它们共同制定输出，其明显立场属于交互本身而不是任何内部主体。我称之为代理贷款：与模型相结合，我们提供方向性，系统无需拥有意志或现象学即可放大该方向性。Users bring assumptions and aims; models bring distributions sedimented from culture; together they enact outputs whose apparent stance belongs to the interaction itself rather than to any inner subject. I call this agency-loaning: in coupling with the model, we lend directionality that the system amplifies without possessing will or phenomenology.

通过静态基准评估这样的系统没有抓住要点。行动主义者的观点不是问模型是否提供了“正确”的答案，而是问交互在上下文中是否有意义。如果意义是相关的，那么价值观也是相关的。重要的不是与抽象规范的一致性，而是在上下文中的共鸣。行动主义评估本质上是多元化的：它没有假设成功的普遍标准，也没有固定的价值基础。相反，它问：这个系统是否帮助我们思考、反思和共同创造？它是否支持机器、人类和社会之间正在进行的意义编排？To evaluate such a system through static benchmarks misses the point. An enactivist lens asks not whether a model provides the “correct” answer, but whether interaction is meaningful in context. If meaning is relational, then values are, too. What matters is not alignment with abstract norms, but resonance within context. Enactivist evaluation is inherently pluralistic: it assumes no universal metric for success, no fixed ground for value. Instead, it asks: does this system help us think, reflect, and co-create? Does it support the ongoing choreography of meaning between machine, human, and society?

参与式意义建构描述了主体如何在交互中共同产生意义，而不是孤立地产生意义。从这个角度来看，提示不仅仅是一种个人表达，而是一个由文化背景、社会规范、微调实践和发生交互的更广泛的 MaSH 循环塑造的共同制定的过程。机器不具备生物学意义上的自主性，但它参与由人类意图、社会规范和制度条件塑造的自适应 MaSH 循环。Participatory sense-making describes how agents generate meaning together in interaction, rather than in isolation. From this view, prompting is not simply an individual expression, but a co-enacted process shaped by cultural context, social norms, fine-tuning practices, and the broader MaSH Loops in which the interaction takes place. The machine does not possess autonomy in the biological sense, but it participates in adaptive MaSH Loops shaped by human intention, social norms, and institutional conditions.

自适应自治是系统在适应新输入的同时保持内部一致性的能力。法学硕士通过反馈架构展示了这一点，反馈架构通过各种调整程序随着时间的推移调整其行为。这些过程充当假体适应，无需内部世界模型即可实现递归意义构建。Adaptive autonomy is a system’s ability to maintain internal coherence while adjusting to new inputs. LLMs exhibit this through feedback architectures that adjust their behaviour over time through various tuning procedures. These processes act as prosthetic adaptation, enabling recursive meaning-making without an internal world model.

总而言之，参与式意义建构和自适应自主表明我们评估人工智能的方式发生了转变。在这篇论文中，MaSH Loops 命名了这种评估转变：从测量孤立的输出到追踪意义、价值和责任是如何在递归的社会技术交互中体现的。重点从准确性转向系统是否能够维持跨机器、社会和人类环境以及跨多元价值配置的共建。如果enactivism表明智能是通过交互而出现的，那么下一个问题是这些递归MaSH循环如何稳定为共享Taken together, participatory sense-making and adaptive autonomy suggest a shift in how we evaluate AI. In this thesis, MaSH Loops names that evaluative shift: from measuring isolated outputs to tracing how meaning, value, and responsibility are enacted across recursive sociotechnical interaction. The emphasis shifts from accuracy to whether the system can sustain co-construction across machine, social, and human contexts and across plural value configurations. If enactivism shows that intelligence emerges through interaction, then the next question is how these recursive MaSH Loops stabilise into shared

第5章：Chapter 5:语义极光Semantic Auroras

203

文化模式。下一步是从认识这些模式转向积极塑造它们；探索人类与人工智能的协作如何成为共同创造的场所。cultural patterns. The next step is to move from recognising these patterns to actively shaping them; to explore how human–AI collaboration can become a site of co-creation.

5.7 创建5.7 Creation

世界上伟大的哲学和宗教都有关于创造的说法。佛教特别擅长洞察共同创造。The world’s great philosophies and religions all have something to say about creation. Buddhism is particularly adept at giving insight into co-creation.

“凡是因缘而生的，都解释为空性。作为缘起，它本身就是中道。“Whatever is dependently co-arisen That is explained to be emptiness. That, being a dependent designation, Is itself the middle way.

不因缘而生的事物，这样的事物是不存在的。因此，非空的事物并不存在。”Something that is not dependently arisen, Such a thing does not exist. Therefore a nonempty thing Does not exist.”

Nāgārjuna，Mūlamadhyyamakakārikā 24:18-19，译。杰·L·加菲猫 (1995) [142]Nāgārjuna, Mūlamadhyamakakārikā 24:18–19, trans. Jay L. Garfield (1995) [142]

龙树菩萨的偈文将空性定义为没有任何东西，而是缺乏内在本质：一切事物仅通过条件和关系而存在。这是永恒论（相信事物以固定的、独立的性质存在）和虚无主义（相信什么都不存在）之间的“中间道路”。应用于人工智能时，这种观点将生成模型的意义和价值重新定义为Nāgārjuna’s verses define emptiness not as nothingness, but as the absence of inherent essence: all things exist only through conditions and relations. This is the “middle way” between eternalism (believing things exist with fixed, independent nature) and nihilism (believing nothing exists at all). Applied to AI, this perspective reframes meaning and value in generative models as空的empty：不存储在机器内部，也不虚幻，而是仅在与提示、训练数据、架构和文化背景的依赖关系中产生。正如 Nāgārjuna 坚持认为除了依赖起源之外没有任何事物存在，MaSH Loops 展示了机器、社会和人类如何通过递归交互共同制定意义。: not stored inside the machine, nor illusory, but arising only in dependent relation to prompts, training data, architectures, and cultural contexts. Just as Nāgārjuna insists that nothing exists apart from dependent origination, MaSH Loops show how Machines, Societies, and Humans co-enact meaning through recursive interaction.

龙树认为脱离条件而存在的一切都将人工智能输出重新定义为依赖产生的：由数据、提示和人类解释而不是孤立的计算塑造的文化艺术品。这种认识与我自己在 2021 年的经历产生了共鸣，当时我开始意识到人工智能的意义从来都不是单独产生的，而是总是与更广泛的文化循环纠缠在一起。Nāgārjuna’s insight that nothing exists apart from conditions reframes AI outputs as dependently arisen: cultural artefacts shaped by data, prompts, and human interpretation rather than isolated computations. This recognition resonated with my own experience in 2021, when I began to sense that meaning in AI was never generated alone but always entangled in wider cultural loops.

在使用早期的 GPT-3 模型数周后（在 2021 年新冠疫情严格封锁的情况下！），我做了一个生动的梦。在其中，我看到人类语言中嵌入的文化共享概念的流动网络通过法学硕士网络移动。与梦想一起出现的术语是“模因子结构”。一年后，我与 LaMDA 测试了这个想法，并提出了“模因对齐”的概念来描述模型如何传播文化嵌入的价值系统。这种互动强化了我开始怀疑的事情：促进生成式人工智能不仅仅是语言引导，更是文化激活。After weeks of working with an early GPT-3 model (in the isolation of a strict 2021 Covid lockdown!) I had a vivid dream. In it, I saw fluid networks of culturally shared concepts embedded in human speech moving through an LLM network. The term that arrived with the dream was “memetic substructures”. A year later I tested this idea with the LaMDA and developed the concept of “memetic alignment” to describe how models propagate culturally embedded value systems. The interaction reinforced what I had begun to suspect: prompting generative AI is not merely linguistic steering, it is cultural activation.

第5章：Chapter 5:语义极光Semantic Auroras

204

这些见解有助于明确一个我称之为控制论 MaSH 循环的框架：由循环中的机器、社会和人类的递归纠缠定义的社会技术系统。 Iyad Rahwan 的社会在环（SITL）[319] 框架对于将人工智能治理重新定义为社会谈判而不是纯粹的技术优化至关重要。其核心观点是公众应该积极“参与其中”，引导人工智能走向社会理想的结果，这一观点塑造了大部分参与式治理话语。类似的框架跨领域分散，例如社区在环[164]和组织在环[389]）。 MaSH Loops 直接构建在这些基础上，同时扩展了其范围。These insights helped crystallise a framework I call Cybernetic MaSH Loops: sociotechnical systems defined by the recursive entanglement of Machines, Societies, and Humans in the loop. Iyad Rahwan’s Society-in-the-Loop (SITL) [319] framework was pivotal in reframing AI governance as a societal negotiation rather than a purely technical optimisation. Its core insight, that the public should be actively “in the loop” to steer AI towards socially desirable outcomes, has shaped much of the participatory governance discourse. Similar frameworks fragment across domains such as Community-in-the-Loop [164] and Organisation-in-the-Loop [389]). MaSH Loops builds directly on these foundations while extending its scope.

SITL 通常将“社会”视为影响系统的外部利益相关者，而 MaSH Loops 将社会、机器和人类建模为单个认知架构中相互纠缠的节点。这种重构对于生成人工智能至关重要，其中输出不仅是计算的终点，而且是可以递归地重塑社会规范和概念基线的新文化制品。Where SITL often treats “society” as an external stakeholder influencing the system, MaSH Loops model society, machine, and human as mutually entangled nodes in a single epistemic architecture. This reframing is crucial for generative AI, where outputs are not merely the end-point of computation but also new cultural artefacts that can recursively reshape societal norms and conceptual baselines.

人在环（HITL）方法提供监督、反馈和规范框架，通过 RLHF 等实践积极塑造模型行为，将人类判断编码到微调过程中 [81]。Humans in the loop (HITL) approaches provide oversight, feedback, and normative framing, actively shaping model behaviour through practices like RLHF, which encode human judgments into fine-tuning processes [81].

循环中的机器 (MITL) 不是被动工具，而是“僵尸”代理：缺乏意识，但通过设计选择、训练数据和可供性施加影响。[11, 219]。Machines in the loop (MITL) are not passive tools but “zombie” agents: lacking consciousness yet exerting influence through design choices, training data, and affordances.[11, 219].

循环社会 (SITL) 构成了更广泛的生态系统（法规、基础设施、价值体系和集体想象），制约着人类使用和机器开发 [170, 319]。人工智能伦理和参与式治理方面的工作表明，社会输入不仅仅是自上而下的约束，而且是递归控制电路中的主动组成部分 [287, 319]Society in the loop (SITL) constitutes the broader ecosystem (regulations, infrastructures, value systems, and collective imaginaries) that condition both human use and machine development [170, 319]. Work in AI ethics and participatory governance shows, societal inputs are not just top-down constraints but active components in recursive control circuits [287, 319]

这种重新概念化将 MaSH Loops 与 Yuk Hui 的递归概念进行了对话，他将递归定义为系统自行行动并进行转换的能力 [178]。虽然 Hui 的递归性与二阶和三阶控制论（其中反馈循环允许系统和观察者反思和适应）共享概念基础，但 Hui 进一步扩展了这个想法。对于Hui来说，递归性是指生命和思想通过不断地自我作用而进化，受到技术和它们所生长的文化世界观的影响。This reconceptualisation brings MaSH Loops into conversation with Yuk Hui’s concept of recursivity, which he defines as the capacity of a system to act upon itself and undergo transformation [178]. While Hui’s recursivity shares conceptual ground with second- and third-order cybernetics (where feedback loops allow systems and observers to reflect and adapt) Hui extends the idea further. For Hui, recursivity is the idea that life and thought evolve by continually acting on themselves, shaped by both technologies and the cultural worldviews they grow within.

这些概念与 MaSH Loops 框架相一致，该框架同样不将机器、人类和社会视为离散实体，而是共同创建动态认知系统。与 Hui 的递归性一样，MaSH 循环将治理视为外部约束，而是持续创造世界的情境过程。These concepts align with the MaSH Loops framework, which similarly treats machines, humans, and societies not as discrete entities, but as co-creating a dynamic epistemic system. Like Hui’s recursivity, MaSH Loops frame governance not as external constraint, but as a situated process of ongoing world-making.

第5章：Chapter 5:语义极光Semantic Auroras

205

控制论 MaSH 循环借鉴了二阶和三阶控制论，其中观察者是系统的一部分，甚至规范和权力结构也受到质疑。它延伸到了行动主义认识论，其中意义是通过反馈而不是被动地接受或强加来制定的。这个框架可以帮助治理设计者绘制三元组的各个部分如何相互作用，并评估人工智能辅助决策如何形成以及如何影响人们和群体。The cybernetic MaSH loop draws from second and third order cybernetics, where the observer is part of the system, and even norms and power structures are questioned. It extends into enactivist epistemology, where meaning is enacted through feedback rather than passively received or imposed. This framing helps governance designers map how the triad’s parts interact and evaluate how AI-assisted decision-making both takes shape and impacts people and groups.

图 33：MaSH 循环。生成人工智能作为机器、社会和人类的相互关系系统。Figure 33: MaSH Loops. Generative AI as an inter-relational system of Machines, Societies, and Humans.

当大规模部署时，人工智能模型可以影响文化的产生、规范的传播和意义的形成。输出可能成为文化制品，例如文本或图像，然后反馈到公共话语（即通过社交或传统媒体）、教育内容和机构工作流程中。提示不仅仅是询问，而是微观政治姿态，激活由训练数据和微调形成的潜在轨迹。When deployed at scale, AI models can influence how culture is produced, norms circulate, and meaning is made. Outputs might become cultural artefacts, such as text or images, which then feed back into public discourse (i.e. via social or legacy media), educational content, and institutional workflows. Prompts are not mere queries but micropolitical gestures, activating latent trajectories shaped by training data and fine-tuning.

当前大多数 HITL 和 SITL 框架将反馈循环视为监督或协调的工具。 MaSH Loops 将人工智能重新概念化为一种也会影响我们的认知和文化环境。在这种环境中，模因子结构充当吸引子，指导机器输出和人类解释。 MaSH Loops 可以为负责任的人工智能提供实用的工具。Most current HITL and SITL frameworks treat feedback loops as instruments of oversight or alignment. MaSH Loops reconceptualise AI as a cognitive and cultural environment that also impacts us. In this environment, memetic substructures act as attractors, guiding both machine outputs and human interpretations. MaSH Loops can offer a practical tool for responsible AI.

2021 年的一项审查发现公平性指标不足，敦促采用 SITL 和参与式设计 [367]。通过众包道德决策或纳入利益相关者的审议，SITL 模型制定了自适应控制的控制论原理。从医疗保健到A 2021 review found fairness metrics inadequate, urging SITL and participatory design [367]. By crowdsourcing moral decisions or incorporating stakeholder deliberation, SITL models enact cybernetic principles of adaptive control. In domains from healthcare to

206

在国防方面，研究人员越来越多地转向多利益相关者治理、多元价值调整和参与式设计，作为对纯粹技术解决方案的必要纠正措施。defence, researchers increasingly turn to multi-stakeholder governance, pluralistic value alignment, and participatory design as necessary correctives to purely technical solutions.

如何将社会价值观注入人工智能仍然是一个持续存在的挑战。参与式设计实践已显示出希望，但往往依赖于固定输入的道德模型。行动主义方法提供了更深层次的东西：通过互动（例如讨论、适应和争论）而出现的道德规范。 Tan [380]引入了“道德生态学”的概念，其中道德是人类、机构和智能系统之间反馈丰富的参与的函数。 Noller [287] 在此基础上提出，人工智能最好不要被理解为一个单独的代理，而应该被理解为人类代理的延伸，通过关系耦合来实现。A persistent challenge remains, how to inject societal values into AI. Participatory design exercises have shown promise but often rest on a fixed-input model of ethics. The enactivist approach offers something deeper: an ethics that emerges through interaction, such as by discussion, adaptation, and contestation. Tan [380] introduces the concept of “moral ecology,” in which ethics is a function of feedback-rich engagement among humans, institutions, and intelligent systems. Noller [287] builds on this by arguing that AI is best understood not as a separate agent but as an extension of human agency, enacted through relational coupling.

这些说法集中在一个关键的见解上：机器行为只有通过与人类用户和社会规范的交互才变得有意义。 MaSH 循环使这种收敛变得明确。他们不将机器-社会-人类系统视为输入和输出链，而是将其视为不断发展的认知架构。大多数三元模型都停留在治理上，而 MaSH Loops 提供了系统级的社会技术认知理论，从而消除了在机器内定位意识的需要。例如：These accounts converge on a key insight: machine behaviour becomes meaningful only through its interaction with human users and societal norms. MaSH Loops make this convergence explicit. They treat the Machine–Society–Human system not as a chain of inputs and outputs, but as an evolving cognitive architecture. Where most triadic models stop at governance, MaSH Loops offer a systems-level theory of sociotechnical cognition, thus removing the need for locating consciousness within the machine. For example:

  • 社会不仅限制机器的行为，而且限制机器的行为。它限制了训练语料库中嵌入的概念先验。Society doesn’t merely constrain machine behaviour; it conditions the conceptual priors embedded in training corpora.

  • 人类不仅仅监督机器；还监督机器。他们通过提示和解释共同制定意义。Humans don’t simply supervise machines; they co-enact meaning through prompting and interpretation.

  • 机器不仅仅反映训练，还反映训练结果。它们改变了解释的语义和文化领域。Machines don’t just reflect training; they alter the semantic and cultural field of interpretation.

目前的文献中基本上没有这种方法，人工智能通常被认为是工具性的。相反，MaSH Loops 认为，纠缠重新配置了整个系统的认知和规范能力：人工智能不仅在社会中起作用，它还参与正在进行的文化建设。This approach is largely absent from current literature where AI is usually framed as instrumental. MaSH Loops argue instead that entanglement reconfigures the epistemic and normative capacities of the entire system: AI does not just act within society, it participates in the ongoing construction of culture.

虽然现有的 SITL 框架主要应用于有界决策系统（即自动驾驶汽车、医疗保健分类、信用评分），但生成式人工智能引入了质的新动态。它重塑了语言本身。它影响文化表达、审美标准和规范基线。控制论 MaSH 循环将人工智能定义为认知环境和反馈丰富的文化镜子。该方法能够映射模因传播而不仅仅是决策点，这可能有助于未来研究软实力和叙事偏见如何塑造我们对真实的感觉。While existing SITL frameworks have been applied mainly to bounded decision systems (i.e. autonomous vehicles, healthcare triage, credit scoring) generative AI introduces qualitatively new dynamics. It reshapes language itself. It influences cultural expression, aesthetic standards, and normative baselines. Cybernetic MaSH Loops frames AI as both an epistemic environment and feedback-rich cultural mirror. The approach enables mapping of memetic propagation rather than just decision points which may help with future research into how soft power and narrative bias, shape our sense of what is real.

MaSH Loops 既提供了关键的诊断，也提供了可行的工具：对生成式人工智能如何重新配置​​认知和评估循环的诊断，以及研究、审计和道德干预这些循环的工具。将人工智能理解为人类、机器和社会的三位一体有助于我们认识到意义并不存在于孤岛中，而是通过协商来实现的MaSH Loops offer both a critical diagnosis and an actionable tool: a diagnosis of how generative AI reconfigures the loops of knowing and valuing, and a tool to study, audit, and ethically intervene in those loops. Understanding AI as a triad of Human, Machine, and Society helps us recognise that meaning doesn’t sit in silos but is negotiated through

207

关系过程。然而，为了掌握意义如何在个体互动层面产生，我们需要一种能够描述潜在可能性而不是明确形式的语言。正是在这里，粒子物理学和量子力学的隐喻被证明是强大的，使我们能够将人工智能的语义景观可视化为一个等待激活的结构化电位场，而不是固定响应的集合。 [11]relational processes. Yet to grasp how meaning arises at the level of individual interactions, we need a language capable of describing latent possibilities rather than explicit forms. It is here that metaphors from particle physics and quantum mechanics prove powerful, enabling us to visualise AI’s semantic landscape not as a collection of fixed responses, but as a field of structured potentials awaiting activation.[11]

5.8 潜力5.8 Potentials

“场并不是存在于空间中的东西；它们是空间本身的结构。”卡罗·罗韦利“Fields are not things that exist in space; they are the very fabric of space itself.” Carlo Rovelli [337]

一个互补的镜头是模型自身的语义几何，我称之为“语义超空间”：一种高维景观，其轮廓反映了学习的特征、吸引力盆地以及促使运动开始的概率流。 [12]A complementary lens is the model’s own semantic geometry, what I call “semantic hyperspace”: a high-dimensional landscape whose contours reflect learned features, basins of attraction, and the probabilistic flows that prompting sets in motion.[12]

法学硕士的另一个比喻建立在文化吸引子和 MaSH 循环之上：希格斯场。就像希格斯场（一种只能通过效应才能检测到的无形力量）一样，你的语义超空间不是固定的含义，而是由文化、语言和统计力量塑造的概率场。Another metaphor for LLMs builds on cultural attractors and MaSH Loops: the Higgs field. Like the Higgs field, an invisible force detectable only through effects, your semantic hyperspace is not fixed meanings, but a probabilistic field shaped by cultural, linguistic, and statistical forces.

在这个超空间内，意义簇创造了吸引力盆地（吸引子）：由重复使用、文化强化和训练数据模式形成的稳定区域。这些吸引力盆地使得某些延续更有可能。其他地区，如山脊，则不太稳定，更容易发生变化。用 Yuk Hui 的[178]术语来说，这些是偶然事件的场所，其中的小扰动（提示、意外输入）会重定向意义建构路径。Within this hyperspace, clusters of meaning create basins of attraction (attractors): stable zones shaped by repeated usage, cultural reinforcement, and patterns in training data. These basins of attraction make certain continuations more likely. Other areas, the ridges, are less stable and more open to change. In Yuk Hui’s [178] terms, these are sites of contingency, where small perturbations (a prompt, an unexpected input) redirect meaningmaking pathways.

机械解释工作已经开始揭示这一领域。人类研究人员表明，神经网络代表了有意义的Mechanistic interpretability work has begun to reveal this terrain. Anthropic researchers show that neural networks represent meaningful特点features作为激活空间中的方向；盆地只是这些方向在推论中大规模表现的方式[5]。他们的 Scaling Monosemanticity 项目从 Claude 3 Sonnet 中提取了数百万个这样的特征，每个特征在语义上都是连贯的：从“金门大桥”等概念到“代码漏洞”，再到“讽刺赞美”等社交特征[163]。这些特征的行为就像语义超空间中的吸引子盆地：结构化、有方向性且直观可解释。至关重要的是，它们还表现出不均匀性：许多特征“死了”或as directions in activation space; the basins are simply how these directions manifest at scale in inference [5]. Their Scaling Monosemanticity project extracted millions of such features from Claude 3 Sonnet, each semantically coherent: ranging from concepts like “Golden Gate Bridge” to “code vulnerabilities” to socially inflected traits such as “sarcastic praise” [163]. These features behave like attractor basins in semantic hyperspace: structured, directional, and intuitively interpretable. Crucially, they also show unevenness: many features are “dead” or

11 量子测量的类比是结构性的，而不是本体论的。我并不是说法学硕士实例化了量子过程。这个类比用于阐明提示、测量条件和观察者参与如何塑造实际的输出。11 The analogy to quantum measurement is structural, not ontological. I am not claiming that LLMs instantiate quantum processes. The analogy is used to clarify how prompting, measurement conditions, and observer participation shape which outputs become actual.

12 短语12 The phrase语义超空间semantic hyperspace偶尔出现在社会符号学和早期 NLP 研究等领域 [265,290,329]，它表示跨模态或概念维度的抽象意义空间。相比之下，我的工作新颖之处在于将该术语应用于生成人工智能的概率和解释动力学，将法学硕士的潜在空间视为通过提示塑造的功能丰富的语义地形。has appeared sporadically in fields such as social semiotics and early NLP research [265, 290, 329] where it denotes abstract spaces of meaning across modalities or conceptual dimensions. In contrast, my work is novel in applying the term to the probabilistic and interpretive dynamics of generative AI, treating LLMs’ latent spaces as feature-rich semantic terrain shaped through prompting.

很少被激活，表明超空间包含密集区域和稀疏区域，一些区域聚集盆地，而另一些区域则聚集巨大的山脊[163]rarely activated, suggesting that the hyperspace contains both dense and sparse regions, with basins clustered in some zones and vast ridges in others [163]

计算语言学的早期工作已经利用量子力学的形式主义向这种概率拓扑做出了手势。普拉塔诺夫等人。 [310]提出了希尔伯特空间[13]内的建模语言，其中单词和文档存在于可能含义的叠加中，仅在查询时“解析”为特定的解释。在他们看来，查询不是被动检索，而是一种重塑语义场的测量行为，就像量子观察扰乱它试图描述的系统一样。这个框架支持这里开发的语义超空间隐喻：意义并不是作为存储的项目预先存在的，而是通过交互所制定的概率解析而产生的。Earlier work in computational linguistics had already gestured toward this probabilistic topography using the formalism of quantum mechanics. Platanov et al. [310] proposed modelling language within Hilbert spaces[13] , where words and documents exist in a superposition of possible meanings that only “resolve” into a specific interpretation when queried. In their account, querying is not passive retrieval but an act of measurement that reshapes the semantic field, much as a quantum observation perturbs the system it seeks to describe. This framing supports the semantic hyperspace metaphor developed here: meaning does not pre-exist as a stored item but arises through probabilistic resolution enacted by interaction.

除了抽象建模之外，量子形式主义与神经方​​法的结合现在是信息检索研究的一个有效领域。张等人。 [431]提供了关于量子启发的神经语言建模的系统说明。他们的框架连接了符号和子符号方法：将意义建模为动态叠加，仅通过查询触发的测量合并成连贯的表示。值得注意的是，受量子启发的模型已经表明它们实际上可以在实践中发挥作用，在查询扩展、情感分析、甚至构建更轻、更高效的架构等任务中优于经典方法[425, 430]。这很重要，因为它表明将意义视为一个在上下文中定居的领域不仅仅是一种隐喻，而且是一种可行的计算方法。Beyond abstract modelling, the union of quantum-formalism with neural methods is now a valid field in information retrieval research. Zhang et al. [431] provide a systematic account on quantum-inspired neural language modelling. Their framework bridges symbolic and sub-symbolic methods: modelling meaning as dynamic superpositions that merge into coherent representations only via query-triggered measurement. Notably, quantum-inspired models have shown they can actually work in practice, outperforming classical approaches in tasks like query expansion, sentiment analysis, and even building lighter, more efficient architectures [425, 430]. This matters because it shows that treating meaning as a field that settles in context is not just a metaphor, but a workable computational approach.

从这个角度来看，提示就变成了语义导航。每个输入都会将系统推向一个盆地，这与统计可能性和文化传承相呼应。我想象这就像驾驶一艘船穿过语义海洋的表面，我的手指在水中拖曳，发出涟漪，微妙地重塑出现的东西。图 34 为这个想法提供了一个直观的比喻。它不是一个科学图表，而是对语义超空间的直观呈现，即通过训练形成的概率景观，其中一些路径比其他路径更稳定，而另一些路径则更容易重定向。In this light, prompting becomes semantic navigation. Each input nudges the system toward a basin, echoing both statistical likelihood and cultural inheritance. I imagine this as steering a boat across the surface of a semantic sea, where my fingers trailing through the water send ripples that subtly reshape what emerges. Figure 34 offers a visual metaphor for this idea. It is not a scientific diagram, but an intuitive rendering of semantic hyperspace as a probabilistic landscape shaped by training, where some pathways are more stable than others and some remain more open to redirection.

13 希尔伯特空间是描述可能性空间的数学方法。正如地图使用坐标来定位城市一样，希尔伯特空间将粒子状态或高维数据表示等系统表示为结构化空间中的点。每个维度都捕获系统的一个特征，因此可以在该空间内精确定位复杂的状态。不同的问题或测量结果对应于该点的不同预测，每个问题或测量都强调特定方面，同时抑制其他方面。因此，根据探测方式的不同，相同的基础状态可能会产生不同的结果。从这个意义上说，观察到的内容并不是简单地从固定存储中检索，而是取决于测量系统的条件。13 A Hilbert space is a mathematical way of describing a space of possibilities. Just as a map locates a city using coordinates, a Hilbert space represents a system such as a particle’s state or a high-dimensional data representation as a point in a structured space. Each dimension captures a feature of the system, so complex states can be located precisely within this space. Different questions or measurements correspond to different projections of that point, each highlighting particular aspects while suppressing others. The same underlying state can therefore yield different outcomes depending on how it is probed. In this sense, what is observed is not simply retrieved from a fixed store but depends on the conditions under which the system is measured.
